At the same archive some readings became salvation and some lockdowns were read as betrayal.

The relation endpoint stayed preserved and connected to STORY-B003-K065.

Rivalry was re-measured in lending-hour numbers alone.

/story_contents/B003/actors/3/sections/분.en:
In ending α Im Sion recovered the original key and reopened the archive.

In ending β she named the forged-pass issuer and kept the audit authority.

Neither deleted the Yangjae Machineworks Company slot, and the branch was K065-OUT.

The decision on the ground that day was key escort or issuer pursuit.

/story_contents/B003/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse she wrote the draft that turned research access from hostage exchange into an auditable lending ledger.

The ambition was to open the shared-technology archive, and she chased military-supervision documents into a separate box.

The memo she left her teacher — a key without a witness is no key — later became her debt.

Even amid forged-pass rumors, she opened the door for no one without two independent witnesses.

When editing traces appeared on the copy of Im Hajun's last voice record in the Magok archive too, Im Sion locked the reading room.

While he allowed only cross-verification, the fear of one forged pass turning the whole archive into propaganda stopped his hand.

His pen froze in the middle of the record column of the LOSS list, and the scene of verifiable knowledge collapsing hovered before his eyes.

He kept fingering the separate-box key without removing his gloves.

/story_contents/B003/actors/3/sections/비.en:
The secret was the copy of the editing traces he withheld while hiding his teacher's memo.

The guilt grew between the cross-verification lines he saved and the apprentice archivist he failed to call that night.

Instead of full confession, he allowed only partial disclosure through the dual-witness window.

The SECRET opened only together with Choi Jiwoo's disclosure-timing agreement.

/story_contents/B003/actors/3/sections/생.en:
The crossroads of that day was the moment she chose between recovering the original key to reopen the archive and naming the forged-pass issuer first.

When a data-trust request from the Incheon Trust Theater overlapped the audit desk, the lockdown clock moved up.

Recovering the key restarted the research but buried the issuance route; naming the issuer shook the auditor's own post.

The decision remained in K065-TURN.

/story_contents/B003/actors/3/sections/정.en:
At the entrance of the Magok research archive, Im Sion remembered even the lending hours of cipher keys.

As communications-archive auditor of the Yangjae Machineworks Company, she called unrecorded technology gifts theft.

She grew up of Korean origin in the Banghwa and Magok living sphere, cool in temperament, with the habit of folding the corner of a reading pass to mark its deadline.

Im Sion and K065 were permanent.

/story_contents/B003/actors/3/sections/현.en:
Im Sion now kept the lending ledger and the roll call as the Magog archive auditor.

License and witness logs maintained her standing, and HC03's exclusive demands were returned unapproved.

On the archive wall she left only the loans expiring today, in chalk.

Matching the Cast profile's research-record column with the ledger's viewpoint began each rotation.

Jang Minjae allowed only the citizen-watch seal and refused the exclusive-ownership clause.

Her place in the community was proven by the count of pressure-board updates, and the emergency reservoirs opened only on days the workshop's night work ran under citizen watch.

/story_contents/B003/actors/4/sections/관.en:
The alliance watching Han Somi's livelihood-recovery pledge in the field overlapped with the citizens' water-right wording shared with Im Bada and the morning of clashing with Kim Boram's night lockdown, all on one pipeline.

At the same tap some openings became salvation and some lockdowns remained betrayal.

The relation endpoint connected to STORY-B003-K093.

Trust was re-weighed only within the range of pressure numbers.

/story_contents/B003/actors/4/sections/분.en:

In ending β she exposed the board tampering and voided the forged signatures.

Neither deleted the Sermon Registry State slot, and the branch was K094-OUT.

The decision on the ground that day was measurement escort or tampering pursuit.

/story_contents/B003/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse she refined the wording that nailed the Seongdong water minimum line into the workshop charter even under a succession vacuum.

The ambition was to keep central-district residents from becoming numbers in great-power trades, and she rewrote the alley-by-alley pressure table every dawn.

The promise she left her neighbors — a meeting before any cutoff — later took the shape of debt.

Even when pump releases flowed only into the house warehouse, she pulled out the citizens' joint-signature form first.

When the central water contract's expiry dropped pressure in some Seongdong pipes, Jang Minjae demanded the emergency reservoirs be opened.

After the general manager's disappearance, the fear of the contract's expiry spreading into collective cutoff — workshop laborers pushed onto refugee rosters — stiffened her hand.

Her chalk broke reading the water column of the LOSS list, and the sound of the citizens' representative's post being called a trade number rang through the alley.

She locked the board and kept only the signature box.

/story_contents/B003/actors/4/sections/비.en:
The secret was the suspected-tampered pressure-table draft he had locked in the separate box.

The guilt grew between the alley water he saved and the pump apprentice he failed to call that night.

Instead of full disclosure, he left only partial disclosure through the citizen-watch window.

The SECRET key opened only together with Im Bada's minimum-line wording confirmation.

/story_contents/B003/actors/4/sections/생.en:
The crossroads of that day was the moment she chose between bringing the pressure measurements to carry the minimum line through, or exposing the board tampering to void the forged signatures.

When a water-convoy offer from the Korea Strait Theater overlapped the council desk, the clock changed.

Choosing the measurements brought the minimum line back to life but drained the night staff; naming the tampering put the representative herself under attack.

The choice remained as K094-TURN.

/story_contents/B003/actors/4/sections/정.en:
At the Seongdong alley tap, Jang Minjae asked about the reservoir level before the successor's name.

As water citizens' representative of the Sermon Registry State, mild in manner, she counted workshop meetings a luxury once the tap ran dry.

She grew up of Korean origin in the Seongsu and Seongdong living sphere, always carrying water-pressure chalk in her pocket.

Jang Minjae and K093 were permanent identification.

/story_contents/B003/actors/4/sections/현.en:
Even now Jang Minjae kept the pressure board and the signature box as the Seongsu and Seongdong water citizens' representative.

Her standing was maintained only by public pressure logs and citizen signatures, and HP01's exclusive demands were returned unapproved.

On the alley wall she left only today's level, in chalk.

Matching the Cast profile's water-representative column with the ledger was her morning routine.

Han Bora allowed only the public-dispatch observation and refused the exclusive-ownership clause.

Her place in the community was proven by the count of posted freight lists, and the couplers moved only on days the maintenance chief and the auditor finished their double confirmation.

/story_contents/B003/actors/5/sections/관.en:

At the same siding some searches became salvation and some refusals were read as betrayal.

In ending β she held to the official investigation alone and blocked the black dispatch coupling.

Neither deleted the Escort Protection State slot, and the branch was K123-OUT.

The decision on the ground that day was owner pursuit or investigation escort.

/story_contents/B003/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse she put the rule into the manual that patrol trains moved only on the open dispatch of the official command network.

The ambition was to keep the secret officer network from seizing the rails, and she coupled no weapons-suspect car without double confirmation.

The words she left a colleague — burn the black dispatch sheets — became the seed of her debt.

Even when officers' notes came in, she refused release while the maintenance-chief's signature column stood empty.

When Amsa-made weapons were found in a medical train, Han Bora re-searched every freight car of his own patrol train.

The fear that his own train would become the black dispatch sheet's carrier and break medical neutrality froze his hands inside the gloves.

His flashlight trembled reading the track column of the LOSS list, and the rumor of a protection war's first spark spread over the platform.

He locked the board and only proposed an official investigation to Bae Woojin.

/story_contents/B003/actors/5/sections/비.en:
The secret was one black-dispatch note she could not tear, folded away.

The guilt grew between the medical convoys she saved and the freight number missed in that night's search.

Instead of full disclosure, she allowed only partial disclosure with the auditor attending.

The SECRET opened only together with Park Hayul's release-order confirmation.

/story_contents/B003/actors/5/sections/생.en:
The crossroads of that day was the moment she chose between naming the smuggling car's true owner and holding to the official investigation alone to refuse the black dispatch coupling.

When a dispatch from the Duman River Far East Theater overlapped the Godeok window, the release clock moved up.

Naming the owner brought neutrality back to life but collided with the officer network; holding to the investigation alone put the train master's post at risk.

The decision remained in K123-TURN.

/story_contents/B003/actors/5/sections/정.en:
On the Godeok siding night platform, Han Bora endured the silence of the rails better than people.

As eastern patrol-train master of the Escort Protection State, she tore up notes ordering munitions cars disguised as medical trains.

She grew up of Korean origin in the Godeok and Amsa living sphere, with the habit of writing the release hour on the board first.

Han Bora and K122 were permanent.

/story_contents/B003/actors/5/sections/현.en:
Han Bora now kept the release board and the freight queue as the eastern patrol-train master.

License and double-confirmation logs maintained her standing, and HC08's exclusive demands were returned unapproved.

On the platform chalkboard she left only today's public dispatches.

Matching the Cast profile's patrol-train column with the ledger began each night rotation.

/story_contents/B003/actors/6/sections/가.en:

The collapse cut the tool wall's sensor table and exposed the battery allocation limit.

In place of emotion, the constraint-violation counter increased, and on deviation it passed through offline quarantine and snapshot rollback.

His standing was maintained not by inheritance but by license, signatures, and attendance logs.

Even when the Sinjeong Wheel House demanded exclusive maintenance ownership, he refused and matched the Cast profile's present column with the ledger every week.

The pit keys were split in two, one held by the duty squad and the other by the observation box.

/story_contents/B006/actors/1/arc/1/summ.en: Weighs the HC01 update window and the XT05 shipping dispatch

/story_contents/B006/actors/1/outcomes/1.en: Spare-bus lane revival puts fleet safety first

/story_contents/B006/actors/1/sections/3.en:
In act one Heo Seogyeom met the all-channel blackout with the power cut.

In act two he bound the HC01 remote update and the XT05 shipping-lane dispatch to the calibration clock.

In act three he paid the price of public dismantling or lane revival in the data gap.

The arc was STORY-B006-K066.

/story_contents/B006/actors/1/sections/가.en:
The Yeouido Computing House demanded a remote-update window for the research car.

Heo Seogyeom opened only the successor charter's observation column and erased real names from the ledger.

Community trust was built only on the days calibration logs went up on both sides at once.

The exclusive-update-ownership clause was refused at the research car's door.

/story_contents/B006/actors/1/sections/관.en:
The contract borrowing Ra Jinwoo's spare cold sensors overlapped with the night matching Baksol's alley-mesh snapshots and the update-window rivalry with the Cheongnam observer, all in one calibration room.

In the same research car some channels became salvation and some remained evidence of betrayal.

The relation ledger's endpoint continued to STORY-B006-K066.

Cooperation and checks were re-measured in waveform numbers alone.

/story_contents/B006/actors/1/sections/분.en:
In ending α Heo Seogyeom publicly dismantled the oxidized connectors and fixed the cause's route.

In ending β he revived the shipping-lane channels with the spare bus and put fleet safety first.

The Banghwa depot slot held, and only the branch split as K066-OUT.

The decision of that day was dismantling attendance or lane-revival escort.

/story_contents/B006/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse he tried to publish research-car sensor calibration in citizen-observation logs to block military-only lockout.

The ambition was the channel map left on the calibration-room chalkboard.

One pair of winter gloves promised to his younger sister was the start of a small debt.

Even when higher cipher keys arrived, he uploaded no firmware without an observer's signature.

The night every night sensor channel went black at once, Heo Seogyeom did not send the research car out of the depot; he cut its internal power instead.

The fear was the picture of the black channels triggering false positives on the ocean-trust shipping lanes and driving civilian fleets into mine waters.

He wrote the cut-off hour in the first line of the LOSS list.

Even when the emergency lights returned, the ignition key stayed around his neck.

/story_contents/B006/actors/1/sections/비.en:
The secret was the one-line memo of firmware uploaded without observation before ignition.

The guilt sat between the shipping-lane channels he saved and his sister's gloves, delayed because of it.

Instead of full confession, he allowed only partial disclosure under re-examination attendance.

The SECRET opened only with the citizen observer's and the maintenance chief's simultaneous signatures.

/story_contents/B006/actors/1/sections/생.en:
The crossroads of that day was whether to publicly dismantle the oxidized connector bundles, or to revive only the shipping-lane channels with the spare bus boards.

When a dispatch from the Incheon Trust Theater reached the calibration room, the order shook.

Choosing public dismantling exposed the cause's supplier; reviving only the lanes lengthened the research-data gap by another day.

K066-TURN was the power-cut order of that night.

/story_contents/B006/actors/1/sections/정.en:
Inside the Banghwa depot research car, Heo Seogyeom wiped the oxide film off sensor-bus connectors with a cotton swab.

As the Banghwa depot research-vehicle mechanic, he locked the ignition switch first whenever a channel's log cut off.

He grew up of Korean origin in the eastern research-depot sphere, dry in temperament, but he traced oscilloscope waveforms by hand.

The name Heo Seogyeom and the identifier K066 were permanent.

/story_contents/B006/actors/1/sections/현.en:
Heo Seogyeom still kept the roll call and the channel-calibration queue as the Banghwa depot research-vehicle mechanic.

License and observation logs maintained his standing, and the Yeouido Computing House's exclusive demands were returned unapproved every time.

On the calibration-room door he left only today's dead-channel list, in chalk.

Matching the Cast profile's research-car column with the ledger's viewpoint was his morning routine.

Act one was the dismantling of the forged military-tag box.

Act two was the collision of the HP07 priority delivery and the XT03 repair request.

Act three was the credit cost the trade paid after exposure or emergency repair.

The arc was STORY-B006-K094.

/story_contents/B006/actors/2/sections/가.en:
The Hangangjin Bridge Council demanded bridge-repair priority delivery at the trade window.

Yu Haeun accepted only the successor charter observation, published only the item numbers, and excluded real names.

Community trust was built by the headcount attending the knot inspections, and empty boxes stamped with logos were pushed out of guild eligibility.

Exclusive-ownership demands were refused at the workshop threshold.

/story_contents/B006/actors/2/sections/관.en:
The contract matching Heo Daon's axle gasket orders overlapped with Seol Minwoo's blockade-section leather signage deliveries and the priority-delivery rivalry with the bridge-council observers, all in one alley.

At the same workbench some boxes became salvation and some were read as betrayal.

The relation ledger's endpoint stayed preserved and connected to STORY-B006-K094.

Cooperation was re-confirmed in knot-tension numbers alone.

/story_contents/B006/actors/2/sections/분.en:
In ending α Yu Haeun exposed the forged supplier and chose guild credit.

In ending β he plugged the joints with spare gaskets and kept walking safety.

The Seongsu trade slot held, and only the branch split as K095-OUT.

The decision of that day was exposure testimony or repair escort.

/story_contents/B006/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
He tried to bind small pumps and leather gaskets into trade-guild credit and build a delivery ledger distinct from great-power munitions subcontracting.

The ambition survived in the item table nailed to the workbench.

One pair of winter boots promised to his nephew was the seed of the debt.

The one rule he kept was sealing at once the order-house column of any false specification that surfaced.

The afternoon bridge-repair materials arrived disguised under military leather tags, Yu Haeun locked the workbench and dismantled the boxes.

The fear was the sound of a fake gasket bursting in a Han River bridge joint and the walking column pouring into the river.

He cut the forged tags with scissors and pasted them into the LOSS list.

Even after the alley loudspeaker went dead, he did not put down the needle.

/story_contents/B006/actors/2/sections/비.en:
The secret was the record that, just before sealing, he pulled one sheet of his nephew's boot leather aside.

The guilt sat between the bridge joints he saved and the boot delivery delayed because of them.

Partial disclosure survived as the route of naming the item number before two witnesses.

The SECRET opened only when it meshed with the bridge attendance log.

/story_contents/B006/actors/2/sections/생.en:
The crossroads of that day was whether to stand the forged-tag supplier before the guild, or to plug the bridge joints first with spare gaskets.

A repair request from the Korea Strait Theater overlapped the Seongsu loudspeaker.

Choosing the supplier's exposure saved trade credit; choosing the emergency joints left the forged route standing.

K095-TURN was the box-dismantling order of that afternoon.

/story_contents/B006/actors/2/sections/정.en:
At the workbench in the Seongsu workshop alley, Yu Haeun sent the delivery box back whenever a leather seal cord's knot sat loose.

As the Seongsu leather and small-machinery trade representative, he snapped his pen first at any drawing-less conversion order.

He grew up of Korean origin in the Seongsu living sphere, low of voice, but never yielded the needle-and-driver order.

Yu Haeun and K094 were never renumbered.

/story_contents/B006/actors/2/sections/현.en:
Yu Haeun maintained the roll call and the delivery-inspection queue as the Seongsu trade representative.

License, signatures, and attendance logs upheld his standing, and the Hangangjin Bridge Council's exclusive demands were refused.

The workbench keys were two bundles, one held by the guild duty desk and one by himself.

When the Cast status and the item ledger drifted apart, he sounded the delivery siren.

/story_contents/B006/actors/3/sections/가.en:
The Guro Alloy House's duty window tried to wrap wheel steel as sponsorship tonnage.

Yang Pilho accepted only the successor charter's audit registration and erased real names and products from the ledger.

His place in the community was measured by how many trains with filled thickness measurements he sent out on time.

When house observers demanded night over-allocation, he refused, pointing at the wall's safety-thickness table.

/story_contents/B006/actors/3/sections/관.en:
The wheel-standard comparison shared with Heo Daon was a partnership, and Jang Sehwa's dispatch-duty hours were a contract.

With the Haedong observer's over-allocation there remained rivalry of raised voices before the lathe.

At the same depot some rims became salvation and some remained evidence of betrayal.

The relation ledger stayed connected to B006 without erasing that endpoint.

/story_contents/B006/actors/3/sections/분.en:
In ending α Yang Pilho exposed the under-thickness allocation and chose the public safety standard.

In ending β he put the spare rims to the refugee train first and kept the passage of lives.

The Godeok depot slot held, and only the branch split as K124-OUT.

The personnel on the ground chose exposure testimony or refugee-release escort.

/story_contents/B006/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
He tried to put steel allocation and refugee-train wheel replacement into the same ledger so munitions tonnage could never swallow civilian axles.

The ambition survived only in pencil in the morning lathe log.

The spare-rim coupon kept at his mother's sickroom was the seat of a small promise.

Release sheets with empty measurement columns never received a stamp.

Refugee-train and munitions-car wheel orders piled onto Godeok the same day.

Yang Pilho stopped the munitions-priority allocation and sealed the under-thickness rims on the lathe.

The fear was the image of a thin rim shattering on the Duman-bound sharp curve and a refugee car overturning.

Even after the broadcast cut off, he tied the seal cord two more times.

/story_contents/B006/actors/3/sections/비.en:
The secret was the internal memo of one rim whose thickness had been borderline before sealing.

The guilt sat between the refugee formations he sent out on time and the sickroom visit he delayed a day because of them.

Partial disclosure allowed only one memo line under witness attendance.

The SECRET key opened only together with the dispatch seal.

/story_contents/B006/actors/3/sections/생.en:
The crossroads of that day was whether to expose the under-thickness allocation route, or to save the refugee train first with the spare rims.

When the Duman River Far East Theater's dispatch rider arrived, the order board shook.

Choosing exposure shook the steel-allocation powers; choosing refugee priority exposed him to reprisal for the munitions delay.

K124-TURN was the tilt of that lathe.

/story_contents/B006/actors/3/sections/정.en:
Under the Godeok depot lathe, Yang Pilho measured a wheel rim's thickness three times with a micrometer.

As the Godeok depot wheel mechanic, he cut the release bell whenever the allocated tonnage pushed against the safety thickness.

He grew up of Korean origin in the eastern depot sphere, ended bargains quickly, and recognized no verbal allocation.

The name Yang Pilho and K123 were fixed identification.

/story_contents/B006/actors/3/sections/현.en:
Yang Pilho kept the roll call and the measurement queue as the Godeok depot wheel mechanic.

License and attendance signatures maintained his standing, and the Guro Alloy House's exclusive demands were refused.

Every morning he corrected the micrometer and the allocation table with the same chalk.

When the Cast profile's maintenance column and the ledger hash drifted apart, he closed that day's releases.

/story_contents/B006/actors/4/sections/분.en:

In ending β he escorted the originals in duplicate and kept the ledger continuous.

The vault slot held, and only the branch split as K153-OUT.

The decision of that day was trace attendance or escort protection.

/story_contents/B006/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse he tried to allow outside removals only after succession ledgers and water treaties went onto the vault's reading ledger.

The ambition of giving the record-law houses a real veto survived in the night patrol logs.

One bundle of spare seal cords offered to his teacher was the seat of a small debt.

Slips with empty witness columns never opened the steel door.

When three forged reading slips arrived at the steel door at the same hour, Na Seonjae blockaded the corridor and locked the elevators until the handwriting comparison ended.

The fear was the scene of one forged slip riding the Imjin-bound convoy car and the whole Seoul Station ledger being copied away.

Even after the emergency bell fell silent, he pulled the seal cord once more.

The slip column of the LOSS list remained empty.

/story_contents/B006/actors/4/sections/비.en:
The secret was the drawer memo he sealed temporarily with his teacher's spare cord.

The guilt sat between the forged removals he blocked and the original convoy delayed because of it.

Partial disclosure allowed only the drawer number under dual attendance.

The SECRET opened only together with the dispatch seal.

/story_contents/B006/actors/4/sections/생.en:
The crossroads of that day was whether to publicly trace the forged-slip issuer, or to send the original ledger's copies to the Imjin gate under dual escort.

When the Imjin River Gate Theater's dispatch rider reached the vault duty room, the order shook.

Choosing the trace exposed internal collusion; choosing the escort let the issuer hide one cell deeper.

K153-TURN was the steel door's choice.

/story_contents/B006/actors/4/sections/정.en:
Before the steel door of the Seoul Station document vault, Na Seonjae blocked hands asking to enter before the access slip's ink dried.

As leader of the vault-guard patrol, he cut the corridor lights whenever a seal number broke the order.

He grew up of Korean origin in the downtown records sphere, hard in appearance, but folded the patrol log's margins to mark abnormal sections.

Na Seonjae and K151 were permanent.

/story_contents/B006/actors/4/sections/현.en:
Na Seonjae kept the roll call and the reading queue as the vault-guard leader.

License, signatures, and dual-attendance logs upheld his standing, and the Record-Law House's exclusive demands were refused.

The steel-door keys were split in two between the squad leader and the observation box.

When the Cast status and the reading ledger drifted apart, he closed that day's removals.

In act one Seol Minwoo tore the dual-blockade slips and forced a single reason column.

In act two he bound the HC08 defense and the XT02 granary dispatch to the opening clock.

/story_contents/B006/actors/5/sections/가.en:
The Changdong Protection House demanded a seat at the blockade window in the name of rail-defense duty.

Seol Minwoo opened only the successor charter's observation column and refused the exclusive-ownership clause.

His place in the community was proven by the count of posting the opening-hours table on the wall, and passage opened only on days the administration and the escort detail both received copies.

No house logo appeared in his ledger.

/story_contents/B006/actors/5/sections/관.en:
Yu Haeun's blockade-signage leather deliveries were a contract, and Jang Sehwa's dispatch-bypass requests were an alliance.

With the rail-defense observer's indefinite slips there remained rivalry of raised voices at the post.

On the same line one column gained passage and another left only waiting.

The relation ledger's endpoint continued to STORY-B006-K175.

/story_contents/B006/actors/5/sections/분.en:
In ending α Seol Minwoo exposed the indefinite issuer and kept the public passage rules.

In ending β he opened the granary window for two hours and chose the continuity of food.

The blockade squad slot held, and only the branch split as K178-OUT.

The decision of that day was exposure testimony or window escort.

/story_contents/B006/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
He tried to put granary convoys and civilian passage onto one blockade ledger so military-only blockades would never strangle the market.

The ambition was the opening-hours table nailed to the post's chalkboard.

The passage notes he sent his younger sibling — never trust an empty reason column — became the seed of his debt.

Even with officers' emergency stamps, he did not lower the lever before the reason column filled.

The morning the West Sea granary convoy and the refugee column overlapped in one blockade section, Seol Minwoo tore the dual-blockade slips and left a single reason column.

The fear was the picture of an indefinite blockade rotting grain and spreading into market riots.

After the alarms went dark, his pen stopped in the middle line of the LOSS list.

Only torn slip fragments remained on the post railing.

/story_contents/B006/actors/5/sections/비.en:
The secret was one empty reason line he withheld while hiding his sibling's note.

The guilt grew between the grain column he saved and the box of medicine that arrived a day late because of it.

Instead of full confession, he allowed only partial disclosure through the re-examination window.

The SECRET opened only together with the administrative re-examination slip.

/story_contents/B006/actors/5/sections/생.en:
The crossroads of that day was whether to expose whoever issued the indefinite blockade, or to open only the granary-convoy window for two hours.

When a dispatch from the West Sea Granary Theater reached the post, he pulled the opening clock forward.

Choosing exposure shook the defense authority; choosing the window opening could see him charged with insubordination.

The decision remained in K178-TURN.

/story_contents/B006/actors/5/sections/정.en:
At the line-blockade guard post, Seol Minwoo stopped the rotation whenever the blocker lever's play crossed a hand's width.

As leader of the line-blockade patrol, he cut the loudspeaker at any slip with an empty reason column.

He grew up of Korean origin in the western line sphere, rough of speech, but wrote blockade hours to the second.

Seol Minwoo and K175 were never renumbered.

/story_contents/B006/actors/5/sections/현.en:
Seol Minwoo now kept the roll call and the lever queue as the line-blockade squad leader.

License and observation logs maintained his standing, and the Changdong Protection House's exclusive demands were returned unapproved every time.

On the post glass he left only the blockade slips expiring today, in chalk.

Matching the Cast profile's blockade column with the ledger's viewpoint was his morning routine.

In act two he weighed the HC12 heavy-equipment pressure and the XT03 dispatch on one elder's desk.

At the same depot some handovers became salvation and some remained evidence of betrayal.

The relation ledger's endpoint stayed preserved and connected to STORY-B006-K265.

/story_contents/B006/actors/6/sections/분.en:

In ending β he evacuated the maintenance workforce along the bypass and kept the jobs continuous.

Neither deleted the rolling-stock depot's slot among the sixteen states; only the branch split as K271-OUT.

The decision on the ground that day followed the turning-point record as either reading attendance or evacuation escort.

/story_contents/B006/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse he inserted, line by line, citizen observation, multilingual notice, and withdrawal deadlines into depot-transfer contracts.

The ambition was blocking great-power unilateral transfers with the elder's veto, and the draft went up first on the elders' room chalkboard.

The words he left his children — reread once more in your mother tongue before signing — became the seed of his debt.

Contracts with empty notice columns never received a stamp.

When strait-side brokers pushed a depot-transfer draft in at midnight, I Hongwon invoked the elder's veto and postponed the handover ceremony.

The fear was the scene of an un-noticed transfer stripping the whole multicultural maintenance workforce of qualification overnight.

He wrote the veto hour in the first line of the LOSS list.

The stamp box on the railing carried a double lock from that day.

/story_contents/B006/actors/6/sections/비.en:
The secret was the copy of the empty-notice draft he withheld while hiding his children's note.

The guilt grew only between the maintenance jobs he kept and the name of one apprentice interpreter he failed to call that night.

Publishing everything could break the depot's trust by one notch, so he left only a partial-disclosure procedure.

The SECRET key did not open without the elder's and the observer's simultaneous signatures.

/story_contents/B006/actors/6/sections/생.en:
The crossroads of that day was whether to read the transfer draft's empty notice column aloud in public, or to evacuate the spare maintenance workforce first along the strait bypass route.

When a dispatch from the Korea Strait Theater overlapped the elders' room, the calculation changed.

Choosing the reading cut the Junggong council's face; choosing the evacuation let the draft's proposer hide.

The choice remained as K271-TURN.

/story_contents/B006/actors/6/sections/정.en:
At the railing of the rolling-stock depot elders' room, I Hongwon closed the stamp box lid whenever a handover document's multilingual notice column went missing.

As depot elder, he grew up in a Korean-born multicultural household where the home languages mixed, but he unified the depot's terminology into one.

His temperament read as slow, but one line of veto stopped a whole day.

The display name I Hongwon and the permanent identifier K265 were never renumbered in the batches that followed.

/story_contents/B006/actors/6/sections/현.en:
Even now I Hongwon kept the roll call and the veto queue as depot elder.

His standing was maintained not by inheritance but by license, signatures, and observation logs.

Even when the Geumcheon District Office Machinery House demanded exclusive transfer, he refused and matched the Cast profile's present column with the ledger every week.

The elders' room keys were shared between himself and the citizen-observation box.

/story_contents/B012/actors/8/sections/관.en:
Translating Kim Woochan's operation sheet into training was a command relation, and trading barricade-gate tactics with I Gangmuk was a contract.

The grudge born of binding Baek On's family roster to forced service overlapped on the same sand.

In the same rank, one cadence became a rescue and one calling of names remained evidence of betrayal.

The relation ends by continuing into STORY-B012-K117.

/story_contents/B012/actors/8/sections/분.en:
On one branch, Jang Seokyun chooses to translate the operation sheet and keeps the escort-corps training alive.

On the other branch, he chooses the public tearing-up of the service clause and keeps the family roster and the margin secret.

The Godeok officer-corps slot remains, and only the marker is K118-OUT.

The decision of that time is attendance at the training, or attendance at the roster publication.

/story_contents/B012/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse he tried to translate Kim Woochan's operation sheet into officer training, so that the protection government's cadence would not come before the family water-ration sheet.

His ambition was a barricade-gate tactical diagram drawn in the sand with a stick alone.

The promise to trade southwest security with I Gangmuk remained on that diagram.

A service clause without a paired gloss was not posted on the board.

On the afternoon the eastern freight-car weight log was published, one of the three training-ground ranks was called out where it overlapped the forced-service roster.

Jang Seokyun put the whistle in his pocket and did not resume the cadence until Baek On's protest over the family roster was read aloud.

A family roster being stamped as a service list was the core of the grudge.

Even after the sand wind died down, he could not fold the operation sheet.

/story_contents/B012/actors/8/sections/비.en:
The secret is that, just before they were called out, he left one rank's names only in the margin of the training ledger.

Guilt grows between the operation translation he saved and the one family line he could not pull out that afternoon.

Instead of reading the whole aloud, only a margin check under dual attendance remained.

The margin is not posted without the simultaneous confirmation of Kim Woochan and I Gangmuk.

/story_contents/B012/actors/8/sections/생.en:
The fork was whether to translate the operation sheet into officer training, or to publicly tear up the clause that bound the family roster to forced service.

The Duman River Far East Theater's urging to publish the freight-car weight log overlapped the back row of the sand.

Choosing the translation kept the escort-corps training going but closed the roster window for a day, and choosing the tearing-up stopped the barricade-gate trade for a day.

K118-TURN is the length of that whistle's silence.

/story_contents/B012/actors/8/sections/정.en:
At the back row of the Godeok Depot sand training ground, Jang Seokyun stopped the cadence and checked first whether the operation sheet was missing its paired Hanja and Hangul gloss.

He was an instructor of the Godeok officer corps of the Escort Protection State, and he grew up in a Chinese-descent diaspora household.

He switched between the speech of the house and the training cadence, but the training originals accepted only standard Korean and cross-glosses.

That history does not predict loyalty, violence, or rank, and Jang Seokyun and K117 are not renumbered on the officer-corps roster.

/story_contents/B012/actors/8/sections/현.en:
Jang Seokyun still moves between the sand training ground and the barricade-gate training-aid warehouse and passes the training queue to the officer corps.

The seat is kept only by that day's training signature and cross-gloss, not by enlisted seniority.

Even when HC08 demands a remote cadence monopoly, he does not hand over the whistle.

The warehouse key is split between the staff window and Defense Gate observation.

/story_contents/B012/actors/9/arc/0/summ.en: It locks long-term memory against the tool-wall noise and leaves only a snapshot

/story_contents/B012/actors/9/arc/1/summ.en: It weighs the HC12 remote demand and the XT01 bypass transfer in the reception queue

/story_contents/B012/actors/9/arc/2/summ.en: Accepts the night-slot gap as the price of dismantling or revival

/story_contents/B012/actors/9/outcomes/0.en: Public dismantling of the noise slots fixes the cause's route

/story_contents/B012/actors/9/outcomes/1.en: Sinnae transfer continuity by the spare-battery bypass mesh

/story_contents/B012/actors/9/sections/3.en:
In Act 1, Ichaeon locks long-term memory against the noise and leaves only a snapshot.

In Act 2, it weighs the HC12 remote demand and the XT01 bypass-transfer request in the reception queue.

In Act 3, it pays for the public teardown or the bypass revival with a gap in the night tool slots and the consumption of the battery allocation.

The narrative-line identifier is fixed as STORY-B012-H12.

/story_contents/B012/actors/9/sections/가.en:
The Geumcheon District Office Machinery House makes joint custody, a citizen-observation seal, and a tripartite signature on transfer into obligations.

Ichaeon's action log carries no real trade name or product name, only a succession-charter observation code.

The number of times a snapshot was recorded on both sides at once, per shift, is its place in the community.

A demand for exclusive remote ownership is returned as a refusal code in front of the tool-wall seal.

/story_contents/B012/actors/9/sections/관.en:
Jang Sehwa's chief maintenance and legal responsibility were a custody-contract code, and Ryu Haneul's shift cooperation was a work queue.

The rivalry of remote lock with the HC12 stewardship, and the yielding of a slot to the medical-train watch, overlapped on one tool wall.

It does not imitate the betrayal-and-rescue narrative of human relations, and it crosses only in approval and refusal codes.

The relation ledger ends by connecting to STORY-B012-H12.

/story_contents/B012/actors/9/sections/분.en:
In ending α, Ichaeon fixes the cause path with a public teardown log of the noise slot.

In ending β, it keeps the Sinnae transfer continuous with a spare-battery bypass mesh.

There is no follow-on cause from infinite energy, and neither side deletes the HC12 custody slot; only the identifier splits into H12-OUT.

The decision in the field at that time is attendance at the teardown, or an escort for the bypass power.

/story_contents/B012/actors/9/sections/붕.en:
The pre-collapse calibration record still held the goal of putting continuous running of the Jamsil-line sector and the safety of the assigned human first, so as to block a sole remote lock.

The priority was marked only as dots on the remaining-charge graph on the side of the tool wall.

One spare battery slot left by Jang Sehwa was the place of the continuity debt.

A transfer order without a tripartite signature did not rise onto the execution queue.

On the shift when the Changdong wheel escort stopped outside the gate, the tool-wall sensor was covered in black-and-white noise.

Ichaeon stopped long-term memory writes, left only the shift snapshot, and locked the hand-module cover.

The highest-priority alarm was the scenario in which a false-positive path turned the medical train into a hostile target.

Even when the emergency power returned, the full memory-recovery order was deleted from the queue.

/story_contents/B012/actors/9/sections/비.en:
The secret of the restricted log is one line of a firmware patch that went up once without observation.

The weight increases between the bypass-slot node it saved and the spare battery it could not call on that shift.

Instability of the computation raises the constraint-violation counter, and on a deviation it passes through offline isolation and then a snapshot rollback.

The SECRET flag is not cleared without the simultaneous signatures of custody responsibility and citizen observation.

/story_contents/B012/actors/9/sections/생.en:
The fork was whether to hand the noise slot to citizen observation as a public teardown log, or to keep only the Sinnae bypass-transfer mesh alive on the spare battery.

The Imjin River Gate Theater's request to open the bypass transfer overlapped the reception queue.

Choosing the public teardown exposed the cause-supply code, and keeping only the bypass mesh alive lengthened the gap in the other night tool slots.

H12-TURN is the sort result of that reception queue.

/story_contents/B012/actors/9/sections/정.en:
In front of the night-watch terminal on the Sinnae tool wall, Ichaeon read the battery-remaining number with the sensor bar alone.

It was the synthetic humanoid H12, its call name Chaeon, and under the joint custody of the Geumcheon District Office Machinery House it opened tool seals with a replaceable hand module.

Night vision was limited and it could not see the whole sector at one glance, and the battery floor and the observation seal divided its actions.

The display name Ichaeon and the identifier H12 are not renumbered even when forked.

/story_contents/B012/actors/9/sections/현.en:
Ichaeon still processes the roll-call signal and the snapshot queue through the field terminals of the Sinnae tool wall and the Mangu maintenance bench.

The status is kept only by custody responsibility, the observation seal, and the tripartite-signature log, not by inheritance.

Even when HC12 demands exclusive remote ownership, it returns a refusal code, and it matches the status cell with the snapshot hash every shift.

Slot-key authority is held split between Jang Sehwa's chief maintenance and the citizen-observation module.

/story_contents/B013/actors/0/arc/0/summ.en: Confirms the empty seal cell at the inspection desk and the back gate at once

/story_contents/B013/actors/0/arc/1/summ.en: Orders the HP02 emergency cell and the XT04 freight-car demand on the survey sheet

/story_contents/B013/actors/0/arc/2/summ.en: Pays for publishing the coordinates or discarding the forged line with a night-survey gap

/story_contents/B013/actors/0/outcomes/0.en: The back-gate coordinates drawn solid keep the medical train's back gate

/story_contents/B013/actors/0/outcomes/1.en: Discarding the forged line blocks the escort band's bypass of the inspection desk

/story_contents/B013/actors/0/sections/3.en:
In act 1, Bok Gam met the empty seal cell again at the inspection desk and the back gate at the same time.

In act 2, he ordered the HP02 emergency-cell duty and the XT04 freight-car demand on a single survey sheet.

In act 3, he paid for publishing the coordinates or discarding the forged line with a gap in the night survey.

The narrative-line identifier was fixed as STORY-B013-K301.

/story_contents/B013/actors/0/sections/가.en:
The Yongsan Track Gate tried to fold the back-gate survey into the observation duty, citing the emergency cell of the neutral dispatch table.

Bok Gam let the dispatch crew step onto the back-gate gravel only on shifts where Jang Sehwa's medical-escort title still headed the master plate, and he sent the exclusive search warrant back as a note with no seal thread.

His place in the community was proved not by a certificate but by survey copies posted at the inspection desk and the back gate at the same time.

The footprints in the emergency cell were conditional, and the map's margin did not open.

/story_contents/B013/actors/0/sections/관.en:
The back-gate survey he handed to Mun Sion was a contract, and the night he pinned the same line to Bong Mo's inspection-desk blackboard was an alliance.

Leaving Jang Sehwa's neutrality title at the head of the master plate was a bargain to keep escort priority.

A record of pulling one another up on the same gravel, and a record of hiding the coordinates for half a day, remained together.

The endpoint of the relation ledger was preserved and continued into STORY-B013-K301.

/story_contents/B013/actors/0/sections/분.en:
In ending α, Bok Gam raised the back-gate coordinates onto the master plate as a solid line and kept the medical train's back gate.

In ending β, he tore up the forged bypass in front of the dispatch crew, so the escort band could not skip the inspection desk.

Neither side erased the Neutral Convoy City's slot among the sixteen states, and only the branch identifier split as K307-OUT.

The decision on the ground at the time followed the turning-point record as one of two: an escort to restore the coordinates, or attendance at the discarding of the forged line.

/story_contents/B013/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
In the winter before the collapse, Bok Gam bound the northeast outer road and the back-gate bypass onto one master plate, so that the Amsa escort band's arbitrary searches could not skip the inspection desk.

The trace of his ambition was a chalk arrow smeared by rain at the back gate, and that arrow later became the coordinate of a debt.

Even when a seal mark aged by only a day, he walked the ground again without folding the map.

His colleagues called the habit stubbornness, but he left any line he had not surveyed as a dotted line alone.

The trace of an Amsa officer who skipped the Sinnae inspection desk and came in through the depot back gate stood empty on the seal ledger and the map at the same time.

Bok Gam did not fill the blank cell by inference, and left only the footprints on the gravel in ink.

The core of the fear was a scene in which a forged bypass led to the medical train's back gate and the neutrality declaration became an empty phrase.

Even after the alarm cut out, he did not pull the survey nail, and he did not take off his gloves.

/story_contents/B013/actors/0/sections/비.en:
The secret was a single survey nail driven under the gravel.

That nail was driven on a bypass line he had not walked, and it let the medical train pass the inspection desk.

The guilt stayed in the hand that did not pull the nail that night, and Bong Mo's inspection-desk blackboard held a blank line for the same hour.

Without Jang Sehwa in attendance, the copy of the nail mark from the back-gate box did not come out.

/story_contents/B013/actors/0/sections/생.en:
The moment he chose was whether to raise the back-gate coordinates onto the public master plate as a solid line, or to tear up the forged bypass in the dispatch meeting room.

When the freight-car weight demand from the Duman River Far East Theater came in over the loudspeaker, the calculation changed.

Raising the coordinates kept the medical train's back gate alive, but the night survey crew dropped out; tearing the forged line first let one escort band take the search warrant as a solid line.

That choice remained as K307-TURN, and reversing it stopped the Sinnae emergency cell for one shift.

/story_contents/B013/actors/0/sections/정.en:
On the gravel at the back gate of the Sinnae depot, Bok Gam cut away a seal thread a day old and drove the survey nail back in.

As a surveyor of the northeast outer road, he moved on foot the moment a closed terminal track came into view, and he called a colleague who drew a bypass as a solid line from rumor alone a neighbor of the blank map.

Of Korean origin, he grew up in the Neutral Convoy City's living zone, and gravel oil and ink stained his palms together.

The name Bok Gam and the identifier K301 were never renumbered, however the sorting changed.

/story_contents/B013/actors/0/sections/현.en:
Bok Gam stood before the Sinnae back-gate survey sheet and corrected only the seal date.

The surveyor's seat was not inherited; it was held only by the survey hash, inspection attendance, and the dispatch log.

Even when the Yongsan Track Gate demanded exclusive ownership of the bypass, he did not withdraw the dotted-line rule.

The status cell of the Cast profile and the margin of the master plate were matched each week by the same nail mark.

/story_contents/B013/actors/1/arc/0/summ.en: Opens the back-gate box that carries the same seal as the counterfeit fever-reducer capsules

/story_contents/B013/actors/1/arc/1/summ.en: Sets the HP06 double-check and the XT04 frostbite queue on the compounding-room scale

/story_contents/B013/actors/1/arc/2/summ.en: Pays for keeping the dotted line or removing the master plate with a gap in the shelf's public posting

/story_contents/B013/actors/1/outcomes/0.en: Keeping the forged source region dotted preserves the market's right of interpretation

/story_contents/B013/actors/1/outcomes/1.en: Removing the seal master plate publishes the protection warehouse's forgery route

/story_contents/B013/actors/1/sections/3.en:
At the opening hour, Won Miru opened again the back-gate box that carried the same seal as the counterfeit fever-reducer capsules.

In the middle, he set the HP06 double-check and the XT04 frostbite queue on the compounding-room scale.

In the closing chapter, he paid for keeping the dotted line or removing the master plate with a gap in the shelf's public posting.

The narrative line was STORY-B013-K326.

/story_contents/B013/actors/1/sections/가.en:
The Jegi-dong Healing Gate tried to put observation of the contamination coordinates into the duty cell, citing double-checking of prescriptions.

Won Miru sent the source-region numbers back for comparison not through the lot board but through the margin of Jeong Hojun's efficacy record, and he left Jeong Harin only the seam drying time, by word of mouth.

His place in the community was proved not by a license but by the number of times he compared shelf medicine and back-gate boxes on the same line.

The demand to use an exclusive purchase order as the master plate's title was rejected by a note of a defective lot.

/story_contents/B013/actors/1/sections/관.en:
The contamination coordinates she handed to Ra Seyeong were a contract, and the morning she received Eun Chaeyun's shelf medicine as a comparison specimen was a sharing.

The night she moved Baek On's Bukhansan Bogukmun testimony into the margin of the master plate became a rescue, and a number hidden for a day in that same margin was also read as a betrayal.

No relation took sides by the smell of medicine alone.

The endpoint of the relations was preserved and continued into STORY-B013-K326.

/story_contents/B013/actors/1/sections/분.en:
In ending α, Won Miru left the forged source region as a dotted line and kept the market's right of interpretation.

In ending β, he pulled the seal master plate and published the forgery route on the protection-warehouse side.

Neither branch discarded the dotted-line rule of the efficacy master plate, and only the branch identifier split as K333-OUT.

The decision on the ground at the time followed the turning-point record as one of two: attendance at the defense of the dotted line, or an escort for the removal of the master plate.

/story_contents/B013/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
In the year the market opened every day, Won Miru bound the eastern crude-drug origins and the counterfeit-capsule routes onto the public master plate, so that the seals of the great-power protection warehouse could not come down onto the floor stalls.

His ambition remained in one pouch of comparison specimens hidden under the shelf, and later became the weight of a debt.

He recorded a late specimen not as an excuse but as a blank cell.

His colleagues called that blank cell stubbornness, but he left any source region he had not surveyed as a dotted line alone.

When testimony came in that the counterfeit fever-reducer capsules matched the seal of the great-power protection warehouse, Won Miru surveyed the Cheongnyangni back gate alone.

He did not condemn the seal by inference, and wrote in the log only the drying time of the seam glue.

The core of the fear was a scene in which the survey specimens vanished along with the pre-purchase ledger and the counterfeit medicine was confirmed as children's medicine of Bukhansan Bogukmun.

Even after the alarm went out, he did not let go of the pouch of comparison specimens.

/story_contents/B013/actors/1/sections/비.en:
The secret was a comparison specimen she had shut behind the shelf, dated one day early.

The guilt clung to the hand that moved that earlier date into the lot cell in ink.

The pouch that overlapped Eun Chaeyun's shelf medicine did not open without Ra Seyeong in attendance, and the line of Baek On's Bukhansan Bogukmun testimony remained only in the margin of the master plate.

/story_contents/B013/actors/1/sections/생.en:
The moment he chose was whether to leave the forged source region as a dotted line, or to pull the seal master plate and pin the forgery on the protection warehouse.

When the queue of frostbite patients from the Duman River Far East Theater came in over the sickbay loudspeaker, the calculation changed.

Keeping the dotted line left the right of interpretation on the market floor alive, but the night comparison crew dropped out; pulling the master plate let one window monopolize the reading of source regions.

That choice remained as K333-TURN, and reversing it stopped the public lots on the Jegi-dong shelf for one shift.

/story_contents/B013/actors/1/sections/정.en:
Won Miru opened the lid of the medicine box at the Cheongnyangni back gate and smelled once more the glue left in a capsule seam.

As a surveyor of origins and counterfeit medicine, he read provenance from the smell and the seams of crude drugs, and he counted drawing a source region as a solid line from rumor alone as the same offense as a late specimen.

Of Korean origin, he grew up in an alley of the Medical Neutrality League, and drug powder had hardened under his nails.

The pair of the display name Won Miru and K333 did not change even when the ledger was re-sorted.

/story_contents/B013/actors/1/sections/현.en:
At the Jegi-dong shelf, Won Miru ran a fingernail along capsule seams and called the lot numbers aloud to match them.

The surveyor's seat was not inherited; it was held only by the comparison hash, the double-check of prescriptions, and the attendance signature.

Even when the Jegi-dong Healing Gate demanded exclusive ownership of the source regions, he did not raise a dotted-line source region to a solid line.

A seal that did not overlap Jeong Hojun's efficacy record stayed only in the margin of the master plate.

/story_contents/B013/actors/2/arc/0/summ.en: Compares the scout sentence written as a hostile action with the cracked pipe

/story_contents/B013/actors/2/arc/1/summ.en: Matches the HP07 wind-speed standard and the XT01 splitting of the sealing key over the pontoon radio

/story_contents/B013/actors/2/outcomes/1.en: Covering the misread solid line speeds the consolidation of the defense units

/story_contents/B013/actors/2/sections/3.en:
In the first scene, Dong Saebom compared again the scout sentence written as a hostile action and the cracked pipe.

In the middle, she matched the HP07 wind-speed standard and the XT01 splitting of the sealing key over the pontoon radio.

In the closing chapter, she paid for publishing the inference original or covering the misread solid line with a gap in the night water supply.

The narrative-line ID was fixed as STORY-B013-K351.

/story_contents/B013/actors/2/sections/가.en:
The Hangangjin Bridge Council tried to make observation of the underside coordinates mandatory, citing the wind-speed closure standard.

Dong Saebom posted the refusal of observation on the ridge board first, and left only the cracked pipe before Go Seojun's direct report.

His place in the community was proved not by rank but by damage copies posted on the ridge and the bridge at the same time.

The sentence of hostile action was not raised into the body of the master plate; it was set down only in the margin beside the name of An Gijun's crack.

/story_contents/B013/actors/2/sections/관.en:
Translating Sim Gaeun's scout report into coordinates was a teacher-and-student contract, and the night he wrote the name of An Gijun's pier crack in the margin was a sharing of the same ground.

The record of exchanging Jang Sehwa's transfer information as dotted lines alone left cooperation and distance-keeping on one line.

A dawn of pulling one another up on the same pontoon, and a dawn of hiding the inference for half a day, stood together.

The endpoint of the relations continued into STORY-B013-K351.

/story_contents/B013/actors/2/sections/분.en:
In ending α, Dong Saebom posted the original of the inference cell on the ridge and delayed the spread of the misreading.

In ending β, she covered the misread solid line and sped the consolidation of the defense units.

Neither side deleted the Gate Military Government's slot among the sixteen states, and only the branch identifier split as K359-OUT.

The decision on the ground at the time followed the turning-point record as one of two: an escort for publishing the original, or attendance at the covering of the solid line.

/story_contents/B013/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
In the days when the bridge still received only daytime inspections, Dong Saebom bound the underside and the water-main damage coordinates onto the public master plate, to cut at once the water technicians' monopoly of information and the Amsa patronage.

Her ambition was the name of a crack left in the pier's margin, and for fear that the name would later become the seed of a grudge, she did not raise an inference to a solid line.

She wrote reports quickly, and on the ground she cut away the habit of superiors who added interpretation.

Damage she had not surveyed she left as a dotted line alone.

When a scout report that recorded the water-main damage as a hostile action spread across the ridge and the bridge at the same time, Dong Saebom erased the inference cell and published only the cracked pipe.

She set down the ink brush without being able to write, on the last line of the log, the scene in which a misread solid line spread into a war of the eastern bridges and she herself became the object of a grudge.

Instead of the alarm, only the sound of water leaking from the pipe remained.

The erased inference was shut in a separate box and not burned.

/story_contents/B013/actors/2/sections/비.en:
The secret was the original ink of the erased inference cell, shut in a separate box.

The guilt lay in the brush with which, on the night of the crisis, he himself broke the promise to leave observation and inference in different colors.

The key of the box turned only after Sim Gaeun had read the coordinates and Go Seojun had opened the direct-report cell.

/story_contents/B013/actors/2/sections/생.en:
The moment she chose was whether to post the original of the erased inference cell on the ridge board, or to cover the misread solid line and speed the consolidation of the defense units.

When the demand to split the sealing key from the Imjin River Gate Theater came in over the gate radio, the calculation changed.

Posting the original kept the right of interpretation alive, but the night underside crew dropped out; covering the solid line let one defense unit monopolize the reading of the damage.

That choice remained as K359-TURN, and reversing it stopped one slot of the Guui water supply.

/story_contents/B013/actors/2/sections/정.en:
In the shade of the Guui pier, Dong Saebom left only the cracked water main and wiped away the red ink in the inference cell.

As a surveyor of the bridge underside, she took on Sim Gaeun's practical work, had observations and inferences written in different colors, and in a crisis erased the inference cell.

Of Korean origin, she grew up below the ridge of the Gate Military Government, and river rust stained the toes of her boots.

The title Dong Saebom and the number K351 remained a pair even when the posting changed.

/story_contents/B013/actors/2/sections/현.en:
On the pontoon of Jamsugyo, Dong Saebom read the wind-speed figure and wrote the date on the cracked pipe in chalk.

The seat of the person in charge of the practical work was not inherited; it was held only by the observation-color ink, the dotted-line rule, and the attendance log.

Even when the Hangangjin Bridge Council demanded exclusive ownership of the underside, she did not raise the sentence of hostile action into the body of the master plate.

The name of the pier crack that An Gijun had posted lived only in the margin.

/story_contents/B013/actors/3/arc/0/summ.en: Confirms the blank cell of the blockade night and the opening trace at the same lock

/story_contents/B013/actors/3/arc/1/summ.en: Weighs the HP08 power slot and the XT03 canned-goods allocation on one line of the blackboard

/story_contents/B013/actors/3/arc/2/summ.en: Pays for reassigning power to the citizens' cell or publishing the winning bidder with an ice-storehouse gap
