/theaters/0/checkpoints/0/function.en: cross-check of originals and copies of the return rolls and kinship certificates, and the record of reissue

/theaters/0/checkpoints/0/place.en: the Anguk and Gwanghwamun roll cross-check window

/theaters/0/checkpoints/1/function.en: splitting and joining of the family queue and the neutral convoys

/theaters/0/checkpoints/2/checks/0.en: the custody record of the two key halves

/theaters/0/checkpoints/2/checks/1.en: the state of the box seals

/theaters/0/checkpoints/2/checks/2.en: water-level safety of the passage window

/theaters/0/checkpoints/2/function.en: dual custody of the sealing key and handover of the Seoul-side quarantine

/theaters/0/checkpoints/2/place.en: the Guui seal window and the temporary Imjin quarantine post

/theaters/0/explicit_unknowns/0.en: The actual destination and waypoints beyond the Imjin quarantine post were not set.

/theaters/0/explicit_unknowns/1.en: The names and acts of outside polities, organs, and armed groups were not set.

/theaters/0/explicit_unknowns/2.en: Time needed for movement beyond Seoul, the scale of returnees, and outside passage rules were not set.

/theaters/0/explicit_unknowns/3.en: Outside languages and travelers' origins were fixed only by Seoul-side registers and interpretation requests.

/theaters/0/hostile_ecology_interaction/.en: When the evacuation column's food traces overlapped the flood level, the Flood-Boar Swarm could occupy the sluice stairs.
A wholesale cull scattered the herd into the alleys, so it was kept only as a last resort.
The leftovers were diverted to a separate sealed collection, and the passage times were divided.
When the migratory birds' movement along the northern wind path overlapped the sluice inspection, access to the bridges and the depot narrowed.
The choice of drying the water surface to drive the flock out left an ecological and water-quality cost.
The roosts and perches of each functional flock and the low-noise inspection window were adjusted.
A materials signal from the northern corridor could widen the working radius of the Blueprint-Ghost Machine Corps' temporary bridges.
Instead of destroying the blueprint vault or the equipment, only the wrong layer port was sealed.
The stop grid and the exception layer were checked first, separating people's dwellings from the materials signal.

/theaters/0/inference.en: Only the inference was allowed that post-collapse flows of goods and refugees toward Kaesong and Pyongyang saw repeated severance and detour, and it was not promoted to canon.

/theaters/0/language_rumor_protocol/inte.en: Interpretation connected to Seoul's existing interpretation corridors only when the party requested it. Outside languages and outside groups' identities were not designated in this theater's data.

/theaters/0/language_rumor_protocol/proh.en: From word-of-mouth alone, no outside polity's policy, a traveler's origin, kinship, or crimes were fixed.

/theaters/0/language_rumor_protocol/reco.en: The Seoul-side ledgers were kept in Korean.

/theaters/0/language_rumor_protocol/rumo.en: Mutually independent registers or seal records collated, with responsible issuers and hand-off agents remaining.
Only a single escort record or damaged copy remained, needing re-collation.
Only family contact or movement rumor existed, unconfirmed by register, seal, or receipt record.

/theaters/0/opening_event/conflict.en: The demand to open the family line first collided with the demand to finish the register collation first.

/theaters/0/opening_event/player_decisio.en: Choose whether to pass only the medical escort through while holding the damaged register, or open the reissue procedure under observation and delay the family line.

/theaters/0/opening_event/timeline_place.en: It was a devised event proposed to run alongside the third water compact of the day in 2126.

/theaters/0/opening_event/trigger.en: The repatriation register of the Imjin provisional quarantine post was damaged, opening Anguk's reissue demand and Gwanghwamun's authenticity review at once.

/theaters/0/original_fiction.en: The Imjin River Gate Theater was a Seoul creative corridor in which Anguk, Gwanghwamun, Sinnae, and Guui jointly ran the gate quarantine and the repatriation registers.

/theaters/0/player_entry_points/0/first_.en: It decided which handover to confirm first, and did not put the family queue and the medicine boxes in the same window.

/theaters/0/player_entry_points/0/role.en: a convoy assistant cross-checking the rolls against the receipt signatures

/theaters/0/player_entry_points/1/first_.en: It decided whether to split the convoy times or to open a separate collection route first, so as to avoid the ecological pressure on the sluice stairs.

/theaters/0/player_entry_points/1/place.en: the approach to the Imjin levee quarantine post

/theaters/0/player_entry_points/1/role.en: a field negotiator for collecting the evacuation leftovers and adjusting the passage window

/theaters/0/prose.en:
At a provisional quarantine post below the Imjin embankment, a Sangha Relief State guide held the repatriation register to the flashlight's light.

The Seocho Computing Group escort wet its wheels on the mud road outside the gate, and the Sinnae transfer window opened the family waiting line first.

A jusa clerk of the Gwanghwamun Republic of Korea Government pointed at the ink bleed of a forged kinship certificate, and the Achasan gate post split its sealing key into two pieces.

Neither side condemned the northern regime; they kept only passage and registers.

/theaters/0/routes/ai_custody.en: joint custody of the return-guidance terminals

/theaters/0/routes/monster_migration.en: watch on the northward movement of the migratory birds and the abandoned-dog pack

/theaters/0/routes/trade.en: nighttime detour boxes of grain and medicine

/theaters/0/scenario_chains/0/summary.en: At the Imjin provisional quarantine post the repatriation register is damaged and Jogyesa at Anguk demands reissue

/theaters/0/scenario_chains/1/summary.en: After the Gangnam group's escort stops outside the gate, Sinnae opens a detour transfer

/theaters/0/scenario_chains/2/summary.en: The Gwanghwamun complex screens forged kinship certificates and the Achasan gate splits the sealing key

/theaters/0/seoul_route/fixed_duration.en: Not set. Movement cost and openness were judged by water level, quarantine waits, passage rights, and the state of the refugee columns.

/theaters/0/seoul_route/outbound_boundar.en: The next waypoint beyond the Imjin embankment quarantine post and the actual manner of crossing the border were not set.

/theaters/0/seoul_route/route_design.en: Seoul-side movement cross-checked the rolls at Anguk and Gwanghwamun, split the family queue from the convoys at Sinnae, and reached the Imjin levee quarantine post through Guui's double seal. The Seocho Computing Group's Gangnam convoy had only the roles of preparation and joining, and was not fixed as a separate straight-line geographic node.

/theaters/0/seoul_route/staging_nodes/0.en: the roll cross-check window of Anguk and Gwanghwamun

/theaters/0/seoul_route/staging_nodes/3.en: the temporary quarantine post beneath the Imjin levee

/theaters/0/seoul_route/verified_geograp.en: Only the public terrain anchors — the Imjin–Han confluence and the northern transfer and refugee corridor — were used.

/theaters/0/state_interests/0/interest.en: It kept the continuity of return-roll reissue and of the family tablets and queue.

/theaters/0/state_interests/0/leverage.en: Anguk's custody of the rolls and its guide staff

/theaters/0/state_interests/0/red_line.en: It did not fix a family relation on a damaged copy alone.

/theaters/0/state_interests/1/interest.en: It kept the handover of convoys and emergency batteries unbroken.

/theaters/0/state_interests/1/leverage.en: preparation of the Gangnam convoy and the surviving cooling and computing keys

/theaters/0/state_interests/1/red_line.en: It did not turn custody of the batteries into a power to judge the rolls.

/theaters/0/state_interests/2/interest.en: It kept the neutral transfer of the family queue and of the medical and goods convoys.

/theaters/0/state_interests/2/leverage.en: the Sinnae transfer slots and the emergency-convoy ledger

/theaters/0/state_interests/2/red_line.en: It did not close the transfer window on one state's order alone.

/theaters/0/state_interests/3/interest.en: It screened the authenticity of kinship certificates and accreditation records by a public procedure.

/theaters/0/state_interests/3/leverage.en: the Gwanghwamun seal and the grammar of record accreditation

/theaters/0/state_interests/3/red_line.en: It did not judge a traveler an outside enemy on suspicion of forgery.

/theaters/0/state_interests/4/interest.en: It spread the safety responsibility for the gate seal and the departure window.

/theaters/0/state_interests/4/leverage.en: the sealing procedure of the Guui sluices and the Achasan outposts

/theaters/0/state_interests/4/red_line.en: It did not leave the sealing key in the sole custody of one person or one house.

/theaters/0/supply_chain/flows/0/content.en: nighttime detour boxes of grain and medicine

/theaters/0/supply_chain/flows/0/handoff.en: The sealing ledger of goods was kept separate from the family register, and at every hand-off the seal state and receipt signature were left together.

/theaters/0/supply_chain/flows/1/handoff.en: Even when the escort ran late, custody of the capacitors and the quarantine judgment of persons were never gathered into one hand.

/theaters/0/supply_chain/flows/2/content.en: the return-roll hashes and the family-reunion queue

/theaters/0/supply_chain/flows/2/handoff.en: Reissue records never replaced the original; damage facts, issuer, and collation grounds were left on separate lines.

/theaters/0/supply_chain/separation_rule.en: Medicine and food boxes, repatriation registers, and sealing keys passed through different hand-off procedures. One suspicion or delay never became grounds for the automatic refusal of another item.

/theaters/0/travel_constraints/rule.en: Closure was recorded not as deletion of the passage but as a state change carrying cause and reopening conditions.

/theaters/0/travel_constraints/seasonal_.en: In the rainy season the flood level and the state of levee access changed whether the sluice stairs and the quarantine post stood open.
In the dry season and in winter, the ecological pressure that followed food traces could overlap the passage along the northwestern edge.
On days when the bird migration overlapped, the low-noise window and the slow-speed window of the bridge and depot lead tracks were adjusted together.

/theaters/0/travel_constraints/suspensio.en: when the cross-check of the roll's original and its copies was unfinished
when custody of the two halves of the sealing key was unconfirmed
when the water-level warning and the evacuation leftovers occupied the same stairs

/theaters/0/verified.en: Only the public geographic positions of the Imjin–Han confluence and the northern transfer and refugee corridors were used as fact anchors. No crimes or policy claims of current regimes or sitting institutions were recorded.

/theaters/1/checkpoints/0/function.en: It cross-checked the current state of the tide table and the drainage valves.

/theaters/1/checkpoints/0/place.en: the Yeongdeungpo sluice and treatment watch

/theaters/1/checkpoints/1/checks/1.en: the compressor noise and condition record

/theaters/1/checkpoints/1/function.en: It confirmed the compatibility of the compressor parts and the cargo seal hashes.

/theaters/1/checkpoints/1/place.en: the Guro standards window and the Yeouido seal ledger

/theaters/1/checkpoints/2/checks/2.en: the state of the split crane keys

/theaters/1/checkpoints/2/function.en: It handled the quarantine of cold boxes, the loading order, and the handover of the night patrol.

/theaters/1/checkpoints/2/place.en: the temporary wharf at the Han River estuary

/theaters/1/explicit_unknowns/0.en: Ports, production sites, sailing routes, and travel times beyond the estuary were not set.

/theaters/1/explicit_unknowns/1.en: The names and policies of outside traders, seamen, and organs were not set.

/theaters/1/explicit_unknowns/2.en: Frozen and grain volumes, ship types, and counts were not set.

/theaters/1/explicit_unknowns/3.en: Outside languages were designated apart from interpretation requests.

/theaters/1/hostile_ecology_interaction/.en: When the sea wind overlapped the breeding season, the Radio-Wave Crow Flock made a shared perch over the bridge and transmission inspection hatches.
Instead of pushing the nests out all at once, relocation poles and a retained stretch were used.
Umbrella columns, substitute perches, and a shifted maintenance hour separated people from the nests.
When the sea noise strengthened, the alarm radius of the Surveillance-Orbit Swarm along the southwestern waterfront could widen.
Instead of destroying the masts wholesale, only the head that raised the false alarm was left on standby.
False alarms were separated by cross-checking the band filter against the medical and sluice markers.
A change in the tide could shift both the Water Compact's drainage hour and the Deep-Trilobite Swarm's return line.
A full drainage could cut the temporary water carriage, so it was not used as an automatic solution.
The work tables of the manual inspection gate and the reference buoy were separated, preserving people's passage.

/theaters/1/inference.en: Only the inference stood that West Sea grain and frozen freight were sensitive to tides and power cuts; other states' official policies were not asserted.

/theaters/1/language_rumor_protocol/inte.en: The coastal interpretation window was a place that connected requested interpretation to Seoul's existing corridors. Outside languages and groups were not designated in advance.

/theaters/1/language_rumor_protocol/proh.en: From word-of-mouth or interpretation need alone, no outside trader's policy, freight's illegality, or traveler's affiliation was fixed.

/theaters/1/language_rumor_protocol/reco.en: The Seoul-side dock and sluice ledgers were kept in Korean.

/theaters/1/language_rumor_protocol/rumo.en: Two or more of tide, temperature, and seal records matched independently, and the hand-off agent was confirmed.
Only a box's or a dock's record remained, needing remeasurement or re-collation.
Only talk of a dead cold shed or outside freight, without temperature, seal, or receipt records.

/theaters/1/opening_event/conflict.en: The watch demanding sluice safety first collided with the dock demanding reduced loss of frozen freight.

/theaters/1/opening_event/player_decisio.en: Choose whether to disclose freezer-box isolation and loading delay, or secure the drainage window first and leave the damage risk in the ledger.

/theaters/1/opening_event/timeline_place.en: It was a devised event proposed to run alongside the third water compact of the day in 2126.

/theaters/1/opening_event/trigger.en: A West Sea tide shift changed the Yeouido sluice drainage schedule and the estuary dock loading order at once.

/theaters/1/original_fiction.en: The West Sea Granary Theater was a creative trade corridor in which Yeongdeungpo, Guro, Yeouido, Yangjae, and Heukseok jointly inspected the estuary docks and frozen credit.

/theaters/1/player_entry_points/0/first_.en: It decided whether to post the sluice safety window before the wharf's loading request.

/theaters/1/player_entry_points/0/role.en: an assistant cross-checking the tide table against the drainage-valve record

/theaters/1/player_entry_points/1/first_.en: It decided whether to quarantine the boxes whose seal hash did not match or to hold the loading until they were measured again.

/theaters/1/player_entry_points/1/place.en: the temporary wharf at the Han River estuary

/theaters/1/player_entry_points/1/role.en: a field handover officer separating and recording cargo with damaged seals

/theaters/1/prose.en:
At the Han estuary provisional dock, the Water Compact sluice watch matched the tide table against the drainage valve.

The Standards Alliance director listened to the freezer compressor noise and changed the parts order, and the Yangjae Machineworks Company deputy set apart only the boxes whose seal hash was broken.

The Won Buddhist dharma officer did not erase the south-bank freezing order even when the power warning lamp lit.

The Yeouido Investment Union circulated only the dock safety bulletin, not price slogans.

/theaters/1/routes/ai_custody.en: split custody of the stevedore crane control keys

/theaters/1/routes/data.en: the ledger of cargo seal hashes

/theaters/1/routes/energy.en: rotation of the wharf emergency generators

/theaters/1/routes/monster_migration.en: watch on the coastal movement of the sewer raccoons and the transfer rats

/theaters/1/routes/security.en: rotation of the wharf night patrol

/theaters/1/routes/trade.en: auction of estuary grain and cold boxes

/theaters/1/scenario_chains/0/summary.en: The Yeouido sluice re-plans dock drainage to match the West Sea tide

/theaters/1/scenario_chains/1/summary.en: The southwestern fabrication window divides freezer compressor parts and Magok verifies the instrumentation logs

/theaters/1/scenario_chains/2/summary.en: When Noryangjin ice credit shakes, Sangam transmission relays only the auction broadcast

/theaters/1/seoul_route/fixed_duration.en: Not set. Tide, drainage, power, freezing state, and passage rights set the cost and waiting of freight movement.

/theaters/1/seoul_route/outbound_boundar.en: Ports, production sites, and sailing routes beyond the estuary dock were not set.

/theaters/1/seoul_route/route_design.en: Cargo had its tide and drainage checked at Yeongdeungpo, its freezer compressors and part standards cross-checked at Guro, and, after Yeouido's seal hash, took its loading order at the temporary estuary wharf. Yangjae and Heukseok were kept as Seoul-side cooperating nodes for repair support and for adjusting the cold-storage order.

/theaters/1/seoul_route/staging_nodes/0.en: the Yeongdeungpo sluice and treatment watch

/theaters/1/seoul_route/staging_nodes/1.en: Guro's compressor and standards cross-check window

/theaters/1/seoul_route/staging_nodes/3.en: the temporary wharf at the Han River estuary

/theaters/1/seoul_route/verified_geograp.en: Only the public market and plant positions of the West Sea coast, the Han estuary waterway, and the Gangseo–Yeongdeungpo belt were used as fact anchors.

/theaters/1/state_interests/0/interest.en: It managed estuary access while keeping the tide, drainage, and treatment safe.

/theaters/1/state_interests/0/leverage.en: the Yeongdeungpo sluice and treatment watch

/theaters/1/state_interests/0/red_line.en: It did not hide the sluice safety record on the grounds of a loading delay.

/theaters/1/state_interests/1/interest.en: It kept the standards compatibility of the freezer compressors and the stevedore equipment.

/theaters/1/state_interests/1/leverage.en: the parts and repair standards of the Guro complex

/theaters/1/state_interests/1/red_line.en: It did not lay a standards mismatch on one particular interpretation corridor.

/theaters/1/state_interests/2/interest.en: It took charge of separating damaged cargo and handing over the repair equipment.

/theaters/1/state_interests/2/leverage.en: capacity for bodywork, rigging, and field repair

/theaters/1/state_interests/2/red_line.en: It did not mix a box with a damaged seal into the ordinary cargo.

/theaters/1/state_interests/3/interest.en: It kept the continuity of the cold-storage order and the rations on the Han River's south bank.

/theaters/1/state_interests/3/leverage.en: Heukseok's chapel watch and the cold-storage order ledger

/theaters/1/state_interests/3/red_line.en: It did not strike a vulnerable queue's place on a power warning alone.

/theaters/1/state_interests/4/interest.en: It left the seal, auction, and wharf-safety circulars as a ledger that could be published.

/theaters/1/state_interests/4/leverage.en: the Yeouido investment ledgers and the transmission memory

/theaters/1/state_interests/4/red_line.en: It did not let a price slogan stand in for seal verification or the safety circular.

/theaters/1/supply_chain/flows/0/handoff.en: Entered the auction and ration ledgers only when both the physical temperature record and the seal hash matched.

/theaters/1/supply_chain/flows/1/content.en: freezer compressor parts and the rotation of the wharf emergency generators

/theaters/1/supply_chain/flows/1/handoff.en: The parts order was kept separate from ownership claims on freezer boxes, and the standards-collation result was left first.

/theaters/1/supply_chain/flows/2/content.en: the cargo seal hashes and the ledger of the sailors' families' temporary lodgings

/theaters/1/supply_chain/flows/2/handoff.en: The lodging queue was never automatically tied to freight price or responsibility for broken seals.

/theaters/1/supply_chain/separation_rule.en: Frozen credit never replaced physical state, and one box's damage was never grounds for judging the origin and safety of the whole dock.

/theaters/1/travel_constraints/rule.en: Links blocked by tide or power were not erased from the map; they remained as sections carrying danger, control, and repair conditions.

/theaters/1/travel_constraints/seasonal_.en: The tide and the state of estuary drainage changed wharf access and the loading order.
When the sea wind overlapped the breeding season, the passage rules over the bridge and transmission inspection hatches were adjusted.
Instability in the cold-storage power demanded the order of verification and quarantine before the movement of cargo.

/theaters/1/travel_constraints/suspensio.en: when the tide table and the drainage-valve record did not agree
when a cold box's temperature record and its seal hash disagreed
when the split custody of the stevedore crane control keys had collapsed

/theaters/1/verified.en: Only the public market and plant positions of the West Sea coast, the Han estuary waterway, and the Gangseo–Yeongdeungpo belt were used as fact anchors. No suspected illegal trade by specific current state organs was written.

/theaters/2/checkpoints/0/function.en: It compared the three-branch relay table with the transshipment ledger and recorded the relay choice.

/theaters/2/checkpoints/1/function.en: It confirmed separately the form of the inland turnback right and of the marriage and memorial accreditation seals.

/theaters/2/checkpoints/1/place.en: the City Hall turnback window and the Myeongdong accreditation window

/theaters/2/checkpoints/2/function.en: It handled separately the cross-check of the sealed cargo and of the loanword annotation.

/theaters/2/checkpoints/2/place.en: the Samseong sealed window and the Heukseok interpretation window

/theaters/2/explicit_unknowns/0.en: The outside termini, actual sea routes, and sailing times of the three relay legs were not set.

/theaters/2/explicit_unknowns/1.en: Outside polities, organs, persons, and the content of canon-link tables were not set.

/theaters/2/explicit_unknowns/2.en: Specific seasonal windows of the strait and freight volumes were not set.

/theaters/2/explicit_unknowns/3.en: Outside languages were designated apart from Seoul's interpretation requests.

/theaters/2/hostile_ecology_interaction/.en: When the strait-side logistics vibration overlapped a break in feeding, the Abandoned-Dog Iron Pack could ring the freezer approaches.
The pack was not treated as a single hostile body, and no order of slaughter was used.
Feeding zones by family and shaded passages were laid out, separating the stevedore approaches.
Dust and pressure changes at the relay wharf could unsettle the Cleanroom Mutant's judgment of the protection doors.
The doors were not all opened without authority for the sake of a medical convoy.
Differential pressure, grounding, and the rolls were not combined on one key; the approval record of each door was cross-checked.
Transshipment vibration could mix the Retired-Line Maintenance-Train Corps' defect map with the real crack coordinates.
Instead of destroying the cars, the wrongly connected defect map was withdrawn.
The exclusion list stamped with the original hash was loaded to the onboard port, and a manual tow route was left.

/theaters/2/inference.en: The inference that three sea relay legs split the demand for necessities, parts, and interpretation was a creative premise; the Seoul-side narrative survived with the private link table removed.

/theaters/2/language_rumor_protocol/inte.en: The existing interpretation resources of Itaewon and Heukseok were used only as Seoul-side resources to collate requested speech. Outside languages, outside state names, and speakers' affiliations were not designated.

/theaters/2/language_rumor_protocol/proh.en: From one relay table or one untranslated word alone, no outside polity's intent, the cause of a lane's closure, or a speaker's identity was fixed.

/theaters/2/language_rumor_protocol/reco.en: The Seoul-side accord ledgers were kept against the Korean annotations.

/theaters/2/language_rumor_protocol/rumo.en: Mutually independent freight records and interpretation originals and annotations matched, and the hand-off authority was confirmed.
Mismatches remained among the relay tables, though part of the seal and turn records was confirmed.
The three relays told different stories, unconfirmed by originals, receipts, or freight records.

/theaters/2/opening_event/conflict.en: The records side demanding the relay mismatch be solved first collided with the escort side demanding the limited turn line be used first.

/theaters/2/opening_event/player_decisio.en: Choose whether to quarantine the boxes with interpretation mismatches, or turn them onto the limited inland route and publish the held records.

/theaters/2/opening_event/timeline_place.en: It was a devised event proposed to run alongside the third water compact of the day in 2126.

/theaters/2/opening_event/trigger.en: At the Yongsan transshipment shed one of the three relay legs closed, and the Suseo substitute turn line opened.

/theaters/2/original_fiction.en: The Korea Strait Theater was a Seoul creative sea route in which Yongsan, City Hall, Myeongdong, Samsung, and Heukseok ran the three-leg relay docks and the interpretation windows. The canon-link table was detachable at any time.

/theaters/2/player_entry_points/0/first_.en: It decided which record to withhold, and did not raise the hearsay of a closed relay to fact.

/theaters/2/player_entry_points/0/role.en: an interpretation assistant cross-checking the relay table against the transshipment ledger

/theaters/2/player_entry_points/1/first_.en: It decided whether to leave the clash of terms on record or to delay the cargo handover until the cross-check was finished.

/theaters/2/player_entry_points/1/role.en: a registrar binding the original, the Korean annotation, and the consent to receipt

/theaters/2/prose.en:
Before the Line Succession State transshipment window, the signboards of the three relay legs blurred in the rain.

The Jeongdong General Labor Union branch chairman opened inland turn slots instead of the closed lane, and the Cathedral Accreditation State priest fixed the marriage and memorial accreditation seals.

The Sermon Registry State deacon handed over only sealed boxes and did not step into border talk.

The Heukseok interpretation window wrote foreign words beside Korean annotations, so the accord survived even with the private link table cleared away.

/theaters/2/routes/ai_custody.en: three-party custody of the navigation-aid terminals

/theaters/2/routes/diaspora.en: counseling for mixed and returning families

/theaters/2/routes/energy.en: reservation of the wharf charging slots

/theaters/2/routes/monster_migration.en: watch on the coastal detour of the Migratory-Wetland Predator Swarm

/theaters/2/routes/security.en: a minimally armed patrol of the relay wharf

/theaters/2/routes/trade.en: a three-way relay of parts, medicine, and canned goods

/theaters/2/scenario_chains/0/summary.en: The Yongsan shed closes one of three legs and Suseo opens a substitute turn line

/theaters/2/scenario_chains/1/summary.en: Garak rations reallocate the canned-goods quota and the Ttukseom workshops send sealed tools

/theaters/2/scenario_chains/2/summary.en: The Noryangjin interpretation window records a term clash and keeps the accord alive without the private link table

/theaters/2/seoul_route/fixed_duration.en: Not set. Relay-table mismatches, dock power, seal state, inland turns, and interpretation checks set waiting and movement cost.

/theaters/2/seoul_route/outbound_boundar.en: The outside termini, actual sea routes, and counterpart parties of the three-leg relay dock were not set.

/theaters/2/seoul_route/route_design.en: At Yongsan the relay tables were cross-checked against the transshipment ledgers, and after inland turnback slots were secured at City Hall, Myeongdong's accreditation seals and Samseong's sealed cargo were attached to Heukseok's Korean annotation and handed to the three-branch relay wharf. Suseo was the substitute turnback line used when one route closed, and was not fixed as a maritime terminus.

/theaters/2/seoul_route/verified_geograp.en: Only the sea distance between the Korean Peninsula and the Japanese archipelago and the general concept of public sea lanes were used as fact anchors.

/theaters/2/state_interests/0/interest.en: It kept the connection between the Yongsan transshipment and the three-branch relay unbroken.

/theaters/2/state_interests/0/leverage.en: the operating memory of the central transshipment ledger and the fence keys

/theaters/2/state_interests/0/red_line.en: It did not automatically pass the risk of one closed route onto another turnback line.

/theaters/2/state_interests/1/interest.en: It published the passage conditions of the inland turnback and the carrying labor.

/theaters/2/state_interests/1/leverage.en: the City Hall turnback line and the passage right of the strike rolls

/theaters/2/state_interests/1/red_line.en: It did not hand cargo with no interpretation to the workers unilaterally.

/theaters/2/state_interests/2/interest.en: It kept the form of the marriage and memorial accreditation seals and the continuity of family counseling.

/theaters/2/state_interests/2/leverage.en: the Myeongdong altar and the diocesan rolls

/theaters/2/state_interests/2/red_line.en: It did not use an accreditation seal as a judgment of borders or outside politics.

/theaters/2/state_interests/3/interest.en: It made plain the custody of the sealed boxes and the relief goods.

/theaters/2/state_interests/3/leverage.en: the Samsung Station chapel rolls and the custom of custody

/theaters/2/state_interests/3/red_line.en: It did not skip verification of sealed cargo on the grounds of a border story.

/theaters/2/state_interests/4/interest.en: It kept trust in the Heukseok interpretation window and the ration link.

/theaters/2/state_interests/4/leverage.en: the chapel watch and the Korean annotation ledger

/theaters/2/state_interests/4/red_line.en: It did not fix a clash of terms as the fault of one interpreter or one family.

/theaters/2/supply_chain/flows/0/content.en: parts, medicine, canned goods, and sealed tools

/theaters/2/supply_chain/flows/0/handoff.en: Seal state, receipt responsibility for tools, and interpretation annotations were left in parallel on the same hand-off record.

/theaters/2/supply_chain/flows/1/content.en: reservation of the wharf charging slots

/theaters/2/supply_chain/flows/1/handoff.en: A charging slot never replaced custody of navigation-aid terminals or passage accreditation.

/theaters/2/supply_chain/flows/2/content.en: the interpretation glossary, the quarantine waiting of returning sailors, and the family-counseling records

/theaters/2/supply_chain/flows/2/handoff.en: A term clash was not treated as the translator's defect; original text, annotation, and speech context were held together.

/theaters/2/supply_chain/separation_rule.en: Marriage and memorial accreditation, interpretation annotations, freight seals, and quarantine waits were handled under different authorities.

/theaters/2/travel_constraints/rule.en: Even when one relay closed, the remaining relays did not automatically absorb the same freight and risk.

/theaters/2/travel_constraints/seasonal_.en: No particular season or sailing day of the strait was fixed; only sea state, relay-wharf power, and seal damage were left as dynamic states.
When the logistics vibration grew, the Seoul-side ecological pressure at the freezer approaches and the stevedore-yard entrances could rise.
When dust and differential-pressure trouble appeared, the medical and goods convoys went through a protection procedure separate from the interpretation check.

/theaters/2/travel_constraints/suspensio.en: when the relay table's terms did not cross-check against the Korean annotation
when the handover record of a sealed box had broken off
when the right of passage on the substitute turnback line was unconfirmed

/theaters/2/verified.en: Only the sea distance between the Korean Peninsula and the Japanese archipelago and the concept of public sea lanes were used as fact anchors. Proper state names, persons, lines, and chronology sentences of the original work were not placed in the public text.

/theaters/3/checkpoints/0/checks/2.en: the state of the seal before receipt

/theaters/3/checkpoints/0/function.en: It published the freight-car weight log and the yard safety record.

/theaters/3/checkpoints/1/function.en: It assigned the detour slots and the winter fuel order separately.

/theaters/3/checkpoints/1/place.en: the Sinnae transfer window and the Gangnam fuel queue

/theaters/3/checkpoints/2/function.en: It confirmed separately the frostbite treatment and the origin evidence with its double seal.

/theaters/3/checkpoints/2/place.en: the Jegi-dong infirmary and Guui's seal window

/theaters/3/explicit_unknowns/0.en: The rail terminus outside Seoul, the actual detour, and travel times were not set.

/theaters/3/explicit_unknowns/1.en: The kinds and volumes of outside minerals and fuel and the outside suppliers were not set.

/theaters/3/explicit_unknowns/2.en: The names and acts of outside governments, state enterprises, and armed groups were not set.

/theaters/3/explicit_unknowns/3.en: Outside languages and returning laborers' origins were fixed only by counseling interpretation requests.

/theaters/3/hostile_ecology_interaction/.en: The cold wave and the break in logistics could change the Sewer-Raccoon Pack's feed density and its movement on the eastern branch lines.
Poison bait and wholesale flooding raised the risk to water quality and of intrusion above ground, so they were not used.
Substitute shelter pipes and heated permitted zones were opened, separating the pump approaches from the family groups.
If the mineral and fuel cars took the coolant first, the outer warehouses the Cryo-Spore Host depended on could be emptied first.
Neither broadcast cooling nor food preservation was hidden and sacrificed.
The cold boundary and the temperature record of each warehouse were published, separating the cost of fuel from the cost of cooling.
A freight-car weight signal mixed in from XT04 could raise the Phantom Dispatch Corps' priority on the long-distance slots.
Instead of breaking the empty cars, the token and the pad power were separated in stages.
Only signed slots were kept, and the share of emergency slots was separated, diverting the empty-car loop.
Fuel cars and heavy tows could press on the load verification of sidings and temporary structures.
Blowing the power core was not used as the default solution for opening passage.
The tow was divided between a published load test and a safe rail guide.

/theaters/3/inference.en: The inference that rare earths, fuel, and rail parts came in through the northeastern detour after the collapse was limited to a creative logistics premise.

/theaters/3/language_rumor_protocol/inte.en: When returnee counseling needed interpretation, Seoul's existing corridors were connected under the requester's consent. Outside languages and counselors' origins were not designated in this data.

/theaters/3/language_rumor_protocol/proh.en: From an origin-tag mismatch or interpretation need alone, no outside government's or company's acts, a laborer's affiliation, or freight's criminality was fixed.

/theaters/3/language_rumor_protocol/reco.en: The Seoul-side weight, fuel, medical, and seal ledgers were kept in Korean.

/theaters/3/language_rumor_protocol/rumo.en: Weight logs and seal or receipt records matched independently, or medical records and the actual hand-off were collated.
Only the fire mark, origin tag, or a single car's record remained, with seal and weight collation outstanding.
Only talk of the departure of outside minerals, fuel, or returnees, without car, seal, or receipt records.

/theaters/3/opening_event/conflict.en: The demand to publish the weight anomaly at once collided with the demand to avoid delay in the winter fuel queue.

/theaters/3/opening_event/player_decisio.en: Choose whether to assign the medical convoy window before the fuel cars, or to finish reweighing and then open both hand-offs together.

/theaters/3/opening_event/timeline_place.en: It was a devised event proposed to run alongside the third water compact of the day in 2126.

/theaters/3/opening_event/trigger.en: The Amsa yard's weight logs showed one car's anomaly, and Sinnae reassigned the transfer slots.

/theaters/3/original_fiction.en: The Duman River Far East Theater was a Seoul creative inland corridor in which Amsa, Sinnae, Gangnam, Jegi-dong, and Guui divided the rail detour and the mineral and fuel inspection.

/theaters/3/player_entry_points/0/first_.en: It decided whether to post the anomalous log on the public board or to send only that car to a detour slot while it was measured again.

/theaters/3/player_entry_points/0/role.en: a field assistant cross-checking the weight log against the seal record

/theaters/3/player_entry_points/1/first_.en: It decided whether to move first the people who needed treatment, apart from the review of the freight-car evidence.

/theaters/3/player_entry_points/1/role.en: an assistant recording the frostbite treatment and the convoy handover separately

/theaters/3/prose.en:
In the Escort Protection State's freight yard, a car's weight sensor jumped too high for one car alone.

The Neutral Convoy City escort put that car into the detour slot, and the Seocho Computing Group deputy rewrote the winter fuel drum order.

The Medical Neutrality League sickbay dried the gloves of a frostbitten returning laborer, and the Gate Military Government company commander sealed the forged origin tag into an evidence envelope instead of the stove.

No one's government was condemned; only freight cars and people were inspected.

/theaters/3/routes/ai_custody.en: joint lock on the locomotive's assisting AI

/theaters/3/routes/diaspora.en: counseling for returnees from Central Asia and Sakhalin

/theaters/3/routes/monster_migration.en: watch on the movement of the Retired-Line Maintenance-Train Corps and the iron-scale

/theaters/3/routes/refugee.en: lodgings for returning Far East workers

/theaters/3/routes/security.en: double confirmation of the freight-car seals

/theaters/3/routes/trade.en: inspection of rail parts and mineral samples

/theaters/3/scenario_chains/0/summary.en: The Amsa waterworks unit publishes the freight weight logs and Sinnae adjusts the transfer slots

/theaters/3/scenario_chains/1/summary.en: The Changdong wheel works divides the winter fuel queue and Jegi-dong receives the frostbitten

/theaters/3/scenario_chains/2/summary.en: The Achasan gate inspects the mineral-sample seals and scraps the forged origin tags

/theaters/3/seoul_route/fixed_duration.en: Not set. Cold snaps, fuel, coolant, load verification, transfer slots, and medical need set movement cost and waiting.

/theaters/3/seoul_route/outbound_boundar.en: The rail terminus outside Seoul, the detour's actual waypoints, and the origin of outside freight cars were not set.

/theaters/3/seoul_route/route_design.en: At Amsa the freight-car weight and yard safety were confirmed, and after detour slots were assigned at Sinnae, Gangnam's fuel queue and Jegi-dong's medical handover were handled separately. Guui's seal window was the last Seoul-side procedure confirming the mineral samples and the freight-car evidence, and the actual alignment of the northeastern departure window was not fixed.

/theaters/3/seoul_route/staging_nodes/0.en: the Amsa yard and the weight-log window

/theaters/3/seoul_route/verified_geograp.en: Only the geographic concepts of the continental rail and the far-east energy corridor were used as fact anchors.

/theaters/3/state_interests/0/interest.en: It kept the Amsa yard safe and the protection of the eastern water and depots.

/theaters/3/state_interests/0/leverage.en: the emergency superintendence of the Amsa waterworks and Godeok Depot

/theaters/3/state_interests/0/red_line.en: It did not turn the weight log private on the grounds of yard safety.

/theaters/3/state_interests/1/interest.en: It kept the neutrality of the detour slots and of the medical and goods convoys.

/theaters/3/state_interests/1/leverage.en: the Sinnae transfer and the emergency-convoy ledger

/theaters/3/state_interests/1/red_line.en: The fuel queue did not automatically erase a medical convoy's right of passage.

/theaters/3/state_interests/2/interest.en: It kept the winter fuel ration queue and the preparation of the convoys.

/theaters/3/state_interests/2/leverage.en: the Gangnam cooling key and the fuel-order ledger

/theaters/3/state_interests/2/red_line.en: It did not use a fuel drum's place in the order as the price of an origin judgment.

/theaters/3/state_interests/3/interest.en: It carried on the treatment of frostbite patients and returning workers without distinguishing enemies.

/theaters/3/state_interests/3/leverage.en: the Jegi-dong medicinal ledger and the treatment contract

/theaters/3/state_interests/3/red_line.en: It did not turn the need for treatment into grounds for a freight-car search or a requisition.

/theaters/3/state_interests/4/interest.en: It kept the double seal on the mineral samples and the freight-car evidence.

/theaters/3/state_interests/4/leverage.en: the procedure of the Guui sluices and the Achasan gate

/theaters/3/state_interests/4/red_line.en: It neither destroyed a mark of unknown origin nor let one side judge it alone.

/theaters/3/supply_chain/flows/0/handoff.en: Sample seals and the use-approval records of rail parts were separated; unknown origin was not automatic grounds for disposal or punishment.

/theaters/3/supply_chain/flows/1/content.en: winter fuel drums and the ration queue

/theaters/3/supply_chain/flows/1/handoff.en: The fuel order was adjusted after the weight logs were published, but the medical convoy's space was never locked out alone.

/theaters/3/supply_chain/flows/2/content.en: lodgings for returning workers and frostbite treatment

/theaters/3/supply_chain/flows/2/handoff.en: Medical triage was separated from the freight evidence, and post-treatment custody remained in the ledger.

/theaters/3/supply_chain/separation_rule.en: Freight cars, minerals, fuel, returning laborers, and medical records could meet at one checkpoint but were never refused together on one suspicion.

/theaters/3/travel_constraints/rule.en: Cold-snap and load hazards were recorded only as the section's safety state, never as grounds for judging the origin of people, fuel, or minerals.

/theaters/3/travel_constraints/seasonal_.en: The cold wave and the break in logistics changed the distribution of feed, waste, and fuel, and raised the passage burden on Seoul's eastern branch lines.
After the thaw, return passage opened only once the conduits and inspection windows closed by the cold wave had been re-examined.
Winter fuel and coolant could show the same shortage signal, but neither gained an automatic priority over the other.

/theaters/3/travel_constraints/suspensio.en: when the weight-sensor log did not agree with the seal record
when the need to move a frostbite patient was confirmed but no medical-convoy slot existed

/hostile_groups/5/combat_counterplay.en:
Instead of gunfire and mass net capture, water-level control, fish-meal refuse collection, substitute perches, low-noise work hours, and drone altitude limits were the baseline.

A full removal that separated protection from harm by appearance alone lost the justification and the legitimacy of ecological restoration at the same time.

The success measures were sluice-sightline secure time, zero train-bird collisions, yard-track intrusion count, and water turbidity.

/hostile_groups/5/negotiation.en:
HC06 provided open water to the waterfowl, shallow mud edges to the waders, and substitute perches outside the entry and exit tracks to the raptors, each separately.

It adjusted the wetland water-level schedule, the fishing and collection ban hours, and the bridge-passage peaks by functional group, and during an XT01 migratory week it announced the train slowdown hours and the low-noise inspection hours together.

/hostile_groups/5/moral_cost.en:
A full removal of the colony to cover a failed restoration collapsed downstream purification and the stopover network, and drying the water only for the sluice sightline struck the citizens with dust, stench, and an inflow of other predators.

Trafficking that wore the mask of a protected species also closed the negotiation window.

/hostile_groups/5/dossier_prose.en:
The G06 Migratory-Wetland Predator Swarm was a mixed assemblage formed as several bird functional groups overlapped on the severed green spaces and the wetland fragments whose restoration had failed, across the Han River, Nanji, and Amsa area.

The waterfront record deck of the Republic of Korea Government at Seoul Station Central and the depot drainage ponds of the Seocho Computing Group on the Gangnam Line were the core stopovers, and the raptors followed the places where the waterfowl and waders looked for food.

When the bridge walkways, the sluice observation lines, and the air over the depot yard tracks were occupied at the same time, citizens easily took the huge bird flock for one hostile group.

But they had no unified command system and no purpose of attacking the city.

Real migratory-bird arrival sites and protected wetlands were only a reference range for understanding place and movement ecology, and the negotiation rules that exchanged different functional groups for water level and timetable were fiction limited to this world.

The success or failure of actual protection work was not to be reduced to the responsibility of a particular institution either.

The territory of the Migratory-Wetland Predator Swarm was not a fixed boundary but a connected net that moved with water, wind, and the density of food.

In ordinary times the shallow water and mud edges at Seoul Station Central, and the drainage ponds and wire perches of the Gangnam Line, became the center.

In the seasonal movement period they went back and forth between north and south along the wind road toward the XT01 Imjin River Gate Theater, and on days when stopover and movement overlapped they occupied even the bridges, the sluices, and the depot entry and exit tracks.

When the wetland dried they scattered to the fountains of inland parks and the rooftop gutters, but this was not the end of a migration. It was a temporary move looking for the next water.

The waterfowl ate aquatic plants and organic floating matter, the waders the benthic life of shallow water, and the raptors rodents and weak birds.

The shorter the distance between safe perches, feeding grounds, and shallow water, the longer the assemblage stayed.

HC06 the Noryangjin Delivery House tried to secure the sluice sightline. When it lowered the wetland water level one-sidedly, the waterfowl moved to the Gangnam Line drainage ponds, and the waders concentrated on the exposed mud edges.

The raptors followed that density and shifted to the depot wires and pylons.

If, on the contrary, the water level was fixed steady, the stopover stabilized, but the head count rose and the risk of collision between trains and birds grew too.

In spring and autumn the waterfowl and waders arrived first, and the raptors appeared after the food had become sufficient.

The depot ponds were not a breeding ground but an intermediate stopover, so when the water level dropped sharply the waterfowl left first. The food relationship of the remaining waders and raptors also came apart in turn.

Removing or driving out only one functional group did not end the problem. It changed the space use of the other functional groups in a direction no one had expected.

This assemblage depended heavily on vision.

Water-surface glare, the color of work vests, and drone silhouettes set off takeoff and avoidance, and engine noise, gunshots, and warning loudspeakers became clues for judging the distance and direction of danger.

They also responded to the smell of fish meal and rot, but they did not understand electronic signals.

H06 Baksol's radar-based altitude classification could catch a large movement early, but it could confuse balloons, drones, and bird flocks, so confirmation by eye was needed.

The waterfowl occupied the open water as a flock, the waders kept a set interval and worked the edges, and the raptors watched the density of the two functional groups from the high wires and pylons.

When H06 summed them into one hostile score, the HC06 ecology watch recorded altitude, water-surface zone, and head count again by functional group.

Individuals learned the repeating train times and the low-noise inspection hours.

A movement route that changed within one season was the result of this learning, and a change in movement season across many generations was distinguished as selection pressure applied by food and climate.

Individuals grown used to the city's timetable used the set slowdown sections as a safety signal, but by that much they could grow dull to the irregular dangers of a natural wetland.

The situation began with a rearrangement of the water surface.

When the waterfowl were pushed onto narrow water and the waders spread as far as the trackside inspection walkways, one raptor pursuit sent the whole flock surging up.

That was the chain flush that crossed the sluice sightlines and the entry and exit tracks.

When the same collision repeated three times, it passed not into culling but into the seasonal running-agreement stage, and train slowdowns, yard-track closures, and water-surface sections had to be adjusted together.

Gunfire and mass net capture looked fast, but they scattered the assemblage unpredictably and lost ecological legitimacy as well.

The baseline response was water-level control by section, fish-meal refuse collection, substitute perches installed outside the entry and exit tracks, securing low-noise work hours, and drone altitude limits.

HC06 provided open water to the waterfowl, shallow mud edges to the waders, and high perches outside the tracks to the raptors, each separately.

During an XT01 migratory week it announced the train slowdown hours and the low-noise inspection hours together, and adjusted the fishing and collection ban hours by functional group as well.

Success was judged not by the number of individuals driven off but by sluice-sightline secure time, zero train-bird collisions, yard-track intrusion count, and water turbidity.

Sorting the birds to protect from the birds to remove by appearance alone also widened the room for trafficking and mistaken capture to enter.

G06-SC1, 'Three Functional Groups in the Shallow Water,' began when the water level at Seoul Station Central fell and waterfowl, waders, and raptors overlapped on one narrow water.

Seoul Station Central and HC06 could run the pumps harder and make the water level differ by section.

The open water and the mud edges separated and collisions fell, but labor and energy use rose.

Making a new wader feeding ground outside the depot could reduce the edge concentration, but the cost of land and dredging had to be accepted.

Installing substitute raptor perches on the wetland outskirts could lower yard-track collisions, but the rodent-predation location could shift toward the dwellings.

H06's observation material had to show the positions and food relationships of the three functional groups together, rather than pointing at one kind of bird as the cause.

In G06-SC2, 'The Birds That Learned the Timetable,' after the slowdown hours at the Gangnam Line depot changed, the stopover flock surged up in time with the track inspection hours.

The waterfowl had learned the previous slowdown hours as a safe takeoff signal, and the raptors had learned the flock that dropped then as a hunting opportunity, so the two learnings collided with the new timetable.

Restoring the slowdown hours made collision prediction easier, but evacuation and logistics slowed.

Installing substitute perches by functional group could separate the routes over the long term, but continuous maintenance and observation were needed.

Dispersing them at once with horns and drones could empty the tracks for the moment, but it broke the learning by which the birds had connected running signals to safety hours, and made the next movement more irregular.

Whether the safety rules wild animals had accumulated could be changed one-sidedly for the sake of human running efficiency became the core dispute among S06, the Gangnam Line, HC06, and H06.

G06-SC3, 'The Tracks of Migratory Week,' occurred when a large movement from the XT01 direction overlapped a sluice inspection and the bridge walkways and the depot entry and exit tracks were occupied repeatedly.

Waterfowl takeoff from the water, wader movement along the edges, and raptor pursuit made a chain of collisions at different heights.

Cutting the running to match the migratory timetable reduced the chance of collision most directly, but evacuation and logistics slowed.

Expanding the water-surface and perch sections could separate the functional groups, but the citizens' walking space and the depot work space had to be reduced.

Drying the water and sending the assemblage out secured the sightline for the moment, but it made dust and stench and drew in rodents or other predators.

A full removal of the assemblage to hide a failed restoration weakened even downstream purification and the international movement ecology axis.

In the end a coexistence agreement was neither a declaration that stopped the city for the birds nor an order that emptied the wetland for the city.

It was a promise to decide in public, in which season and by how much, the right of movement and the space would yield to each other, and not to push that cost onto the residents of one particular zone alone.

Long-term management of the Migratory-Wetland Predator Swarm demanded, beyond the level of standing up a temporary response team each movement period, a system in which S06, the Gangnam Line, and HC06 handed over the water and the tracks as one seasonal asset.

Seoul Station Central remeasured the water-level gradient, turbidity, benthic density, and the 15-minute occupancy rate by functional group. The Gangnam Line kept takeoff altitude, yard-track intrusion, emergency braking, and near-collision avoidance counts tied to the running hours, and H06 published, for every radar classification, the eye-confirmation rate and the misidentification rate.

If raptor perch-stay time lengthened and the waterfowl's mass takeoffs crossed the baseline, or if turbidity had stabilized but only wader feeding declined, it was judged a failure of spatial arrangement, not of simple head count.

When a timetable change or a failed water-level adjustment set off a chain flush, forced dispersal was not repeated. The low-noise window was returned to the last agreed time, and temporary water outside the tracks and substitute perches of different heights were opened to disperse the functional groups in order.

Completion of recovery was declared not at one safe passage but when, across two consecutive movement periods, zero collisions, a decline in intrusions, recovery of the sluice-sightline secure rate, and benthic density held inside the allowed range were confirmed together.

The cause of failure was reflected in the next season's agreement, the slowdown sections and the responsibility for running the pumps were rotated, and compensation hours were allocated so that noise and passage limits did not pile onto the residents of one particular waterfront.

If the perches outside the tracks were kept for a long time, however, droppings concentrated on a particular water, nutrients such as phosphorus and nitrogen accumulated, and the insects that followed could raise the food density of the next season and call a larger stopover flock.

Measuring the nutrients and the insect emergence volume under the perches, and resting the locations periodically, therefore became management as important as preventing collisions.

/hostile_groups/5/prose.en:
On the waterfront record deck at Seoul Station, the waterfowl worked the shallow water, the waders walked along the mud edges, and the raptors looked down on the two flocks from substitute perches outside the depot.

The HC06 Noryangjin Delivery House watch spread the water-level gauge and the passage table by functional group, and H06 Baksol recorded the altitude points divided into birds, drones, and balloons.

During the Gangnam Line track inspection hours the trains were slowed, and when a new wave of birds rode the XT01 wind road the bridge walking hours were cut by one hour.

No line recorded the management failure of a real protected area as the crime of a particular institution, and only the head count by functional group and the sightline secure times remained.

/hostile_groups/2/scenario_outlines/2/mo.en: Whether the animals' social memory may be erased for the sake of human right of passage becomes the point at issue.

/hostile_groups/2/dossier_prose.en:
The Abandoned-Dog Iron Pack is a band of dogs that lives centered on the laboratory wall at the outskirts of the Yangjae Machineworks Company on the Yongsan Line, the closed guard passage, and the vacant lot covered in weeds.

At night some of them go down as far as the fishery unloading yard of the Charter Transcription State on the Noryangjin Line, and by day they hide their bodies in the drains and under the elevated roads.

The rusted collar rings and the corroded identification tags strike each other and make an iron-tag sound at every step, so the name Iron Pack stuck.

This sound is heard in the transfer passage before the footsteps, and it gives citizens the anxiety of old abandonment and neglect coming back all at once.

But they are not one attacking body.

They are an alliance of loose families in which individuals from the private shelters that closed their doors after the collapse, construction-site guard dogs, and companion dogs that lost their people in the evacuating crowds joined up, following food and familiar smells.

The UHF collar tags and the rebinding mediated by those tags are a fictional order that holds only in this region, and they do not become grounds for assigning blame to a particular real shelter or business.

The core range is the vacant lot by the outer wall of the Yongsan Line, but there is no fixed boundary.

In the season when fish guts and frozen leftovers increase they move to the night unloading axis of the Noryangjin Line, and when the logistics vibration coming from the Korea Strait Theater (XT03) grows they widen the range as far as the freezer approach and the unloading-yard entrance, and conversely when the daytime crowds thicken they fall back to the drains behind the market or under the elevated roads.

Leftover protein, discarded ration packs, uncontaminated water, and shade decide the density of the band.

When the Magok Life House (HC03) seals waste protein too tightly, the hungry families scatter into the market alleys and the children's passages, and when it manages the seal loosely they overcrowd one unloading yard and contact with people increases.

Filtration and disinfection alone are not enough for the water; sealed storage that prevents recontamination is needed.

Removing the food and making safety are not the same thing.

An individual that wandered alone finds the companions it met at a past feeding station through body scent and the iron-tag sound, and forms a small family of two or three.

When unloading leftovers grow abundant, several families rebind into an alliance that uses the same road but differs in the order of eating and the resting place.

One medium-sized adult that has lived the longest, and two adults beside it, propose a move first, but there is no permanent leader and no command structure.

A family with pups keeps a separate protection range, and depending on the situation it also refuses the proposal of the lead individual.

When the feeding hours stabilize, territorial defense strengthens rather than breeding exploding, and when a forced capture scatters the band they gather again around the individuals whose identification tags remain.

So a report that they were dispersed once does not mean a long-term solution.

Their rapid changes come from learning rather than from bodily mutation.

They distinguish among themselves human hand signs, the wheel sound of the feeding cart, a vehicle idling, disinfectant, and the thawing smell of frozen food, and they remember individually the person who was safe and the person who was a threat.

There is a possibility that the tendency among the young individuals to keep away from people remains across long generations, but behavior that changes a passage in a few days or follows a particular vehicle has to be seen as social learning inside the family.

Smell reads body scent and the degree of decay, and hearing separates a familiar collar sound from an engine sound.

Ido (H03) can read a passive UHF RFID tag inside about 2 meters, but wet fur, metal rings, and tag orientation make the same individual get counted twice or missed entirely.

The electronic record is only a clue to a past registration, not proof of the present family relation, and a person has to compare appearance, behavior, and companionship again.

The danger grows in three stages according to the way trust collapses, rather than according to the number of individuals.

At first they react only to a particular identification tag and to the feeding cart, and hold the edge of the vacant lot.

Next a familiar engine sound and the unloading leftovers gather several families into one passage and make them follow the convoy cart.

At the last, when a feeding stop or a capture by deception happens, they scatter by family and occupy the market entrance, the transfer stairs, and the freezer approach at the same time.

At that point gunfire or a blanket capture only pushes the scattered individuals out into a wider lived-in quarter.

Blocking fences, feeding detour points, noise reduction, and visual markers for the pup-protection zones come first, and capture has to be limited to injured individuals or to the individuals that actually led an attack.

Success is judged not by the number removed but by zero citizen bites, the decrease in unloading delay time, and the family rebinding rate.

G03-SC1, "The Rusted Name Tag," begins when H03 incompletely reads three tags that still carry different shelter codes at the edge of the unloading yard.

The Yongsan Line and HC03 can delay the unloading until the record comparison is finished, they can also divide the families with the feeding cart and check them, and they can also register first the relation of sleeping together and tending the pups now, ahead of the past code.

The first choice reduces misjudgment but delays the unloading of food.

The second is fast, but it can separate from the family a pup that failed to follow the cart.

The third makes the band the most stable, but it collides with the return claim of an old protector who appears late.

What has to be decided here is not the accuracy of the data alone.

The core is which relation is granted the greater right, the record of ownership from the past or the animal family that formed itself after the collapse.

In G03-SC2, "The Band That Remembers the Feeding Cart," when the engine sound of the old feeding cart sounds in the closed guard passage, the families that had scattered across the Yongsan Line and the Noryangjin Line gather on the unloading road.

Finding the original driver and having the passage cleared gives an immediate effect, but it leaves the vulnerability that one person's absence collapses the whole agreement.

Familiarizing a new driver in stages with the smell and the feeding procedure means the unloading volume has to be reduced for many days, but in the long term the dependence can be dispersed.

Introducing a mobile feeding station with no engine sound does not damage the existing trust signal, but it needs the labor to change the location every day and refrigeration equipment.

An individual that has lost a particular person can refuse food or grow more aggressive, so it matters more to build a structure in which trust is not concentrated on one person than to recover passage immediately.

G03-SC3, "Rebinding on the Transfer Stairs," is the situation in which the logistics vibration of XT03 overlaps the feeding stop and several families surround the freezer.

It is the situation of surrounding the approach.

Opening a feeding zone for each family can divide the passage without harming the dispersed rebinding net, but the ration labor and the sealed stores are consumed for a long time.

Capturing only the injured non-lethally limits the damage to trust, but the recovery of passage is slow.

Moving the night unloading to another freezer preserves the animals' social memory, but the transport distance and the refrigeration cost of the Noryangjin Line merchants increase.

The HC03 mediator can keep the agreement only by binding the feeding hours, the passage opening window, and the capture ceiling into one trade, and by presenting together the smell marker of a past protector and the familiar cart.

The identification-tag data is used only to find a missing family or protector, and it must not be converted into a punishment ledger or a speculative asset.

Coexistence with the Abandoned-Dog Iron Pack is not a matter of them being gentle.

It does not lie in believing that; it lies in acknowledging the possibility of attack while not treating trust as a consumable.

Using the iron-tag sound as a false rescue signal disables every rescue call after it, and cutting the feeding does not make the danger disappear but moves it into the alleys walked by the weaker citizens.

Extermination can empty the transfer route in the short term, but it collapses the ethics of protection and the citizen reporting net together.

Territory marks can be left in place alongside a detour line and used as a passage rule for both sides, rather than erased unconditionally.

Whether the animals' present family and memory may be deleted for the reason of securing human right of passage, or whether the boundary is redrawn while accepting added cost and inconvenience, is in the end a choice that humans have to bear.

The responsibility of tending the Abandoned-Dog Iron Pack for a long time lies in binding the outskirts management of the Yongsan Line, the leftover control of the Noryangjin Line, and HC03's water and treatment into one ledger, while keeping trust from crowding onto one particular feeder.

Every season the sleeping place by family and whether the pups survived, the duplicate reading rate of the same individual, the bacterial re-detection of the sealed water bins, the minutes of dwell time on the unloading road, citizen bites and pursuit reports, and the share of injured individuals that rejoined their original companion group after treatment have to be recorded together.

A simple decrease in the number of individuals omits the families pushed out into the alleys, so it cannot be an indicator of stability.

When a capture by deception or a sudden feeding stop collapses the trust net, the engine sound and the cart that were used are retired for a set period, and managers who have different smells and walking habits have to be paired and familiarization begun again from water offered at a distance.

Whether recovery has happened is judged not by the moment they accept food but by whether an adult comes out of the passage while leaving the pups behind, and by whether the family does not scatter in every direction even when rescue labor approaches.

After a death or a disappearance, re-formation is not forced by following only the remaining identification tags; the night companionship is watched for several days and the new family boundary is drawn again.

Meanwhile, if the movement times and the feeding locations are published too precisely, a theft group can read the dogs' gathering as a freezer work timetable and find the empty warehouses and the detours.

So the location records are shared with a delay, within the range needed for rescue and sanitation, and the market guards must not consume the animals' regularity like a surveillance device.

Only then does the iron-tag sound remain a promise of safety and not become the signal of another exploitation.

/hostile_groups/2/prose.en:
On the vacant lot by the outer wall at Magok, a controller of the Abandoned-Dog Iron Pack hooks a rusted identification tag on a paw and smells the unloading wind.

The Magok Life House (HC03) mediator sets up a feeding-detour cart and a pup-zone flag instead of a muzzle, and Ido (H03) splits the iron-tag clinks from the engine idling and marks only the wandering units separately.

When the night unloading on the Noryangjin Line runs late, one side of the passage is left empty, and on a day when the XT03 logistics vibration grows, only the shade tunnel is extended and no slaughter order is written down.

The territory urine marks are left beside the detour arrows instead of being erased, and they teach the passage rule.

/hostile_groups/7/prose.en:
The alarm lamp of the Noryangjin airlock alley has lit, but the three gatekeepers are not looking at the same door.

One says the differential pressure has dropped, one says the ground line is still alive, and the last looks in the roll for the twelve patients bound for Jegi-dong.

In the first incident the on-site staff can, instead of locking down the door where the alarm sounded, pass an empty cloth through first and confirm the direction of the contamination.

If the inspection runs long the fever reducers are late, and if they open in haste the dust is pushed into the patients' waiting room.

In the second incident they do not swap media for power.

An old blower runs in reverse, so the dust can be sent to only one of the Noryangjin food inspection stand and the Jegi-dong annex.

If the on-site staff sacrifice the empty annex they lose next month's research space, and if they choose the market side that day's auction volume is scrapped.

The third incident is not the collapse of a controller but a dispute over verdict power.

When the Changdong Protection House tries to open every door with the integrated protection key, two of the three gatekeepers refuse the approval stamp.

To save the medical convoy, the on-site staff must take the after-the-fact liability for one particular door, and if a wrong call comes to light they must hand the protection-key authority to a citizen audit.

After the incident ends the curtains are one layer thinner, but trust does not recover on its own.

Only the record of which door opened at which pressure, not of who coughed, protects the standing of the next person to pass.

/hostile_groups/7/dossier_prose.en:
Between the elevated road west of Dongdaemun Station and the night-wage warehouse, a lower passage runs that is not marked on the surface map.

Two flights down, blower heat and the smell of wet concrete arrive instead of the sea wind, and past another steel airlock door the sealed alleys come out, managed by the Dongdaemun night-wage corridor, the western arc of the Medical Neutrality League.

The G08 Cleanroom Mutant lives inside and outside these door leaves, or more precisely within the width where the needle of the differential-pressure gauge trembles.

They began as the sentry and haulage units that guarded the airlock corridor, which lost positive pressure after the collapse, and the sealed annex near the Medical Neutrality League.

They held the filters longer than the set replacement cycle. While they endured, their breathing grew shorter or deeper to match the particle concentration in the air, and a fine electrostatic potential accumulated in the skin.

This is not the result of contamination changing a person's nature. It is the process by which a body that survived beside stopped purification equipment came to read the shifts in its environment.

In their sight, dust is not seen as points, and neither is the blur at the edge of the lighting, which rides the cloth surface.

The scatter light that spreads, and the direction in which the fine hairs stand before a hand touches a door handle, overlap as one mass of flow.

The soles read door-leaf vibration through the rail seats, and the backs of the hands distinguish the prickling potential that comes from a bad ground.

When a motor overheats they sense the local heat, but they cannot learn the condition of a person beyond the wall.

Smell, too, goes only as far as noticing a charred filter.

So their verdicts are always checked against the particle false-reading record left by the synthetic Choidaon, H08.

When Choidaon's graph diverges from the cough record, neither side becomes absolute evidence.

They pass an empty cloth through the duct first, and look again at the dust pattern stuck to the front and the back of that cloth.

When a particle storm rolls in and the senses saturate, they do not try to look farther. They close the door and wait for the blur to settle.

The calendar of their life turns over not by the date but by the pressure difference.

When a dust band forms inside a door, the inspection crew pulls one corner of the gasket and holds it to the light, and through a duct where the reading has spiked they send a rag instead of a person.

On a day when the entrance curtains pass two layers, the movement crew does not take a new room. It gathers in one bay and washes the media.

When the annex toward Jegi-dong publishes the filter replacements and the grounding particulars, they count the people passing in person and match the time it takes for positive pressure to recover.

Even when the pressure comes alive suddenly, they do not treat it as a signal of territorial expansion.

They check whether the revived wind is pushing old particles into the waiting room of the opposite alley, and then open the doors one by one.

When the media fibers crumble and even an optical reading becomes impossible, they lower the curtains and isolate themselves rather than leave.

Waiting until an outside medic sets a safe dismantling order is their last defense.

The economy of the Dongdaemun night-wage undercroft counts air before food.

Recycled filter media, grounding scrap, low-particle cooling air, and a gasket for each door leaf are the core resources, and batteries cannot be drawn outside the allotment ledger.

Grounding scrap goes only into repairing rail seats and door frames, and is not converted to any other use.

When two rolls of media hit bottom, the spread signal that announces a new dwelling switches off automatically, and when they exceed the night positive-pressure power slot they fold even the curtains already hung.

The filters and track-protection supplies demanded by the Changdong Protection House's integrated protection key look toward the same warehouse, but the protection-key inspection ledger and the media-consumption ledger are deliberately kept separate.

Gaskets, too, are allotted not by weight but by door number.

That is because sticking a leftover from one door onto another door at will collapses the whole pressure calculation.

In the season when filters dwindle they move along the ventilation ducts of the sealed annex beneath the Jegi-dong alley at Jegi-dong, and when dust is pushed in from the relay docks of the Korea Strait Theater, XT03, they double the entrance curtains to match the outer pressure.

Rather than taking any state's place, they use the short movement window that opens by the numbers between the Noryangjin Line of Won Buddhism and the Dongdaemun Union of the Medical Neutrality League.

The authority to open a door does not gather in a single leader.

The first gatekeeper takes the differential-pressure gauge, the second confirms the continuity of the ground line, and the third reads the destinations of people and crates from the passage roll.

The lock bar releases only when two of the three approve the same door number.

Choidaon's record is only material for the vote, not deciding power, and when a medical convoy arrives the medic who knows the patients' condition and the keeper of the roll divide temporary priority between them.

If one gatekeeper loses the breathing rhythm, the other two do not succeed to the power.

They close the door and wait for the next shift.

Because of this, internal quarrels concentrate less on who becomes chief than on which measurement has the standing to delay a person.

Even when agreement breaks they do not collide at once.

They begin not to recognize the door numbers each other approved, and a passage that would have ended in one trip turns into three detours.

The incident in which that crack first shows is G08-SC1, "The Direction of the Empty Cloth."

The alarm lamp of the Noryangjin airlock alley lit briefly, and the three gatekeepers each read the differential pressure, the grounding fault, and the roll of the twelve patients bound for Jegi-dong as a danger signal at a different door.

If the on-site staff lock down the alarm door at once, the immediate exposure falls, but the airflow is cut and the starting point of the contamination becomes permanently unclear, and afterward every verdict on the same door hardens into caution.

Passing an empty cloth through first can confirm the scatter direction, but the fever-reducer convoy is delayed.

Detouring only the patients and keeping the door buys time, but the dust is pushed into the waiting room and the gaskets and bedding of that space must be scrapped.

Whatever they choose, the patients' minutes and the whole alley's breath for the next winter are bound under the same alarm.

In G08-SC2, "Reverse-Running Blower," an old blower begins to spin the other way.

The dust can be sent to only one of the empty Jegi-dong annex and the Noryangjin food inspection stand, and the negotiation that tried to exchange media for power has already collapsed.

If the on-site staff choose the annex, that day's exposure of lives falls, but the sealed research space to be used next month is contaminated beyond recovery and the Medical Neutrality League's preparation for care shrinks.
