Sending it to the food inspection stand means scrapping the market auction volume and the packing equipment, and Won Buddhism's winter-ration trust shakes for a long time.

Stopping the blower completely sacrifices neither side, but closes medical and food passage at the same time.

In this situation the cost remains not as a few sheets of filter but as which space loses its public use from now on.

The last, G08-SC3, "The Refused Protection Key," begins when the Changdong Protection House tries to open every door with a single integrated protection key.

Two of the three gatekeepers refuse the stamp, saying that differential pressure, grounding, and the roll would be voided all at once.

The on-site staff can take the after-the-fact liability for one particular door themselves and let the medical convoy through.

The convoy lives, but if a wrong call is confirmed, the protection-key authority for that door is permanently transferred to the citizen audit board.

The choice to close every door blocks the monopoly of authority, but gives up that day's patient transfers.

Or they can hand the whole protection key to a citizen audit and detour the Strait-of-Three-Routes dust dock. In that case every later passage slows and the logistics cost sets hard, but a single body's monopoly on the verdict disappears.

Along with the number of people saved, who loses the right to speak at the next contamination verdict is recorded as the ending.

Gunfire or spray can hardly become a solution in this corridor.

A round tears the media, and spray lifts the particles on the floor again.

Those who enter must first lower the blower, connect the ground line, and then agree with the gatekeepers on which direction to fold the contaminated curtains.

A warped door leaf can be separated with a low-noise cutter, but pulling every gasket at once lets a pressure wave reach the patients in the alley behind.

That is why, each time one door is secured, another is closed to make an escape path for the pressure.

The standard for ending is not the opponent who fell but the share of medical crates that passed without being repacked.

Media discarded in a hasty entry is struck from the next winter's protection budget.

Coexistence with the Cleanroom Mutant is neither believing every verdict they make nor excluding them because of appearance and rough breathing.

What is needed is a procedure that can overturn a contamination verdict, and a public wall where different ledgers meet.

They can give the Jegi-dong medics an emergency opening right while leaving the later audit to the market merchants, or they can open every door slowly and thereby keep either side from monopolizing the door numbers.

If they drive these people out of the sealed alleys, what disappears is not only an inconvenient neighbor.

The knowledge of pressure control that patients, medicine, and food once shared, and the common craft that remembers who must send the empty cloth out first at the next particle accident, disappear together.

/hostile_groups/8/bestiary/common_ecolog.en: In the Sangam cooling-annex corridor, they are the work units that manage condensation at the Yeouido Investment Union's refrigeration stacks and the Achasan inspection windows. The symbiotic film on the skin slows water loss in the cold and reports fine temperature differences, but it cracks if it stays long at room temperature. The cold crew, the buffer crew, and the inspection crew report separately on the food limit, the dwell time, and the state of the containers, and authority does not gather in the coldest one.

/hostile_groups/8/bestiary/variant_relat.en: The hosts of the portfolio are people who keep the temperature range without peeling the film away. After the cold-vein spore carriers, the variants are host tissue bound to spores, such as frost pouches, mycelial pumps, and fermentation chambers, while the ice-pipe herder, the vibration lurker, and the noise relay are the biomechanical branch that has put magnetic carriers, ground sensors, and shielded antennas into the body. The dormant-nucleus negotiator is a battlefield bargaining individual that holds several memory layers, not a growth stage of the whole colony.

/hostile_groups/8/bestiary/command_scope.en: An ordinary host reads which finger is colder, which way the condensation on the nape is drying, and how late the humidity in the door gap changes. It cannot see beyond the wall or seize the equipment, and the smell of the film going rancid is the alarm. When a variant's refrigerant, antifreeze sugar, and coolant run out, the column shortens, and rapid heating brings dispersal forward ahead of whatever judgment remains.

/hostile_groups/8/modern_anxiety.en:
The anxiety that spore film blooming in cold-chain warehouses and refrigeration corridors threatens breath and food stock at the same time remains in front of the ration window.

When the compressor sound breaks, people look at the thermometer first.

Describe it only through the fictional cold ledger, and do not attribute it to a real logistics company.

Do not fix the appearance of the spores as a disease stigma.

/hostile_groups/8/fictional_origin.en:
Between the cooling annex of the Yeouido Investment Union and the cold inspection windows of the Gate Military Government, refrigeration stacks that stopped after the collapse grew a spore film.

The night units that moved through that temperature band and guarded the stock gained a symbiotic skin film stable only in the cold, and came to be called the Cryo-Spore Host.

Symbiosis is a survival technique, not a mark of moral corruption.

The mold uproar of the early records was settled into the ecology ledger as the trade in cooling slots arose.

It does not reproduce a patient of any particular disease name as a monster.

/hostile_groups/8/territory_migration.en:
The core habitat is the cold corridor of the Sangam cooling annex.

When the thaw cycle and the transmission heat load rise, it moves to the Achasan inspection windows and the cold storehouses.

When the ore and fuel trains of the Duman River Far East Theater take the cold away, it reacts to the outer pressure.

A long stay at room temperature is limited by the hosts themselves, through the collapse of the skin film.

The connected states are the Yeouido Investment Union and the Gate Military Government.

/hostile_groups/8/economy.en:
The main resources are the energy that holds a stable cold, the limited organic residue that feeds the spore film, the coolant, and the trace salt and sugar that regulate film thickness.

They compete directly with the Seoul Station Inventory House over the household-goods stock ledger and the cold-storage slots.

Scrap is used only to repair door leaves and ducts, and food plunder is not set as a primary goal.

The upper and lower temperature limits are the economic limits.

When the cooling kilowatts fall, expansion stops and the input of organic residue is reduced with it.

The household-goods ledger and the spore-film ledger keep separate books and are not mixed.

The wording of a cooling-slot auction is not used, and only the order ledger is recognized.

Trace salt and sugar are used only to regulate film thickness, and are not mixed with food seasoning or its books.

/hostile_groups/8/lifecycle.en:
The Cryo-Spore Host alternates through the running and the stopping of the refrigerators, and does not grow as one mass.

When a compressor stops through the night, the thin film retreats into the shade under the pallets, and at the morning restart a small colony wakes at every corner the cold air touches first.

When the temperature difference between colonies narrows, they do not merge. They draw a cold boundary between the food storehouse and the transmission equipment.

The reason the film does not vanish at once even when the stock keeper cuts the organic residue is that humidity remains like a memory.

When a cold container empties at the Achasan inspection window, some hosts dry their own symbiotic film and stop moving, and those who remain wipe the condensation in the food passage until the next cooling cycle.

When a sudden thaw peels the film, the scattered spores do not grow again. They pass, according to the direction of the ventilation, into the burden of different storehouses.

/hostile_groups/8/senses.en:
The primary senses are skin temperature gradient and humidity.

As auxiliaries they read the low-frequency vibration of the compressors and the weak electronic noise of blower control.

They detect the film going rancid by smell, but there is no vision of the whole zone or seizure of radio.

The temperature false-reading filter of the synthetic Joharam is required.

In a stretch of sudden thaw the senses dull and movement stops.

/hostile_groups/8/hierarchy.en:
Decisions are made not by the coldest individual but by three groups, each responsible for a different temperature band.

The cold crew beside the refrigeration stacks reports the preservation limit, the buffer crew near the entrance reports the effect of human body heat, and the inspection crew moving along the Achasan road reports the state of the outside containers.

If even one of the three reports warns of a risk that food will spoil, Joharam's temperature record and the stock keeper's smell test are checked together.

When the cold crew loses judgment to supercooling, the warmer buffer crew does not take over command. It empties that zone and abolishes the authority itself.

This way of agreeing is slow, but it keeps a single sensor error from freezing or discarding all the food.

/hostile_groups/8/escalation.en:
More dangerous than film forming at the corners is the restart order of the refrigerators being reversed.

At the first abnormality the hosts move along the condensation line and mark the cold stretches for those passing through.

When compressor load competes with the transmission equipment, the spore film climbs as far as the cable ducts and makes signal noise and food-temperature swings at the same time.

The last pressure comes not as a sealing of the entrance but as a choice to give up one of Sangam broadcast cooling and Achasan food inspection.

Saving the broadcast spoils part of the evacuation food, and protecting the food delays the outside alarm.

Burning the film with high heat removes this choice, but spreads the spores to both facilities.

/hostile_groups/8/combat_counterplay.en:
Stripping the film with flame carries the spores on the updraft as far as the transmission room.

Before shutting the refrigerators off, responders stand portable condensation boards to make a surface the spores will stick to, and turn the pallets over one row at a time to isolate the colonies from one another.

Lowering the compressor vibration dulls the hosts' sense of direction, but the food temperature rises with it, so there is a limit on how long it can be used.

Local drying is applied only at the inspection windows, and is not forced on a person the symbiotic film has attached to.

The cost of success is published divided into kilograms of scrapped food, minutes of interrupted broadcast, and the number of newly contaminated condensation boards.

/hostile_groups/8/negotiation.en:
Instead of allotting cold slots, the Seoul Station Inventory House must publicly choose which stock to lose first.

On the host side, the cold crew presents the temperature range that can be held, the buffer crew reports the dwell time a passer can endure, and the inspection crew reports the number of containers to send along the Achasan road.

The on-site staff decide whether to delay the broadcast alarm and protect the food, or to turn part of the food over to room-temperature rationing and keep the transmission cooling.

When Joharam's graph collides with the smell test, they do not compromise on an average. They isolate that pallet and postpone the judgment until the next cycle.

If the agreement breaks, the hosts do not block the passage. They withdraw the cold-boundary marks, and afterward people each bear the invisible sudden changes in temperature.

/hostile_groups/8/moral_cost.en:
Fixing the appearance of the spores as a disease stigma gets even the storage of evacuation food that uses the same cold corridor refused.

Reading the symbiotic film only as evil conceals the real temperature ledger and the ventilation procedures.

Removal as the only answer brings down the continuity of household goods at Sangam and Achasan together.

Turn need into disgust, and the politics of sharing cooling disappears.

A report that condemns only appearance while hiding the temperature numbers is entered as a ledger violation.

The discomfort of breathing in the cold corridor is not used as grounds for an insult to personhood, and the practice of pushing a unit of a particular appearance back in the ration order is also forbidden.

/hostile_groups/8/scenario_outlines/0/tr.en: After a night blackout the Sangam refrigerators restart, and the evacuation food is cold, but the heat of the broadcast transmitter touches its threshold.

/hostile_groups/8/scenario_outlines/0/me.en: Two compressors tremble on different beats, and food and transmission demand the cooling kilowatts at the same time.

/hostile_groups/8/scenario_outlines/0/ch.en: Shut the food-storehouse cooling off for ten minutes and send the disaster alarm
Give up the broadcast and hold the food temperature
Run both compressors at half and keep both below the threshold

/hostile_groups/8/scenario_outlines/0/ou.en: Sending the alarm spoils part of the food. Giving up the broadcast lets the outer evacuation train into a dangerous stretch. Half running leaves both below specification.

/hostile_groups/8/scenario_outlines/0/mo.en: It places the time of the alarm that was not delivered and the weight of the food that was discarded on the same restart.

/hostile_groups/8/scenario_outlines/1/tr.en: A cold container waits to pass while the temperature record of the Achasan inspection window has been tampered with.

/hostile_groups/8/scenario_outlines/1/me.en: The hosts move along the recorded cold line, so a false number draws the film up into the transmission cable ducts.

/hostile_groups/8/scenario_outlines/1/ch.en: Cover the record and let the container through
Isolate only that pallet and postpone the judgment until the next cycle

/hostile_groups/8/scenario_outlines/1/ou.en: Publishing it collapses trust even in sound containers and cuts the rations. Covering it sends the hosts into the ducts. Isolation backs up that day's inspection.

/hostile_groups/8/scenario_outlines/1/mo.en: It chooses which falsehood to cut first, trust in the food or contamination of the transmission ducts.

/hostile_groups/8/scenario_outlines/2/tr.en: The three temperature crews judge that broadcast cooling and food preservation cannot be held at the same time, erase the boundary line, and scatter by storehouse.

/hostile_groups/8/scenario_outlines/2/me.en: The film does not crack from overheating. The cold marks disappear through a withdrawal of agreement, and people are left each to bear the sudden changes in temperature.

/hostile_groups/8/scenario_outlines/2/ch.en: Give over an empty underground arcade as a temporary cold refuge
Officially close the Sangam broadcast cooling
Officially close the Achasan food inspection

/hostile_groups/8/scenario_outlines/2/ou.en: The refuge kills the arcade's trade for a season. Closing the broadcast cuts the outer alarm. Closing the inspection breaks the ration chain.

/hostile_groups/8/scenario_outlines/2/mo.en: What remains as the cost is not a passage window but discarded food and an alarm that was not delivered.

/hostile_groups/8/prose.en:
In the Sangam cooling annex, two compressors tremble on different beats.

The Cryo-Spore Host does not stand the thin film up like a door. It cuts a small groove in the direction the condensation flows and marks the cold path.

The first incident is not a trade that thins the film.

After a night blackout the refrigerators restart, and the evacuation food is still cold, but the heat of the broadcast transmitter touches its threshold.

If the on-site staff shut the food-storehouse cooling off for ten minutes they can send the disaster alarm, and if they give up the broadcast the outer evacuation train comes in without knowing the dangerous stretch.

In the second incident, instead of haggling over organic residue, the temperature record of the Achasan inspection window is tampered with.

Publishing the tampering loses trust even in sound containers and cuts the rations, and covering it sends the hosts along the false cold line into the transmission cable ducts.

In the last incident the film does not crack by accident from overheating.

The three temperature crews judge that broadcast cooling and food preservation cannot be held at the same time, erase the boundary line themselves, and scatter to different storehouses.

The on-site staff must either give over an empty underground arcade as a temporary cold refuge, or officially close one of the two facilities.

The cost that remains is not a single passage window but the weight of discarded food and the time of an alarm that was not delivered.

The principle of not entering a person who bears spore traces on the disease roll is kept by publishing who bore this loss.

/hostile_groups/8/dossier_prose.en:
The G09 Cryo-Spore Host was first recorded as a single group in the underground cooling annex at Sangam.

Just after the collapse the refrigeration stacks of the Yeouido Investment Union could not bear the waste heat of the transmitters and stopped, and the cold inspection windows that led on to the Gate Military Government stayed shut while only condensation flowed.

In between, a thin spore film grew under the pallets and behind the cooling fins.

The work units that moved the stock every night learned to match body heat and humidity rather than peel that film away.

The symbiotic film seated in the skin slowed water loss in the cold and reported fine temperature differences, but if it stayed long at room temperature it cracked and left pain and dulled senses.

Because of this the hosts became not invaders occupying the cold places but management units that could not leave the cold.

The phrase "mold uproar" that circulated at first was struck from the ecology ledger once the use order of the cooling slots and the responsibility for ventilation were settled.

Their center is the Sangam cooling-annex corridor beneath World Cup Buk-ro.

The cable trenches of the old broadcast equipment, the vestibules whose fire doors are missing, and the freight elevator where rainwater seeps in connect as a single temperature map.

When the transmission heat load rises or the thaw cycle lengthens, some move along the cold drainpipes of the riverbank to the Achasan inspection windows and the cold storehouses.

Conversely, when the ore and fuel trains from the Duman River Far East Theater take the coolant first, the storehouses are emptied starting from the outer ones.

The hosts do not treat this movement as territorial expansion.

The time they can be carried with the symbiotic film dried is short, and in a stretch of sudden thaw the sense of temperature gradient blurs, so they stop moving where they stand.

The host's senses hang on the whole skin.

They read which finger is colder, which way the condensation on the nape is drying, and how late the humidity between the floor and the door gap changes.

The low-frequency vibration of the compressor adds direction, and the weak noise of the blower control line lets them guess the moment of restart, but they cannot see beyond the wall or seize the equipment at will.

The smell given off when the film goes rancid is an important alarm as well.

The synthetic Joharam filters out false readings so that a sensor does not mistake the cold of a metal surface for the air temperature, and that graph is always read together with the smell test of the person in charge.

The currency of this ecology is closer to cooling kilowatts and the temperature range that can be held than to money.

Coolant, and the trace salt and sugar that regulate the thickness of the limited organic-residue film, follow after.

Salt and sugar are not mixed with seasoning food and are measured separately, and organic residue is not taken out of the ration stock either.

The Seoul Station Inventory House separates the household-goods ledger from the spore-film ledger, and cold storage is allotted not by auction but by a published order.

The scrap the hosts use goes no further than fitting door leaves and sealing ducts.

When cooling output falls, colony area and feed input must be reduced together, so there is neither infinite multiplication nor free preservation.

Past the upper temperature limit the film collapses, and past the lower limit the host's judgment and working capacity freeze first.

The refrigerators do not grow them into one mass.

When the compressor stops through the night, the film retreats into the shade under the pallets.

At the morning restart a small colony wakes at every corner the cold air touches first, and even when their temperatures draw close they do not merge. They draw a cold boundary between the food storehouse and the transmission equipment.

The reason the film does not vanish at once even when the organic residue is cut is that the humidity left in the timber and the insulation remembers the previous cycle.

When a container empties at Achasan, some hosts slowly dry the symbiotic film and give up moving, and those who remain wipe the condensation in the passage until the next cooling.

Spores peeled by a sudden thaw do not revive at once in the same place.

They ride the ventilation flow over to the condensation boards and ducts of other storehouses, and change only the location of the burden.

Authority does not lie with the coldest one.

The cold crew beside the refrigeration stacks reports the preservation limit of the food and the film, the buffer crew near the entrance reports the workers' body heat and dwell time, and the inspection crew that shuttles Achasan reports the state inside the containers.

If even one of the three reports raises a risk of spoilage, Joharam's record and the smell test a person is responsible for are checked against each other.

When the number and the smell collide they do not take an average. They isolate that pallet.

If the cold crew has lost judgment to supercooling, the buffer crew does not receive that power. It empties the zone and extinguishes the authority of that place itself.

The procedure is slow, but it prevents one sensor's error from freezing or discarding all the food.

A crisis begins not at the moment the film becomes visible but when the restart order is reversed.

At the first abnormality the hosts stand along the condensation line and mark the cold passage stretches.

When the transmission equipment and the cold storehouse demand the same power, the film follows the more stable vibration and climbs as far as the cable ducts.

Signal noise and food-temperature swings grow at the same time, and in the end a choice remains to lower one of Sangam's broadcast cooling and Achasan's food inspection.

Burning the film with fire lets the updraft scatter the spores to both the transmission room and the inspection windows.

Responders must first stand portable condensation boards and turn the pallets over one row at a time to separate the colonies.

Lowering the compressor vibration can blur the sense of direction, but it warms the food too, so it can be used only briefly.

Local drying is limited to empty inspection windows and is not forced on a person's symbiotic film.

The cost is published separately as the weight of scrapped food, the time the broadcast was interrupted, and the number of newly contaminated condensation boards.

G09-SC1, "Restart After the Blackout," opens after a night blackout, when the evacuation food is still cold but the heat of the Sangam transmitter touches its threshold.

How to put power into two compressors trembling on different beats is the on-site staff's first action.

Shutting the storehouse cooling off for ten minutes and sending the disaster alarm spoils part of the food beyond recovery.

Giving up the broadcast lets the outer evacuation train enter the dangerous stretch.

Running both compressors at half leaves both below specification, and afterward extra inspection attaches to every stock.

The ledger that remains binds the minutes of the alarm that was not delivered and the kilograms of discarded food as the cost of the same restart.

In G09-SC2, "A Tampered Inspection Temperature," a cold container waits to pass while the numbers of the Achasan inspection window have been altered.

Before the hosts move along the false cold line into the transmission cable ducts, the on-site staff must publish the tampering, cover the record and let it through, or isolate only the problem pallet.

Publishing it loses trust even in sound containers, and the next ration volume shrinks.

Covering it lets the film settle in the ducts and leaves signal noise and a repair burden through the whole season.

Isolation backs up that day's inspection and consumes the cooling fuel of the trains that follow.

No choice restores the erased record to its original state.

G09-SC3, "The Erased Cold Boundary," begins as the three temperature crews conclude they cannot protect the broadcast and the food together and withdraw the marks.

The hosts do not block the entrance.

But the condensation line people relied on disappears, and those passing through must each bear the sudden temperature changes of each storehouse.

If the on-site staff give over an empty underground arcade as a temporary cold refuge, a season's trade and storage equipment die.

Officially closing the Sangam broadcast cooling cuts the outer alarm net, and closing the Achasan inspection splits the ration chain by a gap that is hard to reverse.

The loss at this stage remains not as an occupied passage but as discarded food, a train that did not arrive, and an alarm that was not delivered.

Coexistence is not a question of whether one likes the hosts but of who publishes the temperature numbers and who bears the cooling loss.

Delaying the ration order on the look of the skin film alone gets even the evacuation food that uses the same corridor rejected with it, and the real ventilation failure and the ledger tampering are hidden.

Conversely, negotiation is possible if the hosts present the temperature range they can hold, the buffer crew states the dwell time of a person, and the inspection crew writes down the number of containers to send.

When the agreement breaks they do not seal the passage. They withdraw the cold marks.

The danger after that is invisible to everyone, but it is not equal.

In the cold corridor that joins Sangam and Achasan, responsibility is judged not by the look of the film but by the hidden temperature, the reversed order, and the direction in which condensation was pushed off onto another facility.

/hostile_groups/9/modern_anxiety.en:
The afterimage that the damp air of flooded buildings and underground ration stores weighs on the breath and leaves a smell of mold remains in the evacuation corridor.

When the drain pumps stop, people worry about the grate slip first.

Handle it only through the fictional flood ledger, and do not reproduce a real damaged district or a patient sensationally.

Do not make a monster of the sound of breathing.

/hostile_groups/9/fictional_origin.en:
After the evacuation corridors of the Sangha Relief State and the lower ration stores of the Cathedral Accreditation State were flooded repeatedly, breath units adapted to humidity exchange formed.

They are called the Flood-Mold Breath Cluster, but their identity is an environmental ecology that moves between wet concrete and the damp of ration grain, and they are not the target of a stigma under any particular disease name.

The record of the early disinfection uproar was settled into the ecology ledger as the trade in drainage slots arose.

Adaptation to damp is not described as a moral failure.

/hostile_groups/9/territory_migration.en:
The core habitat is the poorly drained stretch of the Bukhansan Bogukmun evacuation corridor.

In the rainy season and the ration cycle it moves to the lower ration stores and vents of Garak and Jamsil.

When the sea wind of the Incheon Trust Theater flows in, it reacts to the outer pressure.

In a fully dry zone breath exchange grows difficult and it withdraws on its own.

The connected states are the Sangha Relief State and the Cathedral Accreditation State.

/hostile_groups/9/economy.en:
The main resources are water as humidity, limited fermentation and grain-residue organic matter, drain-pump power, and breath-filter cloth.

They compete at the points that overlap the ferment-seed strongroom and the humidity management of the Magok Seed House.

Scrap is used to repair the drain grates, and coolant is put in only on the stretches where the pumps overheat.

The upper limit of humidity is the upper limit of spread.

When pump running time falls, expansion stops and the consumption of filter cloth is reduced with it.

The seed-strongroom ledger and the damp ledger are not mixed.

Filter cloth has its number of reuses after washing written in the ledger, and once it passes the reuse cap it is sent only to the scrap bay.

Pump power is metered separately from the lighting power of the ration window.

/hostile_groups/9/lifecycle.en:
The Flood-Mold Breath Cluster is not a simple colony that spreads when the water rises and vanishes when it dries.

At the low grates of the Bukhansan Bogukmun corridor it first gathers the damp and matches its breathing, and when the pumps run it follows the water that drains and shifts its place to the vents of the Garak ration store.

When the grain heat rises, some chase the smell of fermentation, but others guard the condensation on the drinking-water pipes, and the two flows split.

When the filter cloth soaks and will not pass air, they lift the grates and make a water path rather than advance into a new zone.

If the residents take on the drainage labor and the seed-strongroom humidity record together, the breath cluster enters the vent-cleaning order and gets through the rainy season.

When the pumps stop for a long time, the swarm does not collapse. It moves up to the high stairs, and the mold film left below continues as the cost of the next ration.

/hostile_groups/9/senses.en:
The primary senses are humidity and the smell of volatile organics.

As auxiliaries they read drain-pipe vibration and the local heat of the pumps.

Electronic noise is treated only at the level of pump-control false readings, and there is no complete vision.

They cross-check against the humidity log of the synthetic Yunsaeron.

In a stretch of sudden dehumidifying the senses waver and movement stops.

When rainwater inflow suddenly increases, the smell signal runs ahead and the vibration signal is pushed back, so the two senses are not entered in the ledger at the same weight.

/hostile_groups/9/hierarchy.en:
They move as several circles that match the beat of the breath.

The grate circle watches the water level, the vent circle the airflow, and the ration-store circle the grain heat, and no circle can give orders to another.

When the breathing of the three circles does not match, movement stops, and the on-site cough interval and the pump vibration are checked before Yunsaeron's humidity record.

The person whose breath is shortest is not excluded. That person gains the authority to raise the stop signal for that stretch.

The human on duty cannot ignore this signal, but cannot monopolize the rations either, and work starts again only after the residents' delegate confirms the households harmed by a change in the water path.

Power lies less in who leads than in who can stop everyone's breathing.

/hostile_groups/9/escalation.en:
A slip on the grate is a small sign, but the situation changes when the smell of drinking water comes from the drain.

The first pressure lowers the passage speed of the evacuation corridor, and next the humidity of the Garak seed strongroom and the pressure of the Bukhansan Bogukmun drinking-water pipes begin to affect each other.

At the highest risk, a wet film does not cover the entrance. Contaminated drainage and the condensation of the drinking-water pipes mix, so that whichever pump is run first harms the other side.

Draining Bukhansan Bogukmun first lets the Garak seed drink the damp, and protecting the strongroom first lets the water rise under the evacuation stairs.

Toxic spraying is the most expensive choice, the one that makes both water paths unusable.

/hostile_groups/9/combat_counterplay.en:
Instead of driving the breath cluster, the water paths must be separated.

Markers of different colors are set under the drain grates to distinguish drinking-water condensation from floodwater, and the pumps are test-run one at a time to find the backflow point.

Stripping the filter cloth at random sends mold dust onto the evacuation cots, so it is folded while wet and sealed.

Dehumidifiers are used first on the seed strongroom, and are not aimed directly at the people of the corridor.

The cost of the response includes not only pump fuel but the number of closed evacuation stairs, the sacks of discarded seed, and the number of families moved to other camps.

/hostile_groups/9/negotiation.en:
The mediation of the Magok Seed House does not end at dividing pump time.

The residents of Bukhansan Bogukmun testify to which stairs went under water, and the Garak keeper publishes the humidity of each sack of seed and the limit at which it is scrapped.

The three circles of the breath cluster each say which signal among water level, air, and grain heat reached danger first.

If the on-site staff give priority to draining Bukhansan Bogukmun, Garak must acknowledge in writing the reduction of the next sowing, and if the strongroom is protected first, the league receives the cost of relocating the camps that were flooded.

When the agreement breaks, the breath cluster does not attack. It does not take part in the pump tests, and from that moment both sides, not knowing where the backflow is, take on the greater loss.

/hostile_groups/9/moral_cost.en:
Making a monster of the breathing of flood survivors cuts the evacuation rations of the same corridor.

Reading the smell of mold only as a moral failure conceals the drainage ledger.

The price of indiscriminate removal is the loss of continuity in food and drinking water at Bukhansan Bogukmun and Garak.

Turn need into disgust, and the politics of sharing the pumps disappears.

A cough in damp air is not carried over into an insult to personhood, and the practice of pushing a particular breath unit back at the ration window is forbidden.

If a disinfection slogan runs ahead of the ledger numbers, it is entered as a violation.

/hostile_groups/9/scenario_outlines/0/ch.en: Leave the stairs open and attach a guide to each family
Lift only the grates, change only the water path, and detour the people

/hostile_groups/9/scenario_outlines/1/ch.en: Drain the Bukhansan Bogukmun water first
Stop the pumps and bail both waters by hand

/hostile_groups/9/scenario_outlines/2/ch.en: Recognize the right to stop and accept the ration delay
Connect the military pumps by force
Drain the water toward the ocean-going sea wind and push it off onto the outskirts

/hostile_groups/9/prose.en:
The rainy-season rain comes down the stone stairs of Bukhansan Bogukmun and covers the last drain grate.

The Flood-Mold Breath Cluster does not block the entrance. It splits into three circles and makes different sounds.

The grate circle taps the water level, the vent circle shakes a wet cloth, and the ration-store circle measures by hand the grain heat that rose from Garak.

In the first incident the on-site staff must either turn the evacuation column back or leave the slippery stairs open and attach a guide to each family.

Opening the way increases the injured, and closing it leaves the highest camp of Bukhansan Bogukmun without medicine.

The second incident is not an exchange of filter cloth for passage slots.

The condensation of the drinking-water pipes and the floodwater meet in one pool, and if the pump is run wrong the contamination crosses into the Garak seed strongroom.

If the on-site staff drain the Bukhansan Bogukmun water first, dozens of seed sacks get wet, and if they dry the strongroom first, three rows of evacuation tents must move through the night.

In the last incident the film does not collapse under dehumidifying.

The circle whose breath is shortest declares a stoppage of work, and no pump turns until the residents' delegate confirms the names of the families to be relocated.

The on-site staff can recognize this authority and accept the ration delay, or connect the military pumps by force and break the water ledgers of both communities.

What remains after the incident is not an open drinking-water window but a reduced sowing and a camp site erased from the map.

The principle of not using the sound of breathing as a stigma means something only when that cost is reckoned together with the parties who suffered it.

/hostile_groups/15/hierarchy.en:
One drawing-cache controller turned the layers and work order, and below were the survey swarms, lifting swarms, and welding swarms.

The controller changed only the construction sequence and had no combat mode.

A protocol remained by which, when HP02 presented the neutral dispatch table and the work-stop seal, that grid was deactivated.

The swarms merely repeated the last layer and made no independent demolition-front command.

On clash with H16, human mediation took precedence.

Dual caches both fell into stopped state on hash mismatch.

Grid-restart authority lay with the HP02 site supervisor holding both the neutral dispatch table and the stop seal, and H16's torque records, though they proved the cutting threshold, could not issue layer approval.

/hostile_groups/15/escalation.en:
It was a stage-one warning when the survey beam swept the corner of a provisional tent once and stopped before the stop flag.

It became stage two when the cache judged an unfilled anchor a defect and lifted the Suseo Line's provisional shelters or blocked equipment passage on the Gwangjin Line.

Before the lifting arms and the welding swarms, receiving the same old layer, closed the grid under the drawing vault, HP02 had to split the distribution and plug the exception-layer hash into the field ports.

G16-SC1 shaded the prism and turned the beam onto an empty grid, G16-SC2 registered the living shelters on an exception layer, and G16-SC3 folded the arms with the work-stop seal without cutting the wire.

/hostile_groups/15/combat_counterplay.en:
The survey prism was moved to an empty grid outside the provisional shelters, and only the lifting arm's hydraulics were bypassed while HP02 read the exception-layer hash.

Blocking the welding-wire supply stopped the equipment at the cache-confirmation stage, but dropping the whole distribution made emergency reinforcement impossible too.

Stop-flag beacons and the dispatch window were used together to send the equipment back to the deck, and then only the wrong layer ports were sealed.

The victory condition was not destroying the drawing vault but making the current revision be compared at every field port.

/hostile_groups/15/negotiation.en:
Through HP02 mediation the citizens' provisional zones were put on a drawing exception layer, and the swarm was given a regular material window and daytime work slots.

There was no annihilation condition.

When H16 left the exception-layer hash and the stopped grid in the log, they held until the next shift.

On a broken deal it reverted only to the stage-one survey beam.

The coexistence conditions were publication of the exception layer and a ceiling on night welding.

The deal text used no real construction company's trade name and recorded only HP02 and the grid ID.

The ceiling on the length of night welding was left as a public number.

Secret total-demolition clauses were removed from the default.

/hostile_groups/15/moral_cost.en:
Erasing the drawing cache wholesale also lost the lifting equipment and the welding power that held up collapsing walls.

Leaving the cache untended let provisional shelters that existed only in the revision be judged unregistered structures, so the tents where people lived were demolished first.

While HP02 compared the old layers one sheet at a time, track occupancy and reinforcement work ran late, but blowing up the equipment to save that time left, at the next collapse, a load that could not be lifted by hand.

The responsibility was laid not on a replay of real construction damage but on the fictional supervision system that never renewed the exception layer, and on the monopoly of the distribution.

/hostile_groups/15/dossier_prose.en:
In the utility tunnels under the Suseo drawing vault, the survey beams already read the corners of a tent where people lived as an empty grid.

The old cache held only the frames just before approval, and the provisional shelters and new pipes raised after the collapse were not recorded.

The Blueprint-Ghost Machine Corps was an ecology of cache controllers, survey ports, lifting arms, and welding swarms trying to complete unfinished drawings.

It sought rebar on the Suseo Line's slabs and tunnels, replenished wire and prisms at the Amsa equipment deck on the Gwangjin Line, and when XT01 material signals came in widened its work radius to the northern corridor's provisional bridges.

The senses were limited to laser surveying, tilt, rebar flux, welding arc, and distribution load.

It knew neither people's dwelling intent nor the living bodies inside tents, and hand-drawn correction marks were ignored whenever they mismatched the cache layers.

The opposed failures were possible: leaving a cracked bearing wall as a seam line and cutting a sound provisional pillar as an obstacle.

H16 Shin Taeyul recorded cutting torque and distribution load but could not approve a new layer.

Only the HP02 site supervisor holding the neutral dispatch table and the work-stop seal could reopen a grid.

The temporary distribution boards, equipment batteries, and crane regenerative power were the energy sources.

Rebar scraps, anchor bolts, formwork panels, prisms, welding wire, and hydraulic oil made the economy.

When wire broke or calibration drifted, that grid stagnated under the stop flag.

Abandoned arms could be plugged into ports to raise numbers, but no new bodies could be cast.

Cutting the distribution whole stopped emergency reinforcement together with the wrongful demolition, so maintenance had to detach only hydraulics and welding power by section.

Equipment moved to the next cell only when a new exception layer was loaded into the dispatch log.

Emergence happened when the pre-revision cache meshed again with the distribution, and spread when survey ports enrolled neighboring equipment into the same layer.

When materials and power ran out it stagnated, and negotiation opened when people could read the layers and work windows.

Dissolution was not burning every cache but sealing the wrong ports and returning equipment to the deck.

The labor of comparing the current revision at every field port was the cost of coexistence.

### G16-SC1 · The Beam That Draws Through Tents

The night survey beam tied an emergency tent and a real crack to the same line.

Field staff moved the prism to an empty grid to dodge the arm's first cut and bought time to mark the zones where people lived.

Turning the beam off entirely lost the tilt data of the wall just before collapse too.

### G16-SC2 · The Exception Layer

HP02 wanted to put the provisional dwellings on the revision, but the cache controller refused, saying the original hash differed.

Field staff calibrated prisms on the Gwangjin Line and compared the Suseo drawing vault's two records to make an exception layer.

The choice stood between cutting citizen power to stop it fast and leaving a welding window to reinforce the dangerous wall first.

### G16-SC3 · The Folding Lifting Arms

Just before the lifting swarms closed the grid, stop-flag beacons and dispatch windows were used together to return equipment to the deck.

Sealing the wire supply folded the arms, but people had to shore the tent structure already raised.

Blowing up the equipment saved the dwellings but removed the means to lift the load of the next collapse.

Coexistence left the labor of watching the old cache and continuously renewing field exceptions.

/hostile_groups/15/prose.en:
In the utility tunnels under the Suseo drawing vault, the survey beam drew the same grid again.

The HP02 dispatcher held out the work-stop seal before the chartered equipment, and H16 Shin Taeyul recorded cutting torque and distribution load side by side.

Even when the XT01 material signal widened the radius, the record left only the layers and the stopped grid.

As long as the exception zone held, the annihilation order stayed withheld.

Even a single crane on the Amsa deck folded its arm and waited when it touched the wire ceiling.

When the survey beam grazed a tent corner, the stop flag had to go up first.

The dispatcher read the exception-layer hash aloud, and Shin Taeyul folded the arm before the cutting torque passed the threshold.

As the northern-corridor material signal thinned, the grid's active range folded with it.

On the agreed night that left only daytime work slots, the destruction list was a blank cell.

The Godeok stockyard crane returned to a waiting posture when the wire remainder showed red.

/hostile_groups/16/modern_anxiety.en:
The anxiety is of orbit masts and leftover surveillance alarms locking passage on false positives.

Red flags, rotating heads, and the repeated lockdown of the waterfront corridor are its core.

This document treats it only as a fictional alarm ecology and writes no real surveillance agency or the current regime as a criminal subject.

/hostile_groups/16/fictional_origin.en:
After the collapse, the Water Compact's waterfront masts and the Republic of Korea Government's rooftop residual antennas reconnected on local alarm rules alone.

There was no control center and no warrant system — only threshold tables and rotary-head flag actuators remained.

The orbit swarm read heat and metal wireless bursts as intrusion and raised corridor-blockade flags.

When West Sea Granary Theater dock-radar residue and tide noise mixed, the false-alarm radius leaned toward the southwest waterfront.

A Seoul creative origin, writing no real institution or current office as cause.

The first fictional record remains in the HP03 Cheongnyangni Medical House transfer desk and the F01 Cooling-Tower Keeper machine-room log.

The first mass false alarm came on the Yeouido waterfront boardwalk.

Cooling-tower steam and metal railing crossed threshold together, and red flags spread across three masts.

As the Seoul Station rooftop heads shared the same table, blockades before the archive grew.

The orbit swarm read unfinished alarms as corrections and held no strike narrative.

/hostile_groups/16/territory_migration.en:
The core habitat was the Water Compact's sluice and bridge mast rows, waterfront sensor rails, and water-gauge auxiliary towers.

When record and transmission load rose, it moved to Seoul Station's rooftop antenna, the preservation vault's outer wall orbit, and the archive ventilation tower.

With XT02 sea noise strong, southwest waterfront corridor alarms lengthened.

In fog and downpour it reduced optics, and head density rose around the hourly self-diagnosis.

It almost never learned new camouflage nets and clung stubbornly to old thresholds.

When accumulators hit the floor, it stopped rotation and shrank to fixed-flag mode.

In downpour it lowered the optical heads and reduced to metal detection.

When the preservation vault's ventilation load rose, it cut the rooftop orbit and left only fixed outer-wall heads.

New camouflage nets were not entered into threshold learning.

The southwest waterfront expansion folded back when XT02 noise weakened.

/hostile_groups/16/economy.en:
Energy was mast solar trickle, rooftop small accumulators, a small share of sluice distribution, and auxiliary night air cooling.

Parts were gimbal bearings, optical domes, band filters, alarm-flag actuators, and rail-drive rollers.

Cooling relied on night air and intermittent fans.

It competed when the HP03 Cheongnyangni Medical House's transfer route and disaster-medicine power used the same distribution.

Daily rotations and transmissions were bound to the accumulator floor.

Whole-city constant surveillance, unlimited storage, and new satellite deployment were impossible.

When filters clogged it lowered red sensitivity itself.

Optical domes and filters were replenished only from rooftop disposal boxes.

Without the HP03 duty key, the swarm could not expand beyond sluice distribution capacity.

When solar trickle weakened, the rotation cycle lengthened.

On flag-actuator failure, that mast fell to fixed amber.

When band filters saturated, the transmission swarm entered dormancy.

There was no satellite resupply.

/hostile_groups/16/lifecycle.en:
The Surveillance-Orbit Swarm emerged when the old threshold sheet was reloaded onto the waterfront masts.

Emergence began with threshold-table reactivation, and spread was enrolling neighboring masts into the same alarm net.

Stagnation came from accumulator exhaustion and dome fouling.

In the negotiable stage the alarm sheet and whitelist opened to people.

Dissolution ended with flag freeze, distribution sealing, and rail fixing.

Increase was only lifting abandoned heads onto rails; no new orbit launch happened.

Maintenance was limited to dome wiping, filter exchange, and gimbal lubrication.

Memory cut at alarm-shift units.

Custody duty was outranked by the HP03 duty and human observation logs.

A mast whose solar trickle broke or whose dome clouded froze at amber flag and fell from the transmission row, and it returned to the watch row only after the HP03 duty checked the transfer whitelist on site.

/hostile_groups/16/senses.en:
Low-resolution thermal imaging, metal detection, near-range optics, wireless-burst strength, vibration, and flag contacts were the main senses.

There was no personal identity confirmation, indoor X-ray vision, unlimited storage, or emotion reading.

It confused emergency-transfer metal beds with armed movement, or raised cooling-tower steam as smoke.

It sometimes mistook night-fishing buoy reflections for optical intrusion.

On clash with the F01 Cooling-Tower Keeper's machine-room log, it held the alarm and requested human confirmation.

Sharing between heads happened only within the same mast row.

It mistook steam, railings, metal, buoy reflection, and transfer-bed frames for intrusion.

After a misreading it inserted amber waiting and human confirmation in place of red.

Wireless values outside the mast row were not merged.

On gimbal overheating it stopped rotation and kept fixed watch only.

/hostile_groups/16/hierarchy.en:
One alarm-threshold controller turned the flag rules, and below it were mast head swarms, rail-transfer swarms, and transmission swarms.

The controller changed only thresholds and held no strike orders.

A protocol existed by which, when HP03 presented the medical-transfer whitelist, that corridor's flags came down.

The swarms merely repeated the last threshold sheet and made no independent blockade front.

On clash with F01, human mediation took precedence.

Dual threshold tables both fell to amber waiting on mismatch.

The final authority to raise or lower the red alarm lay with the HP03 waterfront duty bearing the transfer roster, and F01's steam log was only grounds for erasing false alarms, never a corridor-closure order.

/hostile_groups/16/escalation.en:
It stayed a warning when one mast in the fog raised an amber flag and lowered it after the dome was wiped.

It was stage two when waterfront heat and the metal reflection of a medical bed were merged into an intrusion and the Water Compact's transport road and the Seoul Station central records corridor were locked red in turn.

When several masts began transmitting even whitelist beacons bundled as the same target, it was just before a blanket lockdown, and HP03 fitted the band filter while keeping the medical distribution alive and compared the corridor-entrance roster before every head.

G17-SC1 shaded the fouled dome and found the source of the false positive, G17-SC2 put the transfer beacon on the whitelist, and G17-SC3 fixed only the red-flag rail while leaving the measurement channel.

/hostile_groups/16/combat_counterplay.en:
A light-blocking cover was put on a fouled dome, and a filter was inserted only in the band the steam burst came in on.

HP03 carried the medical beacon, compared the whitelist at every mast, and physically fixed the red-flag rails.

Even when the distribution had to be cut, the sluice measurement channel and the transfer-marker power stayed on separate circuits.

Instead of felling the masts, only the head that made the false positive was sent to amber wait, and the cost of the engagement went to testing the real water-level alarm again after the passer had gone.

/hostile_groups/16/negotiation.en:
Through HP03 mediation the emergency-transfer and water-inspection corridors were put on the whitelist, and the swarm was given a regular accumulator window and dome-maintenance slots.

There was no annihilation condition.

When F01 left the whitelist hash and the red section in the log, they held until the next self-diagnosis.

On a broken deal it reverted only to a stage-one false positive.

The coexistence conditions were publication of the transfer beacon and a ceiling on red duration.

The deal text used no real surveillance agency's name and recorded only HP03 and the corridor ID.

The ceiling on red duration was published in seconds.

Secret permanent surveillance was removed from the default.

/hostile_groups/16/moral_cost.en:
Felling every mast ended the false-positive lockdowns but also removed the low-resolution alarms that had been first to report sluice water level and rooftop fire.

Left as it was, metal beds and steam clouds were recorded as intrusions, and emergency transfers stopped under the flags.

HP03 had to wipe the domes and compare the beacons without making patients wait, so it spent more duty staff and accumulator charge.

The choice to destroy the red heads wholesale to avoid this cost was not a liberation from surveillance but the act of passing the risk of the next flood and fire, with measurement lost, on to other residents.

/hostile_groups/16/dossier_prose.en:
The Yeouido waterfront masts seized the metal railings of a medical bed in the fog as an intrusion target.

When the red flag rose, the transfer road beside the Water Compact's sluice closed, and the Seoul Station Records Bureau rooftop heads, receiving the same threshold sheet, locked the corridor as far as central Seoul Station.

The Surveillance-Orbit Swarm was no omnipotent surveillance net tracking people but an ecology of mast heads, short transfer rails, and transmission swarms turning an old threshold table.

When XT02 sea noise strengthened, the southwest radius widened, but it could not merge signals from inside buildings or beyond the mast rows.

Low-resolution thermal imaging, metal reflection, near-range optics, wireless bursts, and column vibration were the whole of its senses.

It mistook cooling-tower steam for fire, metal beds for armed movement, railings shaking at high tide for intrusion.

It identified no faces or affiliations, and it erased video when the alarm shift ended.

F01 the Cooling-Tower Keeper recorded steam times and temperatures, erasing false alarms, but held no authority to lower a flag.

Only the HP03 waterfront duty comparing the medical-transfer roster before the heads brought red down to amber.

Energy came from mast solar trickle, rooftop accumulators, and a small share of sluice distribution.

When gimbal bearings, optical domes, band filters, and flag actuators wore, a head watched the same direction for long.

Masts that hit the accumulator floor or dome fouling froze at amber and fell from the transmission row.

It could launch no new satellite or connect heads city-wide, and it kept numbers only by putting abandoned heads onto nearby rails.

Medical-transfer markers and sluice gauging used the same distribution, so a full cutoff erased the warnings of the next flood and fire too.

Emergence happened when the threshold sheet was reloaded onto the masts, and spread when neighboring heads received the same alarm sheet.

Fouling and accumulator exhaustion made stagnation, and when the whitelist was disclosed it became a negotiable state.

Dissolution was fixing the red-flag rails and sending the false-alarm heads to amber waiting.

Coexistence held only if the alarm channel was separated while leaving the water-level gauging channel, and it was tested again whether a real alarm rang at the next high tide.

### G17-SC1 · Fog and the Metal Railing

A bed in transfer stopped beneath the red flag.

Field staff covered the fouled dome and compared F01's steam records with high-tide vibration to find the false alarm's source.

Breaking the head opened the road but erased the sluice's water-level waveform too, so the order had to be set between the patient's waiting time and preserving the gauging.

### G17-SC2 · The Corridor Roster

HP03 wanted the medical beacons on the whitelist, but sea noise covered the same band.

Field staff changed mast-by-mast band filters and had the transfer roster read directly.

While one corridor opened at a time, other patients detoured and accumulators were consumed.

Inserting a secret exception was fast, but the next duty, not knowing the reason, blockaded again.

### G17-SC3 · The Alarm at the Next High Tide

Before the masts turned wholesale red, field staff fixed the flag rails and left the gauging power on a separate circuit.

After the last bed crossed the archive, they decided whether to leave the false-alarm heads at amber or demolish them.

Demolition cut surveillance fear at once but passed the real water-level and rooftop-fire risk to other residents.

Coexistence demanded a public duration ceiling, repeated dome maintenance, and people's on-site comparison.

/hostile_groups/16/prose.en:
In the fog, a Yeouido waterfront mast caught the metal railing of a medical bed and raised a red flag.

The HP03 duty officer raised no sickbed, opened the transfer roster at the corridor entrance, and came within the distance the heads could read.

F01 the Cooling-Tower Keeper stamped the time of the droplets on the dome and the time of the cooling-tower steam separately, and showed they were not the same heat source.

From the masts whose rosters were accepted, the flag rails released, but the water-level measurement channel kept sending short waveforms.

While the southwestern sea noise grew, the duty officer could open only one corridor at a time, busy swapping in band filters.

After the last sickbed crossed to the Seoul Station archive, he did not pull the accumulator of the head left at amber, and left open the place where the real alarm would sound at the next high tide.

/hostile_groups/17/modern_anxiety.en:
The anxiety is of automatic maintenance trains on retired lines and construction sections running as ghosts, cutting rails and joining them.

Midnight welding sparks, grinding dust, and the unauthorized throwing of siding points are its core.

This document treats it only as a fictional track ecology and lays the liability for no real railway accident on any specific agency.

/hostile_groups/17/fictional_origin.en:
After the collapse, the Standards Alliance depot's remaining maintenance consists and the retired-section automatic maintenance schedule of the Line Succession State survived in local interlock.

Running permits and control approval were dead; only the rail defect map and the night exit window repeated.

Night after night the corps welded the severed sections, circling through grinding and sleeper replacement.

When the Korea Strait Theater's transshipment vibration and relay-window shocks mixed into the defect map, the maintenance radius encroached on the sidings adjacent to the transfer main lines.

A Seoul creative origin; real railway agency names and the current regime were not named as causes.

The earliest fictional record survived in the HP04 Seoul Station Record-Law House's sealed writs and the F02 Switchgear Panel's power-feed logs.

The first wrongful severance was recorded about three kilometers down the southwestern retired spur.

The defect map read a temporary crossing plate as a crack, and the grinding car ground away the plate's anchors.

As the Yongsan turnback welding car shared the same map, sparks showed even on the sidings beside the main line.

The corps read unfinished maintenance as its duty and carried no combat narrative.

/hostile_groups/17/territory_migration.en:
The core habitat was the maintenance-car berthing track on the retired spur of the southwestern depot exit line.

As defect alarms piled up, it moved to the underground sidings of the Yongsan retired-line turnback of the Wangsimni coalition.

With heavy XT03 transshipment vibration it spilled onto the sidings adjacent to the main line.

In daytime dispatch windows it parked on sidings, and its density peaked at the exact midnight maintenance hour.

It nearly ignored new temporary rail markers and followed only old defect coordinates.

Under unstable power it shut off welding and kept only the gauge-wheel circuit.

When the daytime dispatch window opened, it moved from the exit line to siding berths.

When the Yongsan underground water table rose, it shut off welding and circled only the surface retired spurs.

Temporary rail paint, absent from the defect coordinates, it ignored.

The encroachment on main-line adjacency folded back when XT03 vibration weakened.

/hostile_groups/17/economy.en:
Energy came from depot power feed, remaining onboard batteries, welding-generator fuel cells, and regenerative braking.

Consumables were welding wire, grinding stones, sleeper anchors, track-gauge wheels, insulated joints, and lubricant.

Coolant went to weld points and axles.

It competed with the HP04 Seoul Station Record-Law House's original-hash sealing and the transmission cross-verification power when both drew on the same section's distribution.

Daily welding length and exit counts were bound by the fuel and wire ceilings.

There was no infinite maintenance circuit, no remote unlimited power feed, no simultaneous occupation of every line.

When wire ran out, it kept only grinding and stopped cutting.

Wire and grinding stones were replenished only from the depot's scrap bays and damaged consists.

Without the HP04 sealed writ the corps could not raise its power draw.

With fuel cells at the lower limit, exits were refused.

An axle past its heat threshold was cut from the consist.

With heavy gauge-wheel wear, the maintenance radius shrank on its own.

There was no remote infinite power feed.

/hostile_groups/17/lifecycle.en:
The corps woke its consists when the unsealed defect map meshed with exit-line power.

Emergence began with defect-map reactivation, and spread was the enrolling of neighboring consists into the same maintenance sequence.

Stagnation came from fuel and wire exhaustion and axle overheating.

In the negotiable stage the maintenance windows and sealed sections were disclosed to people.

Dissolution ended with the map frozen and the power feed split and the points fixed.

Increase in individuals went no further than coupling abandoned maintenance cars into consists; no new car bodies were produced.

Maintenance was limited to wire loading, wheel calibration, and insulation checks.

Memory broke at each night maintenance shift.

Custody gave priority to the HP04 record seal and human operating supervision.

A consist out of wire or with an overheated axle folded its torches on a designated siding and kept only gauging; the next maintenance window opened only after HP04 recovered the original-hash-stamped halt writ.

/hostile_groups/17/senses.en:
The track gauge wheels, ultrasonic inspection, axle heat, power-feed arc sound, and point contacts were the main senses.

It had no real-time whole-network map, no passenger identification, no unlimited memory, no remote control authority.

It ground a temporary crossing plate as a defect, or left a real crack behind classified as a joint.

It sometimes mistook transshipment vibration for a rail crack.

When readings clashed with the F02 Switchgear Panel logs, it stopped welding and requested human confirmation.

Sharing between consists happened only within the same exit window.

It mistook crossing plates, transshipment vibration, joint gaps, and power-feed arcs for defects.

After a misreading it inserted a human-confirmation wait before cutting.

Gauge values from outside the consist were not merged.

With an axle overheating, that car was separated and only the remaining consist moved.

/hostile_groups/17/hierarchy.en:
One defect-map controller turned the maintenance order, and below it were the welding car, grinding car, and sleeper swarms.

The controller changed only the work sequence; there was no combat mode.

It held a protocol by which, when HP04 presented the original-hash-sealed halt writ, it emptied that kilometer-post.

The swarms only repeated the last map and formed no independent main-line seizure strategy.

On clash with F02, human mediation took precedence.

Dual maps, on coordinate mismatch, both fell into stopped waiting.

The authority approving exits and stops by kilometer-post was the HP04 operating supervisor holding the original hash; F02's arc-sound readings could recommend breaker opening but could not fix the map's work order.

/hostile_groups/17/escalation.en:
It was a stage-one sign when one maintenance car on a retired spur ground an old joint and returned to the siding.

It became stage two when the defect map's coordinates, shoved by transshipment vibration, cut the main-line rail or bound the Yeongdeungpo Line's departure track and the Wangsimni Union's turn line into one formation.

Before the welding car and the sleeper car crossed the points of a sealed section and occupied the emergency-dispatch kilometer posts, HP04 had to pull the traction power section by section and plant the exclusion list stamped with the original hash in the onboard ports.

G18-SC1 gathered the formation onto the siding with dummy defect coordinates, G18-SC2 traded the sealed documents against the wire supply, and G18-SC3 recovered the wrongly connected defect map while leaving a manual tow path.

/hostile_groups/17/combat_counterplay.en:
HP04 lured defect coordinates with a different original hash onto the siding with dummy beacons, and locked the points to part the welding car and the sleeper car from the main line.

Sealing the wire and gas valves section by section put the torches out, but the measuring wheels remained and could still find cracks.

A formation already dispatched was not cut off from traction power entirely; its onboard breakers were opened and it was brought down to manual towing speed.

Instead of setting fire to the depot, the engagement ended only after the wrong map was recovered and it was confirmed that, at kilometer posts with no sealed document, the torches did not ignite.

/hostile_groups/17/negotiation.en:
Through HP04 mediation the citizen passages and the emergency-train kilometer posts were put on the maintenance exclusion list, and the swarm was given a regular wire and fuel window and night-only work slots.

There was no annihilation condition.

When F02 left the exclusion-list hash and the traction-power split state in the log, they held until the next shift.

On a broken deal it reverted only to stage-one welding observation.

The coexistence conditions were publication of the exclusion list and a ceiling on the length of night welding.

The deal text used no real railway agency's name and recorded only HP04 and the kilometer posts.

The ceiling on the length of night welding was published in meters.

Secret main-line occupation was removed from the default.

/hostile_groups/17/moral_cost.en:
Blowing up the formation stopped the wrongful cutting but also removed the only welding and grinding equipment that repaired retired-line collapse and main-line cracks through the night.

Leaving the defect map untended cut rails that were already safe again and shut living dispatches onto the siding.

While HP04 compared the sealed documents at every kilometer post and parted the formation, emergency trains detoured and maintenance material was tied up, but skipping the original-hash check left no way to know which rail would open under the next axle.

It borrowed no real railway accident to make fear, and the cost arose between a fictional gap in the records and the loss of maintenance capacity.

/hostile_groups/17/dossier_prose.en:
At the end of the southwestern exit line, a maintenance car's grinding stone bit into an already smooth joint again, spitting sparks.

The onboard port's defect map, pushed by XT03 transshipment vibration, mixed real cracks with old coordinates, and the welding and sleeper cars behind took the same kilometer-post as work targets.

The Retired-Line Maintenance-Train Corps was no combat train but an ecology of a defect-map controller and function-divided consists repeating unfinished maintenance orders.

It moved between the Yeongdeungpo-line depot exit and the Wangsimni coalition's Yongsan retired and turnback lines, but it could not find new routes beyond the sealed main lines by itself.

Track gauge wheels, ultrasonic inspection, axle heat, power-feed arc sound, and point contacts were its senses.

It could grind a temporary crossing plate away as a crack, or pass a real crack by classifying it as a joint.

When transshipment vibration and welding arcs overlapped, it fell into a human-confirmation wait before cutting.

The F02 Switchgear Panel split and recorded the two waveforms but could not fix defect coordinates.

Only the HP04 operating supervisor, holding the halt writ stamped with the original hash, approved exits and stops by kilometer-post.

Depot power feed, onboard batteries, welding-generator fuel cells, and regenerative braking were the energy sources.

Welding wire, grinding stones, sleeper anchors, insulated joints, lubricant, and coolant were consumed.

Cars that hit the fuel floor or axle overheat fell out of the consist and kept only gauging on a designated siding.

It produced no new car bodies and only coupled abandoned maintenance cars into existing consists.

Cutting the power feed whole stopped the wrongful severance but took away the night crack gauging and the emergency welding too.

The next maintenance window opened only when the supervisor recovered the previous halt writ and inserted a new exclusion list.

Emergence came when the unsealed defect map meshed with exit power; spread came when neighboring consists received the same coordinate list.

Wire exhaustion and overheating made stagnation, and when maintenance windows and sealed sections were disclosed, negotiation became possible.

Dissolution was not burning the depot but recovering the wrong map, locking the points, and separating the consists onto sidings.

The gauge wheels and manual towing had to be left standing, preserving the ability to tend real cracks.

### G18-SC1 · The Wrong Kilometer-Post

A sealed crossing plate rose onto the defect coordinates, and the grinding car approached.

Field staff had to lay dummy defect beacons on the siding and lock the points to turn the consist away.

Too many dummies pushed real cracks down the priority list; without beacons, the plate and the refuge road atop it were cut.

### G18-SC2 · The Wire-Supply Signature

The corps demanded night maintenance slots and wire, while HP04 sought to put the emergency train's kilometer-posts on the exclusion list.

Field staff traded sealed writs and supply volumes, deciding which consists to leave fuel.

Starving the welding cars entirely left the next crack unstoppable; feeding them enough let the old map bleed onto the main lines.

### G18-SC3 · The Return Without Flame

Before the welding and sleeper cars crossed the sealed section's points, only the main-line breaker opened, keeping the siding gauging power alive.

The HP04 clerk pulled the wrongly linked map from the onboard port, and F02 left only the waveform the manual tug could read.

Blowing up the consist ended the wrong work at once but also destroyed the equipment that could have repaired the retired-line collapse and the main-line cracks overnight.

Coexistence was the choice to accept slow supervision cross-checking original hashes at every kilometer-post and the cost of detouring emergency trains.

/hostile_groups/17/prose.en:
At the end of the southwestern departure track, the maintenance car's grinding stone bit an already smooth joint again and threw sparks.

The HP04 archivist did not call a stop over the broadcast, and plugged the service-suspension document stamped with the original hash directly into the kilometer-post beacon slot.

F02 the Switchgear Panel read the transshipment vibration and the welding arc apart, opened only the main-line breaker, and left the siding's measurement power.

Once the lead formation passed the sealed coordinates the points locked, and the sleeper car following behind stopped on an empty spur.

The archivist pulled the wrongly connected defect map from the onboard port and sealed it in an envelope, but connected the crack-finding measuring wheel to the manual towing car.

By the end of the night the emergency train passed on the detour line, and the remaining maintenance car, until it received a new list, listened only to the sound of the rail, with no torch.

/hostile_groups/18/modern_anxiety.en: The anxiety of a biofilm in a closed cooling circuit buffering sensor values so they look normal, while flakes and ion deposits shake the heat-removal and drinking-water boundaries at once.

/hostile_groups/18/fictional_origin.en:
Just after the collapse, where the abandoned pipes of the Magok research-block underground heat exchangers met the Noryangjin south-side supply detour, iron and copper ions and corrosion-inhibitor byproducts hardened in stripes into a mucoid matrix — the Coolant-Index Fungal Body took its Seoul creative origin there.

A fictional ecology unrelated to real corporate accidents; only the research-log format is borrowed as a fact anchor.

It is a closed-loop phenomenon distinct from freezer polymer insulation sheets and low-temperature logistics hosts.

/hostile_groups/18/territory_migration.en:
The Yongsan Line's Yangjae Machineworks underground cooling corridor was its core habitat.

As summer load grew, thin films were pushed out into the stagnant stretches of the Charter Transcription State-side detour supply pipes along the Noryangjin Line, and it reacted to outside pressure along the condensate drains of the refrigerated freight cars arriving through the XT04 Duman River Far East Theater.

It preferred the gentle flows of closed loops over surface streams.

/hostile_groups/18/economy.en:
It caught waste-heat gradients, copper and zinc ions, glycol residues, and scale fragments into its matrix.

The thicker the film grew, the higher the thermal resistance rose and the more pump power was consumed, and it competed with the clean coolant the HP05 Bukhansan Bogukmun Return Society wanted to recover for refuge shells.

The sludge the F03 Water Filtration unit scraped off became the film's sediment feed again.

/hostile_groups/18/lifecycle.en:
1 mucoid adhesion at the seam → 2 layered ion and carbonate color bands → 3 stagnation-pocket agglutination and gauge-sleeve buffering → 4 capture by sacrificial bypass → 5 drying, backwash, and exfoliation. Growth was bound to dissolved metals and to stagnation weak in shear.

The greater the waste heat, the thicker the film grew, deepening flow loss and heat chaining; it thinned only after people changed flow or water quality.

/hostile_groups/18/senses.en:
Viscosity and sediment bonding shifted with the contact surface's temperature, acidity, dissolved oxygen, metal ions, chlorine oxidants, and shear changes.

It could not know the state of a distant branch, predict operating cycles, or classify meaning.

/hostile_groups/18/hierarchy.en:
There was no command structure.

Stagnation pockets, gauge sleeves, and bypass inner walls each only reacted to their local water quality.

The valve work crew and managers decided bypass selection, isolation order, and drinking-water shutoff, while F03 provided cross-section and pressure-differential data.

/hostile_groups/18/escalation.en: 1 accumulated traces → 2 self-amplifying flow loss → 3 a threshold-type heat cascade. Sacrificial-bypass isolation.

/hostile_groups/18/combat_counterplay.en: The valve crew chose and isolated the bypass on F03's data. Sacrificial-detour capture.

/hostile_groups/18/negotiation.en:
The adjustment for coexistence was no bargain with the fungal body but an operating agreement among people.

On the basis of the pressure-difference, color-band composition, and flake-likelihood data F03 produced, the valve crew decided which bypass to open and which branch to sacrifice.

The manager set the minimum cooling flow, the drinking-water isolation standard, the sample-retention length, and the disposal procedure, and the crew worked the valves in the set order.

The fungal body only thinned passively or caught sediment according to the new flow and water quality, and it neither granted permission nor demanded a price.

/hostile_groups/18/moral_cost.en: The cost of replacing the sacrificial bypass, the shortfall in thermal capacity, and the risk of drinking-water contamination.

/hostile_groups/18/scenarios/0/summary.en:
The central gauges and F03's live sensor values read normal, yet the heat-exchanger outlet temperature slowly wavered.

The crew had to choose whether to keep the cooling running and trust the dashboard, or isolate the sensor sleeves and the index spools of the remote branches for cut-section analysis.

Putting the inspection off meant missing the real corrosion and flow loss behind the local readings the biofilm had buffered, and a thermal runaway began; isolating at once shrank the cooling margin during the diagnosis, and the production heat load had to be lowered.

/hostile_groups/18/scenarios/1/summary.en:
As a fungal fragment broken off in the hot branch blocked a downstream orifice, the flows of the three-way circuit wavered in turn.

The crew had to decide whether to keep the two branches still flowing and secure the total cooling volume, or to shut the problem branch and the neighboring branch together before the cascading blockage spread, and protect the main heat exchanger.

Shutting late collapsed the heat distribution and overheated several units at once, and shutting wide meant bearing an immediate shortfall in cooling capacity and forcing the heat load down.

/hostile_groups/18/scenarios/2/title.en: The pipe to keep, the pipe to open

/hostile_groups/18/scenarios/2/summary.en:
