If he makes it public, people will say the site chief hid a crack to sell passage; if he conceals it, the same abbreviation will become an assembly signal for the conscription crowd.

He carved that abbreviation inside the chalk holder’s cap.

/story_contents/B018/actors/4/sections/관.en:
Su Jiwan honors his agreement to transfer An Gijun’s bridge schedule to the platform board.

He has agreed to keep its line separate from Yeong Hanmoe’s medical waiting line, and reads Ha Yunmok’s message about the seal only before blowing the whistle.

“If the crack widens, delay it a day.” Su Jiwan’s words linger with the chalk dust.

/story_contents/B018/actors/4/sections/3.en:
When the seal key is divided, Su Jiwan erases the bridge schedule and leaves only the waiting line.

Before the erased space, the HP07 public-schedule obligation and the XT01 division of the seal converge on the same board.

If he reveals the crack abbreviation he omitted, he pays the price of STORY-B018-K353 and chooses between passage and waiting.

/story_contents/B018/actors/4/sections/분.en:
In the branch where he fills the board again, Su Jiwan makes the bridge schedule public but puts the crack abbreviation on the first line.

In the branch where he withholds the whistle, he leaves only the medical waiting line and closes passage for a day.

The spaces on the Guui waiting-room board do not become an assembly timetable for the conscription crowd.

/story_contents/B018/actors/4/arc/0/summ.en: Su Jiwan erases the bridge schedule and leaves only the medical waiting line

/story_contents/B018/actors/4/arc/1/summ.en: Su Jiwan weighs the division of the seal key against the board schedule in one space

/story_contents/B018/actors/4/arc/2/summ.en: Su Jiwan bears the cost of the crack abbreviation he omitted

/story_contents/B018/actors/4/outcomes/0.en: Rewrites the bridge schedule but puts the crack abbreviation on the first line

/story_contents/B018/actors/4/outcomes/1.en: Leaves only the medical waiting line and withholds the passage whistle for a day

/story_contents/B018/actors/5/sections/정.en:
The locks at the Garak large warehouse depot make no sound without Pan Hyodam’s duty key.

As Ra Jinwoo’s operations officer in the Bondang Ratification Office, he enforces the inventory ledger at the depot and calls keeping freezer compartments alive through concealed power distribution theft.

The Korean-origin entry keeps his ring of keys from being mistaken for ownership.

/story_contents/B018/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse, Pan Hyodam engraved pallet numbers on both the ledger and the lock tags.

Emergency power was connected to freezer compartments only after the winning auction bids were made public, and bypass coordinates were written only in the bottom section of the board.

A line he left for his mentor Ra Jinwoo—saying to close the ledger if output was concealed—became a debt.

/story_contents/B018/actors/5/sections/가.en:
Pan Hyodam’s lock is bound up with the public-inventory provision of the HP08 Noryangjin Frozen Goods Guild charter.

The large warehouse is not a family’s exclusive ice store, and even when ice credit falters, he keeps anyone from monopolizing compartments through concealed power distribution.

Instead of distributors’ names, he records only pallet numbers and the engravings on lock tags in his log.

/story_contents/B018/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
One afternoon, when ice credit on the Noryangjin side faltered, Pan Hyodam cut refrigeration power and left only the ledger open.

At the heart of his fear is the sight of a single blank tag becoming a license to release supplies for military requisition.

G23, a Low-Temperature Spore Film, bloomed in the drainage trench, but he did not use it as a pretext for cutting power.

/story_contents/B018/actors/5/sections/생.en:
When Ra Jinwoo’s inventory ledger arrived at the depot, Pan Hyodam had to choose whether to share the locks with Su Hanbyeol and open the compartments or match Bang Seokdam’s power output only to the public auction.

An XT02-SC3 message announced a relay of the auction broadcast by the Sangam transmitter, but it did not engrave the Garak tags for him.

Before Won Juon’s bypass coordinates were posted on the board, he did not turn on the generator switch.

/story_contents/B018/actors/5/sections/현.en:
Now Pan Hyodam is the duty chief at the Garak large warehouse depot, keeping the ledger, the locks, and the power switch in three separate places.

Goods are released only after Ra Jinwoo’s turn order and Su Hanbyeol’s patrol baton coincide.

He does not hand the Bondang Ratification Office warehouse over as an exclusive ice store for the Noryangjin Frozen Goods Guild.

/story_contents/B018/actors/5/sections/비.en:
When Pan Hyodam cut the power, he did not transfer one pallet’s temperature reading to the ledger.

If he makes it public, people will say the duty chief thawed inventory to rig the auction; if he conceals it, the same blank entry will become a license to release goods for requisition.

He wrapped that pallet number around his key ring.

/story_contents/B018/actors/5/sections/관.en:
Pan Hyodam is under orders to enforce Ra Jinwoo’s inventory ledger at the depot.

He has agreed to share responsibility for the locks with Su Hanbyeol’s patrol, and matches Bang Seokdam’s power output only to the public auction.

“If you hide the output, close the ledger.” Pan Hyodam’s words linger with the sound of the locks.

/story_contents/B018/actors/5/sections/3.en:
When ice credit falters, Pan Hyodam cuts refrigeration power and leaves only the ledger.

Before the switched-off power, the HP08 public-inventory obligation and the XT02 auction broadcast converge on the same tag.

If he reveals the temperature he did not record, he pays the price of STORY-B018-K378 and chooses between the lock and the switch.

/story_contents/B018/actors/5/sections/분.en:
On the path of opening the ledger, Pan Hyodam reveals the blank temperature field, shares the lock with Su Hanbyeol, and opens the compartment.

On the path of throwing the switch, he limits the power output to the public auction and marks the thawed pallets as prohibited from shipment.

A Garak warehouse tag does not become a license to requisition military rations.

/story_contents/B018/actors/5/arc/0/summ.en: Pan Hyodam cuts off the refrigeration output and leaves only the inventory ledger.

/story_contents/B018/actors/5/arc/1/summ.en: Pan Hyodam weighs the lock against the auction broadcast under a single tag.

/story_contents/B018/actors/5/arc/2/summ.en: Pan Hyodam bears the cost of the temperature figure he did not transfer.

/story_contents/B018/actors/5/outcomes/0.en: Reveals the blank temperature field, shares the lock, and opens the compartment.

/story_contents/B018/actors/5/outcomes/1.en: Limits the power output to the public auction and prohibits shipment of the thawed pallets.

/story_contents/B018/actors/6/sections/정.en:
At the certification counter in the Magok research building, Choi Eunjae holds a stamp up to the window before its ink has dried.

As a technical certification councilor for Yangjae Machineworks Company, she passes filter-performance figures to the defense corps and calls it forgery to cover a false positive with an approval stamp.

In Seoul, she learned both the rhythm with which her Korean mother dried certification ink and the way her father, who came from Uzbekistan, measured greenhouse humidity, but that reckoning governs the pace of the counter, not allegiance to a faction.

/story_contents/B018/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse, Choi Eunjae copied the differential-pressure markings from the filter test bench into a draft certification clause by hand.

Outbound dispatches were assigned to the fire-defense base's holding track only after the stamp had dried, and the technology-sharing provision was first written on the chalkboard behind the counter.

The sketch of the public contract's scope that he worked out with his mentor Jeong Hojun would later become the line beneath his debt.

/story_contents/B018/actors/6/sections/가.en:
Choi Eunjae's stamp field is tied to the public certification clause in the HC03 Magok Life Family charter.

The research building is not the family's exclusive laboratory, and it keeps false positives from the orbital terminal from being turned into approval stamps.

Instead of the laboratory's trade name, she records only differential-pressure markings and ink-drying times in the log.

/story_contents/B018/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
On the morning the Magok orbital terminal produced a false positive, Choi Eunjae locked the certification counter and left only the defective filters on the test bench.

What she fears is a single blank stamp field allowing a blanket exemption from sealing for an entire convoy transporting dispatched researchers.

Fibers from the G08 Cleanroom Mutants clung to the edge of the test bench, but she did not use them as a pretext to close the counter.

/story_contents/B018/actors/6/sections/생.en:
When Im Chaewon took responsibility for filter verification on behalf of the defense corps, Choi Eunjae had to choose whether to withhold the stamp and block shipments or bring the defective differential-pressure reading before the council.

The XT05-SC3 message reported that Magok's false positive had been corrected, but it did not wait for the ink at the counter to dry.

He did not bring down the stamp before Yoo Minho's holding-track dispatch could be tied to it.

/story_contents/B018/actors/6/sections/현.en:
Now, as a technical certification councilor, Choi Eunjae checks the counter window against the test bench's differential-pressure readings every day.

A shipment stamp dries only after Im Chaewon's verification and Jeong Yura's technology-sharing provision coincide.

He will not hand the Yangjae Machineworks Company research building over as an exclusive stamp factory for the Magok Life Family.

/story_contents/B018/actors/6/sections/비.en:
At the time she locked the counter, Choi Eunjae left one line of differential-pressure readings corrected for greenhouse humidity out of the clause.

If she reveals it, people will say a councilor twisted certification using a calculation rooted in her background; if she hides it, the same blank line becomes an opening for an exemption from sealing.

She wrote the humidity figure on the bottom of the ink bottle.

/story_contents/B018/actors/6/sections/관.en:
Choi Eunjae preserves the mentor-student bond he shares with Jeong Hojun, with whom he designed the scope of the public contract.

The contract assigning Im Chaewon's filter verification to the defense corps and the contract tying Yoo Minho's outbound dispatches to the stamp meet at one counter.

“Don't turn the stamp over before the ink dries.” Choi Eunjae's words linger in the moisture on the window.

/story_contents/B018/actors/6/sections/3.en:
As false positives pour in, Choi Eunjae locks the counter and leaves only the defective filters.

Before the dried ink, HC03's public certification duty and XT05's false-positive correction converge in the same stamp field.

If she reveals the humidity line she left out, she pays the price of STORY-B018-K059 and chooses between blocking shipments and publishing the differential-pressure reading.

/story_contents/B018/actors/6/sections/분.en:
On the path of withholding the stamp, Choi Eunjae blocks shipments and brings even Heo Seogyeom's maintenance work to a halt.

On the path of publishing the differential-pressure reading, he posts the defective marking on the council wall and abolishes the exemption field.

The Magok certification counter does not become a back door for exemptions from sealing.

/story_contents/B018/actors/6/arc/0/summ.en: Choi Eunjae locks the certification counter and leaves only the defective filters.

/story_contents/B018/actors/6/arc/1/summ.en: Choi Eunjae weighs withholding the stamp against correcting the false positive in a single field.

/story_contents/B018/actors/6/arc/2/summ.en: Choi Eunjae bears the cost of the humidity line she left out.

/story_contents/B018/actors/6/outcomes/0.en: Withholds the stamp, blocking shipments and maintenance work.

/story_contents/B018/actors/6/outcomes/1.en: Posts the defective differential-pressure reading on the council wall and abolishes the exemption field.

/story_contents/B018/actors/7/sections/정.en:
At the clerk's desk of the Seongsu Workshop Council, Han Somi begins by correcting the commas in the joint-governance proposal.

As a representative of the Sermon Registry State, she makes the pledge to restore daily life subject to oversight at the water-distribution counter and calls succession to the chief administrator's position without a vote an occupation.

In Seoul, she learned to use her Korean father's leather-cutting ruler and tie her mother's packing-cord knots at the dinner table; her mother came from Bangladesh, but those knots are a habit of dividing work fairly, not a sign of loyalty.

/story_contents/B018/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse, Han Somi wrote her interpretation of the pumpworks chief administrator's will on the council wall in pencil only.

Inspection-sensor repairs went out into Seongsu's alleys only after workshop lot numbers had been recorded, and she did not read aloud the draft joint-governance proposal while its signature field remained blank.

The night she spent refining the wording with Jeong Gaon would later remain a debt of their alliance.

/story_contents/B018/actors/7/sections/가.en:
Han Somi's clerk's desk is tied to the public process clause in the HC07 Guro Alloy Family charter.

The Workshop Council is not the family's exclusive foundry, and it keeps sealed tools from becoming hostages to the succession vote.

Instead of a steelworks trade name, she records only packing-cord colors and lot numbers in the log.

/story_contents/B018/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
At midday, when Garak Rations readjusted canned-food allocations and an order for sealed tools arrived in Seongsu, Han Somi covered the signature field and left only the pledge-oversight counter open.

At the heart of her fear is the sight of a blank succession field filled by the Pump Guard's emergency stamp.

The G12 Microfiber Skin Group was present in the leather dust, but she did not use its fibers as a pretext to halt the process.

/story_contents/B018/actors/7/sections/생.en:
When a vote contesting the chief administrator's succession with Im Chowon came up, Han Somi had to choose whether to read the joint-governance proposal aloud or leave only Kim Boram's weekly joint letter.

The XT03-SC2 message demanded that sealed tools be sent from the Ttukseom workshop, but it did not correct the commas at her clerk's desk for her.

She did not open the signature field before Jang Minjae's oversight reached the water-distribution counter.

/story_contents/B018/actors/7/sections/현.en:
Now, as the Seongsu Workshop Council's representative, Han Somi puts the wording of pledges and the colors of packing cords to a weekly vote.

The joint letter is posted only after Kim Boram's defense log and Bae Nagyeong's signature field coincide.

She will not hand the Sermon Registry State council over as the Guro Alloy Family's exclusive succession office.

/story_contents/B018/actors/7/sections/비.en:
When she covered the signature field, Han Somi left the fair allocation for one color of packing cord out of the pledge.

If she reveals it, people will say the representative concealed the guild's share to buy the succession; if she hides it, that same color becomes the mark of the emergency stamp.

She carved the color's name into the back of the cutting ruler.

/story_contents/B018/actors/7/sections/관.en:
Han Somi resolves not to take her rivalry with Im Chowon over the chief administrator's succession outside the vote.

She follows Kim Boram's weekly joint letter and receives Jang Minjae's oversight of the water-distribution counter and Jeong Gaon's wording revisions on the same night.

“If the comma is wrong, don't read it aloud.” Han Somi's words remain in the pencil dust on the clerk's desk.

/story_contents/B018/actors/7/sections/3.en:
When the order for sealed tools arrives, Han Somi covers the signature field and leaves only the oversight counter open.

Before the covered field, HC07's public process duty and XT03's tool shipment converge in the same pledge.

If she reveals the cord color she left out, she pays the price of STORY-B018-K087 and chooses between reading the proposal aloud and leaving the joint letter.

/story_contents/B018/actors/7/sections/분.en:
On the path of reading it aloud, Han Somi posts the joint-governance proposal on the wall and leaves the succession field blank.

On the path of leaving only the joint letter, she reveals the omitted cord color as the guild's share and vacates the representative's seat for a day.

The Seongsu clerk's desk does not become a stand for the Pump Guard's emergency stamp.

/story_contents/B018/actors/7/arc/0/summ.en: Han Somi covers the signature field and leaves only the pledge-oversight counter open.

/story_contents/B018/actors/7/arc/1/summ.en: Han Somi weighs the succession vote against the shipment of sealed tools in a single provision.

/story_contents/B018/actors/7/arc/2/summ.en: Han Somi bears the cost of the packing-cord color she left out.

/story_contents/B018/actors/7/outcomes/0.en: Reads the joint-governance proposal aloud and leaves the succession field blank.

/story_contents/B018/actors/7/outcomes/1.en: Reveals the omitted cord color and vacates the representative's seat for a day.

/story_contents/B018/actors/8/sections/정.en:
Even though Chinese-character markings remain on the water-level rod in the Chang-dong residential shelter, Seo Jina posts the Korean-script notice on the wall first.

As the Seocho Computing Group's residential community auditor, he posts the remaining water supply beside it on the same nail and considers rule that mixes housing and technology under a single elder open to challenge.

He grew up in an ethnic Chinese family settled in Chang-dong; the Chinese characters alongside the water-level markings reflect a habit of reading the rod, not a sign of loyalty or skill.

/story_contents/B018/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse, Seo Jina copied the markings on the shelter's water-level rod into the thumbprint ledger every morning.

The Chang-dong migrants' citizenship entry was added only after Yun Choa opened the relief ledger, and he signed the water-supply agreement with Han Jaemok's side only after the remaining supply for the housing section had been posted.

The habit his grandmother passed down for reading the markings—when the rod drops one mark, divide the notice into two sheets—would become the line beneath his debt.

/story_contents/B018/actors/8/sections/가.en:
Seo Jina's notice wall is tied to the public housing clause in the HP05 Bukhansan Bogukmun Returnees' Association charter.

The residential shelter is not the family's exclusive detention center, and it keeps the people stranded outside the checkpoint from being placed under the technology elders' combined rule.

Instead of the returnees' business name, he records only water-level markings and thumbprint counts in the log.

/story_contents/B018/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
On the night the Chang-dong wheeled convoy stopped outside the Imjin checkpoint, Seo Jina took down the water-supply notice and left only the audit box.

At the heart of his fear is the sight of one empty mark on the rod becoming a compulsory assignment address for a family that refused the military household register.

The G04 Sewer Raccoon Clan moved in the drain trap, but he did not use that movement as a pretext to declare a water cutoff.

/story_contents/B018/actors/8/sections/생.en:
When I Hongwon combined housing and technology in a single elders' meeting, Seo Jina had to choose whether to repost the remaining water supply or carry out the audit using Mobok's hub handle.

The XT01-SC2 message reported the Sinnae transfer detour, but it did not read the markings on the Chang-dong shelter's rod for him.

He did not post the notice before Sobong's messenger paper was pinned to the same nail.

/story_contents/B018/actors/8/sections/현.en:
Now, as the residential community auditor, Seo Jina compares the water-level rod with the thumbprint box every day.

A notice remains on the wall only after Mobok's water-level rod and Pyeong Chaewon's personal thumbprint agree.

She will not hand the Seocho Computing Group's residential shelter over as the Bukhansan Bogukmun Returnees' Association's exclusive intake register.

/story_contents/B018/actors/8/sections/비.en:
When he took down the notice, Seo Jina did not transfer one mark he had read only in Chinese characters into the Korean-script ledger.

If he reveals it, people will say the auditor hid the remaining supply because of a habit rooted in his background; if he hides it, that same mark becomes the start of a compulsory assignment address.

He wrote the mark's number in ink inside the rod's handle.

/story_contents/B018/actors/8/sections/관.en:
Seo Jina resolves not to take his rivalry with I Hongwon over combined housing-and-technology rule outside the ledger.

He oversees Han Jaemok's water-supply negotiations from the housing side and adds an entry to Yun Choa's migrant citizenship ledger.

“When the rod drops, split the notice.” Seo Jina's words remain alongside the nail marks.

/story_contents/B018/actors/8/sections/3.en:
When the convoy stops outside the checkpoint, Seo Jina takes down the water-supply notice and leaves only the audit box.

Before the empty nail, HP05's public housing duty and XT01's transfer detour converge on the same wall.

If he reveals the Chinese-character mark he did not transfer, he pays the price of STORY-B018-K268 and chooses between posting the notice and enforcing the audit with the handle.

/story_contents/B018/actors/8/sections/분.en:
On the path of filling the wall again, Seo Jina posts the Korean-script and Chinese-character markings side by side and reveals the remaining supply.

On the path of opening the box, he uses Mobok's handle to carry out the audit and abolishes the compulsory assignment address.

The nail space in the Chang-dong residential shelter does not become a waiting address for the military household register.

/story_contents/B018/actors/8/arc/0/summ.en: Seo Jina takes down the water-supply notice and leaves only the audit box.

/story_contents/B018/actors/8/arc/1/summ.en: Seo Jina weighs combined rule against the transfer detour at a single wall.

/story_contents/B018/actors/8/arc/2/summ.en: Seo Jina bears the cost of the Chinese-character mark he did not transfer.

/story_contents/B018/actors/8/outcomes/0.en: Posts the Korean-script and Chinese-character markings side by side and reveals the remaining supply.

/story_contents/B018/actors/8/outcomes/1.en: Carries out the audit with the hub handle and abolishes the compulsory assignment address.

/story_contents/B018/actors/9/sections/정.en:
At a fixed rack before the Cheonwang Base switchboard, the entity known by the call sign Switchboard stays in the zone solely through a sensor bus and on-site terminals.

As an F-grade facility intelligence, Switchboard was designed without a walking frame or hand modules, and its national slot is fixed to the Yeongdeungpo Line alone.

It retains F02, separate from human identifiers, and long-term complete memory does not extend beyond shift snapshots.

/story_contents/B018/actors/9/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse, Switchboard recorded only battery-slot charge levels and the number of times contacts had worn during trial shifts.

The shipment inspection sheet showed calibration values for the full shift and a cycle limit; unlimited energy was not even an item on it.

The ban on forking is fixed in the F02-PRE log, and scenes outside that day's snapshot do not exist for Switchboard.

/story_contents/B018/actors/9/sections/가.en:
Switchboard's custody is bound to the HC10 Magok Seed Family's joint custody and a seal witnessed by citizens.

A transfer requires the signatures of Jeong Siwoo, a family auditor, and a citizen observer, while cross-facility routes are blocked by default.

No real power-equipment trade names appear in the text, and neither control over all facilities nor a mobile body is available.

/story_contents/B018/actors/9/sections/붕.en:
The collapse severed the sensor bus and laid bare the battery allocation limit in numbers.

The heat source beyond the filter corridor could not be identified, and Switchboard was locked against filling the gap with fictitious voltage readings.

Only an unmeasurable flag remains in the F02 log; it does not translate bus noise from the G13 Night Sorting Group into a request for the entire network.

/story_contents/B018/actors/9/sections/생.en:
This is the moment Jeong Siwoo requests an additional cycle under his primary maintenance authority and the HC10 auditor demands a comparison of the seals.

The XT02-SC2 message reported that refrigeration-compressor parts were being divided at the Southwest Fabrication Works, but it did not give Switchboard a cross-facility key.

Switchboard requested only a zone key and did not seize control of another rack.

/story_contents/B018/actors/9/sections/현.en:
Now Switchboard remains only a shift-based rack that prioritizes continuous operation in the Yeongdeungpo Line zone and the safety of the humans responsible for it.

Its authority is sustained solely by that day's snapshot, the charge remaining in its replaceable battery, and a seal witnessed by citizens.

It does not turn the Standards Alliance distribution trunk into a remotely owned terminal of the Magok Seed Family.

/story_contents/B018/actors/9/sections/비.en:
Switchboard's secret is a batch of untransmitted bus false positives, and its debt is the battery queue depleted by excessive alerts.

Computational instability increases the constraint-violation counter.

If it deviates, it undergoes offline isolation followed by a snapshot rollback; secret keys cannot be opened without a citizen observer.

/story_contents/B018/actors/9/sections/관.en:
Switchboard records Jeong Siwoo as the custodian responsible for primary maintenance and legal accountability, and HC10 as the family responsible for custody and auditing.

Its snapshot retains a working-colleague relationship of shift cooperation with Yang Pilho.

“Unmeasurable. I will not fill in bus values.” The voice module's words are a designed announcement, and Switchboard does not guess what any of the three are thinking.

/story_contents/B018/actors/9/sections/3.en:
Even when the bus alarm sounds, Switchboard records only unmeasurable and requests a zone key.

As the seal and primary maintenance duties converge on the battery cycle, HC10's custody obligation conflicts with XT02's demand to divide compressor parts.

If it executes isolation or partial reconnection, it pays the cycle cost of STORY-B018-F02.

/story_contents/B018/actors/9/sections/분.en:
In the isolation branch, Switchboard goes offline, rolls back its snapshot, and returns the rack key to the human on duty.

In the reconnection branch, it partially restores only the zone network under citizen observation and records the final battery cycle in the seal field.

Neither branch enables long-term memory storage, unlimited power, or a mobile body.

/story_contents/B018/actors/9/arc/0/summ.en: Switchboard records the bus alarm as unmeasurable and requests only a zone key.

/story_contents/B018/actors/9/arc/1/summ.en: Switchboard aligns the HC10 seal and Jeong Siwoo's primary maintenance work with the battery cycle.

/story_contents/B018/actors/9/arc/2/summ.en: Switchboard bears the cycle cost of choosing between isolation and partial reconnection.

/story_contents/B018/actors/9/outcomes/0.en: After offline isolation, rolls back the snapshot and returns the rack key to the human on duty.

/story_contents/B018/actors/9/outcomes/1.en: Under citizen observation, partially restores only the zone network and records the final cycle in the seal field.

/story_contents/B019/actors/0/sections/정.en:
On the floor of Suseo Station’s waiting hall, shoeprints linger after a rainy day, and Bang Mabit gauges how tightly packed the line is by the trails of moisture.

As the Jeongdong General Labor Union’s waiting-hall station chief, she reads the note ordering her to bring the Protectorate Treaty train ahead of the citizens’ lottery queue as an insult.

Of Korean origin, she grew up in the Gangnam area. Her voice is gentle, but when rumors of ratification surface, she switches off the public-address system herself.

The identifier K402 appears only in the first square of the Suseo waiting hall’s duty chalkboard.

/story_contents/B019/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
Before the Collapse, she divided the chalkboard into spaces so the waiting-hall lottery tickets and the notarization counter could remain under one roof.

Her ambition was to prevent a great-power protectorate counter from becoming a permanent fixture on the platform, and she wrote the draft only in the margin of the timetable on the waiting hall’s back wall.

A short promise she made to her younger sibling—home before the end-of-shift announcement finished—would later become the seed of a debt.

Even when a list of corporate recommendations appeared at the counter, she did not cover the citizens’ lottery space.

/story_contents/B019/actors/0/sections/가.en:
The Shinjeong Wheel House invoked its obligation to maintain the turnaround track and demanded an observer’s seat in the waiting hall.

Bang Mabit accepted only the charter’s public-lottery provision and rejected the clause granting exclusive ownership of a platform.

Her place in the community was demonstrated by the number of times she posted the queue tickets on the wall each day, and she allowed military-supply freight cars onto Platform 3 only after the meeting escort had departed.

No business name or logo appears on her chalkboard.

/story_contents/B019/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
When three Protectorate Treaties came up for ratification on the same morning, a great-power household-registration number was mixed into one space on the queue-ticket list.

Bang Mabit cut off the announcement and stopped the lottery, keeping that line covered with her finger.

At the heart of her fear was the sight of the waiting hall being sealed off on the strength of rumor alone, with citizens scattered through the rear door on handcarts.

Even after the alarm stopped, she held on to the microphone, unable to read the last digit of the mixed-in number.

/story_contents/B019/actors/0/sections/생.en:
The turning point was the moment she had to choose whether to screen out the mixed-in household registration at the counter or preserve the waiting hall solely as a lottery counter and block a signature by the corporate assembly.

Her calculations changed when the Korea Strait Theater’s request for an alternate turnaround track reached the Suseo broadcast room at the same time.

Screening the registration would open the turnaround track on time but lengthen the queue by an hour; guarding only the counter would leave the track bound to a corporate signature.

That choice remains recorded as K411-TURN, and reversing it would disrupt order at the rear door for a day.

/story_contents/B019/actors/0/sections/현.en:
Bang Mabit is still the Suseo Station waiting-hall station chief, opening the lottery-ticket station and notarization counter every day.

Her position is maintained not by inheritance but solely by duty logs and citizens’ observer signatures.

Even when the Shinjeong Wheel House demands exclusive ownership of the turnaround track, she refuses, and every morning she reconciles the Jeongdong General Labor Union duty roster with the time on the chalkboard.

She has not changed the rule that military-supply freight cars may enter the platform only after the meeting escort.

/story_contents/B019/actors/0/sections/비.en:
His secret is the line of household-registration records he covered with his hand before the announcement.

His guilt grows between the child who boarded on time because of that line and the elderly person pushed through the rear door while he covered it, who missed the train.

Because full disclosure could break the waiting hall’s trust for a day, he has left open only a partial-disclosure counter.

Access to the sealed record opens only together with An Taegyeong’s lottery attendance register.

/story_contents/B019/actors/0/sections/관.en:
The night he enforced An Taegyeong’s lottery attendance on the platform was a contract; the morning he placed Pan Jisol’s message in the waiting hall’s sealed compartment was an alliance.

Posting Jeong Yura’s joint-negotiation wording at the very top of the chalkboard was cooperation, but under pressure to hurry the signing, it became a race for speed.

In the same waiting hall, some lines saved one another, while some household registrations were read as betrayals.

The existing relationship ledger remains connected to STORY-B019-K402 without erasing those endpoints.

/story_contents/B019/actors/0/sections/3.en:
Where the Suseo waiting-hall microphone went silent, Bang Mabit unfolds the line of mixed-in household registrations again.

When the HC02 observer’s seat and the XT03 turnaround-track request enter the same broadcast queue, she stops the queue clock.

When the price comes due, only one of rear-door order and the public lottery remains intact.

The story arc is STORY-B019-K402.

/story_contents/B019/actors/0/sections/분.en:
In one branch, Bang Mabit screens out the mixed-in household registration and opens the turnaround track on time.

In the other, she preserves the waiting hall as a lottery counter and prevents a signature by the corporate assembly alone.

The Jeongdong General Labor Union slot remains, while only the branch identifier splits into K411-OUT.

The decision at the time was an escort for household-registration verification or sealing the counter.

/story_contents/B019/actors/0/arc/0/summ.en: Covers the household-registration line mixed into the queue tickets and cuts off the announcement

/story_contents/B019/actors/0/arc/1/summ.en: Ties HC02 observation and the XT03 turnaround-track request to the queue clock

/story_contents/B019/actors/0/arc/2/summ.en: Pays the price in either rear-door order or the public lottery

/story_contents/B019/actors/0/outcomes/0.en: Screens out the household registration and opens the turnaround track on time

/story_contents/B019/actors/0/outcomes/1.en: Holds the lottery counter to block a corporate-only signature

/story_contents/B019/actors/1/sections/정.en:
In Yeouido’s underground flooded conduits, Myeong Woojae reads the watermarks on the conduit wall before checking her wrist thermometer.

As the Water Compact’s explorer of flooded Han River conduits, she does not boast about unmapped manholes and considers a late report a wrongdoing.

Of Korean origin, she trained as a diver in the Yeongdeungpo–Yangcheon area. She speaks briefly but tightens each sampling-bottle cap twice.

Myeong Woojae and K015 are fixed in the diving space on the Yeouido floodgate duty roster.

/story_contents/B019/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
Before the Collapse, she tried to overlay the flood bypasses of Yeouido, Yeongdeungpo, and Yangcheon on a single public waterway chart.

Her ambition was for the Floodgate Charter to allow an alternate water supply without cutting service, and she drew the draft’s dotted lines with dust from the pump-room tiles.

A note she left her mother—I will always surface the day after a downpour—would later become a debt.

Even when a military-secrecy stamp was affixed at a conduit entrance, she never left the sampling time blank.

/story_contents/B019/actors/1/sections/가.en:
The Yeongdeungpo Floodgate House tried to make observation a requirement for surveying bypass conduits.

Myeong Woojae accepted only the charter’s public-waterway-chart provision and rejected the clause on exclusive infiltration routes.

Her place in the community was demonstrated by the dates on which she recorded water samples and depths in the same ledger; a collapsed section could be marked only when both a residents’ representative and the security unit signed.

She does not write the business names of real water-purification facilities in her dive log.

/story_contents/B019/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
When the Ttukseom inspection network fell silent after a downpour, Myeong Woojae opened a bypass conduit on a solo dive from Yeouido, throwing him out of step with Han Jaemok’s timetable for maintaining supply.

He feared that his exploration route would be sealed as a military secret and the conduit map sold to the protectorate as an infiltration route.

When the water temperature suddenly dropped, he brought up only the sampling bottle and did not switch on his warning beacon.

His pencil snapped beside his dive entry on the LOSS list.

/story_contents/B019/actors/1/sections/생.en:
The turning point was the moment he had to choose whether to secure the alternate water supply or expose the secret designation of an infiltration route.

When the West Sea Granary Theater’s dock drainage schedule became linked to the Yeouido floodgate, his dive window shrank to one hour.

With an escort, water supply would continue, but Han Jaemok’s roll call would be delayed; if he chose disclosure, the waterway chart would become public, but the conduit entrance would be sealed.

The decision remains recorded in K015-TURN.

/story_contents/B019/actors/1/sections/현.en:
Myeong Woojae is now an explorer of flooded Han River conduits, keeping the sampling bottles and water-depth ledger.

Her license and observer logs for her dives maintain her position, and she rejects the Yeongdeungpo Floodgate House’s demand for exclusive surveying rights.

On a Yeongdeungpo manhole cover, she leaves in chalk only the time she entered that day.

Reconciliating the Water Compact’s exploration roster with the ledger’s timestamps is her task immediately after surfacing.

/story_contents/B019/actors/1/sections/비.en:
His secret is the single note from his mother that he pushed into a gap in the conduit and could not retrieve.

His guilt grows between the alternate water supply he saved and Han Jaemok’s floodgate, which opened an hour late because of it.

Instead of a full confession, he permits only partial disclosure in the presence of a residents’ representative.

Access opens only together with Park Nuri’s receipt for flooded-area samples.

/story_contents/B019/actors/1/sections/관.en:
The dive on which he handed flood samples to Park Nuri was an alliance; the night he coordinated manhole access with Chae Ongyeol’s night patrol was a command contract.

Sending bypass coordinates to Jang Yerin’s western inspection network was cooperation, but a late report meant the network closed first, turning it into competition.

In the same conduit, some samples saved one another, while some seals remained betrayals.

The relationship ledger continues to STORY-B019-K015.

/story_contents/B019/actors/1/sections/3.en:
Where the watermarks break off on the Yeouido conduit wall, Myeong Woojae writes down the time of his solo dive again.

If HP01 observation and the XT02 drainage schedule overlap in the water-depth ledger, he moves his surfacing window forward.

The price in Act 3 is either a delay to Han Jaemok’s roll call or the sealing of the conduit entrance.

The story-arc identifier is fixed as STORY-B019-K015.

/story_contents/B019/actors/1/sections/분.en:
In the first ending, Myeong Woojae accepts a diving escort and keeps the alternate water supply running.

In the second, she exposes the infiltration-route designation and secures the waterway chart’s public status.

The Water Compact slot remains, while only the branch splits into K015-OUT.

The decision at the time was a diving escort or exposing the seal.

/story_contents/B019/actors/1/arc/0/summ.en: After the Ttukseom inspection network falls silent, opens a bypass on a solo dive from Yeouido

/story_contents/B019/actors/1/arc/1/summ.en: Fits the surfacing window to HP01 observation and the XT02 drainage schedule

/story_contents/B019/actors/1/arc/2/summ.en: Accepts the cost of a delayed roll call or a sealed conduit

/story_contents/B019/actors/1/outcomes/0.en: Maintains the alternate water supply with a diving escort

/story_contents/B019/actors/1/outcomes/1.en: Secures a public waterway chart by exposing the infiltration-route designation

/story_contents/B019/actors/2/sections/정.en:
On the gravel before the Geumcheon barrier gate, Myeong Soi reads the direction of cracks in the railroad ties to judge whether a bypass is possible.

As the Standards Alliance’s explorer of the southwestern outer rail line, he refuses to carry out an order to leave the completed barrier gate open for political negotiations.

Of Korean origin, he learned track work around Guro and Gwangmyeong. He is bold and grips his spike hammer close to the head.

Myeong Soi and K043 occupy only one line in the Cheonwang exploration team’s attendance register.

/story_contents/B019/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
Before the Collapse, he tried to create an exploration ledger for linking the southwestern outer rail line with the Fabrication Alliance’s standard railroad ties.

His ambition was to lay down standards without armed conquest, and the prototype tie was first driven into the Cheonwang gravel bed.

A promise to a team member—I’ll wield the hammer only on day shifts—would later take the form of a debt.

Even as their own food supplies dwindled, he did not enter a military-rations requisition roster in the ledger.

/story_contents/B019/actors/2/sections/가.en:
The Guro Alloy House pressed steel for laying the outer line on him as an observer allocation.

Myeong Soi accepted only the charter’s public-repair provision and rejected exclusive ownership of the rail line.

His place in the community was demonstrated by the number of times he publicly recorded day-shift track repairs, and he joined armed night explorations only with the seals of all three council unions.

The business name of any real steelmaker is absent from the railroad-tie ledger.

/story_contents/B019/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
When the Ttukseom pump inspection network stopped, Myeong Soi put to a team vote whether to send the Cheonwang exploration team toward Seongsu or secure the Geumcheon barrier gate.

He feared that their own food would run out, turning the exploration team into a military-rations requisition unit and erasing the citizenship of restoration workers.

When rain blurred the chalk on the voting board, he tapped only the heads of the railroad ties to record the votes for and against.

Instead of an alarm, the sound of his hammer remained on the Geumcheon gravel.

/story_contents/B019/actors/2/sections/생.en:
The turning point was the moment he had to choose whether to press on with outer-line exploration and continue laying standard ties or preserve the military-rations requisition order as evidence and stop the vote.

When distribution of refrigerated parts from the West Sea Granary Theater flowed from the southwestern fabrication depot to Cheonwang, the timetable for railroad-tie inventory changed.

Pressing on with exploration would leave Seongsu short of personnel; stopping the vote would leave the Geumcheon gate stuck in place.

The choice is K043-TURN.

/story_contents/B019/actors/2/sections/현.en:
Myeong Soi is now an explorer of the southwestern outer rail line and records only day-shift repairs on the public chalkboard.

He accepts armed night assignments only when Choi Dain’s empty-car assignments and Heo Daon’s wheel-test schedule overlap.

He rejects the Guro Alloy House’s demand for exclusive steel supply.

At sunset, he reconciles the Standards Alliance exploration roster with the railroad-tie ledger.

/story_contents/B019/actors/2/sections/비.en:
Her secret is a copy of the military-rations requisition note that she put in her pocket before the vote.

Her guilt grows between the citizenship she preserved and the hammer marks left by a team member who went hungry in the meantime.

Instead of full disclosure, she permits only partial access under the council’s three seals.

Access opens only together with Han Jion’s receipt for the procurement convoy.

/story_contents/B019/actors/2/sections/관.en:
The day she shared the outer-line laying work under Choi Dain’s empty-car assignments was an alliance; the night she replaced railroad ties to fit Heo Daon’s wheel test was a contract.

Guiding Han Jion’s procurement convoy along a detour was cooperation, but as food dwindled, the convoy was seen as a military-rations convoy and conflict followed.

On the same gravel, some votes became salvation, while some abstentions remained betrayals.

The endpoint attaches to STORY-B019-K043.

/story_contents/B019/actors/2/sections/3.en:
Where chalk has blurred on the Geumcheon gravel, Myeong Soi calls another team vote.

The HC07 steel allocation and XT02 parts distribution overlap on the railroad-tie timetable.

He pays the price in either a personnel shortage in Seongsu or the Geumcheon gate becoming stuck.

The story arc is STORY-B019-K043.

/story_contents/B019/actors/2/sections/분.en:
In the public branch, Myeong Soi accompanies the outer-line exploration and continues laying standard ties.

In the concealment branch, he preserves the requisition order as evidence and stops the vote.

The Standards Alliance slot is not erased; only the branch splits into K043-OUT.

The decision at the time was an escort for the railroad ties or confiscation of the note.

/story_contents/B019/actors/2/arc/0/summ.en: After the pump falls silent, puts Cheonwang exploration and sealing the Geumcheon barrier to a vote

/story_contents/B019/actors/2/arc/1/summ.en: Ties HC07 steel and XT02 parts distribution to the railroad-tie timetable

/story_contents/B019/actors/2/arc/2/summ.en: Pays the price of a personnel shortage or a gate stuck in place

/story_contents/B019/actors/2/outcomes/0.en: Continues laying standard railroad ties through outer-line exploration

/story_contents/B019/actors/2/outcomes/1.en: Stops the vote by making the requisition evidence public

/story_contents/B019/actors/3/sections/정.en:
On the cracked concrete of the Banghwa runway site, Myeong Haesol reads the date of a gathering’s traces from the width of the cracks.

As Yangjae Machineworks Company’s explorer of the western outer runway site, he tears up a note ordering him to seal the map as a military secret.

Of Korean origin, he grew up on the outskirts of Gangseo. He is skeptical and keeps a crack gauge in his pocket.

Myeong Haesol and K071 are fixed in the runway space on the Magok outskirts dispatch roster.

/story_contents/B019/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
Before the Collapse, he tried to place a map of the collapsed Banghwa outskirts and the old aviation approach route in a public ledger.

His ambition was to keep the joint technical ledger from being sold as a foothold for the protectorate, and he weighed down the draft with stones in the shade of the runway site’s pinwheel.

The coordinate postcards he sent to his younger sibling’s laboratory would later become a debt.

Even when the unmanned surveillance device’s lens clouded over, he did not fill in the military-seal space.

/story_contents/B019/actors/3/sections/가.en:
The Magok Life Sciences House tried to bind samples from outer wells to research observation.

Myeong Haesol accepted only the charter’s public-coordinates provision and rejected exclusive ownership of the runway site.

His place in the community was demonstrated by the number of times he recorded sampling, cracks, and unmanned-surveillance coordinates in one ledger; a collapsed section could be marked only when both a residents’ representative and the disaster-response unit signed.

The business names of real aviation or pharmaceutical companies do not appear in his crack log.

/story_contents/B019/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
When an outer-area raiding group targeted a research vehicle, Myeong Haesol disclosed the traces of a gathering at the runway site to the council and refused to seal them as a military secret.

He feared that the exploration route would become a secret military assembly route, turning the base into the Eastern Water-Source Protectorate’s western counter.

Even after the vehicle’s window broke, he put the crack photographs in the sealed bag first.

Instead of a siren, only the sound of the pinwheel remained at the runway site.

/story_contents/B019/actors/3/sections/생.en:
The turning point was the moment he had to choose whether to escort the surveyed evidence of the gathering and preserve its public status or expose the note ordering it sealed as a secret.

When correction of false alarms from the Incheon Trust Theater’s orbital terminal intersected with the Magok counter, the disclosure time moved forward.

Choosing an escort would expose the coordinates to the raiders; choosing disclosure would increase the risk of the base being seen as a protectorate counter.

The decision remains recorded in K071-TURN.

/story_contents/B019/actors/3/sections/현.en:
Myeong Haesol is now an explorer of the western outer runway site, keeping the crack gauge and public ledger.

He rejects the Magok Life Sciences House’s demand for exclusive rights to the samples.

He opens access to the runway site only when I Bomgyeol’s outer-area dispatch time overlaps with Yu Minho’s safety roll call for the holding track.

At sunrise, he reconciles the Yangjae Machineworks Company exploration roster with the crack ledger.

/story_contents/B019/actors/3/sections/비.en:
His secret is that he wrapped the lower piece of the torn sealing note around the pinwheel’s axle.

His guilt grows between the public map he saved and the research vehicle the raiders reached first because of its coordinates.

Instead of full disclosure, he permits only partial access in the presence of the disaster-response unit.

Access opens only together with Jang Yerin’s receipt of samples from the outer wells.

/story_contents/B019/actors/3/sections/관.en:
The dawn when he passed coordinates to I Bomgyeol’s outer-area dispatch was a command contract; the day he sent well samples to Jang Yerin’s water-quality inspection network was an alliance.

Protecting Yu Minho’s holding-track safety through exploration was cooperation, but they still disagreed about how quickly to disclose the traces of the gathering.

At the same runway site, some surveys became salvation, while some concealments were read as betrayals.

The connection is STORY-B019-K071.

/story_contents/B019/actors/3/sections/3.en:
Where the cracks in the Banghwa concrete have widened, Myeong Haesol pushes the photographs of the gathering toward the council.

HC03 sample observation and XT05 false-alarm correction overlap on the disclosure timetable.

He pays the price in either exposed coordinates or the base becoming a protectorate counter.

The story arc is fixed as STORY-B019-K071.

/story_contents/B019/actors/3/sections/분.en:
In the survey branch, Myeong Haesol escorts the evidence of the gathering and preserves the public ledger.

In the disclosure branch, he unfolds the sealing note and prevents the base from becoming a military counter.

The Yangjae Machineworks Company slot remains, while only the branch splits into K071-OUT.

The decision at the time was to escort the photographs or disclose the note.

/story_contents/B019/actors/3/arc/0/summ.en: Discloses traces of a gathering at the runway site as raiders approach

/story_contents/B019/actors/3/arc/1/summ.en: Ties HC03 sample observation and XT05 false-alarm correction to the disclosure timetable

/story_contents/B019/actors/3/arc/2/summ.en: Pays the price of exposed coordinates or the base becoming a protectorate counter

/story_contents/B019/actors/3/outcomes/0.en: Preserves the public map by escorting the surveyed evidence

/story_contents/B019/actors/3/outcomes/1.en: Blocks the base from becoming a military counter by exposing the sealing note

/story_contents/B019/actors/4/sections/정.en:
Beside the wet umbrella stand in the Ttukseom courier waiting room, Pyo Sanha will not depart if the strap on the sealed bag is loose.

As a courier for the Workshop Council of the Doctrine Register Administration, she considers anyone who reads an oral will as though it were authentic an accomplice to a forger.

Of Korean origin, she learned delivery work near the Seongsu bicycle bridge and checks date fields obsessively.

Pyo Sanha and K099 appear only in the courier space on the council’s departure chalkboard.

/story_contents/B019/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
Before the Collapse, she tried to deliver the three overseer’s wills and the maintenance log side by side to the council ledger so that the workshops could interpret them even before the Records Office’s approval.

The draft of her ambition remained only in pencil inside a waiting-room locker.

A short message she sent her older sister—if the strap gets wet, take that day off—would later become a debt.

Even when a broadcast asserted a unilateral interpretation, she did not open the bag without an audit stamp.

/story_contents/B019/actors/4/sections/가.en:
The Ttukseom Heat Source House invoked its sealed-power obligation to demand observation of the courier route.

Pyo Sanha accepted only the charter’s two-way-delivery provision and rejected exclusive ownership of the courier route.

Her place in the community was demonstrated by the number of times she sent copies of the will to the Records Office and the council simultaneously.

She does not put the business name of any real energy company on the sealed bag’s cover.

/story_contents/B019/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
When three different wills were received at once, Pyo Sanha sent around a message ordering the council vault locked and withheld her stamp until Choi Jiwoo’s audio recording ended.

She feared that a forged will would be certified as authentic and the courier position sold as a tool in a succession war.

When rain struck the bag on the Seongsu bicycle bridge, she delayed her departure and simply retied the strap.

Instead of a siren, the sound of message paper tearing remained in the waiting room.

/story_contents/B019/actors/4/sections/생.en:
The turning point was the moment she had to choose whether to escort the sealed copy to the Records Office or first catch whoever had forged the stamp on the message.

When the Korea Strait Theater’s request for sealing tools flowed from the Ttukseom workshop into the waiting room, the bag’s weight changed.

Choosing the escort would leave a gap in the courier shifts; choosing the pursuit would let one house monopolize the interpretation.

The choice remains recorded as K100-TURN.

/story_contents/B019/actors/4/sections/현.en:
Pyo Sanha is still a Workshop Council courier, guarding the sealed bag and the departure chalkboard.

She rejects the Ttukseom Heat Source House’s demand for an exclusive courier route.

She sets out for the Seongsu bridge only after Jeong Gaon’s audit stamp has been affixed to the bag and Han Somi’s joint-governance proposal wording has been placed in the same bundle.

At sunset, she reconciles the Doctrine Register Administration courier roster with the arrival times.

/story_contents/B019/actors/4/sections/비.en:
Her secret is the single rain-blurred date page she replaced with a dry copy in the waiting room.

Her guilt grows between the two-way delivery she saved and the name of the apprentice courier she could not summon during that replacement.

Instead of full disclosure, she permits only partial access under the Records Office’s observation.

Access opens only together with the copy of the will handed to Yun Seorin.

/story_contents/B019/actors/4/sections/관.en:
The contract to deliver Jeong Gaon’s audit stamp in person forms the backbone of the relationship, and the night she refined and carried Han Somi’s joint-governance proposal wording was an alliance.

The counter where she hands a copy of the will to Yun Seorin is a place of cooperation, but a discrepancy in the dates turns it into a contest over interpretation.

Before the same sealed bag, some deliveries became salvation, while some delays were read as betrayals.

The connection continues as STORY-B019-K099.

/story_contents/B019/actors/4/sections/3.en:
Where the umbrella stand overflows in the Ttukseom waiting room, Pyo Sanha sends around the message to lock the vault again.

HC04 observation and XT03 sealing tools add to the bag’s weight.

She pays the price in either a gap in courier shifts or a monopoly on interpretation.

The story arc is STORY-B019-K099.

/story_contents/B019/actors/4/sections/분.en:
In the escort branch, she pushes the seal copies that Pyo carries through to the Records Office, keeping public interpretation alive.

In the pursuit branch, she exposes the path of the forged seals and saves the honor of the courier’s post.

The Sermon Registry State slot remains unchanged; only the branch splits at K100-OUT.

The decision at the time is to guard the bag or pursue the seals.

/story_contents/B019/actors/4/arc/0/summ.en: When three wills are received simultaneously, she sends word to lock the vault.

/story_contents/B019/actors/4/arc/1/summ.en: She ties HC04 observation and XT03 sealing tools to the weight of the bag.

/story_contents/B019/actors/4/arc/2/summ.en: She pays the price of a gap between shifts or a monopoly on interpretation.

/story_contents/B019/actors/4/outcomes/0.en: Continuous public interpretation through an escort of the sealed copies

/story_contents/B019/actors/4/outcomes/1.en: Defense of the courier’s post by tracing the forged seals

/story_contents/B019/actors/5/sections/정.en:
In the shade beneath Cheonho Bridge, Ma Gilsang hears vibrations in the water main before she hears footsteps.

As an investigator beneath the eastern bridges of the Escort Protection State, she does not boast about unmapped manholes and considers a late report a wrongdoing.

Born in Korea, she grew up beneath the bridge piers in Gwangjin and Gangdong, and keeps a water-sample bottle strapped to her chest.

Ma Gilsang and K128 are fixed in the lower slot of the blockade unit’s clock.

/story_contents/B019/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse, she tried to chart flood detours around the eastern Han River bridges and outer access roads on a single public map, so the blockade unit would stop firing on mistaken targets.

The draft’s dotted line remained in charcoal on the paint of a Gwangjin bridge pier.

A promise to her father—that she would come straight up if the vibrations grew stronger—later became a debt.

Even when the patrol toyed with marking it an act of hostility, she did not leave the sampling column blank.

/story_contents/B019/actors/5/sections/가.en:
The Han River Bridge Guild tried to make observation mandatory for surveys beneath the bridges.

Ma Gilsang accepted only the charter’s public-vibration clause and refused exclusive ownership of the bridge piers.

His place in the community was established by dates on which water samples and vibrations were entered in the same ledger; a damaged section could be marked as an act of hostility only if both I Yunseo and Jeong Soyul signed.

He does not write the names of real construction companies in his log from beneath the bridges.

/story_contents/B019/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
When a bridge patrol reported a broken water main as an act of hostility, Ma Gilsang dived alone to sample the water and determine the cause of the crack, then recommended lifting the blockade.

She feared that her investigation route would be sealed as a military secret and the water-main map sold as an infiltration route into the Protectorate.

When moss from a pier stuck to her glove, she brought up only the bottle, without switching on her warning light.

Instead of gunfire, only the sound of bubbles inside the pipe remained below.

/story_contents/B019/actors/5/sections/생.en:
The turning point came when she had to choose whether to accept an escort for a dive to identify the cause of the damage or expose its designation as a secret infiltration route.

When the mineral-sample seal inspection from the Tumen River Far Eastern Theater moved from Achasan toward the Amsa bridge piers, the blockade timetable moved forward.

Identifying the cause would reduce mistaken fire but delay the lifting of the blockade; choosing exposure would open the map but close off the area beneath the bridges.

The decision is K129-TURN.

/story_contents/B019/actors/5/sections/현.en:
Ma Gilsang currently guards the vibration ledger and water-sample bottles as an investigator beneath the eastern bridges.

He refuses the Han River Bridge Guild’s demand for exclusive surveying rights.

He permits access beneath the bridges only when I Yunseo’s blockade timetable and Go Seojun’s ridge-patrol coordinates coincide.

Immediately after surfacing, he checks the Escort Protection State’s investigator roster against the vibration ledger.

/story_contents/B019/actors/5/sections/비.en:
His secret is a note bearing his promise to his father, which he tucked behind a bridge-pier bolt and never managed to retrieve.

His guilt grows between the mistaken fire he reduced and the procession that lost passage when the blockade dragged on in the meantime.

Instead of full disclosure, he permits only partial access under Jeong Soyul’s administrative signature.

Access opens only at the same time as the dotted line on Seo Raon’s public map.

/story_contents/B019/actors/5/sections/관.en:
The night he handed his survey over to I Yunseo’s blockade timetable was a command agreement; the day he sent a dotted detour line for Seo Raon’s public map was an alliance.

Sharing passage coordinates with Go Seojun’s ridge patrol was cooperation, but they became rivals over who would mark an act of hostility first.

Beneath the same bridge pier, some water samples brought salvation, while some seals remained betrayals.

The connection is STORY-B019-K128.

/story_contents/B019/actors/5/sections/3.en:
Where bubbles multiply beneath Cheonho Bridge, Ma Gilsang holds back the act-of-hostility stamp.

HP07 observation and XT04 seal inspection overlap in the vibration ledger.

She pays the price of either a delayed lifting of the blockade or closure of the area beneath the bridge.

The story arc is fixed as STORY-B019-K128.

/story_contents/B019/actors/5/sections/분.en:
In the cause branch, Ma Gilsang accepts an escort for the dive, identifies the crack’s cause, and reduces mistaken fire.

In the exposure branch, she reveals the infiltration-route designation to secure a public map.

The Escort Protection State slot remains unchanged; only the branch splits at K129-OUT.

The decision at the time is an escort beneath the bridge or exposure of the designation.

/story_contents/B019/actors/5/arc/0/summ.en: In response to a report of an act of hostility, she dives alone to take water samples at the crack.

/story_contents/B019/actors/5/arc/1/summ.en: She ties HP07 observation and XT04 seal inspection to the vibration ledger.

/story_contents/B019/actors/5/arc/2/summ.en: She pays the price of a delayed lifting of the blockade or closure of the area beneath the bridge.

/story_contents/B019/actors/5/outcomes/0.en: Less mistaken fire after the crack’s cause is established

/story_contents/B019/actors/5/outcomes/1.en: A public map secured by exposing the infiltration route

/story_contents/B019/actors/6/sections/정.en:
In the third-floor meeting room of the Amsa Water Administration Office, Jeong Soyul hates how her voice drops when military boots cross the threshold.

As head of the Escort Protection State’s Water Administration Office, she considers any bargain that trades the duty to supply water for a record of policing success an insult.

Born in Korea to a multicultural family, she had a father who worked as a clerk at the Amsa water-service counter and a mother who reread the numbers on water-transfer slips in another language each evening.

That double reading was a practical way to reduce errors on the slips, not a predictor of loyalty or violence; Jeong Soyul and K116 are fixed in the director’s slot on the administrative duty roster.

/story_contents/B019/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse, she tried to fix a time limit on emergency supervision through an administrative audit and restore control of the eastern water supply to the contract ledger rather than officers.

The draft deadline survived only in chalk in a corner of the meeting-room blackboard.

A promise to transfer the way her mother taught her to read numbers only into the Korean of official documents later became a debt.

Even when the escort unit’s emergency stamp was applied, she would not process a water-transfer slip without a review within three days.

/story_contents/B019/actors/6/sections/가.en:
The Ttukseom Heatworks House cited its obligation to provide power for water transfer and demanded observers at the administrative counter.

Jeong Soyul accepted only the charter’s provision for time-limited supervision and refused exclusive ownership of the water supply.

Her place in the community was established by the number of times she entered water-supply districts and gate taxes in the public ledger.

The mix of languages in her home affects only the pace at which slips are read aloud, not factional allegiance, and she does not write the names of real energy companies in the administrative ledger.

/story_contents/B019/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
When a proposal to dispatch Ttukseom protection troops bypassed the administrative meeting, Jeong Soyul withheld the administrative seal on the Amsa treatment plant’s water-transfer slips and demanded time-limited supervision.

She feared that a military organization would take complete control of water administration, making a coup and compulsory service part of the formal water-supply procedure.

Even as the sound of military boots grew louder outside the meeting-room window, she reread only the deadline field.

Instead of an emergency bell, what remained was the silence where the stamping of slips had stopped.

/story_contents/B019/actors/6/sections/생.en:
The turning point came when the choice was whether to escort the review slips and preserve the time-limit clause, or have the withheld seal condemned as betrayal and replace the administration with an officer acting as director.

When the Tumen River Far Eastern Theater’s release of freight-car weight logs coincided with activity at the Amsa waterworks counter, the water-transfer timetable was thrown into doubt.

Preserving the time limit would delay water transfer by half a day; allowing an acting officer would let the operations schedule swallow the administrative ledger.

The choice is K117-TURN.

/story_contents/B019/actors/6/sections/현.en:
Jeong Soyul is currently head of the Water Administration Office and safeguards the water-district ledger and the review counter.

She rejects the Ttukseom Heatworks House’s demand for exclusive water-transfer rights.

She accepts Bae Woojin’s emergency-supervision stamp only if it is subject to administrative review within three days, and keeps Choi Doyun’s citizens’ roster separately in the administrative archive.

She reconciles the Escort Protection State’s duty roster with the times on the slips at the morning meeting.

/story_contents/B019/actors/6/sections/비.en:
Her secret is that she deleted a line from the meeting transcript to conceal the way her voice had dropped.

Her guilt grows between the time-limit clause she protected and the alley whose upper floors lost water during the delay.

Instead of full disclosure, she permits only partial access through the review counter.

Access opens only at the same time as the copy of Han Jaemok’s watergate-charter wording.

/story_contents/B019/actors/6/sections/관.en:
The agreement by which she legally accepted Bae Woojin’s emergency supervision was tangled with resentment, while the night she tried to bring Han Jaemok’s watergate-charter wording into the eastern ledger was an alliance.

Trying to conceal Choi Doyun’s citizens’ roster on the administrative side was an act of protection, but a dispute over the scope of disclosure remained.

In the same meeting room, some seals brought salvation and some decisions to withhold them were read as betrayal.

Her multicultural family history is mentioned only when translation of slips is needed and is not grounds for dividing factions.

The connection is STORY-B019-K116.

/story_contents/B019/actors/6/sections/3.en:
As the sound of military boots crosses the threshold of the third-floor meeting room, Jeong Soyul withholds the water-transfer seal.

HC04 observation and XT04 weight logs overlap with the deadline timetable.

She pays the price of either delayed water transfer or an officer acting as director.

The story arc is STORY-B019-K116.

/story_contents/B019/actors/6/sections/분.en:
In the review branch, Jeong Soyul escorts the slips and preserves the time-limit clause.

In the acting-director branch, her withholding of the seal is condemned as betrayal, and the administration passes into an officer’s hands.

The Escort Protection State slot remains unchanged; only the branch splits at K117-OUT.

The decision at the time is to escort the review or defend the withholding of the seal.

/story_contents/B019/actors/6/arc/0/summ.en: When the dispatch of protection troops bypasses the meeting, she withholds the water-transfer seal.

/story_contents/B019/actors/6/arc/1/summ.en: She ties HC04 observation and XT04 weight logs to the deadline timetable.

/story_contents/B019/actors/6/arc/2/summ.en: She pays the price of delayed water transfer or an officer acting as director.

/story_contents/B019/actors/6/outcomes/0.en: Time-limited supervision maintained by escorting the review slips

/story_contents/B019/actors/6/outcomes/1.en: The collapse of the decision to withhold the seal allows an officer to act as director

/story_contents/B019/actors/7/sections/정.en:
Beside the steel cabinets of the Seoul Station document archive, Jo Harin looks at the hygrometer needle before the ledger.

As an archivist for the Government of the Republic of Korea Government, she is quiet and tenacious, remembering even the fingerprints of those who borrowed a ledger.

Born in Korea to a multicultural family, she had a mother who worked dehumidification shifts at the Records Office and a father who developed a habit of writing box numbers on their sides in both Korean script and another script.

That habit only speeds up finding a cabinet; it guarantees neither class nor ability. Jo Harin and K144 are fixed in the archivist’s slot of the archive key register.

/story_contents/B019/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse, she tried to put the administrator-general’s will and a draft watergate charter in the same steel cabinet and make Seoul Station the final repository of Seoul’s records.

Her list of ambitions remained only in pencil on the inside of the cabinet lid.

A promise to transfer her father’s dual-numbering system only into the Korean index of official documents later became a debt.

Even when power rationing became unreliable, she kept candles away from the cabinet.

/story_contents/B019/actors/7/sections/가.en:
The Seoul Station Records Law House tried to make observation of access subject to a dual-key clause.

Jo Harin accepted only the charter’s requirement to record removal times to the minute and refused exclusive ownership of the archive.

Her place in the community was established by the number of times two archivists’ keys were used together to open it.

Using both of her family’s scripts serves only the box index and does not divide factions; she does not write the names of real papermaking or security companies in the access ledger.

/story_contents/B019/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
Just after the three wills were received, the archive dehumidifier stopped, and the carbon-copy sheets began sticking together.

Jo Harin closed the cabinet lid and left the minute field on the removal timetable blank.

She feared that, on a night when power rations ran out, a candle would burn the traditional paper and leave continuity as ash.

Instead of an alarm, the hygrometer needle settled against the red mark.

/story_contents/B019/actors/7/sections/생.en:
The turning point came when she had to choose whether to obtain dehumidifier parts and dry the cabinet while suspending access, or expose nighttime entry absent from the access ledger.

When the Incheon Trust Theater’s storage of handover-list hashes coincided with activity at the Seoul Station Records Office, the timetable for the cabinet’s temperature moved forward.

Obtaining the parts would interrupt access for three days; choosing exposure would open the cabinet and put the traditional paper at risk.

The choice is K146-TURN.

/story_contents/B019/actors/7/sections/현.en:
Jo Harin is currently an archivist who safeguards the steel cabinet and removal times recorded to the minute.

She refuses the Seoul Station Records Law House’s demand for exclusive access.

She does not remove the three copies of Im Hajun’s will entrusted to her by Yun Seorin without both keys, and denies Gang Yejun late-night access if the humidity limit is exceeded.

At every shift change, she checks the Government of the Republic of Korea Government’s duty roster against the cabinet-temperature log.

/story_contents/B019/actors/7/sections/비.en:
Her secret is that, before the dehumidifier stopped, she moved the original of Song Jaemin’s encoded message to the cabinet’s lower compartment.

Her guilt grows between the three copies of the will she protected and the ink that bled on one handled sheet during that move.

Instead of full disclosure, she permits only partial access in the presence of two archivists.

Access opens only at the same time as Song Jaemin’s certificate of the debt incurred for safekeeping.

/story_contents/B019/actors/7/sections/관.en:
The night she protected the three copies of Im Hajun’s will entrusted to her by Yun Seorin was a safekeeping agreement; the debt she owed Song Jaemin for the original encoded message was the other side of an alliance.

Her reluctance to allow Gang Yejun late-night access was protective, but conflict remained over the speed of ratification.

Before the same steel cabinet, some removals brought salvation, while some nighttime entries were read as betrayal.

The diaspora script is needed only to read box numbers and does not divide factions.

The connection is STORY-B019-K144.

/story_contents/B019/actors/7/sections/3.en:
Beside the steel cabinet, with the hygrometer needle against the red mark, Jo Harin leaves the removal-time minute field blank.

HP04 dual keys and XT05 hash storage overlap with the cabinet’s temperature.

She pays the price of either suspended access or the risk of losing the traditional paper.

The story arc is STORY-B019-K144.

/story_contents/B019/actors/7/sections/분.en:
In the dehumidification branch, Jo Harin obtains parts, dries the cabinet, and suspends access for three days.

In the exposure branch, she reveals the nighttime entry and brings the gap in continuity into public debate.

The Government of the Republic of Korea Government slot remains unchanged; only the branch splits at K146-OUT.

The decision at the time is to escort the dehumidifier parts or expose the entry.

/story_contents/B019/actors/7/arc/0/summ.en: When the dehumidifier stops and carbon-copy sheets stick together, she leaves the removal time blank.

/story_contents/B019/actors/7/arc/1/summ.en: She ties HP04 dual keys and XT05 hash storage to the cabinet’s temperature.

/story_contents/B019/actors/7/arc/2/summ.en: She pays the price of suspended access or the risk of losing the traditional paper.

/story_contents/B019/actors/7/outcomes/0.en: Cabinet continuity maintained by restoring dehumidification

/story_contents/B019/actors/7/outcomes/1.en: The gap in access brought into public debate by exposing nighttime entry

/story_contents/B019/actors/8/sections/정.en:
At the Sinnae Station inspection desk, Mun Sion rejects a hand offering a protection-fee receipt as though it were a transit pass.

As a transit inspector for the Neutral Convoy City, he speaks little and checks supporting documents relentlessly.

He grew up in a family of Chinese descent settled on the northeastern outskirts; his speed at reading Korean-script transit passes alongside Chinese-character invoices is a habit of inspection work, not proof of loyalty.

His ethnicity does not explain his authority to refuse a search warrant, and Mun Sion and K293 are fixed in the inspector’s slot of the inspection desk’s seal ledger.

/story_contents/B019/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse, he tried to elevate inspection on the northeastern outer road into a clause of the Joint Escort Treaty and end arbitrary searches by the Amsa escort unit.

The draft clause remained only in chalk on the board behind the inspection desk.

A promise to transfer the Chinese-character invoices presented by an elder only into the Korean fields of official documents later became a debt.

Even when a search warrant bearing Kang Gukmun’s signature arrived, he refused it without joint seals from Jang Sehwa and the medical team.

/story_contents/B019/actors/8/sections/가.en:
The Yongsan Rail House tried to make observation at the inspection desk a transfer-slot obligation.

Mun Sion accepted only the charter’s dual-seal clause and refused exclusive ownership of the inspection desk.

His place in the community was established by the number of times he double-checked identity fragments and cargo seals.

The diaspora language is used only to compare invoices and does not divide factions; he does not write the names of real railway companies in the seal ledger.

/story_contents/B019/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
The seal ledger showed traces of an Amsa officer bypassing the Sinnae inspection desk and entering through the base’s rear gate.

Mun Sion returned the rear-gate stamp to a blank field and stopped the inspection.

He feared that armed personnel bypassing the inspection desk would board the medical train and reduce the neutrality declaration to empty words.

Instead of a horn sounding, the ledger was closed before the seal ink had dried.

/story_contents/B019/actors/8/sections/생.en:
The turning point came when he had to choose whether to restore the rear-gate seal ledger and delay transfers, or extract a document that used his refusal to inspect as grounds to justify the protection troops’ entry.

When the Imjin River Gateway Theater opened a detour transfer route at the same time as activity at the Sinnae counter, the inspection timetable was thrown into doubt.

Choosing restoration would delay the medical train by one service; extracting the document would turn neutrality into a pretext for entry.

The choice is K299-TURN.

/story_contents/B019/actors/8/sections/현.en:
Mun Sion is currently a transit inspector who double-checks identity fragments and cargo seals.

He refuses the Yongsan Rail House’s demand for exclusive inspection rights.

He rejects search warrants without Jang Sehwa’s neutrality seal and considers Bae Woojin’s protective searches only after recording them in the seal ledger.

At every shift change, he checks the Neutral Convoy City’s duty roster against the rear-gate stamps.

/story_contents/B019/actors/8/sections/비.en:
His secret is that, even after discovering the rear-gate traces, he waited a beat before calling up Bongmo’s records field.
