/story_contents/B022/actors/3/sections/정.en:
At the water-supply counter in the Amsa administrative office, Yeon Hajin fills a blank space in a voucher’s margin with ink before writing a person’s name.

As keeper of the municipal water-supply ledger for the Escort Protection State, he records as a violator any officer who fails to enter a verbal reduction in the ledger.

Of Korean origin, he grew up in the alleys around Godeok’s water supply, and yesterday’s stamp ink remains on his sleeve.

His display name, Yeon Hajin, and immutable identifier, K129, are not renumbered.

/story_contents/B022/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
Before the Collapse, she tried to make eastern water-supply zones and gateway taxes valid only when entered in an administrative ledger she had audited, so emergency oversight would not become a permanent stamp.

Her ambition was a water-supply copy posted simultaneously at the administrative office and the audit desk, and she first wrote the draft in a margin notebook.

A review voucher she passed to Jeong Soyul would later become the seed of a debt.

She stipulated that even an emergency stamp was invalid without review within three days.

/story_contents/B022/actors/3/sections/가.en:
The Yeongdeungpo Watergate House invoked its divided custody of the Guui watergate key to demand an observer’s seat in the eastern water-supply ledger.

Yeon Hajin allowed only a joint inspection with Han Jaemok and did not put orders to use water as a weapon in the margin.

His standing in the community was demonstrated by the number of times he posted water-supply copies at both desks simultaneously, and a proposal to deploy protection troops became invalid if it bypassed the administrative meeting.

No real business name appears on his vouchers.

/story_contents/B022/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
When the proposal to deploy protection troops bypassed the administrative meeting, Yeon Hajin left the administrative margin of Amsa’s purified-water transmission voucher blank and withheld his seal.

His fear was that one forged water-supply slip would overwrite the entire citizens’ register with an officers’ household register.

Before addressing the deployment proposal, he covered with sealing tape the footsteps of the Transfer Rat Colony expanding its feeding web in the Godeok transfer passage.

After the alarm stopped, he held his ink stick, unable to read the last line of Choi Doyun’s alley ration slip.

/story_contents/B022/actors/3/sections/생.en:
The crossroads came when he had to choose whether to escort a review witness and preserve the seal, or expose the margin notebook recording embezzlement and risk his position as ledger keeper.

On the voucher, this overlapped with word from the Tumen River Far East Theater that Amsa’s waterworks unit was releasing railcar-weight logs and Sinnae was adjusting transfer slots.

Escorting the witness would keep the water supply running but leave the deployment language in place; exposure would prevent a permanent stamp but leave the water-transmission voucher blank for a day.

The choice is K130-TURN.

/story_contents/B022/actors/3/sections/현.en:
Yeon Hajin conducts voucher roll call as the water-supply ledger keeper at the Amsa administrative office.

Jeong Soyul’s review logs and Gang Yejun’s duplicate of the eastern ledger maintain her position.

An emergency stamp is invalid without review within three days, and Choi Doyun’s alley ration slips are kept separately.

Her first use of ink is to match the keeper field in the profile to the margin time.

/story_contents/B022/actors/3/sections/비.en:
Her secret is one line about embezzlement that she saw only in the margin and did not put on the review voucher she passed to Jeong Soyul.

Her guilt grows between the conversion into a household register prevented by her withheld seal and the alley left dry by a day’s gap in water transmission.

Instead of a full confession, she permits only partial disclosure through duplicate copies.

The SECRET field opens only at the same time as Gang Yejun witnesses the ratification.

/story_contents/B022/actors/3/sections/관.en:
The night she transferred Jeong Soyul’s review voucher into the ledger was a master-apprentice relationship, and the dawn she kept Choi Doyun’s alley ration slips separately was a contract close to protective residence.

Sending a duplicate when Gang Yejun’s ratification review called for the eastern ledger was an act of witnessing; at the same counter, one person gained water and another lost a reduction.

The endpoint leads to STORY-B022-K129.

No verbal reduction became a ledger for any of those relationships.

/story_contents/B022/actors/3/sections/3.en:
At the water-supply counter, Yeon Hajin puts the bypassed deployment proposal and the blank margin on the same voucher.

He then ties observation of the HP01 watergate key and XT04 weight logs to the review clock.

Finally, he bears the cost of a gap in water transmission for either escorting the witness or exposing the embezzlement.

The storyline is STORY-B022-K129.

/story_contents/B022/actors/3/sections/분.en:
On one path, Yeon Hajin escorts the review witness and preserves the seal.

On the other, he exposes the margin notebook recording embezzlement, risks his position as ledger keeper, and prevents a permanent stamp.

The Escort Protection State slot remains; only the branch splits into K130-OUT.

The decision at the time was to escort the witness or disclose the margin.

/story_contents/B022/actors/3/arc/1/summ.en: Ties the HP01 watergate key and XT04 weight logs to the review clock

/story_contents/B022/actors/4/sections/정.en:
At the auction stand in Jongno’s notarized-copy market, Ma Eungyeol pulls a copy with a blank witness field out from under the auctioneer’s gavel.

An auctioneer in the Republic of Korea Government government’s notarized-copy market, he immediately removes any merchant trying to offer scrap iron at a high price from the morning drawing, and does not put the price of a copy of a will on the bid board.

Of Korean origin, he grew up in the alleys by the Jongno archive, and adhesive from yesterday’s seal stickers remains on his palm.

His display name, Ma Eungyeol, and immutable identifier, K157, are not renumbered.

/story_contents/B022/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
Before the Collapse, she tried to hold auctions of notarized copies and original map plates only together with Records Office seals, so Seoul Station prices would become a public ledger of ratification.

Her ambition was a desk that would not release an item if its witness field was blank, even after a winning bid; she first wrote the draft in a compartment beneath the auction stand.

The time of the notarization-seal check she entrusted to O Seoyul would later become the seed of a debt.

She returned Garak’s emergency-price proposal with resentment.

/story_contents/B022/actors/4/sections/가.en:
The Seoul Station Records Law House invoked its original-hash seal to demand an observer’s seat at the Jongno auction chest.

Ma Eungyeol allowed only a joint inspection with Yeo Ri-an and did not put language calling for unilateral disclosure in the bids.

His standing in the community was demonstrated by the number of times he checked seal stickers before auctions, and auctions of copies under the pretext of military provisions were refused.

No real business name appears on his bid board.

/story_contents/B022/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
When the wording on the expiration of the Ttukseom water-supply contract arrived in three versions, Ma Eungyeol refused to auction copies under the pretext of military provisions and allowed only public viewing.

His fear was that Garak’s price ledger would swallow the Jongno counter too, and treaty copies would be sold at military-provisions prices.

Before taking bids, he covered with sealing tape the traces of the Migratory-Wetland Predator Group moving behind the scenes in the pools beneath Cheonggye.

After the alarm stopped, he held the gavel, unable to read the blank line where Ran Jiho hoped his official rank would not become an item for sale.

/story_contents/B022/actors/4/sections/생.en:
The crossroads came when he had to choose whether to expose the ledger of secret-shipment winning bids and end the military-provisions pricing, or escort a sealed sample and preserve only the public auction.

At the auction stand, this overlapped with word from the Imjin River Gateway Theater that the Seoul Station Records Office was identifying forged certificates of kinship and the Achasan gateway was dividing custody of the sealing key.

Exposing the ledger would end the secret shipments but stop bidding that day; escorting the sample would preserve public viewing but leave the expiration wording in place.

The choice is K159-TURN.

/story_contents/B022/actors/4/sections/현.en:
Ma Eungyeol opens the lottery roll call as auctioneer at the Jongno notarized-copy market.

Ma Dohan's execution log of the transport order and O Seoyul's seal confirmations keep him in his position.

Copies with an empty witness column do not leave even when sold, and he goes against Nam Yungyeong's emergency prices.

Matching the auctioneer column of his profile to the time of bidding is his first gavel.

/story_contents/B022/actors/4/sections/비.en:
His secret is a copy number overlapping a forged kinship certificate, written only in the bottom column before O Seoyul's confirmation.

His guilt grows between the ratification protected by the ration auction he refused and the transport order emptied by the halted bidding.

He allows only partial disclosure through public viewing instead of a full confession.

The SECRET column opens only at the same moment as Yeorian's hash attendance.

/story_contents/B022/actors/4/sections/관.en:
The night he carried out Ma Dohan's transport order by auction was a contract, and the dawn he confirmed O Seoyul's notarial seal before the auction was an attendance.

The morning he sent back Nam Yungyeong's offer of emergency prices with a grudge was a refusal, and taking Ran Jiho's peerage out of the lot column was a debt.

At the same auction stand, one person won a copy and another lost a bid.

The end point leads to STORY-B022-K157.

/story_contents/B022/actors/4/sections/3.en:
At the auction stand, Ma Eungyeol sets three expiry drafts and an empty witness column under the same gavel.

Next he ties HP04 hash observation and the XT01 forged-kinship screen to the bidding clock.

At the end he pays the price of halted bidding for one of two things: exposing the smuggling line or escorting the samples.

The narrative line is STORY-B022-K157.

/story_contents/B022/actors/4/sections/분.en:
On one side, Ma Eungyeol exposes the smuggling-line winning-bid ledger and cuts off the ration prices.

On the other, he escorts the sealed samples, leaves only public viewing, and keeps that day's bidding going.

The Republic of Korea Government slot is kept, and only the branch splits into K159-OUT.

The decision at the time is to publish the smuggling ledger or to escort the samples.

/story_contents/B022/actors/4/outcomes/1.en: Sealed samples escorted keep public viewing; expiry drafts remain

/story_contents/B022/actors/5/sections/정.en:
At a riverside transshipment berth in Yongsan, Ju Haeum strikes from the sailing list any refrigerated compartment whose temperature sticker has fallen off.

As the Line Succession State's auctioneer at the riverside transshipment market, she drops family merchants who try to push empty crates at high prices from the morning lottery, and never puts the price of apprentice rations up for bidding.

Of Korean origin, she grew up in the Yongsan warehouse alleys, and the mark of the previous day's thermometer cord stays on her neck.

The display name Ju Haeum and the permanent identifier K181 are never renumbered.

/story_contents/B022/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
Before the Collapse, she tried to open transshipment and warehouse-lease auctions only together with the coordinator's seal, so that relay prices would become the public ledger of the Council of Successor States.

Her ambition was a berth where a false inventory compartment could not sail even if sold, and the draft was written first in her temperature log.

The time she left to Song Ideun for checking the lease ledger later becomes the seed of a debt.

She refused the Garak side's offer of emergency prices at the berth.

/story_contents/B022/actors/5/sections/가.en:
The Yongsan Line Gate demanded an observer seat at the riverside auction box, citing its neutral medical-escort formation.

Ju Haeum opened only Jang Sehwa's joint inspection and did not mix military supply compartments into public bidding.

Her place in the community was proven by how many times she checked temperature stickers before the auction, and family-only auctions were refused.

No real company names appear on her berth blackboard.

/story_contents/B022/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
When the tenants of the refrigerated compartments began pulling out their cargo, Ju Haeum refused family-only auctions and sold only public compartments.

Her fear was the sight of Garak's price ledger swallowing even the riverside berths, and Yongsan transshipment being sold at ration prices.

She covered with sealing tape, before the bidding, the burn film the electrolyte-burn swarm left on the berth as leak stains from the refrigeration compressors.

After the alarm went off, she stood gripping a thermometer without having read the last line of Ju Seoram's compartment lockdown.

/story_contents/B022/actors/5/sections/생.en:
The crossroads at the time was the moment she chose between exposing the smuggling-line winning-bid ledger to cut off family-only sailings, and escorting the temperature samples to save only the public-compartment auction.

In the Korea Strait Theater, word overlapped at the berth that the Yongsan transshipment warehouse would close one of its three routes and that Suseo would open an alternative return line.

Exposing the ledger stops the family compartments but cuts that day's transshipment; escorting the samples revives public bidding but leaves the closed route.

The choice is K184-TURN.

/story_contents/B022/actors/5/sections/현.en:
Ju Haeum opens the temperature roll call as auctioneer at the riverside transshipment berth.

Song Ideun's lease-ledger checks and Ju Seoram's execution log of compartment lockdowns keep her in her position.

False inventory compartments cannot sail even when sold, and she goes against Nam Yungyeong's emergency prices at the berth.

Matching the auctioneer column of her profile to the sailing time is her first thermometer.

/story_contents/B022/actors/5/sections/비.en:
Her secret is the weight of the cargo the tenants pulled out, written only in her temperature log before Song Ideun's check.

Her guilt grows between the public compartments protected by the family auction she refused and the apprentice rations emptied by the reduced transshipment.

She allows only partial disclosure through the temperature samples instead of a full confession.

The SECRET column opens only at the same moment as Jang Sehwa's neutral attendance.

/story_contents/B022/actors/5/sections/관.en:
The night she carried out Ju Seoram's compartment lockdown as a disqualification from auction was a contract close to command, and the dawn she checked Song Ideun's lease ledger before the auction was an attendance.

The morning she refused Nam Yungyeong's offer of emergency prices at the berth was a grudge, and at the same berth one person won public compartments while another lost a sailing.

The end point leads to STORY-B022-K181.

The price of apprentice rations became a bid in no relationship.

/story_contents/B022/actors/5/sections/3.en:
At the berth, Ju Haeum puts the missing cargo and the fallen temperature stickers on the same list.

Next she ties HP02 neutral observation and the XT03 route closure to the sailing clock.

At the end she pays the price of reduced transshipment for one of two things: exposing the smuggling line or escorting the temperature samples.

The narrative line is STORY-B022-K181.

/story_contents/B022/actors/5/sections/분.en:
On one side, Ju Haeum exposes the smuggling-line winning-bid ledger and cuts off family-only sailings.

On the other, she escorts the temperature samples, sells only public compartments, and accepts the closed route.

The Line Succession State slot is kept, and only the branch splits into K184-OUT.

The decision at the time is to publish the smuggling ledger or to escort the temperature samples.

/story_contents/B022/actors/5/outcomes/1.en: Temperature samples escorted keep public bidding; closed route accepted

/story_contents/B022/actors/6/sections/정.en:
Before the four-column blackboard of the Suseo compact mediation room, Sim Yuri covers with his palm any column missing a signatory and does not ring the council bell.

As the compact mediator of the Jeongdong General Labor Union, he does not ring the bell until all four columns are filled even when one side raises its voice, and he pushes envoys who try to rewrite protection packages as number columns into a separate agenda item.

He measures the length of silences by a childhood habit from the night interpreters' waiting list in Suseo, copying onto a blackboard the rhythm of his mother calling out Korean glosses beside foreign words, and that history does not stand in for the character of the place he came from.

The name Sim Yuri and the identifier K392 are permanent.

/story_contents/B022/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
Before the Collapse, he tried to set the agenda order of the eleven-lesser-state council from the mediator's seat so that joint negotiation would not split into partitioned vassalage under separate great powers.

His ambition was a bell that rang only after all four columns, water, passage, medicine, and compensation for losses, were signed, and the draft was written first in the bunk compartment beside the mediation room.

The chairing sentences he left to Jeong Yura later become the seed of a debt.

If even one column lacked a signatory, he postponed the whole agreement.

/story_contents/B022/actors/6/sections/가.en:
The Itaewon Interpreters' Gate demanded an observer seat in the mediation room, citing its multilingual waiting lists and treaty glosses.

Sim Yuri opened only Pyo Siwan's joint inspection and did not put the private linkage table into the agenda columns.

His place in the community was proven by how many times the four-column signatures were left on the same blackboard, and Bae Woojin's protection plan was quarantined as a separate agenda item.

No real company names appear on his mediation blackboard.

/story_contents/B022/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
Just before the eleven-seat council, when envoys of three great powers came into the mediation room carrying different protection and water packages, Sim Yuri locked the council bell.

His fear was the sight of mediation becoming a bystander between Bae Woojin's protectorate government and Han Jaemok's Sluice Charter.

He covered with sealing tape, before the packages, the noise of the blueprint-ghost machine corps pounding the walls under Suseo according to unfinished drawings.

After the alarm went off, he stood gripping chalk without having read the last line of Ryu Eunbi's Medical Charter clause.

/story_contents/B022/actors/6/sections/생.en:
The crossroads at the time was the moment he chose between rearranging the agenda to start from the water column and hold the council together, and exposing one great-power envoy's secret deal to break the council apart.

In the Korea Strait Theater, word overlapped on the blackboard that the Noryangjin interpreters' window had recorded a terminology clash and would keep the treaty even without the private linkage table.

Changing the order revives the signatures but leaves the secret deal; exposure blocks partitioned vassalage but leaves the eleven seats empty for a day.

The choice is K401-TURN.

/story_contents/B022/actors/6/sections/현.en:
Sim Yuri opens the four-column roll call as mediator in the Suseo compact mediation room.

Jeong Yura's chairing log and Jang Sehwa's council attendance keep him in his position.

Won Saeul's neighboring bunk is not opened for envoys only, and Bae Woojin's protection plan does not mix into the plenary columns.

Matching the mediator column of his profile to the blackboard time is his first chalk.

/story_contents/B022/actors/6/sections/비.en:
His secret is one line of an envoy's secret deal, heard only on the interpreters' waiting list and never written into Jeong Yura's sentences.

His guilt grows between the bystander role he prevented by locking the bell and the rumors of partition fed by the day the council sat empty.

He allows only partial disclosure through publishing the four columns instead of a full confession.

The SECRET column opens only at the same moment as Won Saeul's bunk log.

/story_contents/B022/actors/6/sections/관.en:
The night he chaired Jeong Yura's lesser-state council was command, and the dawn he opened the council side by side with Jang Sehwa was an alliance.

Putting Ryu Eunbi's Medical Charter clause on the agenda was an attendance, and splitting Bae Woojin's protection plan into a separate item was a refusal.

In the same mediation room, one person won signatures and another lost a package.

The end point leads to STORY-B022-K392.

/story_contents/B022/actors/6/sections/3.en:
In the mediation room, Sim Yuri puts the three packages and the missing signature columns on the same blackboard.

Next he ties HP10 interpreter observation and the XT03 terminology-clash record to the council clock.

At the end he pays the price of empty seats for one of two things: rearranging the agenda or exposing the secret deal.

The narrative line is STORY-B022-K392.

/story_contents/B022/actors/6/sections/분.en:
On one side, Sim Yuri rearranges the agenda to start from the water column and holds the council together.

On the other, he exposes one great-power envoy's secret deal and leaves the eleven seats empty for a day.

The Jeongdong General Labor Union slot is kept, and only the branch splits into K401-OUT.

The decision at the time is to rearrange the agenda or to publish the secret deal.

/story_contents/B022/actors/6/arc/1/summ.en: Ties HP10 interpreter observation and the XT03 terminology-clash record to the council clock

/story_contents/B022/actors/6/arc/2/summ.en: Pays the price of empty seats for rearranging the agenda or exposing the secret deal

/story_contents/B022/actors/6/outcomes/0.en: Agenda reordered from the water column keeps the council; secret deal remains

/story_contents/B022/actors/6/outcomes/1.en: Envoy's secret deal exposed blocks partitioned vassalage; eleven seats empty for a day

/story_contents/B022/actors/7/sections/정.en:
At the wheel test bench of the Sinjeong Base armored repair train, Choi Hangyeol locks the release switch whenever the brake sound falls out of step with the promised time.

As the Water Compact's chief of the Sinjeong Base armored repair train, she keeps crews whose release times slipped on the test log for a long time, and judges people by wheel and brake figures rather than words.

She remembers times through a history from the siding night shift, when her father wrote a double name inside the toolbox, a different name at home and Choi Hangyeol at the base, and she touched that note before each release; that history does not predict her maintenance skill.

The name Choi Hangyeol and the identifier K005 are permanent.

/story_contents/B022/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
Before the Collapse, she tried to build a circular maintenance network in which repair trains ran between the western sluices and the Sinjeong sidings within a day, becoming the physical backbone of the Sluice Charter.

Her ambition was a maintenance order on a public dispatch board, and the draft was written first in the wheel test log.

The pump and wheel parts contract she made with Gang Minseo later becomes the seed of a debt.

She sealed off separately in the Sinjeong warehouse the parts of states that broke their contracts.

/story_contents/B022/actors/7/sections/가.en:
The Sinjeong Wheel House demanded an observer seat at the release box, citing the battery-cell rotation of the Sinjeong Base sidings.

Choi Hangyeol opened only Yu Sejin's joint inspection and did not hand the remote key to the escort corps.

Her place in the community was proven by how many times she posted the maintenance order on the dispatch board, and wheels bound for Amsa were locked unless they met the southwestern standard.

No real company names appear on her test bench.

/story_contents/B022/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
When Amsa demanded reconstruction-service registration instead of parts, Choi Hangyeol locked the Amsa-bound wheels in the Sinjeong warehouse and declared she would accept only the southwestern standard.

Her fear was the sight of Cheonwang's parts standard being blocked and the armored train standing still, merely watching the sluices break.

She switched to read-only, before the release switch, the light of the watch-rail swarm falsely detecting leftover alarms on the Sinjeong rooftops.

After the alarm went off, she stood gripping calipers without having read the last line of Jeong Siwoo's standards alliance.

/story_contents/B022/actors/7/sections/생.en:
The crossroads at the time was the moment she chose between finding replacement wheels to save the circular maintenance network, and exposing the smuggling ledger of the sealed warehouse to cut off the Amsa run.

In the West Sea Granary Theater, word overlapped at the test bench that the Yeouido sluice would rework its dock drainage schedule to the West Sea tides.

Finding replacement wheels saves the sluices but leaves the sealed compartment; exposing the ledger cuts off the smuggling but stops releases for a day.

The choice is K005-TURN.

/story_contents/B022/actors/7/sections/현.en:
Choi Hangyeol opens the wheel roll call as chief of the armored repair train at Sinjeong Base.

Jeong Siwoo's Cheonwang standards alliance, Park Taegyeom's western dispatch window, and Heo Eunchan's power log keep her in her position.

Heo Dodam is bound to her as an apprentice who repairs wheels and pumps together, and Je Yun guarantees releases with records.

Matching the train-chief column of her profile to the test time is her first caliper.

/story_contents/B022/actors/7/sections/비.en:
Her secret is the double-name note inside the toolbox, and the name of an apprentice she failed to call on the night she touched that note before a release.

Her guilt grows between the southwestern standard protected by locking the Amsa run and the sluices left empty by a day's halted releases.

She allows only partial disclosure through the dispatch board instead of a full confession.

The SECRET column opens only at the same moment as Gi Bareum's parts-column log.

/story_contents/B022/actors/7/sections/관.en:
The night she made the pump and wheel parts contract with Gang Minseo was an alliance of supply, and the dawn she aligned the Cheonwang standard with Jeong Siwoo was a contract of measurement.

Lending the western dispatch window to Park Taegyeom was a debt, and Heo Dodam's apprenticeship, Je Yun's release guarantee, and Heo Eunchan's power command diverged on the same siding.

One person won a release and another lost a wheel.

The end point leads to STORY-B022-K005.

/story_contents/B022/actors/7/sections/3.en:
At the test bench, Choi Hangyeol puts the reconstruction-service demand and the locked Amsa-bound wheels under the same calipers.

Next she ties HC02 battery observation and XT02 dock drainage to the release clock.

At the end she pays the price of halted releases for one of two things: procuring replacement wheels or exposing the smuggling.

The narrative line is STORY-B022-K005.

/story_contents/B022/actors/7/sections/분.en:
On one side, Choi Hangyeol finds replacement wheels and saves the circular maintenance network.

On the other, she exposes the smuggling ledger of the sealed warehouse, cuts off the Amsa run, and stops releases for a day.

The Water Compact slot is kept, and only the branch splits into K005-OUT.

The decision at the time is to escort replacement wheels or to publish the smuggling ledger.

/story_contents/B022/actors/8/sections/정.en:
Before the recommendation board at Suseo Base, Eun Boram does not pin kinship-favor notes under the test-score column but folds them away.

As the recommendation-committee clerk for technical firms at the Jeongdong General Labor Union, she never puts a lineage note at the top of the board when the test-score column is empty, and folds away, with the date, the names of those who try to change recommendations through favors.

She looks first for the blanks on the board through a history of writing Korean skills-test dates on the kitchen calendar of a returnee household, and that history does not predict technical skill or loyalty.

The name Eun Boram and the identifier K393 are permanent.

/story_contents/B022/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
Before the Collapse, she tried to turn recommendations of specialist staff at Suseo Base into open skills tests and break the firms' monopoly on recommendations in the dual council.

Her ambition was a rule that the reason for a recommendation and the test score be posted on the same board, and the draft was written first on the blackboard of Su Neulgyeol's maintenance depot.

The Joint Technical Ledger idea she passed on to Jeong Hojun later becomes the seed of a debt.

She made undisclosed dispatches void without confirmation by citizen lottery.

/story_contents/B022/actors/8/sections/가.en:
The Digital Media City Trust House demanded an observer seat at the recommendation board, citing its hash seals on test scores.

Eun Boram opened only Choi Eunjae's joint inspection and did not put the corporate council's sole-recommendation sentences into the score column.

Her place in the community was proven by how many times reasons and scores were posted on the same day, and Im Chowon was called not as a dispatch candidate but as a joint examiner.

No real company names appear on her board.

/story_contents/B022/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
When Magok requested water-testing staff, some recommendation committee members circulated an undisclosed dispatch list first, and Eun Boram sealed the test column on the board.

Her fear was the sight of the recommendation committee becoming a hostage window that hands technicians over to great powers.

She covered with sealing tape, before the list, the sound of the bespoke-medicine remnant shaking stalled treatment devices in the cooling pipes by the base's back gate.

After the alarm went off, she stood gripping chalk without having read the last line of Won Choon's release blackboard.

/story_contents/B022/actors/8/sections/생.en:
The crossroads at the time was the moment she chose between pinning the undisclosed list on the board to break the monopoly on recommendations, and pulling a particular technician out of a hostage exchange while closing the test window for a day.

In the Incheon Trust Theater, word overlapped on the board that the Sangam transmitters would hold an open lottery for the remaining bandwidth and that Yeouido would align its times with the water duty.

Posting the list revives openness but leaves the hostage pressure; pulling the technician out saves one person but halts the skills tests for a day.

The choice is K402-TURN.

/story_contents/B022/actors/8/sections/현.en:
Eun Boram opens the board roll call as recommendation-committee clerk at Suseo Base.

Jeong Hojun's recommendation-rule contract, Jeong Yura's staffing clause, and Su Neulgyeol's field apprenticeship log keep her in her position.

Won Choon keeps the recommendation board at the very top of her blackboard, and undisclosed dispatches are not released without confirmation by citizen lottery.

Matching the clerk column of her profile to the test time is her first chalk.

/story_contents/B022/actors/8/sections/비.en:
Her secret is one line with the name behind a favor, written only on the kitchen calendar and never posted on the board.

Her guilt grows between the hostage-taking prevented by the sealed test column and the water testing left empty by a day's halted recommendations.

She allows only partial disclosure through posting reasons and scores together instead of a full confession.

The SECRET column opens only at the same moment as Choi Eunjae's hash attendance.

/story_contents/B022/actors/8/sections/관.en:
The night she reflected Jeong Hojun's Joint Technical Ledger idea in the recommendation rules was a contract, and the dawn she put Jeong Yura's public contract into the staffing clause was an alliance.

Su Neulgyeol backing the rules in the field was an apprenticeship, and Won Choon keeping the board at the top of her blackboard was an attendance.

At the same base where she tried to call Im Chowon as a joint examiner, one person won a test and another lost a dispatch.

The end point leads to STORY-B022-K393.

/story_contents/B022/actors/8/sections/3.en:
At the board, Eun Boram divides the undisclosed list and the empty test column with the same chalk.

Next she ties HP09 hash observation and the XT05 bandwidth lottery to the recommendation clock.

At the end she pays the price of halted tests for one of two things: publishing the list or rescuing the hostage.

The narrative line is STORY-B022-K393.

/story_contents/B022/actors/8/sections/분.en:
On one side, Eun Boram pins the undisclosed list on the board and breaks the monopoly on recommendations.

On the other, she pulls a particular technician out of the hostage exchange and closes the skills tests for a day.

The Jeongdong General Labor Union slot is kept, and only the branch splits into K402-OUT.

The decision at the time is to post the list or to rescue the hostage.

/story_contents/B023/actors/0/sections/정.en:
At the auction stand on Noryangjin Berth 3, Ma Hayul checks the temperature stickers on the sides of the boxes before he reaches for the gavel.

As a Won Buddhist fish wholesale market auctioneer, he immediately removes any boat owner who has tampered with a scale from the morning drawing list.

Of Korean origin, he grew up around the Han River estuary. His bargaining voice stretches out like a song, but he does not raise the opening price for the ice compartment serving a sick child.

The display name Ma Hayul and immutable identifier K205 remain only in the fish section of the Noryangjin auction ledger.

/story_contents/B023/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse, he posted a noon weight chart on the wall so he would open the fish and ice auctions only when inventory was made public.

He aspired to make Noryangjin prices a public ledger for common payment rights; the draft existed only in a patch of chalk space beneath the auction stand.

A note freezing the cost of ice for his younger sibling's fever medicine would later become a debt.

Even when someone whispered that he should offer empty boxes as military provisions, he would not declare a winning bid without real stock.

/story_contents/B023/actors/0/sections/가.en:
The Noryangjin Cold Storage Merchant Guild demanded auction observer seats, citing its ice-credit obligations.

Ma Hayul accepted only the charter's temperature-sampling clause and rejected the provision granting exclusive ownership of the berth.

His standing in the community was demonstrated by the number of times he kept thawed stock from shipping, and the escort-rights envelope was opened only alongside Yun Seoha's opening-price entry.

No actual cold-storage company's trade name appears in his auction ledger.

/story_contents/B023/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
When rumors of a poor harvest alone began sending empty boxes out at high prices, Ma Hayul rejected the fish-supply circuit designated for military provisions and auctioned only real stock.

At the heart of his fear was the sight of the Garak price ledger swallowing even the Noryangjin berths, with southern food sold at eastern military-provision prices.

Even after a sheet of auction paper blew away, he did not raise his gavel while he could not read the last number in a compartment whose temperature sticker had fallen off.

Droppings from the Migratory-Wetland Predator Pack remained at the edge of the berth, but he recorded them only as a cleaning turn, not as evidence of a poor harvest.

/story_contents/B023/actors/0/sections/생.en:
The crossroads then came when he had to choose between posting the smuggling-boat auction ledger at the counter and escorting temperature samples to protect the public auction.

When the West Sea Granary Front's ice-credit relay overlapped with Sangam broadcasting, the circuit clock moved forward one slot.

Posting the ledger would kill the market price for empty boxes but suspend Masol's eligibility for a cold-storage compartment for a day; escorting the samples would keep the auction running but leave the smuggling boats' names in the dark.

That choice remains as K209-TURN, and reversing it would leave the ice compartment for the sick child empty for half a day.

/story_contents/B023/actors/0/sections/현.en:
Ma Hayul still works as a fish wholesale market auctioneer, opening the morning drawing and the temperature-sample queue.

His position is maintained not by inheritance but solely through auction logs and citizen observers' signatures.

He refuses the Noryangjin Cold Storage Merchant Guild's demand for exclusive ownership of the ice and checks the Won Buddhist duty roster against the noon weight chart.

He has not changed the rule against shipping thawed stock, even if it wins a bid.

/story_contents/B023/actors/0/sections/비.en:
His secret is the number of the ice compartment associated with the note he tucked between boxes for his younger sibling and never retrieved.

His guilt grows only between the public prices he saved that day and the fever medicine that went out one circuit late because he held on to the samples.

Because posting everything on the wall could break the boat owners' trust for a day, he left only a partial-disclosure counter open.

Access opens only in conjunction with Masol's compartment temperature log.

/story_contents/B023/actors/0/sections/관.en:
The morning he enforced Yun Seoha's opening price in the fish circuit was a command contract; the noon he shared compartment eligibility and turns with Masol was an alliance.

He rejected Nam Yungyeong's proposal for emergency prices with resentment. At the same auction stand, some winning bids saved one another, while some empty boxes were read as betrayals.

O Haerin's payment-rights broadcast does not reach his gavel before market hours begin.

The existing relationship ledger connects to STORY-B023-K205 without erasing those endpoints.

/story_contents/B023/actors/0/sections/3.en:
At the spot on Berth 3 where a temperature sticker fell off, Ma Hayul unfolds the empty-box circuit again.

When HP08 observer seats and the XT02 ice relay enter the same auction queue, he sets down his gavel.

When the price comes due, only one of cold-storage compartment eligibility and public prices remains intact.

The story-arc identifier is fixed as STORY-B023-K205.

/story_contents/B023/actors/0/sections/분.en:
In one branch, Ma Hayul posts the smuggling-boat ledger, killing the market price for empty boxes.

In the other, he escorts the temperature samples to protect the public auction but leaves the smuggling boats' names in the dark.

The Won Buddhist slot remains, while the branches are distinguished by K209-OUT.

The decision at the time is to guard the ledger or escort the samples.

/story_contents/B023/actors/0/arc/1/summ.en: Links HP08 observation and the XT02 ice relay in the auction queue

/story_contents/B023/actors/1/sections/정.en:
In the relay room at Sangam's northwest gateway, Mo Guk cannot tolerate gaps in radio traffic and keeps merchants who are merely passing through on the ledger for a long time.

As head of the Yeouido Investment Union's northwest gateway relay hub, she does not let rumors without coordinates pass beyond the gateway.

Of Korean origin, she learned shift duty in the shadow of a transmission tower near Nanjido. She speaks softly, but to any unilateral radio correction she attaches an opposing opinion of the same length the next day.

Mo Guk and K230 are fixed in the relay section of the gateway duty chalkboard.

/story_contents/B023/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse, she posted relay logs and transit rosters on the same wall to make the northwest gateway an entrance for public relays.

She aspired to keep a bypass radio channel available even if a great power cut the electricity; the draft frequencies survived only as chalk marks on the gateway's back wall.

A brief message to her father—do not bring words without coordinates home—later became a debt.

Even when a proposal to install a censorship checkpoint came in, she would not transmit radio traffic absent from the roster.

/story_contents/B023/actors/1/sections/가.en:
The Digital Media City Trust Family tried to tie the drawing for remaining spectrum to an observer obligation.

Mo Guk accepted only the charter's public-log clause and rejected the provision for exclusive censorship.

Her standing in the community was demonstrated by the dates on which she kept medical bulletins a relay priority, and a unilateral correction was not finalized until an opposing opinion was attached.

She does not write any actual telecom company's trade name in her ledger.

/story_contents/B023/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
When a waveform matching the edited supreme commander's voice leaked once through the gateway relay, Mo Guk cut transmission and wrote the source-tracing steps on the wall.

She feared the gateway becoming a censorship checkpoint that shut out the shared time of weaker nations.

Communications Mycelium noise brushed the same band, but she did not call it evil; she counted only the false positives.

Even after the alarm stopped, she kept her headset on, unable to read the waveform's final segment.

/story_contents/B023/actors/1/sections/생.en:
The crossroads then came when he had to choose between blocking the source of the leaked radio transmission and fixing the medical-bulletin priority clause in the gateway ledger.

When the Incheon Trust Front's public drawing for remaining spectrum overlapped with Yeouido water-supply duty, the transmission window shrank to twenty minutes.

Blocking the source would stop the censorship but push Jang Sehwa's bulletin back one cycle; fixing the clause would save the bulletin but leave the waveform's origin unresolved.

The decision remains in K234-TURN.

/story_contents/B023/actors/1/sections/현.en:
Mo Guk is currently head of the northwest gateway relay hub, posting logs and transit rosters on the same wall every day.

Her license and observer logs maintain her position, and she rejects the Digital Media City Trust Family's demand for exclusive spectrum.

Checking the wall clock against the Yeouido Investment Union duty roster is part of her routine immediately after a shift change.

Rumors without coordinates still do not pass beyond the gateway.

/story_contents/B023/actors/1/sections/비.en:
His secret is the single line of his father's message that he hid in the waveform margin and could not make public.

His guilt grows between the censorship he stopped and the medical bulletin delayed one cycle because of it.

Instead of a full confession, he permits only partial disclosure in the presence of Bok Dumo and his measured coordinates.

Access opens only in conjunction with Sun Hangyeol's sealed testimony.

/story_contents/B023/actors/1/sections/관.en:
The night he received Bok Dumo's measured coordinates and overlaid them on the gateway relay was a contract; the dawn he connected So Gam's messenger route at the gateway was an alliance.

Keeping Jang Sehwa's medical-bulletin agreement in the priority slot was cooperation, but if Sun Hangyeol's testimony was late, the roster closed first, turning it into a race against time.

In the same relay room, some transmissions saved one another, while some waveforms remained betrayals.

The relationship ledger continues as STORY-B023-K230.

/story_contents/B023/actors/1/sections/3.en:
Where the static in her gateway headset cuts out, Mo Guk rewinds the leaked waveform.

When the HP09 drawing and the XT05 spectrum request appear on the same wall, she moves up the transmission window.

The price in Act 3 is either a delayed medical bulletin or a permanent censorship checkpoint.

The story arc is STORY-B023-K230.

/story_contents/B023/actors/1/sections/분.en:
In one branch, Mo Guk blocks the source of the leak and closes the censorship checkpoint.

In the other, he fixes the medical-bulletin clause in the ledger, preserving Jang Sehwa's priority slot.

The Yeouido Investment Union slot remains, while the branches are distinguished by K234-OUT.

The decision at the time is to seal the source or guard the bulletin clause.
