/story_contents/B023/actors/1/arc/1/summ.en: Overlaps the HP09 spectrum drawing and XT05 duty within the transmission window

/story_contents/B023/actors/1/arc/2/summ.en: Bears the cost of either a delayed bulletin or permanent censorship

/story_contents/B023/actors/1/outcomes/0.en: Blocking the source of the leak closes the censorship checkpoint

/story_contents/B023/actors/1/outcomes/1.en: Fixing the medical-bulletin clause preserves the priority slot

/story_contents/B023/actors/2/sections/정.en:
Among the racks at the Bukhansan Bogukmun drying yard, Mo Gam reads moisture before body heat and deals harshly with hands that hide undried roots deep in boxes.

As head of the Sangha Relief State's herb-drying hub, she distinguishes the smell of medicine from a fake seal with the same nose.

Of Korean origin, she learned drying shifts along a mountain evacuation route. She speaks briefly, but does not sit down until she has moved an unsealed box to the isolation compartment.

Mo Gam and K255 are written in the hub section of the drying-weight chalkboard.

/story_contents/B023/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse, she wrote weights on the wall every day to bring mountain herb drying into the federation's public inventory.

She aspired to keep great-power relief boxes from taking control of the drying-yard key; the draft lot numbers survived only in charcoal dust beneath the racks.

A sack of fever-reducing roots she dried separately for her niece or nephew was a small promise, and that sack became a debt.

Even when a relief clerk tried to hold the key alone, she would not permit an unsealed release.

/story_contents/B023/actors/2/sections/가.en:
The Bukhansan Bogukmun Return Association tried to extend returnee-roster quarantine to observation of the drying yard.

Mo Gam accepted only the charter's public-weight clause and rejected the provision for an exclusive relief warehouse.

His standing in the community was demonstrated by the dates when he matched lots against Bong Gam's medication roster, and boxes with fake seals were isolated before they reached Hwang Serin's distribution scale.

He does not write any actual pharmaceutical company's trade name in his drying log.

/story_contents/B023/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
When dried roots bearing the same lot marking were found beside a box of counterfeit medicine, Mo Gam sealed off a row of racks and covered the corresponding entry in the children's medication roster.

She feared the contaminated roster overlapping with the damaged returnee roster at the Imjin quarantine station, leaving the children of Bukhansan Bogukmun out of the reissuance line.

The smell of a Custom-Medicine Remnant passed through the isolation compartment, but she wrote no monster's name on the wall; she wrote the lot number three times.

Even after the charcoal fire went out, she could not read the last character of the covered entry.

/story_contents/B023/actors/2/sections/생.en:
The crossroads then came when she had to choose between isolating the entire lot and sharing control of the drying-yard key with the relief clerk.

When the Imjin River Gateway Front's demand to reissue returnee rosters reached the drying-yard door, the quarantine timetable moved forward.

Isolation would save the medication roster but halt relief boxes for a day; sharing the key would let the boxes in but open a gap through which fake seals could mix in again.

The choice remains as K260-TURN.

/story_contents/B023/actors/2/sections/현.en:
Mo Gam still heads the herb-drying hub and guards the weight chalkboard and isolation compartment.

Her position is maintained not by inheritance but solely through lot logs and federation observers' signatures.

She refuses the Bukhansan Bogukmun Return Association's demand for an exclusive warehouse and checks the wall weights against the Sangha Relief State duty roster every morning.

Unsealed boxes still go only to the isolation compartment.

/story_contents/B023/actors/2/sections/비.en:
His secret is a note saying the lot number on his niece or nephew's sack differed by only one character from the marking on the counterfeit box.

His guilt grows only between the child saved by covering the medication entry and the neighbor who received no fever-reducing roots during isolation.

Because full disclosure could cost the drying yard a season of trust, he left only partial disclosure available.

Access opens only in conjunction with Ryu Eunbi's receipt for the medicinal-efficacy samples.

/story_contents/B023/actors/2/sections/관.en:
The night he matched drying lots against Bong Gam's medication roster was a contract; the morning he put the herbs' share on Hwang Serin's distribution scale was an alliance.

Sending drying samples for Ryu Eunbi's medicinal-efficacy testing was cooperation, but a delay in inspection filled the isolation compartment first, turning it into a competition.

On the same racks, some roots saved one another, while some seals remained betrayals.

The relationship ledger connects to STORY-B023-K255.

/story_contents/B023/actors/2/sections/3.en:
Where the drying rack's hygrometer shows red, Mo Gam spreads out the roots from the same lot again.

When HP05 quarantine observation and XT01 roster reissuance converge at the door, she extends the isolation line.

The price in Act 3 is either stalled relief boxes or wider access to the key.

The story-arc identifier is fixed as STORY-B023-K255.

/story_contents/B023/actors/2/sections/분.en:
In one branch, Mo Gam isolates the lot to protect the children's medication roster.

In the other, she shares the key with the relief clerk to bring in the boxes, but leaves a gap in the seals.

The Sangha Relief State slot remains, while the branches are distinguished by K260-OUT.

The decision at the time is to guard the isolation or witness the division of control over the key.

/story_contents/B023/actors/2/arc/0/summ.en: Finds dried roots bearing a counterfeit lot marking and seals off a row of racks

/story_contents/B023/actors/2/arc/1/summ.en: Brings HP05 quarantine and XT01 roster reissuance together at the drying-yard door

/story_contents/B023/actors/2/arc/2/summ.en: Pays the price in either stalled relief or shared control of the key

/story_contents/B023/actors/2/outcomes/0.en: Lot isolation prevents contamination of the medication roster

/story_contents/B023/actors/2/outcomes/1.en: Sharing control of the key with the relief clerk allows the boxes in

/story_contents/B023/actors/3/sections/정.en:
At the Chang-dong residential shelter water-supply hub, Mo Bok reads the nighttime water level from the length of the bucket line and records the moment technology empties a kettle as a failure of the hub.

As head of the Seocho Computing Group's residential shelter water-supply hub and Seo Jina's operations officer, he does not paint an oral message to close a valve onto its handle.

Of Korean origin, he grew up in a shelter beside the Chang-dong rail yard. When the water-level rod reaches its lowest mark, he divides the line in two before speaking.

Mo Bok and K280 remain in the handle section of the hub wall.

/story_contents/B023/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse, he tried to turn the hub valve only when the Engineering Council posted its notice, before the bucket line scattered.

He aspired to keep the technical test schedule from holding kettles hostage; the timetable was revised only after the paint beneath the handle had dried.

A level mark he left on a neighbor child's kettle was a small promise, and that mark became a debt.

Even if a paper reporting a drop in pipe pressure arrived first, he chose to divide the line without a notice on the wall.

/story_contents/B023/actors/3/sections/가.en:
The Yongsan Rail Gate tried to tie the Chang-dong wheel-escort queue to the water-supply valve schedule.

Mo Bok accepted only the charter's public-water-level clause and rejected the provision for an exclusive test schedule.

His standing in the community was demonstrated by the number of times he carried out Seo Jina's housing audits at the handle, and So Bong's messenger papers were valid only on days when they were pinned to the same nail as the water-level rod.

No actual railway company's trade name appears in his hub log.

/story_contents/B023/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
When a paper reporting a drop in northern pipe pressure arrived before the technical test notice, Mo Bok split the bucket line in two and did not write the postponement on the hub wall.

He feared the hub valve being bound to the test schedule and the handle coming away with its paint before the kettle cooled.

Traces of the Coolant-Indexing Mycelium remained at a pipe joint, but he did not shout warnings of contamination; he recorded only the joint's temperature.

Even after the paper's edge got wet, he could not read the last notch at the lowest mark.

/story_contents/B023/actors/3/sections/생.en:
The crossroads then came when he had to choose between finding a replacement water-level rod to reunite the line and identifying the hand that erased the handle paint to begin the procedure for replacing the hub head.

An incident at the Imjin River Gateway Front—Chang-dong's wheel escort stopped outside the gateway, after which Sinnae opened a bypass transfer—overlapped with the valve schedule.

Finding a rod would restore the line but leave the waiting escort a shift short of water; identifying the hand would stop the test but leave the hub without leadership for a day.

The decision remains in K286-TURN.

/story_contents/B023/actors/3/sections/현.en:
Mo Bok currently heads the residential shelter water-supply hub, guarding the water-level rod and bucket line.

His position is maintained solely by Seo Jina's audit logs and the time the handle paint dried.

He refuses the Yongsan Rail Gate's demand for an exclusive test queue and checks the rod's marks against the Seocho Computing Group duty roster.

He still does not transfer oral messages onto the paint.

/story_contents/B023/actors/3/sections/비.en:
His secret is that he did not post the pressure-drop paper on the wall and instead first aligned the mark on the neighbor child's kettle.

His guilt grows between the kettle he saved and the record of Pyeong Chaewon missing the kettle schedule because of the unannounced postponement.

Instead of full disclosure, he permits only partial disclosure in the presence of So Bong as messenger.

Access opens only in conjunction with Seo Jina's audit box.

/story_contents/B023/actors/3/sections/관.en:
The night he carried out Seo Jina's housing audit at the hub handle was an exercise of command; the dawn he pinned So Bong's messenger paper and the water-level rod to the same nail was a contract.

Pyeong Chaewon reading the kettle schedule against the rod was cooperation, but if he was late moving Han Jaemok's water-negotiation time to the shelter side, the line split first, causing a clash.

At the same hub, some buckets saved one another, while some paint remained a betrayal.

The relationship ledger continues as STORY-B023-K280.

/story_contents/B023/actors/3/sections/3.en:
Where the handle paint has been erased, Mo Bok takes hold again of the bucket line split in two.

When the HP02 escort queue and XT01 bypass transfer coincide with the valve schedule, he delays opening and closing it.

The price in Act 3 is either thirst among the waiting escort or a gap in hub leadership.

The story arc is STORY-B023-K280.

/story_contents/B023/actors/3/sections/분.en:
In one branch, Mo Bok uses a replacement rod to reunite the line.

In the other, he identifies the hand that erased the paint, stopping the test queue but putting his own position as hub head at risk.

The Seocho Computing Group slot remains, while the branches are distinguished by K286-OUT.

The decision at the time is to escort the rod or identify the hand.

/story_contents/B023/actors/3/arc/0/summ.en: Splits the bucket line in response to a pressure-drop paper and omits a wall notice

/story_contents/B023/actors/3/arc/1/summ.en: Brings the HP02 escort queue and XT01 bypass transfer together at the valve time

/story_contents/B023/actors/3/arc/2/summ.en: Bears the cost of either escort thirst or a gap in hub leadership

/story_contents/B023/actors/3/outcomes/0.en: A replacement water-level rod restores the bucket line

/story_contents/B023/actors/3/outcomes/1.en: Revealing the hand that erased the paint stops the test queue

/story_contents/B023/actors/4/sections/정.en:
Before a pillar in Sinnae's northeastern neutral market, Bok Yong bears down hardest on merchants who hide prices and drives out anyone who says patient-transport slots should be put up for auction.

As head of the Neutral Convoy City's neutral-market hub, he regards public scales as the basis of credit.

Of Korean origin, he learned market-price shifts in the Mangu transfer alleys. When an order bears a military-supply designation, he blocks its release until the medical team's notice is posted, then sits down.

Bok Yong and K305 are fixed in the hub section of the market wall's price board.

/story_contents/B023/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse, he wrote prices and inventory on the same wall to keep the neutral market a public-pricing hub for transfers.

He aspired to keep great-power protection fees from buying space in the market; draft prices survived only as chalk marks on a scale leg.

His promise to give emergency supplies priority at Guk Yong's duty clinic became the seed of a debt.

Even when a note told him to call the patient slot an auction item, he rang the no-sale bell first.

/story_contents/B023/actors/4/sections/가.en:
The Yongsan Escort Family demanded a place at the market's release counter, citing its obligation to make night deliveries.

Bok Yong accepted only the succession charter's public-scale clause and rejected the provision for an exclusive military-supply slot.

His standing in the community was demonstrated by the number of times he matched Bok Bong's relay invoices to market prices, and O Haerin's price broadcast was not copied onto the wall before market hours began.

No actual logistics company's trade name appears in his ledger.

/story_contents/B023/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
Just after weapons were found, Bok Yong discovered an order bearing a military-supply designation tucked into the market scale. He stopped releases and hid the sheet behind the medical team's notice board.

He feared market inventory being diverted exclusively to military supplies, halting supplies for the medical train.

A Transit Rat Colony burrowed under the scale, but he did not call for its extermination; he recorded only the locations of the holes.

Even after the no-sale bell cracked, he could not read the last item on the order.

/story_contents/B023/actors/4/sections/생.en:
The crossroads then came when he had to choose whether to reveal the order sheet during market hours or fix the emergency-supplies priority slot in the ledger and seal the order sheet.

In the Tumen River Far East Theater, an incident in which the Amsa Waterworks Group released the freight-car weight logs and Sinnae adjusted the transfer slots coincided with the order at the scales.

Revealing it would close the military-supplies slot but interrupt night deliveries for a day; fixing the priority slot would save the infirmary but leave the stamped order sheet in the dark.

The choice remains recorded as K311-TURN.

/story_contents/B023/actors/4/sections/현.en:
Bokyong still serves as head of the Northeastern Neutral Market hub, opening the price board and public scales.

His position is maintained not by inheritance but solely through dispatch logs and signatures from medical-team observers.

Even when the Yongsan Escort House demands a dedicated night slot, he refuses and aligns the duty roster and failed-auction times with the Neutral Convoy City.

Patient-transfer slots are not put up for auction.

/story_contents/B023/actors/4/sections/비.en:
His secret is that he tucked the military-supplies order sheet behind the medical team's noticeboard and did not disclose it until after Geun Soli's failed-auction bell rang.

His guilt grew between the emergency slot he saved and the record of Bokbong's invoice being delayed a day because he could not match prices while hiding it.

Instead of full disclosure, he permits only one line of items to be seen in Gukyong's presence.

Access opens only when the medical team posts its notice.

/story_contents/B023/actors/4/sections/관.en:
The noon when he matched prices to Bokbong's relay invoice was a contract; the night when he prioritized emergency supplies for Gukyong's duty infirmary was an alliance.

Consulting O Haerin's price broadcasts only during market hours was restrained cooperation, but when Geun Soli's failed-auction bell rang first, dispatch was delayed and it became a dispute over speed.

At the same scales, some prices saved one another, while some order sheets were read as betrayal.

The relationship ledger is linked to STORY-B023-K305.

/story_contents/B023/actors/4/sections/3.en:
Faced with a stamped military-supplies order sheet caught in the scales, Bokyong flips the dispatch switch down again.

When the HC11 night window and XT04 transfer slot overlap on the price board, he delays the failed-auction bell.

The cost in Act 3 is either an interruption to night deliveries or the continued existence of the stamped order sheet.

The story-arc identifier is fixed as STORY-B023-K305.

/story_contents/B023/actors/4/sections/분.en:
In one branch, Bokyong reveals the order sheet and closes the military-supplies slot.

In the other, he fixes the emergency-priority slot in the ledger and seals the order sheet.

The Neutral Convoy City slot remains in place; only the branch splits at K311-OUT.

The decision then was a public escort or sealing the priority slot.

/story_contents/B023/actors/4/arc/0/summ.en: Takes the stamped military-supplies order sheet off the scales and stops dispatch

/story_contents/B023/actors/4/arc/1/summ.en: Overlays the HC11 night window and XT04 transfer slot on the price board

/story_contents/B023/actors/4/arc/2/summ.en: Pays the price of either interrupted night deliveries or the order sheet's continued existence

/story_contents/B023/actors/4/outcomes/0.en: Disclosure of the military-supplies order sheet prevents the market slot from being militarized

/story_contents/B023/actors/4/outcomes/1.en: Fixing the emergency-priority slot and sealing the order sheet

/story_contents/B023/actors/5/sections/정.en:
At the Jegi-dong Market scales, Dong Juha reads the origin tags and box weights at a glance and turns away, on the spot, an envoy urging advance purchases.

As head of the Medical Neutrality League's Jegi-dong Market scales hub, he remembers credit ledgers longer than people's faces.

Originally from Korea, he learned to take shifts at the scales in Cheongnyangni's medicinal-herb district; for large advance purchases, he opens the scales only with the seals of Ryu Eunbi and Jeon Sol.

Dong Juha and K330 remain in the hub slot on the tag line.

/story_contents/B023/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse, he hung origins and drying dates on tags to keep the Jegi-dong Market auction scales a visible part of the Deliberative Council's public allocation system.

His ambition was to prevent bids monopolized by powerful states from buying up the floor price; the draft graduations were engraved only on the legs of the scales.

His promise to put Jeon Sol's patient allocation first in the shipping order became a debt.

Even before counterfeit medicine flowed toward Bukhansan Bogukmun, he would not open the scales for a box with no origin listed.

/story_contents/B023/actors/5/sections/가.en:
The Jegi-dong Healing Guild sought to tie medicinal-herb allocations for frostbite patients to observation at the scales.

Dong Juha accepted only the charter's public-tag clause and rejected the provision for exclusive monopoly bidding.

His standing in the community was demonstrated by the number of times he enforced Sim Dalho's auction rules at the scales, and Dong Neulsol's transported loads were shipped only on days when their weights matched those same graduations.

No real medicinal-herb business names appear in his ledger.

/story_contents/B023/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
When counterfeit medicine flowed toward Bukhansan Bogukmun that summer, the medicinal-herb district sealed itself off, and both the advance-purchase ledger and the scales' seal disappeared.

Dong Juha stopped the auction and left only empty tags standing while he waited for Tak Eunsol's testimony.

He feared a scene in which counterfeit medicine flowed to Bukhansan Bogukmun alongside the scales' graduations and the market was sealed off for an entire season.

Spores from a Low-Temperature Spore Host settled on the sealing cord, but he did not call it a demon; he recorded only where the cord had broken.

/story_contents/B023/actors/5/sections/생.en:
The crossroads then came when he had to choose whether to recover the scales' seal or expose the purchasing agent of a powerful state at the auction house.

In the Tumen River Far East Theater, an incident in which the Chang-dong Wheel Guild divided the winter fuel queue and Jegi-dong took in frostbite patients overlapped with the shipping order.

Recovering the seal would restart the auction but push the frostbite patients' medicinal herbs back one round; exposing the agent would break the monopoly but leave the unsealed scales unused for several more days.

The decision remains recorded in K337-TURN.

/story_contents/B023/actors/5/sections/현.en:
Dong Juha is now head of the Jegi-dong Market scales hub, matching tags to graduations every day.

His position is maintained not by inheritance but solely through auction logs and signatures from Deliberative Council observers.

Even when the Jegi-dong Healing Guild demands exclusive allocations, he refuses and aligns the Medical Neutrality League duty roster with the shipping order.

Boxes without an origin listed do not go on the scales.

/story_contents/B023/actors/5/sections/비.en:
His secret is a scrap at the end of the missing sealing cord on which he wrote one line with the name of one of Jeon Sol's patients.

His guilt grew between the graduations he recovered and the box of medicinal herbs that could not reach frostbite patients in the meantime.

Instead of full disclosure, he permits only the scrap to be seen in the presence of Tak Eunsol, who testified.

Access opens only when Pan Handeul's unloading line does.

/story_contents/B023/actors/5/sections/관.en:
The morning he enforced Sim Dalho's auction rules at the scales was an act of command; the noon when he matched Dong Neulsol's transported load to the same graduations was both command and contract.

Putting Jeon Sol's patient allocation into the shipping order was an alliance, but when Pan Handeul's unloading line was blocked, the weights went awry and it became a conflict.

Tak Eunsol's testimony about the seal was a vow; at the same scales, some tags saved one another, while some advance purchases remained betrayals.

The relationship ledger continues in STORY-B023-K330.

/story_contents/B023/actors/5/sections/3.en:
Where the empty tags sway, Dong Juha feels again for the missing sealing cord.

When the HP06 frostbite allocation and XT04 fuel queue overlap in the shipping order, he delays the bell that starts the auction.

The cost in Act 3 is either a delay in patients' medicinal herbs or a period when the unsealed scales stand idle.

The story arc is STORY-B023-K330.

/story_contents/B023/actors/5/sections/분.en:
In one branch, Dong Juha recovers the scales' seal and restarts the auction.

In the other, he exposes the purchasing agent of a powerful state at the auction house, breaking the monopoly.

The Medical Neutrality League slot remains in place; only the branch splits at K337-OUT.

The decision then was to escort the seal's recovery or verify the agent's identity.

/story_contents/B023/actors/5/arc/0/summ.en: Stops the auction when the scales' seal disappears after counterfeit medicine leaks out

/story_contents/B023/actors/5/arc/1/summ.en: Overlays the HP06 frostbite allocation and XT04 fuel queue on the shipping order

/story_contents/B023/actors/5/arc/2/summ.en: Pays the price of either delayed medicinal herbs for patients or idle scales

/story_contents/B023/actors/5/outcomes/0.en: Recovery of the scales' seal restarts the public auction

/story_contents/B023/actors/5/outcomes/1.en: Exposure of a powerful state's purchasing agent blocks monopoly bidding

/story_contents/B023/actors/6/sections/정.en:
Before the lock on a Guro rooftop water tank, Park Soeon tears up a note telling her to offer the roof's waterproof seams and the main power line as bargaining chips instead of folding it and putting it in her pocket.

As representative of the Standards Alliance's Guro Building Cooperative, she long remembers people who value a resident ballot less than a skilled worker.

The repair order left by her mother, who came from Vietnam to a Guro industrial-complex dormitory, has Vietnamese numerals and Korean building and unit numbers on the same page; she unfolds it only before the cooperative drawing.

Park Soeon and K033 remain fixed in the representative slot on the building cooperative's noticeboard and are not renumbered.

/story_contents/B023/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse, she published rooftop water-tank and pump bids building by building so that cooperative drawings would fix the repair order for workshop buildings and residential shells.

Her ambition was to prevent military-supplies work crews from claiming civilian power first, and winning workshops had to share their skill scores with the labor union.

Her mother's dormitory note—if the roof leaks, seal it before the main line—later became the original form of her debt.

Even when their own raw-water supply became unstable, she did not put the water tank in the Water Compact's collateral slot.

/story_contents/B023/actors/6/sections/가.en:
The Geumcheon District Office Heavy Machinery House sought to extend the distribution of parts from the Southwest Fabrication Works to observation of building bids.

Park Soeon accepted only the charter's public-drawing clause and rejected the provision for an exclusive military-supplies work crew.

His standing in the community was demonstrated by the number of times he supported Gang Minseo's allocation of production processes from the building side, and he added Myeong Dahae to cooperative signatures only on days when they had inspected the water-storage seal together at the market pillar.

No real heavy-industry business names appear in his bid ledger.

/story_contents/B023/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
When rumors spread that the western water-supply contract was expiring, Park Soeon sealed the building's water tank and demanded direct negotiations with the Water Compact's rationing representative.

He feared that, once their own raw-water supply was cut off, the tank would run dry and cooperative members would become hostages to the water-supply contract.

The Blueprint Ghost Machine Collective licked the rooftop pump blueprints, but he did not call it a specter; he passed only the blueprint hash to Gang Minseo.

Even after the lock rusted, he could not undo the last knot in the sealing cord.

/story_contents/B023/actors/6/sections/생.en:
The crossroads then came when he had to choose whether to obtain a replacement water-storage pump and break the seal, or expose the bid-rigging ledger and reopen the cooperative drawing.

In the West Sea Granary Theater, an incident in which the Southwest Fabrication Works distributed freezer-compressor parts and Magok verified the measurement logs coincided with rooftop power.

Obtaining the pump would break the seal but delay Gu Chansol's dispatch of repair materials by a day; exposing the collusion would reopen the drawing but leave a gap in which Choi Dain's combat engineers were pulled away from the roof.

The choice remains recorded as K033-TURN.

/story_contents/B023/actors/6/sections/현.en:
Park Soeon still serves as representative of the Guro Building Cooperative, holding public bids and drawings for resident ballots.

Her position is maintained not by inheritance but solely through winning-bid logs and skill scores shared with the labor union.

Even when the Geumcheon District Office Heavy Machinery House demands an exclusive work crew, she refuses and aligns the Standards Alliance duty roster with the time the water tank was sealed.

She does not use roofs or main power lines as bargaining chips.

/story_contents/B023/actors/6/sections/비.en:
His secret is that the Vietnamese numerals on his mother's note overlap by one unit with the building and unit numbers in the bid-rigging ledger.

His guilt grew between the water he protected by sealing the tank and the civilian building left without power because Byeon Jua could not enforce the circuit color in the meantime.

Instead of full disclosure, he permits only one line of the note to be seen in the presence of Han Jion and the raw-water ration sheet.

Access opens only when Gang Minseo's production-allocation ledger does.

/story_contents/B023/actors/6/sections/관.en:
Supporting Gang Minseo's allocation of production processes from the building side was both a contract and an alliance; the night he depended on Han Jion's raw-water ration sheet was a contract close to a debt.

When Choi Dain's requisition of combat engineers took workers away from roof construction, it became a conflict, while Gu Chansol's priority dispatch of repair materials kept households going.

Myeong Dahae's monitoring of the water-storage seal and Byeon Jua's enforcement of circuit colors left both rescue and delay on the same rooftop.

The relationship ledger is linked to STORY-B023-K033.

/story_contents/B023/actors/6/sections/3.en:
Before the rusted water-tank lock, Park Soeon again weighs the expiry rumor against the resident ballots.

When HC12 parts distribution and XT02 measurement verification overlap with rooftop power, she tightens the sealing cord further.

The cost in Act 3 is either delayed repair materials or a gap in roof construction.

The story-arc identifier is fixed as STORY-B023-K033.

/story_contents/B023/actors/6/sections/분.en:
In one branch, Park Soeon obtains a replacement pump and breaks the water-storage seal.

In the other, she exposes the bid-rigging ledger and reopens the cooperative drawing, accepting the gap left by the requisition of combat engineers.

The Standards Alliance slot remains in place; only the branch splits at K033-OUT.

The decision then was to escort the pump or disclose the ledger.

/story_contents/B023/actors/6/arc/0/summ.en: Seals the rooftop water tank amid rumors that the water-supply contract is expiring

/story_contents/B023/actors/6/arc/1/summ.en: Overlays HC12 parts distribution and XT02 measurement on rooftop power

/story_contents/B023/actors/6/arc/2/summ.en: Pays the price of either delayed materials or a gap in roof construction

/story_contents/B023/actors/6/outcomes/0.en: A replacement pump allows the water-storage seal to be broken

/story_contents/B023/actors/6/outcomes/1.en: Exposure of bid-rigging reopens the cooperative drawing

/story_contents/B023/actors/7/sections/정.en:
At the Banghwa well noticeboard, Kim Doha asks about the kitchen tap-water level before the noise from the laboratory wing, and halts the meeting if the raw-water ration sheet is empty.

As Yangjae Machineworks Company's Magok–Banghwa residents' representative, she puts the number of rationing pots in the first voting slot even on days when she boasts of her knowledge.

Her aunt, who came from Manila to the Banghwa market, counted pots in Tagalog numerals and copied the well level onto a Korean noticeboard; she uses that habit only when publishing evacuation routes.

Kim Doha and K061 remain in the veto slot of the residents' joint petition.

/story_contents/B023/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse, she posted evacuation routes and well levels on the same wall to anchor residents' veto power over minimum raw-water and food levels in the three-party review.

Her ambition was to keep the gateway village from becoming a hostage even if the research facility could not produce anything, and she put the number of pots to a vote before the number of dispatched researchers.

Her aunt's market note—if the ration sheet is empty, take down the flag first—became the seed of a debt.

Even when someone proposed relying on outsiders for bulk food supplies, she removed transfer of the resident register from the meeting agenda.

/story_contents/B023/actors/7/sections/가.en:
The Magok Life House sought to trade research dispatches for residents' observation of rationing.

Kim Doha accepted only the charter's minimum-level clause and rejected the provision for an exclusive laboratory wing.

His standing in the community was demonstrated by the dates on which he completed Jeong Hojun's three-party review from the residents' side, and Chae Bom increased patrols only on nights when she had vowed to hold back her whistle until the flag returned from the alley.

No real research-institute business names appear in his joint petition.

/story_contents/B023/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
When rumors that the western water-supply contract was expiring unsettled even the Banghwa water tank, Kim Doha froze researcher dispatches and demanded a minimum-level clause from the Water Compact.

She feared a scene in which dependence on outsiders for raw water and food allowed a single line of the water-supply contract to transfer the entire resident register.

A Cleanroom Mutant alarm sounded in the laboratory wing, but she did not blame a monster and close the meeting; she simply counted the well figures again.

Even after the flag got wet, she could not read the last line of the register.

/story_contents/B023/actors/7/sections/생.en:
The crossroads then came when he had to choose whether to arrange an alternative food convoy and lift the dispatch freeze, or find the secret agreement to transfer the register and strengthen the residents' veto.

In the Incheon Trust Theater, an incident in which Magok corrected a false alarm at the orbital terminal and Garak extended its separated-family counseling window coincided with the well noticeboard.

Opening the convoy would fill the pots, but Yu Minho's base transit toll would cut civilian rations by one slot; revealing the secret agreement would strengthen the veto but prolong the dispatch freeze, causing the laboratory wing's power to draw more from civilian homes.

The decision remains recorded in K061-TURN.

/story_contents/B023/actors/7/sections/현.en:
Kim Doha is now the Magok–Banghwa residents' representative, posting the well level and number of rationing pots every day.

Her position is maintained not by inheritance but solely through the joint petition from the three-party review and residents' attendance.

Even when the Magok Life House demands exclusive dispatches, she refuses and aligns the Yangjae Machineworks Company duty roster with the water-tank graduations.

She does not put the laboratory wing's report at the top of the agenda before confirming that kitchen taps have water.

/story_contents/B023/actors/7/sections/비.en:
His secret is a memo noting that his aunt's count of pots in Tagalog matched the number of households in the draft secret agreement.

His guilt grew between the register he protected with the freeze and the passage blocked while Byeon Taeon enforced the veto in the waiting room.

Instead of full disclosure, he permits only one line of the memo to be seen in the presence of Han Jion's raw-water procurement convoy.

Access opens only when Gu Seonyul's market joint petition does.

/story_contents/B023/actors/7/sections/관.en:
Completing Jeong Hojun's three-party review from the residents' side was both a contract and an alliance; the morning he exchanged food with Han Jion's raw-water procurement convoy was a survival contract.

When Yu Minho's base transit toll cut civilian rations, it became a rivalry, while Chae Bom's whistle vow kept the flag in the alley.

The night Byeon Taeon and Gu Seonyul enforced the veto and joint petition was a rescue, but if the dispatch freeze dragged on, the same waiting room became a place of delay.

The relationship ledger is linked to STORY-B023-K061.

/story_contents/B023/actors/7/sections/3.en:
Where the Banghwa well figures have been erased, Kim Doha plants the dispatch-freeze flag again.

When HC03 laboratory-wing demands and XT05 correction of an orbital false alarm overlap on the noticeboard, she holds the vote on pot numbers first.

The cost in Act 3 is either the increase in the transit toll or the time during which the laboratory wing's power draws from civilian homes.

The story arc is STORY-B023-K061.

/story_contents/B023/actors/7/sections/분.en:
In one branch, Kim Doha opens an alternative food convoy and lifts the dispatch freeze.

In the other, she finds the secret agreement to transfer the register, strengthens the residents' veto, and maintains the freeze.

The Yangjae Machineworks Company slot remains in place; only the branch splits at K061-OUT.

The decision then was to cover the convoy or verify the secret agreement.

/story_contents/B023/actors/7/arc/0/summ.en: Freezes research dispatches amid rumors about the water-supply contract and recounts the well figures

/story_contents/B023/actors/7/arc/1/summ.en: Overlays the HC03 dispatch demand and XT05 false-alarm correction on the vote about pots

/story_contents/B023/actors/7/arc/2/summ.en: Bears the cost of either a higher transit toll or power drawn from civilian homes

/story_contents/B023/actors/7/outcomes/0.en: An alternative food convoy lifts the dispatch freeze

/story_contents/B023/actors/7/outcomes/1.en: Exposure of the secret register agreement strengthens residents' veto power

/story_contents/B023/actors/8/sections/정.en:
Before the Yeouido berth-drawing drum, Jeong Moran carries on bargaining as if singing, yet immediately takes back the turn token of any boat owner who cheated the dockside scales.

As head of the Water Compact's Yeouido Water Transport Cooperative, he reads the price of rumors faster than the river wind, and allows water-supply barges to depart only with a rationing-district representative's seal.

He counts the dockside numbers left by his maternal family, who returned from Sakhalin, in Russian, but posts the turns on the noticeboard only in Korean; he uses that habit only for the morning drawing.

Jeong Moran and K006 are fixed in the cooperative-head slot of the berth ledger.

/story_contents/B023/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
Before the collapse, she sought to make water transport a source of sluice revenue equal to railway transit tolls by placing western Han River berths and water-supply barges under a cooperative permit system.

Berth turns were assigned by public drawing every morning, with a separate slot for Gu Haon to administer that drawing as an auction.

The words left by a boat owner in her maternal family—return an empty turn rather than leave your boat empty—became the basis of a debt.

Even when Noryangjin's cold-storage credit became unstable, she was reluctant to permit food to be loaded onto water-supply barges.

/story_contents/B023/actors/8/sections/가.en:
The Hangangjin Bridge Guild sought to tie the dock-drainage schedule to observation of the berth drawing.

Jeong Moran accepted only the charter's public-drawing clause and rejected the provision for exclusive bridge passage.

Her standing in the community was demonstrated by the number of times I Seodam's Yangcheon water-supply barge contracts were sealed, and only the berth turns she shared with Gu Taeyun were exchanged for Yangcheon water canteens.

No real shipping-company names appear in her permit ledger.

/story_contents/B023/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
When a power outage threatened Noryangjin's cold storage, Yeouido boat owners began loading food onto water-supply barges, and Jeong Moran considered closing the berths.

He feared a scene in which failing cold-storage credit swallowed even the berth fees, leaving Yeouido's barges empty.

The Sewer Raccoon Clan burrowed into the dock drains, but rather than condemn them as repulsive, he passed only the drainage times to I Seodam.

Even after the drawing drum overflowed, he could not read the last name associated with an unsealed departure.

/story_contents/B023/actors/8/sections/생.en:
The crossroads then came when he had to choose whether to catch the cargo of an illicit boat and tighten cooperative permits, or expose manipulation of the berth drawing and transfer transport rights to another boat owner.

In the West Sea Granary Theater, an incident in which the Yeouido sluice rescheduled dock drainage to match West Sea tides coincided with departure times.

Catching the illicit boat would strengthen permits, but O Haerin's refrigerated convoy would displace water-supply cargo and intensify competition; exposing the drawing manipulation would make the turns fair, but delay Han Jaemok's sluice-passage permit by a day.

The choice remains recorded as K006-TURN.

/story_contents/B023/actors/8/sections/현.en:
Jeong Moran still heads the Yeouido Water Transport Cooperative, conducting the morning drawing and sealing water-supply barges.

His position is maintained not by inheritance but solely through permit logs and rationing-district seals.

Even when the Hangangjin Bridge Guild demands an exclusive drainage queue, he refuses and aligns the Water Compact duty roster with berth times.

He still takes back the turn tokens of boat owners who cheat the scales.

/story_contents/B023/actors/8/sections/비.en:
Her secret is a folded note saying that the Russian number from her maternal family matched one slot in the manipulated drawing drum.

Her guilt grew between the water-supply barges she protected by closing the berths and the record of Gu Taeyun's Yangcheon water canteens losing a berth for a day in the meantime.

Instead of full disclosure, she permits only the number on the note to be seen in I Seodam's presence as the seal is inspected.

Access opens only when Han Jaemok's sluice-passage ledger does.

/story_contents/B024/actors/0/sections/정.en:
At the scale stand of the Achasan gate market, Won Dagyeol rubs with his thumb the ink thickness of order slips stamped with exemption sentences.

As head of the gate-passage market outpost for the Gate Military Government, he sends merchants who hide the passage toll back from the scale, and pushes talk that prices the military exemption column out of the market.

Of Korean origin, he grew up in the alleys of Gwangjin and Guui, and treats the marks of a public scale as credit.

Won Dagyeol and K355 are written only in the outpost column of the gate price board.

/story_contents/B024/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
Before the Collapse, he wrote passage goods and water levies side by side in chalk on the same wall.

His ambition was to keep protection money from buying market columns, and his draft prices stayed only in pencil on the back of the scale base.

A promise to his sister, that he would bring her a doe of rice before the evening scale stopped, later becomes the seed of a debt.

Even when great-power exemption certificates came up first, he never covered the actual-stock column.

/story_contents/B024/actors/0/sections/가.en:
The Noryangjin Cold-Storage Merchant Company demanded an observer seat at the gate scale, citing its duty of cold-storage credit.

Won Dagyeol accepted only the charter's clause on public prices and refused the sentence granting exclusive ownership of the market.

His place in the community was proven by the dates on which he did not release exemption orders before Ha Yunmok posted the ledger.

No real distribution company names appear on his price board.

/story_contents/B024/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
When exemption papers from three great powers came in the same week, Won Dagyeol refused releases under military-supply pretexts and put only actual stock on the scale.

At the core of his fear was the sight of market stock drained off for military supply, turning a day's share for residents on restricted water into empty crates.

Even after the needle stopped, he stood gripping chalk, unable to call out the last weight of the empty crates.

Won Yena's bridge invoice arrived at the same hour, but he did not open the exemption column for it.

/story_contents/B024/actors/0/sections/생.en:
The turning point was the moment he chose between posting the exemption orders on the market wall and fixing a priority column for water supplies in the ledger.

When the Duman River Far East Theater's sealed inspection of mineral samples overlapped with the gate scale, the release window shrank to an hour.

Posting the exemptions filters out forged slips but lets the military-supply line block the window for a day; fixing the water column keeps the residents' day's share but pushes back the mineral seals.

The decision remains in K363-TURN, and if it is reversed the empty crates take over the price column again.

/story_contents/B024/actors/0/sections/현.en:
Won Dagyeol still writes prices and passage goods on the wall as head of the gate-passage market outpost.

His outpost authority is kept only by scale logs and the times of Ha Yunmok's postings, and there is no column for lineage.

Even when the Noryangjin Cold-Storage Merchant Company demands exclusive auctions he refuses, and every morning he moves Bang Mareum's three columns into the market ledger.

He sends Nam Yungyeong's offer of emergency prices back with a grudge and weighs only actual stock.

/story_contents/B024/actors/0/sections/비.en:
His secret is a memo about hiding his sister's share of rice in the bottom compartment of the scale for one night.

His guilt grows only between the day's water he saved and the inspection that put off the mineral seals by an hour because of it.

Posting it all on the wall could cut off the gate's credit for a day, so he left only a window of partial disclosure.

It can be viewed only at the same moment as Won Yena's invoice.

/story_contents/B024/actors/0/sections/관.en:
The bridge invoice matched for Won Yena was a contract, and the night he moved Bang Mareum's three columns into the market ledger was a cooperation that shared the reckoning.

The morning he waited for Ha Yunmok's ledger posting was a matter tied to the tax collector's window, but Nam Yungyeong's emergency price remained a grudge at the same scale.

At the same gate, some weights saved one another and some exemption sentences read as betrayal.

The end points of existing relationships connect to STORY-B024-K355 without being erased.

/story_contents/B024/actors/0/sections/3.en:
Where the gate scale stand has stopped, Won Dagyeol spreads out the three exemption papers again.

When the HP08 observer seat and the XT04 sealed inspection come up on the same price board, he snaps his release chalk.

When he pays the price, only one of the residents' day's share and the on-time mineral inspection remains whole.

The narrative line is STORY-B024-K355.

/story_contents/B024/actors/0/sections/분.en:
In one branch, Won Dagyeol posts the exemption orders on the wall and filters out forged origin slips.

In the other branch, he fixes the priority column for water supplies in the ledger and stops the empty crates.

The Gate Military Government slot is kept, and only the branch identifier splits into K363-OUT.

The decision at the time is an escort for public exemptions or sealing the water column.

/story_contents/B024/actors/0/arc/0/summ.en: Refuses three great-power exemption papers and puts only actual stock on the scale

/story_contents/B024/actors/0/arc/1/summ.en: Matches the release window to HP08 observation and the XT04 sealed inspection

/story_contents/B024/actors/0/arc/2/summ.en: Pays the price of either the residents' day's share or the on-time mineral inspection

/story_contents/B024/actors/0/outcomes/0.en: Public exemptions scrap forged origin slips

/story_contents/B024/actors/0/outcomes/1.en: Fixed water-priority column stops the empty crates

/story_contents/B024/actors/1/sections/정.en:
On the scale of the Garak produce hall, Dong Yesol picks out and sets down first the lettuce with broken leaf veins.

As head of the produce-hall market outpost for the Cathedral Accreditation State and Nam Siyun's working hand, he treats producer-state envoys proposing direct trade as thorns, and counts the goods table before alliance slogans.

Of Korean origin, he grew up in the Songpa area, and his voice is friendly, but he locks the scale when the posting before an escort award is blank.

Dong Yesol and K380 are fixed in the outpost column of the produce-hall duty blackboard.

/story_contents/B024/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
Before the Collapse, he tried to bind the Garak produce lines into the market face of the lesser states' joint purchasing window.

His ambition was to make it one body with Suseo's joint negotiating rights, and the draft clauses stayed folded only in a drawer under the auction stand.

A short word he left his father, that he would check the temperature of the cabbage bays once more before the monsoon, later becomes a debt.

Even when Amsa's protection-contract wording was pinned to the escort column, he never covered the goods table.

/story_contents/B024/actors/1/sections/가.en:
The Seoul Station Inventory House demanded an observer seat in the produce hall, citing its duty of ration distribution.

Dong Yesol accepted only the charter's clause on public goods and refused the sentence on an exclusive market.

His place in the community was proven by how many times he refused to award escort bids without Mun Doyun's public posting.

He does not write real distribution company names in his scale log.

/story_contents/B024/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
When rumors of a bad harvest spread, the merchants' council voted to seal the warehouses, and Dong Yesol locked the produce-hall scale for three days.

His fear was the picture of Amsa's protection contract swallowing the produce escorts and the market sinking into a subcontractor for army rations.

Even after putting the weights in their box, he could not read the last mark on the locked needle.

Cheon Nasol's correction note came in through the crack in the door, but he did not open it during the three days of the seal.

/story_contents/B024/actors/1/sections/생.en:
The turning point was the moment he chose between overturning the seal vote and taking the joint produce-purchasing clause to the lesser-state council.

When the Korea Strait Theater's readjustment of canned-food allocations overlapped with the Garak ration window, the scale window shrank to half a day.

Overturning the vote reopens the escorts but leaves the merchants' council's vote empty for a day; taking the joint purchasing clause revives the lesser-state window but stops the produce hall for three more days.

That calculation remains only as K388-TURN.

/story_contents/B024/actors/1/sections/현.en:
Dong Yesol now buys and sells tables by goods line as head of the produce-hall market outpost.

His authority to carry out Nam Siyun's merchants' council votes in the market is tied to duty logs and the times of Mun Doyun's postings.

Even when the Seoul Station Inventory House demands exclusive awards he refuses, and he keeps pushing the produce clause into Jeong Yura's joint-negotiation draft as part of his outpost routine.

In the cold-storage bays he shares with Mae Riul, he accepts only crates with origin stakes.

/story_contents/B024/actors/1/sections/비.en:
His secret is a note about moving a bundle of cabbage meant for his father into the shade behind the scale on the first day of the seal.

His guilt grows between the joint purchasing draft he saved and the alley peddlers who missed the auctions during those three days.

He allows only partial disclosure in Cheon Nasol's presence instead of a full confession.

It can be viewed only at the same moment as Mun Doyun's bid posting.

/story_contents/B024/actors/1/sections/관.en:
The night he carried out Nam Siyun's votes in the market was command, and the morning he matched goods with Cheon Nasol's scale was the cooperation of a shared eye.

Trying to put the produce clause in for Jeong Yura was an alliance, but when Mun Doyun's public posting ran late the awards stopped and it became a fight over speed.

In the same produce hall, some crates saved one another and some seal votes remained betrayals.

The relationship ledger continues to STORY-B024-K380.

/story_contents/B024/actors/1/sections/3.en:
Before the locked produce-hall scale, Dong Yesol counts the merchants' council votes again.

When HC09 observation and the XT03 canned-food allocation overlap on the same goods table, he swallows the award whistle.

The price in Act 3 is either a gap in the merchants' council or a further halt of the produce hall.

The narrative line identifier is fixed as STORY-B024-K380.

/story_contents/B024/actors/1/sections/분.en:
In the first ending, Dong Yesol overturns the seal vote and reopens the escorts.

In the second ending, he takes the joint produce-purchasing clause to the lesser-state council and prevents the ration subcontracting.

The Cathedral Accreditation State slot is kept, and only the branch splits into K388-OUT.

The decision at the time is an escort for the vote or an escort for the joint purchasing clause.

/story_contents/B024/actors/1/arc/0/summ.en: After the bad-harvest rumor, locks the produce-hall scale for three days on the merchants' council seal vote

/story_contents/B024/actors/1/arc/1/summ.en: Matches the award window to HC09 observation and the XT03 canned-food allocation

/story_contents/B024/actors/1/arc/2/summ.en: Accepts the price of a merchants' council gap or a further produce-hall halt

/story_contents/B024/actors/1/outcomes/1.en: Joint produce-purchasing clause moved to the lesser-state council

/story_contents/B024/actors/2/sections/정.en:
On the sidings of the Suseo depot, Won Choon calls those who break shift not by name but by the time.

As base duty chief of the Jeongdong General Labor Union, she treats siding duty like home, and writes on the blackboard as an insult each moment a corporate recommendation swallows a release.

Of Korean origin, she grew up in the Gangnam area, and she locks the release column without washing the chalk dust from her wrists.

Won Choon and K404 are fixed only in the first line of the base duty blackboard.

/story_contents/B024/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
Before the Collapse, she made the rule of posting duty names and release times on the same blackboard.

Her ambition was to keep the Suseo base as the Compact City's own outpost so that great-power escorts could not stand on the sidings.

A note she left her younger sibling, to lock the toolbox before the shift whistle blew, later becomes a debt.

Even when recommendation lists were pushed up the board, she never left the test signature column blank.

/story_contents/B024/actors/2/sections/가.en:
The Changdong Defense House demanded an observer seat on the sidings, citing its duty of track defense.

Won Choon accepted only the charter's clause on public duty and refused the sentence on exclusive releases.

Her place in the community was proven by how many times she blocked outside armed approaches without Su Neulgyeol's test signature.

She does not write real vehicle company names on her blackboard.

/story_contents/B024/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
When Magok requested water-testing staff, one line of an undisclosed dispatch list had already been written on the base release blackboard.

Won Choon covered that line with chalk and stopped the releases.

Her fear was the picture of base duty becoming a stepping stone for hostage dispatches and Eun Boram's open tests breaking from within.

Even after the whistle fell silent, she did not snap her chalk, never having read the last letter of the covered line.

/story_contents/B024/actors/2/sections/생.en:
The turning point was the moment she chose between erasing the undisclosed line and switching base releases to a double key.

When the Korea Strait Theater's opening of an alternative return line overlapped with the Suseo sidings, the release window shrank to one train set.

Erasing the line opens the return line on time but destroys the evidence of dispatch; switching to a double key keeps the test signatures but delays the return line by half a day.

The choice is written with the time in the K413-TURN column.

/story_contents/B024/actors/2/sections/현.en:
Won Choon still posts duty names and release times on the same blackboard as duty chief of the Suseo depot.

Her authority is kept only by shift logs and Su Neulgyeol's test signatures.

Even when the Changdong Defense House demands exclusive ownership of the sidings she refuses, and she has not changed the rule of keeping Eun Boram's recommendation board at the very top of the blackboard.

She calls Im Chowon only as a joint examiner, never as a dispatch candidate.

/story_contents/B024/actors/2/sections/비.en:
Her secret is the first syllable of the undisclosed dispatch line she covered.

Her guilt grows between the return train set that left on time and the apprentice who missed a shift because the toolbox could not be opened while the line was covered.

Erasing it all could cut off trust in the tests for a day, so she left only a partial-disclosure column.

It can be viewed only at the same moment as Cho Jinsol's testimony blackboard.

/story_contents/B024/actors/2/sections/관.en:
The night she shared duty with Su Neulgyeol's maintenance depot was a contract, and the morning she put Eun Boram's recommendation board at the top was an alliance of open tests.

The duty testimony that overlapped with Cho Jinsol's was close to an oath, and trying to call Im Chowon as a joint examiner was cooperation, but when a dispatch line was written first it became a fight over interpretation.

On the same sidings, some whistles saved one another and some single lines read as betrayal.

The relationship end point continues to STORY-B024-K404.

/story_contents/B024/actors/2/sections/3.en:
Before the covered line on the release blackboard, Won Choon writes the dispatch time again.

When HC08 observation and the XT03 return-line request come up on the same whistle, she blocks the double keyhole.

When she pays the price, only one of the dispatch evidence and the on-time return remains.

The narrative line is STORY-B024-K404.

/story_contents/B024/actors/2/sections/분.en:
In one branch, Won Choon erases the undisclosed line and opens the return line on time.

In the other branch, she switches releases to a double key and protects the signatures of the open tests.

The Jeongdong General Labor Union slot is kept, and only the branch identifier splits into K413-OUT.

The decision at the time is an escort for erasing the line or splitting the key.

/story_contents/B024/actors/2/arc/0/summ.en: Covers the undisclosed dispatch line with chalk and stops the releases

/story_contents/B024/actors/2/arc/1/summ.en: Ties HC08 observation and the XT03 return-line request to the duty whistle

/story_contents/B024/actors/2/arc/2/summ.en: Pays the price of either the dispatch evidence or the on-time return

/story_contents/B024/actors/2/outcomes/0.en: Undisclosed line erased; return line opens on time

/story_contents/B024/actors/2/outcomes/1.en: Double key keeps the open-test signatures

/story_contents/B024/actors/3/sections/정.en:
Byeon Goun gauges the density of the crowd by the water stains on the floor of the Yeongdeungpo waiting hall.

As station master of the Yeongdeungpo waiting hall for the Water Compact, she hears orders to push the ration line behind the military freight cars as an insult, and when a water-cut notice appears she takes the broadcast herself.

Of Korean origin, she grew up in the Yeongdeungpo and Yangcheon area, and her voice is gentle, but she does not put down the microphone in the face of rumors of turbid water.

Byeon Goun and K017 are fixed in the station-master column of the waiting-hall duty roster.

/story_contents/B024/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
Before the Collapse, she tried to make the waiting hall's ration window and the medical waiting list public every day under the same roof.

Her ambition was to become the face-to-face window of the Sluice Charter, where water, treatment, and passage could be signed for in one place.

A word she left her mother, that she would open the Yangcheon line first before the water-cut broadcast went out, becomes the seed of a debt.

Even when military stop requests came first, she never emptied the water-train bays.

/story_contents/B024/actors/3/sections/가.en:
The Yeouido Ledger House demanded an observer seat in the waiting hall, citing its duty of keeping the sluice ledgers.

Byeon Goun accepted only the charter's clause on public waiting lists and refused the sentence on exclusive platforms.

Her place in the community was proven by the dates on which she coupled military freight cars only after the water train had left.

She does not write real water-treatment company names in her broadcast scripts.

/story_contents/B024/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
When a pipe accident in one ration district cut off water to part of Yangcheon, Byeon Goun opened the Yeongdeungpo waiting hall as a citizens' water window and put off the military stop.

Her fear was the sight of the waiting hall sealed on nothing more than rumors of turbid water and residents scattering to the smuggling boats under the bridges.

Even after the broadcast cut out, she stood gripping the microphone, unable to read the last number on the waiting list.

Jin Hagyeom's message about sealing the clinic arrived the same afternoon, but she did not close the window.

/story_contents/B024/actors/3/sections/생.en:
The turning point was the moment she chose between blocking the order to seal the waiting hall and exposing the waiting-list tampering to rearrange the windows.

When the West Sea Granary Theater's dock drainage schedule meshed with the Yeouido sluices, the water window shrank to an hour.

Blocking the seal keeps the citizens' window but pushes back the drainage schedule; exposing the tampering corrects the waiting list but stops the window for half a day.

The decision remains in the K017-TURN broadcast log.

/story_contents/B024/actors/3/sections/현.en:
Byeon Goun now opens the ration window and the medical waiting list every day as station master of the Yeongdeungpo waiting hall.

Her authority as station master is kept only by broadcast logs and citizen observers' signatures.

Even when the Yeouido Ledger House demands exclusive ownership of the window she refuses, and she carries out Yu Sejin's dispatch order on the platform but never couples military freight cars in front of the water train.

She moves Im Bada's alley waiting lists only onto the station blackboard.

/story_contents/B024/actors/3/sections/비.en:
Her secret is a memo showing she moved the Yangcheon line's numbers up one place before the water-cut broadcast.

Her guilt grows between the child who got water on time and the old man who, because of it, waited for the military stop and missed a medical bed.

Broadcasting it all could cut off trust in the waiting hall for a day, so she left only a window of partial disclosure.

It can be viewed only at the same moment as Jin Hagyeom's sealing message.

/story_contents/B024/actors/3/sections/관.en:
The night she carried out Yu Sejin's dispatch order on the platform was command, and the morning she announced Jin Hagyeom's clinic seal over the waiting-hall broadcast was an alliance.

Moving Im Bada's alley waiting lists onto the blackboard was a contract, but when a military stop was coupled first the lines tangled and it became a quarrel.

In the same waiting hall, some numbers saved one another and some broadcasts read as betrayal.

The relationship ledger continues to STORY-B024-K017.

/story_contents/B024/actors/3/sections/3.en:
In the waiting hall where the water-cut broadcast has gone silent, Byeon Goun reads the water stains of the Yangcheon line again.

When HC14 observation and the XT02 drainage schedule overlap on the same microphone, she swallows the military-stop announcement.

The price in Act 3 is either a drainage delay or a half-day halt of the window.

The narrative line is STORY-B024-K017.

/story_contents/B024/actors/3/sections/분.en:
In the first ending, Byeon Goun blocks the seal order and protects the citizens' water window.

In the second ending, she exposes the waiting-list tampering and rearranges the windows, stopping the line for a while.

The Water Compact slot is kept, and only the branch splits into K017-OUT.

The decision at the time is an escort to block the seal or an audit of the waiting list.

/story_contents/B024/actors/3/arc/0/summ.en: Opens the waiting hall as a citizens' water window during the Yangcheon water cut and puts off the military stop

/story_contents/B024/actors/3/arc/1/summ.en: Ties HC14 observation and the XT02 drainage schedule to the broadcast queue

/story_contents/B024/actors/3/arc/2/summ.en: Accepts the price of either a drainage delay or a window halt

/story_contents/B024/actors/3/outcomes/0.en: Seal blocked; citizens' water window kept

/story_contents/B024/actors/3/outcomes/1.en: Waiting-list tampering exposed, then the window redrawn by lottery

/story_contents/B024/actors/4/sections/정.en:
Byeon Siram reads the size of the work crews by the dust on the platforms of the Guro waiting hall.

As station master of the Guro waiting hall for the Standards Alliance, he cannot stand orders that put water trains behind in political priority, and fills blanks in the timetable before people.

Of Korean origin, he grew up in the Guro and Geumcheon area, and he never couples military freight cars before the stamp at the release window has dried.

Byeon Siram and K045 are fixed in the station-master column of the waiting hall's release blackboard.

/story_contents/B024/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
Before the Collapse, he divided columns so that parts releases, citizenship registration, and the ration pots were signed under one roof.

His ambition was to become the face-to-face window of the Fabrication Alliance so that even if its own raw water was cut off the waiting lines would not become hostages.

A promise he left a fellow work crew, to blow the whistle before the reservoir level touched the red line, becomes a debt.

Even when freight cars without a standards stamp came first, he never closed the citizenship window.

/story_contents/B024/actors/4/sections/가.en:
The Guro Alloy House demanded an observer seat at the Guro releases, citing its duty of fabrication standards.

Byeon Siram accepted only the charter's clause on public releases and refused the sentence on an exclusive waiting hall.

His place in the community was proven by how many times he coupled military freight cars only after the citizenship registration window had closed.

He does not write real steelmaker names on his timetable.

/story_contents/B024/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
When rumors spread that the western water contract was expiring, Byeon Siram sealed the waiting hall's reservoir and demanded direct negotiation with the Water Compact's ration representative.

His fear was the sight of the station's own raw water cut off and its waiting lines becoming hostages of the water contract.

Even after snapping the seal lock shut, he stood with the whistle in his mouth, unable to read the last line of the water-level gauge.

Gu Chansol's tool car stood at the platform, but while the reservoir was sealed he did not raise its place in the order.

/story_contents/B024/actors/4/sections/생.en:
The turning point was the moment he chose between finding a replacement reservoir pump to lift the seal and exposing the ledger of collusion at the windows to reopen the station lottery.

When the West Sea Granary Theater's distribution of refrigeration compressor parts overlapped with the Guro releases along with the Magok metering logs, the pump window shrank to half a day.

Finding the pump lifts the seal but pushes the parts order back a day; exposing the collusion reopens the lottery but keeps the reservoir locked a day longer.

The calculation remains in the K045-TURN release log.

/story_contents/B024/actors/4/sections/현.en:
Byeon Siram now makes the ration and release windows public every day as station master of the Guro waiting hall.

His authority is kept only by the water-level log and citizenship registration signatures.

Even when the Guro Alloy House demands exclusive releases he refuses, and he has not moved the place where Han Jion's ration pots sit on one side of the waiting hall.

He takes Yu Sejin's detour of the western water trains at Guro, but does not blow the whistle while the reservoir is sealed.

/story_contents/B024/actors/4/sections/비.en:
His secret is a note about setting aside one drum of the work crew's water before the seal.

His guilt grows between the citizenship window he saved and Gu Chansol, whose tool car he pushed back a day because of it.

He allows only partial disclosure in Han Jion's presence instead of full disclosure.

It can be viewed only when the water-level log and the release stamp coincide.

/story_contents/B024/actors/4/sections/관.en:
The night he set Han Jion's ration pots on one side of the waiting hall was a contract, and the morning he raised Gu Chansol's tool car in the platform order was a release alliance.

Taking Yu Sejin's water-train detour at Guro meant taking command, but when the reservoir was locked the detour stopped and it became a quarrel.

In the same waiting hall, some whistles saved one another and some seals remained betrayals.

The relationship ledger continues to STORY-B024-K045.

/story_contents/B024/actors/4/sections/3.en:
Before the sealed reservoir, Byeon Siram draws the red-line water level again.

When HC07 observation and the XT02 parts distribution overlap on the same release blackboard, he swallows the whistle for the military freight cars.

The price in Act 3 is either a delay in the parts order or one more day of sealing the reservoir.

The narrative line is STORY-B024-K045.

/story_contents/B024/actors/4/sections/분.en:
In one branch, Byeon Siram finds a replacement pump and lifts the reservoir seal.

In the other branch, he exposes the ledger of collusion at the windows and reopens the station lottery.

The Standards Alliance slot is kept, and only the branch identifier splits into K045-OUT.

The decision at the time is an escort for the pump or exposing the ledger.

/story_contents/B024/actors/4/arc/1/summ.en: Matches the release window to HC07 observation and the XT02 parts distribution

/story_contents/B024/actors/4/arc/2/summ.en: Pays the price of either a parts delay or a further seal

/story_contents/B024/actors/4/outcomes/0.en: Replacement pump lifts the reservoir seal

/story_contents/B024/actors/4/outcomes/1.en: Collusion ledger exposed, then the station lottery reopens

/story_contents/B024/actors/5/sections/정.en:
In the Magok waiting hall, Byeon Taeon asks about the sound of kitchen tap water before the noise of the lab buildings.

As station master of the Magok waiting hall for the Yangjae Machineworks Company, he halts the broadcast whenever the raw-water ration table is blank, even on days of showing off knowledge, and never puts research freight cars ahead of household rations.

Of Korean origin, he grew up in the Gangseo area, and every evening he rewrites the chalk on the evacuation-route board.

Byeon Taeon and K073 are fixed in the station-master column of the waiting hall's veto blackboard.

/story_contents/B024/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
Before the Collapse, he tried to design a gate hub where minimum lines for raw water and food and technical certification were signed under one roof.

His ambition was to make it the face-to-face window of the residents' veto, and the draft was written only in the margin of the well-level table.

A word he left at his younger sibling's lab, to broadcast the ration-pot numbers before the dispatch headcount, becomes a debt.

Even when certification freight cars came first, he never covered the household-pot column.

/story_contents/B024/actors/5/sections/가.en:
The Bukhansan Bogukmun Records House demanded an observer seat in the waiting hall, citing its duty of research certification.

Byeon Taeon accepted only the charter's clause on public minimum lines and refused the sentence on exclusive dispatch.

His place in the community was proven by the dates on which he put the ration-pot numbers into the vote broadcast before the research dispatch headcount.

He does not write real research institute names in his broadcast scripts.

/story_contents/B024/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
When rumors that the western water contract was expiring shook even the fire reservoirs, Byeon Taeon froze the researcher-dispatch window and demanded the Water Compact's minimum-line clause.

His fear was the picture of depending on outsiders for bulk food and raw water until a single line of the water contract handed over the whole waiting-hall roster.

Even after lowering the window shutter, he did not let go of the microphone, unable to read the last name on the roster.

Gu Yeonjae's certification car stood behind the water train, but during the freeze he did not couple it in front.

/story_contents/B024/actors/5/sections/생.en:
The turning point was the moment he chose between arranging an escort of substitute food to lift the window freeze and hunting down the secret deal to hand over the roster to strengthen the residents' veto.

When the Incheon Trust Theater's correction of false detections at track terminals meshed with the Magok machine room, the dispatch window shrank to one shift.

Arranging the escort gets the pots boiling again but pushes back the false-detection correction; finding the secret deal hardens the veto but keeps the window closed a day longer.

The choice remains in the K073-TURN vote log.

/story_contents/B024/actors/5/sections/현.en:
Byeon Taeon now posts the evacuation routes and well levels publicly as station master of the Magok waiting hall.

His authority is kept only by the vote broadcasts and Kim Doha's joint petition of the residents' veto.

Even when the Bukhansan Bogukmun Records House demands exclusive dispatch he refuses, and he has not changed the order of coupling Gu Yeonjae's certification car only behind the water train.

He receives Han Jion's raw-water supply convoy at the Magok platform, but cuts the broadcast whenever the pot numbers are blank.

/story_contents/B024/actors/5/sections/비.en:
His secret is a note about setting aside a drum of raw water meant for his sibling's lab the day before the freeze.

His guilt grows between the minimum-line clause he saved and the technician who, because of it, put off the track false-detection fix by a shift.

Broadcasting it all could cut off trust in the roster for a day, so he left only partial disclosure.

It can be viewed only at the same moment as Kim Doha's joint petition.

/story_contents/B024/actors/5/sections/관.en:
The night he carried out Kim Doha's residents' veto in the waiting hall was command, and the morning he coupled Gu Yeonjae's certification car behind the water train was a contract under the same roof.

Receiving Han Jion's raw-water convoy at the platform was cooperation, but when the pot numbers were fewer than the dispatch headcount the broadcast cut off and it became a quarrel.

In the same waiting hall, some votes saved one another and some roster lines read as betrayal.

The relationship ledger continues to STORY-B024-K073.

/story_contents/B024/actors/5/sections/3.en:
Before the frozen dispatch window, Byeon Taeon counts the pot numbers again.

When HC05 observation and the XT05 false-detection correction overlap in the same broadcast queue, he swallows the research-car announcement.

The price in Act 3 is either a delayed false-detection fix or one more day of freezing the window.

The narrative line is STORY-B024-K073.

/story_contents/B024/actors/5/sections/분.en:
In the first ending, Byeon Taeon arranges the substitute food escort and lifts the dispatch-window freeze.

In the second ending, he finds the secret deal to hand over the roster and strengthens the residents' veto.

The Yangjae Machineworks Company slot is kept, and only the branch splits into K073-OUT.

The decision at the time is a food escort or tracking the secret deal.

/story_contents/B024/actors/5/arc/2/summ.en: Accepts the price of either a false-detection delay or a further freeze
