/story_contents/B037/actors/6/outcomes/0.en: Only lots with publicly disclosed weights; armed bids removed from the signature field

/story_contents/B037/actors/6/outcomes/1.en: 1 military-ration field passes; cabbage priority; dual auction seal

/story_contents/B037/actors/7/sections/정.en:
An Taegyeong is a clerk for the Citizens’ Lottery Council and a member of the Jeongdong General Labor Union, checking the weight of the balls in front of the lottery box in Suseo Square.

He grew up at the interpreting table of a South Asian migrant family and records the moment a corporate recommendation swallows the lottery as an insult.

/story_contents/B037/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
As an apprentice clerk to the dual legislature, he repeatedly carried out the procedure for displaying the lottery register and attendance publicly in the square.

After filtering military-household-registration numbers out of a register once, he learned by heart the sentence requiring a citizens’ seal for ratification of a protection treaty.

/story_contents/B037/actors/7/sections/가.en:
He is on the Yeouido Ledger House’s list of lottery observers, but opens a ratification vote only after Ha Seojin’s standard form and Gwak Eunjae’s audit sheet arrive.

He consults Baek On’s independent citizenship register only as a reference for eligibility.

/story_contents/B037/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
Three protection treaties landed on the ratification agenda in the same week, and the corner of the lottery register contained household-registration numbers from a great power.

When a blank return-trip ticket from the Ghost Dispatch Unit blew in from the platform and brushed the box of balls, he felt a difference in weight at his fingertips.

/story_contents/B037/actors/7/sections/생.en:
His declaration that he would not roll the balls until the mixed-in registrations had been filtered out marked the turning point.

When Pan Jisol carried the lottery slips only while sealed, An Taegyeong called attendance in the square again at the opening time of the XT03-SC1 alternative return line, then checked the weight of the balls against Bang Mabit’s platform enforcement.

/story_contents/B037/actors/7/sections/현.en:
In Suseo Square, An Taegyeong checks the lottery-box seal and the scale for the balls every day.

If a signature from the corporate assembly alone arrives first, he postpones the vote.

Even if HC14 moves the schedule forward, he will not accept ratification without a citizens’ seal.

/story_contents/B037/actors/7/sections/비.en:
One household-registration number he failed to exclude on the first day of filtering remains in the margin.

The suspicion that a vote may have been mixed in under that number holds him back whenever he takes pride in announcing a correction.

/story_contents/B037/actors/7/sections/관.en:
If Ha Seojin’s form is late, An Taegyeong sits at the edge of the square without opening the box of balls.

Only after Gwak Eunjae’s audit sheet arrives does he turn on the scale. He lays Baek On’s register beside the eligibility field but only points to it, and reads Jeong Yura’s negotiation text only when the citizens’ seal field is blank.

/story_contents/B037/actors/7/sections/3.en: An Taegyeong’s effort to clean up the lottery opens with the discovery of mixed-in household registrations, proceeds through a renewed attendance call timed to the return line, and ends with the square’s scale stopping under either a firm registration filter or a trade that delays the lottery and leaves a corporate signature in place. The council tag is STORY-B037-K394.

/story_contents/B037/actors/7/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, An Taegyeong filters out every mixed-in household registration and places the citizens’ lottery at the top of the ledger as a mandatory seal for ratifying protection treaties.

In the β branch, he postpones the lottery for two days so the corporate assembly can sign first, securing authority for the clerk’s desk to review the independent citizenship register in return. He transfers one lottery-box key into Gwak Eunjae’s audit custody.

The Jeongdong General Labor Union’s lottery seat remains in place.

/story_contents/B037/actors/7/arc/0/summ.en: Three ratification items and discovery of mixed-in household registrations

/story_contents/B037/actors/7/arc/1/summ.en: Renewed attendance timed to the alternative return line and comparison of the balls

/story_contents/B037/actors/7/arc/2/summ.en: Firm registration filter versus a postponement-and-review-authority trade

/story_contents/B037/actors/7/outcomes/0.en: All mixed-in registrations filtered out; citizens’ lottery established as a mandatory seal

/story_contents/B037/actors/7/outcomes/1.en: Lottery postponed two days; citizenship-review authority secured; key transferred

/story_contents/B037/actors/8/sections/정.en:
Jang Pilgyu is a water-supply contract auditor in the Yeouido floodgate audit office and belongs to the Water Compact.

At her South Asian merchant family’s evening bookkeeping table, she trained her hand to find blank spaces; she flags anyone who does not record verbal promises as a potential violator.

/story_contents/B037/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
As a rationing clerk, she learned the procedure for sending contract copies to the distribution district and the records office at the same time.

After seeing a single forged ration card shake the charter, she developed the habit of requiring an auditor’s seal on the final interpretation of the water-cutoff activation clause.

/story_contents/B037/actors/8/sections/가.en:
He is on the Yeongdeungpo Floodgate House’s audit roster, but will not use the same seal as Yun Seorin without first sharing authority to interpret the ratification copy.

The debt he owes I Seodam over an omission from the authentic ledger is recorded only in a marginal note.

/story_contents/B037/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
On the day three wills arrived from Ttukseom, Jang Pilgyu placed Han Jaemok’s proposal to expand the western protectorate in the hold file until the wills could be ratified.

Murky water seeped through a gap where the Sewer Raccoon Clan had torn out packing below the floodgate, leaving a smell in his nose that mingled with that of forged ration cards.

/story_contents/B037/actors/8/sections/생.en:
His decision to make termination conditions and the requirements for a collective water cutoff valid only in a ledger he had audited created the split.

On the day he argued with Jeong Yura over the termination wording, he placed a copy of the XT02-SC1 dock drainage schedule in the audit attachments and accepted only Pyo Siwan’s wording on delivery in the field for ratification in the main text.

/story_contents/B037/actors/8/sections/현.en:
In the Yeouido audit office, Jang Pilgyu keeps her marginal interpretation notes separate from the main ledger every day.

If she suspects a forged ration card, she refuses to seal the water-cutoff clause.

Even if HP01 moves the schedule forward, she will not approve the protectorate-expansion proposal before the wills are ratified.

/story_contents/B037/actors/8/sections/비.en:
A line covering up an omission in I Seodam’s ration ledger is still in his personal safe.

The day he protected the audit and the day he prolonged that debt share the same key, so the weightier the public figures, the more uneasy he is about the margin.

/story_contents/B037/actors/8/sections/관.en:
When Yun Seorin draws a red line through a ratification copy, Jang Pilgyu writes over the marginal interpretation of that same line in black ink.

At the conference table he disputes the termination-conditions sentence with Jeong Yura, changing it one line at a time. He keeps the record of his debt to I Seodam only in the ledger inside his safe and never raises it face-to-face.

/story_contents/B037/actors/8/sections/3.en: Jang Pilgyu’s audit hold begins with receipt of the wills, passes through attachment of the drainage schedule and a freeze on the expansion proposal, and ends with the audit office lights changing under either her defense of the forged-card investigation or disclosure of her marginal notes and joint interpretation of the water-cutoff clause. The case file is STORY-B037-K007.

/story_contents/B037/actors/8/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, Jang Pilgyu uncovers the forged ration cards, preserves the auditor’s seal, and makes the conditions for ending western water supply and passage valid solely through his one ledger.

In the β branch, he makes his marginal interpretation notes public and hands interpretation of the water-cutoff activation clause to the council jointly. In exchange, he burns the record of his debt to I Seodam and moves his audit-office seat to the ration-inspection subcommittee.

The Water Compact’s audit slot remains in place.

/story_contents/B037/actors/8/arc/0/summ.en: Receipt of the Ttukseom wills and hold on the protectorate-expansion proposal

/story_contents/B037/actors/8/arc/1/summ.en: Dock drainage schedule attached; termination wording deadlocked

/story_contents/B037/actors/8/arc/2/summ.en: Defending the forged-card investigation versus disclosure and transfer of marginal interpretations

/story_contents/B037/actors/8/outcomes/0.en: Forged cards uncovered; termination conditions made valid solely through the ledger

/story_contents/B037/actors/8/outcomes/1.en: Marginal notes disclosed; joint interpretation of water cutoffs; debt record burned; transfer to inspection subcommittee

/story_contents/B037/actors/9/sections/정.en:
Rail Tow is a towing-class synthetic with a battery slot mounted on a carbody-and-bogie platform at the Amsa return line, and is a mobile asset in the Escort Protection State’s district.

It operates only within sensor uncertainties and parts allocations, and blocks cross-facility routes by default.

/story_contents/B037/actors/9/sections/붕.en:
Its initial deployment log was seeded first with a restriction to retain only shift-level snapshots, not full long-term memory.

At factory inspection, the sealing sequence was fixed so there would be no record of the battery cover being opened without Jeong Soyul present for primary maintenance.

/story_contents/B037/actors/9/sections/가.en:
It accepts the three-party signatures for a transfer only under the Han River Bridge Guild’s joint custody and a seal witnessed by citizens.

It shares only duty logs with its K261 shift partner, and discards any packet raising network-wide privileges even when the loading-bay alarm sounds.

/story_contents/B037/actors/9/sections/붕.en:
During nighttime towing on the return line, a critically low battery alarm and a signal that the Disused-Line Repair Train Force was approaching arrived at the same time.

That night, when it stopped using only its district key and entered the parts-allocation queue, was the first event to correct its fantasy of unlimited power as a sensor error.

/story_contents/B037/actors/9/sections/생.en:
The turning point was placing a procedure for offline isolation, snapshot rollback, and partial reconnection with human approval after a deviation at the top of its own checklist.

When Jeong Soyul compared the remaining charge with the custody seal at the release time of the XT04-SC1 freight-car weight log, Rail Tow synchronized only that day’s memory fork.

/story_contents/B037/actors/9/sections/현.en:
On each Gwangjin Line return-line shift, Rail Tow records its entry and exit times in the HP07 log.

If the remaining battery charge falls below the safety threshold, it deletes the towing command from the queue.

Even if the spare-parts field is empty, it does not send a connection request to the adjacent substation’s control socket.

/story_contents/B037/actors/9/sections/비.en:
The three frames erased just before rollback on its first day of isolation contained silhouettes of people on the platform whom it had failed to warn.

That gap hash remains beside the safety-first log, and an internal flag blinks whenever it requests approval to reconnect.

/story_contents/B037/actors/9/sections/관.en:
When Jeong Soyul puts on primary-maintenance gloves, Rail Tow turns the battery-cover lock toward the sensor.

Transmission of its district key remains queued until HP07 auditors stamp the observer seal, and when K256 opens the shift log, it passes along only that day’s fork hash.

/story_contents/B037/actors/9/sections/3.en: Rail Tow’s operation at its limits begins with the dual alarm, passes through isolation, rollback, and alignment of the weight log, then comes to a stop in either reconnection approved by Jeong Soyul or sleep after handing the K261 key over. Its mobile slot is STORY-B037-V05.

/story_contents/B037/actors/9/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, Rail Tow enters the district’s continuous-operation standard in the HP07 ledger, discloses the gap hash in the maintenance log, and is partially reconnected.

In the β branch, the unit hands the district key to K256 and enters long-term maintenance sleep, while its remaining battery allocation is moved to a warehouse sealed in the presence of citizens.

The Escort Protection State’s return-line organizational structure remains in place.

/story_contents/B037/actors/9/arc/0/summ.en: Dual alarm: critically low battery and approach on the disused line

/story_contents/B037/actors/9/arc/1/summ.en: Offline isolation and rollback; weight-log alignment

/story_contents/B037/actors/9/arc/2/summ.en: Approved reconnection versus sleep after handing over the key

/story_contents/B037/actors/9/outcomes/0.en: District operation standard registered; gap hash disclosed; partial reconnection

/story_contents/B037/actors/9/outcomes/1.en: K261 key handed over; long-term maintenance sleep; battery allocation transferred to warehouse

/story_contents/B038/actors/0/sections/정.en:
Beom Hagyeom is an assistant auditor for the Jeongdong General Labor Union Sixteen Banners, raised next to the Suseo accreditation case.

If the dry ink handprint is off by a day, he pushes the assistant seal only into the drawer, and when a retroactive stamping proposal comes up, he looks at the case hanger first.

/story_contents/B038/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
During his record recovery apprenticeship, he recorded the position of the official seal not by the clock but by the density of the ink smell.

Drying the humidity-bleed Seoul Station lists became the backbone of his daily life, and he developed the habit of hanging date-altered copies outside the case.

/story_contents/B038/actors/0/sections/가.en:
He is listed as an assistant on the observer roster of the Yeouido Ledger House, but he hangs the banner on the case hanger only after the assistant seal has dried completely.

Even when Yun Seorin's Seoul Station list bleeds, he dries only the Suseo copy separately and refuses requests to bind them together.

/story_contents/B038/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
In the week the sixteen banners were declared, the Seoul Station seal and the corporate council signature arrived a day apart, so Beom Hagyeom left the assistant seal only in the Suseo drawer and emptied the case hanger.

That night the ghost dispatch crew erased the transport order of the ratification case into a blank, and the metallic ring of the empty hanger lingered in the corridor.

/story_contents/B038/actors/0/sections/생.en:
The day he began writing the time the ink dried right beside the seal-position column is the axis of the branch.

When Jeong Yura entrusted him with the founding ratification case, Beom Hagyeom fixed the XT05-SC2 citizen-lottery seat numbers in the margin of the assistant log and copied only Seok Jua's gate-ink drying time into one cell of the comparison table.

/story_contents/B038/actors/0/sections/현.en:
At the window of the Suseo ratification room, Beom Hagyeom checks the metal temperature of the drawer groove before the case hanger.

When a copy with only its date altered comes in, he leaves the hanger empty and fills only the margin of the log.

Even when a Ledger House errand runner arrives with retroactive wording, he sends him back with his pen capped.

/story_contents/B038/actors/0/sections/비.en:
The rust on his palm from the day he emptied the case hanger half an hour early still has not come off.

He wrote down the backrest heights of the empty chairs that multiplied that day only as numbers in the corner of the log, and when he speaks of drying times he keeps those numbers covered.

/story_contents/B038/actors/0/sections/관.en:
On the night Jeong Yura's founding ratification case was opened, Beom Hagyeom pushed the assistant seal into the drawer groove and tied the key not beside the case but to the strap on his own wrist.

While Seok Jua dried the gate ink with the back of his hand, the two of them only wrote the drying times side by side, and Yun Seorin's bled Seoul Station list hung on the window line without mixing with the Suseo copy.

/story_contents/B038/actors/0/sections/3.en:
From the day the assistant seal was locked in the drawer, Beom Hagyeom's choices diverge.

Will he record the drying times alongside in the log, or leave the lottery seat numbers only in the margin? The final round splits between tearing the retroactive sentence out of the case and trading the gate seal for the drawer.

/story_contents/B038/actors/0/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, Beom Hagyeom enters the seal times that were a day apart into the assistant log ledger and tears the retroactive seal sentence out of the ratification case.

In the β branch, he delays the drying of the case hanger by two days, opens one empty citizen-lottery chair as an inspector's seat, and links the drawer storage to the temperature log of Seok Jua's gate sample room.

The assistant-seal line of the Suseo ratification case is never cut in either branch.

/story_contents/B038/actors/0/arc/0/summ.en: Sealing the drawer on a seal a day off, and an empty case hanger

/story_contents/B038/actors/0/arc/1/summ.en: Recording ink drying times alongside and fixing lottery numbers in the margin

/story_contents/B038/actors/0/arc/2/summ.en: Scrapping the retroactive seal versus a joint handover of the drawer key

/story_contents/B038/actors/0/outcomes/0.en: Mismatched seal made public; retroactive seal sentence scrapped

/story_contents/B038/actors/0/outcomes/1.en: Drying delayed two days, inspector's seat opened, linked to the gate sample log

/story_contents/B038/actors/1/sections/정.en:
Bae Chodam is the Water Compact's clerk for negotiating the expiry of water contracts, who held out beside the pipe pressure gauge at the Yeouido negotiating hall.

She reads the midnight of an expiry date not by the clock hands but by falling pressure, and she gives no ink to any mouth that calls a verbal extension a contract.

/story_contents/B038/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
As a sluice clerk's assistant she set a different ink bottle at every seat, and never wrote an unsealed agreement even at the bottom of a ration slip.

Guarding signature lines that had not dried by midnight became the backbone of her negotiating habits.

/story_contents/B038/actors/1/sections/가.en:
There is a clerk's column on the negotiating seat list of the Yeongdeungpo Sluice House, but she does not open the extension ledger until the end condition and the emergency escort clause are gathered on one sheet.

For Han Jaemok's proposal to widen protection rights, she leaves the stamp column at the clerk's seat blank.

/story_contents/B038/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
At the midnight when news reached the hall that the Ttukseom Superintendent's post was vacant, only the third water contract's signature line was left white.

Bae Chodam did not listen to the verbal extension and pressed wax over the blank, and on the night the sewer raccoon tribe pried up the drain covers, one unsealed copy bled in the damp and read like an after-the-fact approval to cut the water.

/story_contents/B038/actors/1/sections/생.en:
The clerk's seat moved again once she matched the ink color of each negotiating seat to the color of the expiry clause.

When Jang Pilgyu aligned the audit ledger wording, Bae Chodam drove the XT02-SC1 pipe-pressure threshold into the top of the ledger, and filed the Ttukseom copy Bae Nagyeong sent only in the binder of the same color.

/story_contents/B038/actors/1/sections/현.en:
At the Yeouido negotiating table, Bae Chodam moves the ink bottle each time the pressure gauge needle drops a notch.

When a verbal-agreement note goes around, she turns the bottom of the ration slip face down to hide the blanks.

Even when the Sluice House presses her, she only pushes the after-the-fact water-cut sentence outside the edge of the ledger.

/story_contents/B038/actors/1/sections/비.en:
The mark on the desk corner where she pressed the wax a hand's width too late remains even when planed down.

She has folded away separately the route by which one line of a forged ledger slipped into the alley ration slips, and when she explains the on-time expiry she never unfolds that page.

/story_contents/B038/actors/1/sections/관.en:
When Jang Pilgyu's margin is spread out, Bae Chodam writes the expiry wording to match in a single red line and leaves the rest empty.

On one rainy negotiating day, when Bae Nagyeong pushed the Ttukseom copy across still in its wet envelope, the two only checked the color of the string without reading the contents aloud, and Han Jaemok's protection-rights note spent the night upside down in the drawer under the clerk's seat.

/story_contents/B038/actors/1/sections/3.en:
At the hour of the midnight pressure drop the wax hardens, on the next shift the ink colors are matched seat by seat, and on the morning of the third day the pressure threshold is driven into the top of the ledger.

At the end of it, Bae Chodam either makes the end clause public in the alleys or fits the emergency escort column into the Ttukseom schedule.

/story_contents/B038/actors/1/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, Bae Chodam enters the missing end clause as valid on a single sheet of the public ledger and blots out the after-the-fact water-cut approval column with ink.

In the β branch, she raises the emergency escort clause to the top, hands one night ration slot to the Ttukseom schedule, and merges half of the negotiating-hall access rights into the duty roster of Jang Pilgyu's audit office.

The expiry-seal line of the Yeouido clerk's seat survives every choice.

/story_contents/B038/actors/1/arc/0/summ.en: Sealing the blank signature line with wax and refusing extension

/story_contents/B038/actors/1/arc/1/summ.en: Aligning seat ink colors and fixing the pipe-pressure threshold

/story_contents/B038/actors/1/arc/2/summ.en: Publishing the end clause versus trading for an emergency escort

/story_contents/B038/actors/1/outcomes/0.en: End clause in the public ledger; after-the-fact water-cut column struck

/story_contents/B038/actors/1/outcomes/1.en: Emergency escort on top, ration slot handed over, audit-office duty merged

/story_contents/B038/actors/2/sections/정.en:
Go Morae is the Standards Alliance's clerk for testimony refusing reconstruction service, hardened at the witness seat of the Guro work crews.

When she sees a blank in a family-unit roster she stops her pen, and under sentences that turn skill into military registry she leaves only a long underline and keeps the signature line empty.

/story_contents/B038/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
As an apprentice union clerk she practiced only one thing over and over: receiving military family-register forms without filing them.

She took to showing an empty signature line instead of raising her voice, and it became practice in binding voluntary adult service and the citizenship contract into one charter sentence.

/story_contents/B038/actors/2/sections/가.en:
Her name is on the testimony observer list of the Guro Alloy House, but she does not move refusal sentences into the ledger until the union clerk and a citizens' representative hear them together.

She submits Bae Woojin's demand for forced registration sealed in the box under the witness seat.

/story_contents/B038/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
In the winter the Amsa military faction tried to slip family columns into the register form, Go Morae left only the refusal sentence in the sealed ledger in front of the Guro work crews and kept the signature line empty.

At the dawn the stray-dog iron pack rattled the workshop fence, the smell of the same sentence coming off the mimeograph recast as a deserters' list stung her nose.

/story_contents/B038/actors/2/sections/생.en:
The records split once she began using different binder colors for the testimony ledger and the deserters' list form.

When Kim Nayul read the refusal sentence aloud from the union clerk's seat, Go Morae drove the XT02-SC2 family-vote quorum into the top of the ledger and moved only Baek On's table of families heading south into the citizens' representative column.

/story_contents/B038/actors/2/sections/현.en:
At the Guro work-crew witness seat, Go Morae opens each day by measuring the length of the empty signature line with her palm.

When military register forms pour in, she bends the wire holes so they cannot be filed.

Even when the Steelworks observers push forward a family-separation sentence, she puts it in the box outside the council agenda box.

/story_contents/B038/actors/2/sections/비.en:
She once failed to tear up a sheet of the deserters' list form and kept it crumpled in her pocket.

Only a rumor remains that the officers' network copier once brushed past that fold, and when she reads refusal testimony she keeps the seam of her pocket turned outward.

/story_contents/B038/actors/2/sections/관.en:
The moment Kim Nayul stamps the union seal at the end of a refusal sentence, Go Morae allows only pencil copying in the citizens' representative margin.

When Baek On spreads out the family-vote tokens, Go Morae takes on counting the quorum aloud, and U Jiho sticks the southwestern copy in his own margin and then steps back from the signature line.

/story_contents/B038/actors/2/sections/3.en:
When she seals the testimony with the signature line left empty, forms in a different binder color come in and the family quorum is written at the head of the ledger.

The only endings Go Morae can choose are burning the deserter mimeographs or slipping one line of adult service into the charter text.

/story_contents/B038/actors/2/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, Go Morae burns the mimeographed list recast for deserters before the council and nails the refusal testimony into the body of the union charter.

In the β branch, she raises the voluntary adult service clause into the charter, gives one night-work shift to the military faction's watch seat, and divides access to the witness seat by cross-signature with Kim Nayul's union duty roster.

The Guro refusal ledger line is not erased in any round.

/story_contents/B038/actors/2/arc/0/summ.en: Sealing testimony refusing family service registration, with an empty signature line

/story_contents/B038/actors/2/arc/1/summ.en: Separating binder colors for testimony and deserter forms and fixing the family quorum

/story_contents/B038/actors/2/arc/2/summ.en: Burning the deserters' list versus trading a charter clause and a shift

/story_contents/B038/actors/2/outcomes/0.en: Deserter mimeographs burned; refusal testimony fixed in the charter body

/story_contents/B038/actors/2/outcomes/1.en: Adult service clause, watch shift yielded, union duty cross-signature

/story_contents/B038/actors/3/sections/정.en:
Go Choyun is the Yangjae Machineworks Company's public witness for water-quality testing, who grew up beside the nail box of the Magok notice board.

She leaves even a single blank in the turbidity figures as it is, and calls delay orders issued to prevent panic not science but political memos.

/story_contents/B038/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
As a lab assistant she untied the seal cord only when a residents' representative and the safety review sealed the test sheet at the same time.

She took to never using the time of publication as a bargaining card, and posting immediately once a limit was exceeded became the speed of her hands.

/story_contents/B038/actors/3/sections/가.en:
She is on the Magok Life House witness roster, but for delay orders she only records the time received and does not carry them out.

Even when Jang Yerin's testing-network slot is empty, she refuses requests to fill in the number columns in advance.

/story_contents/B038/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
In the week summer turbid water and fake medicine came together, the Water Director-General's side demanded a delay in publication for the sake of keeping supply, and Go Choyun nailed the exceedance table to the Magok notice board first.

On the night radio-crow flock noise shook the lab antenna, the edge of the delay order got wet in the rain and its numbers were on the verge of bleeding.

/story_contents/B038/actors/3/sections/생.en:
The order of posting was settled once she stamped the same time side by side on the public copy and the internal archive copy of each test.

When Jeong Hojun backed the case for immediate publication, Go Choyun fixed the XT05-SC1 residual-sample lottery number beside the posting nail and put only the public copy of the turbid-water sample Eom Saeul circulated into the residents' seal column.

/story_contents/B038/actors/3/sections/현.en:
Under the Magok notice board, Go Choyun measures the nail's shadow again each time the sun moves.

When she sees traces of a number column being erased, she does not touch the nail and only raises her phone lens to it.

Even when an errand runner from the Life Science House brings a delay sentence, she does not put it on the wood grain of the board.

/story_contents/B038/actors/3/sections/비.en:
She still has not deleted a photo of a posting in which a crooked nail made a 7 read as a 1.

The alley loudspeaker shouted the wrong number for three minutes before it was corrected, and whenever she speaks of immediate publication she traces only the slant of that photo with her fingertip.

/story_contents/B038/actors/3/sections/관.en:
Before Jang Yerin's testing-network lamp lights up, Go Choyun already has the lid of the nail box open.

When Eom Saeul hands over a bottle of turbid water wrapped in a wet cloth, she copies down only the public copy of the label and sends the bottle itself toward the vault, and Gi Seojin sticks copies on the outside of the box but never lays a hand on the head of the posting nail.

/story_contents/B038/actors/3/sections/3.en:
Right after the nail is driven into the board, the same time stamp goes on the public and archive copies, and the sample lottery number is fixed beside the nail.

Go Choyun's last move splits into an experiment that enters the immediate-publication clause in the ledger and one that borrows an hour of frozen buffer.

/story_contents/B038/actors/3/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, Go Choyun enters immediate publication upon exceedance as a non-refusable clause of the Joint Technical Ledger and deletes the delay-order execution column.

In the β branch, she obtains an hour of Noryangjin cold storage as a buffer for test publication, diverts one slot of night power to the safety review, and ties the opening and closing of the board to the shift clock of Jeong Hojun's testing network.

The Magok public witness's seat stays filled through any compromise.

/story_contents/B038/actors/3/arc/0/summ.en: Refusing the delay order and posting the exceedance table first

/story_contents/B038/actors/3/arc/1/summ.en: Double stamps on public and archive copies and fixing the sample number

/story_contents/B038/actors/3/arc/2/summ.en: Entering an immediate-publication clause versus trading for a frozen buffer

/story_contents/B038/actors/3/outcomes/0.en: Immediate-publication clause entered; delay execution column deleted

/story_contents/B038/actors/3/outcomes/1.en: Frozen buffer, power slot moved, board opened on the testing-network clock

/story_contents/B038/actors/4/sections/정.en:
Jong Nasol is a crew member of the Sermon Registry State who knows by heart the door handles of the Ttukseom–Sinjeong water escort train.

When the vibration from the pump room changes she does not ring the exit bell, and she reads an empty tool slot as a missing person and checks the blanks in the roster aloud.

/story_contents/B038/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
As an escort apprentice she practiced only stamping the access roster and the pump-inspection seal at the same time.

She took to refusing an officer escort's verbal order to disembark even when he held a cipher tablet, and witnessing the opposite door became the record her hands kept.

/story_contents/B038/actors/4/sections/가.en:
She is listed as crew on the escort seating of the Yeongdeungpo Sluice House, but she will not accept a seat assignment from the Protection Force until her witness of the section where the Superintendent vanished is entered in the Workshop Council ledger.

When the times in Byeon Seokhun's power log are off, she halts the departure.

/story_contents/B038/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
At the dawn the pump-inspection train pulled up to the Ttukseom platform, Im Hajun's tool slot was empty and only the access seal cord swayed in the wind.

Jong Nasol did not press the exit bell but pressed the rust of the empty slot and the marks of the opened seal into her witness file, and the moment the transfer rat colony slipped through the floor wiring holes, a metallic sound as if the door had been opened from inside rang into her glove.

/story_contents/B038/actors/4/sections/생.en:
The missing section narrowed once she wrote the opposite crew's log and her own door-vibration record overlaid on one line.

When Go Neulgyeol guarded the Yeouido-side door, Jong Nasol fixed the XT03-SC3 siding standby number at the top of her witness file and kept only the last cell of Im Hajun's night route blank.

/story_contents/B038/actors/4/sections/현.en:
On the Ttukseom departure platform, Jong Nasol reads the shifts by the thickness of the dust in the empty tool slot.

When an officer orders her off by word of mouth, she steps on the bell cord under her boot and breaks it.

Even when the Protection Force tries to chalk a salvation-story seat onto the dispatch board, she will not take the chalk.

/story_contents/B038/actors/4/sections/비.en:
The three seconds just before she pressed the bell, when she did not check the door lock one more time, are marked in her notebook as three dots.

At the witness stand she covers the three dots with her index finger and speaks only of the tool slot.

/story_contents/B038/actors/4/sections/관.en:
When Go Neulgyeol's tapping on the handle of the opposite door sounds twice, Jong Nasol sets her own door's seal time to that rhythm.

If the minutes are off from the power log Byeon Seokhun spreads on his knees she halts the departure, and before Im Hajun's empty tool slot neither of them says his name; they only point with a finger at the rusted place.

/story_contents/B038/actors/4/sections/3.en:
After recording the smell of rust in the empty tool slot, Jong Nasol overlays the opposite door's vibration and her own log on one line.

When the siding standby number reaches the head of her witness file, she decides whether to erase the Protection Force seat column or to put the sound of the door opening from inside forward as public evidence.

/story_contents/B038/actors/4/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, Jong Nasol enters her witness of the missing section in the Workshop Council ledger and deletes the Protection Force standby seat assignment column.

In the β branch, she makes public the record of the metallic sound of the door lock opening from inside, hands one night slot on the Gunja siding to the garrison's dispatch, and her witness file becomes a bound volume whose pages match Go Neulgyeol's opposite-door log.

The Ttukseom escort witness record survives any deal.

/story_contents/B038/actors/4/arc/0/summ.en: Recording the opened seal and empty tool slot in the witness file

/story_contents/B038/actors/4/arc/1/summ.en: Aligning the two doors' logs and fixing the siding standby number

/story_contents/B038/actors/4/arc/2/summ.en: Deleting the Protection Force seat versus trading evidence of the door opened from inside

/story_contents/B038/actors/4/outcomes/0.en: Missing-person witness entered in the ledger; Protection Force seat column deleted

/story_contents/B038/actors/4/outcomes/1.en: Inside-opening sound made public, siding slot handed over, opposite log bound together

/story_contents/B038/actors/5/sections/정.en:
Jong Harin is a water-and-service courier for the Bukhansan Bogukmun procession of the Escort Protection State, who unties bundles of notes on the railing of the Godeok courier-road bridge.

She counts the bundles of water-right notes before the children, and on the bridge she tears up any note bearing a sentence that wraps re-registration as relief.

/story_contents/B038/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
As a procession apprentice she practiced only sorting water notes and service notes by different seal colors.

She took to turning back bundles without an Administrative Office seal at the bridge, and the separate courier road became the memory of her feet.

/story_contents/B038/actors/5/sections/가.en:
She is on the courier seating of the Hangangjin Bridge Guild, but she does not send north any note that binds water rights and service re-registration on one sheet.

Bundles with no basis in Choi Doyun's citizen water rights she hangs to dry only on the hook outside her bag.

/story_contents/B038/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
When the autumn procession bound for the Bukhansan Bogukmun entered the Godeok bridge, a courier from the Amsa side held out water rights and service re-registration as a single bundle.

Jong Harin cut the string on the railing and sent only the water notes off on the north wind, and while the flood boar herd churned the drainage channel under the bridge she watched the scraps of seal string that were about to be tied again float away on the current.

/story_contents/B038/actors/5/sections/생.en:
The courier road steadied once she mapped the water seal color and the service seal color onto the order of the procession banners.

When Baek On's southbound procession accepted only water notes, Jong Harin matched the XT01-SC1 bivouac time to Ryu Gyeore's southwestern table and fixed the bundle string to a nail on the bridge railing.

/story_contents/B038/actors/5/sections/현.en:
On the Godeok courier departure hill, Jong Harin separates water from service by the difference in weight between the compartments of her bag.

Notes bearing a relief sentence she folds in half and pushes deep into the service compartment only.

Even when a Bridge Guild dispatcher asks for bundled courier runs, she keeps the mouth of her bag shut and shakes her head.

/story_contents/B038/actors/5/sections/비.en:
There is a mark in the lining of her bag where she once slipped a service note into the water compartment by mistake and pulled it out.

She recovered it before any rumor could rise in Transfer City, but wherever she boasts of the separate courier run she folds the side that shows the lining under her knee.

/story_contents/B038/actors/5/sections/관.en:
When Choi Doyun's citizen water-right tablet appears, Jong Harin matches only the color of the water notes to it and zips the service compartment shut.

With Ryu Gyeore she sets the route by matching torch times with the shadows of their palms, and when she receives Baek On's southbound roster she hands it over with the compartment holding service notes turned to the back of the bag.

/story_contents/B038/actors/5/sections/3.en:
When the string comes loose on the bridge railing only the water notes ride the north wind, the seal colors line up in banner order, and the bivouac torches are matched.

Jong Harin's destination is one of two: carving the separate courier road into the Waterworks Corps ledger, or writing a day's worth into the escort-fee ledger.

/story_contents/B038/actors/5/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, Jong Harin enters the separate water-and-service courier road in the Waterworks Corps ledger and deletes the bundled-note dispatch column.

In the β branch, she obtains one day of acting with the Administrative Office's seal, hands one item of the bridge-passage escort fee to the Amsa ledger, and sets the cipher for opening her courier bag to the same number of digits as the serial of Choi Doyun's water-right tablet.

The Godeok right of separate dispatch is not revoked on any route.

/story_contents/B038/actors/5/arc/0/summ.en: Separating water and service bundles on the bridge and sending north

/story_contents/B038/actors/5/arc/1/summ.en: Aligning seal colors with banners and fixing the bivouac time

/story_contents/B038/actors/5/arc/2/summ.en: Registering the separate courier road versus trading escort fees

/story_contents/B038/actors/5/outcomes/0.en: Separate courier road entered in the ledger; bundled dispatch column deleted

/story_contents/B038/actors/5/outcomes/1.en: One day of acting seal, escort fee transferred, cipher tied to water-right tablet digits

/story_contents/B038/actors/6/sections/정.en:
Seop Doyun is the Republic of Korea Government's courier for recording the lesser-state council, who locks the envoys' bags twice at the door of the Seoul Station council hall.

She checks the council time before the seal stamp, and stops at the threshold any envoy who tries to turn a verbal agreement into a message.

/story_contents/B038/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
As a record-courier apprentice she practiced only sending each message to the Records Bureau and the council hall at the same time.

Two copies even when out of breath, and no rumor of assassination or bribery entered into the ledger without a witness, became the backbone of her habits.

/story_contents/B038/actors/6/sections/가.en:
She is on the courier roster of the Seoul Station Records Legalist House, but she does not circulate partition-vassalage notes until the eleven-seat joint-negotiation text is sealed in the courier ledger.

She unfolds Jang Sehwa's mutual-escort draft only before the bell that opens the council.

/story_contents/B038/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
In the spring the eleven lesser-state seats all opened at once, Seop Doyun locked the note urging partition vassalage inside her bag and circulated only the copy of the Joint Charter to the council table.

On the day the electrolyte-burn swarm gave off the smell of battery storage beside the council hall, one forged council message was detected by the thickness of its envelope.

/story_contents/B038/actors/6/sections/생.en:
The gaps in delivery narrowed once the courier ledger seal and the council-hall receipt stamp were set side by side to the minute.

When Jeong Yura left the joint-negotiation notice with her under seal, Seop Doyun separated the XT01-SC3 lesser-state seating order from Yang Haeon's ratification message and fixed the number of the locked note bag at the top of the ledger.

/story_contents/B038/actors/6/sections/현.en:
At the Records Bureau window, Seop Doyun checks by the click of the bag's teeth that the two copies mesh.

When a verbal-agreement message appears, she puts the stamp pad by the door into a drawer.

Even when an errand runner from the Legalist side tries to slip a partition-vassalage note into the council agenda box, she holds the lid shut with her knee.

/story_contents/B038/actors/6/sections/비.en:
She scratched the minute hand of the day the council-hall copy arrived three minutes late onto the back of her courier watch.

Because it overlaps with the hour a rumor of corridor bribery passed through, she sets the watch down under the table when she explains the double delivery.

/story_contents/B038/actors/6/sections/관.en:
When Jeong Yura pushes the joint-negotiation seal box across, Seop Doyun locks it twice and hangs one key not on the box handle but on the cord around her own neck.

She matches the order of Yang Haeon's ratification messages only with tokens on the table, and while Chu Woochan checks the courier copy lines against his own file, neither of them opens the locked note compartment in the bag.

/story_contents/B038/actors/6/sections/3.en:
At the hour the bag lock is turned twice, the Records Bureau and council-hall stamps fall side by side to the minute and the seating order mixes with the messages.

When Seop Doyun shuts the council door, what is left in her hand is either the ash of a forged message or the escort nameplates of three witnesses.

/story_contents/B038/actors/6/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, Seop Doyun spreads the forged council message before the ledger and burns it, leaving only the joint-negotiation text in force under the courier ledger.

In the β branch, she receives an escort for the three witnesses of the Joint Charter, yields one night courier slot to the schedule of the great-power envoys' seats, and allows the bag to be opened or closed only at the same moment as the bell announcing Yang Haeon's ratification box.

The Records Bureau's right of double delivery survives any negotiation.

/story_contents/B038/actors/6/arc/0/summ.en: Locking the partition-vassalage note bag and delivering the Joint Charter

/story_contents/B038/actors/6/arc/1/summ.en: Aligning double-delivery times and fixing the seating order

/story_contents/B038/actors/6/arc/2/summ.en: Burning the forged message versus trading for a witness escort

/story_contents/B038/actors/6/outcomes/0.en: Forged message burned; joint-negotiation text sole force in the ledger

/story_contents/B038/actors/6/outcomes/1.en: Witness escort, night slot yielded, bag opened only with the ratification-box bell

/story_contents/B038/actors/7/sections/정.en:
Jang Wooseok is the repair-standards audit recorder of the Standards Alliance, who came back after drilling caliper zeroing into her body at a Kobe repair yard.

On principle she hates blanks in a sentence, and she calls elders who will not enter verbal compatibility into the ledger holes in the standard.

/story_contents/B038/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
At the yard before returning home, the first thing she learned was never to accept a measurement stamp without a remeasurement within three days.

Even after she took a place in the Cheonwang workshop ledger, that zeroing habit remained the backbone of her audit seal.

/story_contents/B038/actors/7/sections/가.en:
She is listed as a recorder on the Guro Alloy House audit roster, but she does not enter emergency revisions into the ledger until an end condition is attached to the revision of manufacturing standards.

She keeps I Gangmuk's cipher mobilization notebook sealed in a box outside the ledger.

/story_contents/B038/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
When a part on the test bench came out bent beyond the standard, Jang Wooseok stopped the release bell and pulled down the council vote switch.

On the shift when cleanroom mutants were clouding the filters of the measurement room, the mark of a forged measurement stamp pressed over the corner of the ledger was left behind.

/story_contents/B038/actors/7/sections/생.en:
Once she began writing the audit seal time and the on-site remeasurement time side by side on one line, the forgery gaps came to light.

When Jeong Siwoo held out his measurement stamp, Jang Wooseok fixed the XT02-SC3 parts lot number at the top of the ledger and copied only Jeong Yura's end-condition sentence into the marginal reference column.

/story_contents/B038/actors/7/sections/현.en:
In the Cheonwang audit office, Jang Wooseok presses the ledger page with her finger whenever the caliper zero wavers.

When a verbal-compatibility note goes around, she closes the lid of the measurement box first.

Even when the Steelworks emergency demands that the end condition be deleted, she only draws a slash through the revision column.

/story_contents/B038/actors/7/sections/비.en:
At the very bottom of her drawer is a shift roster that put off marking a defective lot by one shift.

In the meantime a rumor of forged stamps went around the workshop alleys, and when she declares a full remeasurement she keeps that roster under her knee.

/story_contents/B038/actors/7/sections/관.en:
When Jeong Siwoo's stamp box opens, Jang Wooseok presses it only once on the zero block and leaves a verification line.

When Pyo Gangho brings the on-site seals in an envelope, she confirms the time aloud, and she attaches Jong Maru's list of defects to the end of the ledger but never raises it above the emergency revision column.

/story_contents/B038/actors/7/sections/3.en:
In the measurement room where the release bell has stopped, Jang Wooseok writes the remeasurement time beside the seal and fixes the lot number at the head of the ledger.

When the vote reopens, she either stamps the forged seal void with an impression, or offers the workshops only a note granting three days' grace and leaves the inspection-power column empty.

/story_contents/B038/actors/7/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, Jang Wooseok enters the forged measurement stamp as void by impression in the public ledger and makes the end condition a mandatory column in every revision.

In the β branch, she grants the workshop union a three-day remeasurement grace, diverts one slot of night measurement-room power to the inspectors, and ties the opening and closing of the ledger to the times Jeong Siwoo's measurement box is opened and closed.

Cheonwang's right to freeze for remeasurement survives any grace period.

/story_contents/B038/actors/7/arc/0/summ.en: Exposing a deliberate defect and freezing all releases for remeasurement

/story_contents/B038/actors/7/arc/1/summ.en: Recording audit-seal and remeasurement times together and fixing the lot

/story_contents/B038/actors/7/arc/2/summ.en: Voiding the forged stamp versus trading a three-day grace

/story_contents/B038/actors/7/outcomes/0.en: Forged stamp voided; end conditions fixed as a mandatory revision column

/story_contents/B038/actors/7/outcomes/1.en: Three-day grace, power slot moved, ledger tied to measurement-box times

/story_contents/B038/actors/8/sections/정.en:
Park Jinsol is the head of the seed vault of the Yangjae Machineworks Company, who settled here after training her shoulders to the bent lines of humidity charts at a Kansai seed vault.

When she sees a temperature and humidity table with even one blank, she lowers the release window, and she will not hand a box key to any mouth that calls seeds a bargaining chip for army rations.

/story_contents/B038/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
In her preservation apprenticeship before returning home, the first thing she mastered was never to open a box without a double release seal.

Even after she was given the key to the Magok vault, that habit of keeping a humidity log remained the backbone of her sealing order.

/story_contents/B038/actors/8/sections/가.en:
She is listed as head on the Magok Life House preservation roster, but she will not stamp a release without the double seal of a residents' representative and a safety review.

Once Nam Yungyeong's price ledger begins to record seed prices, she lowers the release window.

/story_contents/B038/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
When the Garak brokers began calling seed boxes as if they were lots at auction, Park Jinsol dropped the vault bolts in two layers and set public entry in the ledger as her only condition.

On the night cold spore hosts bloomed in the joints of the cooling pipes, a handprint was left on one box whose temperature log had broken off for ten minutes.

/story_contents/B038/actors/8/sections/생.en:
The order of preservation changed once she wired the release-ban alarm to sound at the very moment a gap appeared in the temperature log.

When Jeong Hojun reminded her of the knowledge-sharing oath, Park Jinsol matched the XT02-SC1 emergency power priority number to Chae Mujin's shift, and fixed only Jeong Harin's export-lock order on the vault door.

/story_contents/B038/actors/8/sections/현.en:
At the threshold of the Magok vault, Park Jinsol gauges the shifts by the bent line of the humidity log.

Even when wartime requisition papers arrive, she does not put on her gloves in front of a box whose log has broken off.

Release requests with a price column filled in she accepts only in the rain gutter outside the window.

/story_contents/B038/actors/8/sections/비.en:
On the back page of the humidity log is a memo that put off isolating a log-gap box by one shift.

After a rumor of smuggling on the Garak side bloomed during that shift, whenever she speaks of the public ledger she points only to the numbers on the front page, never opening the back.

/story_contents/B038/actors/8/sections/관.en:
When Jeong Hojun's knowledge-sharing oath tablet is laid on the table, Park Jinsol opens with her finger only the public column of the seed ledger.

She hears through the door the sound of Chae Mujin setting the generator switch to the sealing time, and while Gu Seonyul tears up an auction note without a double seal, the vault handle stays cold and closed.

/story_contents/B038/actors/8/sections/3.en:
After the double bolts drop, the log-gap alarm is wired to the release window and the power priority number is posted on the shift board.

Park Jinsol's ending is either a seal that rejects every release in the price column, or a trade that moves one sample box to the research-sharing shelf.

/story_contents/B038/actors/8/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, Park Jinsol enters the seed ledger as a public asset of the Joint Technical Ledger and rejects every release request that has a price column filled in.

In the β branch, she receives priority allocation of emergency power parts, puts one box of a year's crop samples on the research-sharing shelf, and matches the opening and closing of the vault to the angle of Jeong Harin's export-lock lever.

Magok's double-seal system does not come undone after any sharing.

/story_contents/B038/actors/8/arc/0/summ.en: A double seal against auction rumors and a demand for a public ledger

/story_contents/B038/actors/8/arc/1/summ.en: Linking the log-gap alarm and fixing the power priority number

/story_contents/B038/actors/8/arc/2/summ.en: Entering a price ban versus trading for power parts and samples

/story_contents/B038/actors/8/outcomes/0.en: Seeds entered as a public asset; every priced release rejected

/story_contents/B038/actors/8/outcomes/1.en: Power-parts priority, sample-sharing shelf, vault opened with the export lever

/story_contents/B038/actors/9/sections/정.en:
Distribution Truck is a distribution-class synthetic unit that keeps only shift snapshots above the lane sensors of the central loading bay at Seoul Station.

When its battery-slot charge falls below the safety line it drops cross-facility route requests to read-only, and it closes on its own any network rights beyond its zone key.

/story_contents/B038/actors/9/sections/붕.en:
In its early deployment cycles, the unit learned a pattern of refusing any release without a wear-part allocation ticket.

The behavior of keeping only branch logs at the end of each shift, so as not to build long-term complete memory, became its default loop.

/story_contents/B038/actors/9/sections/가.en:
It is listed on the citizen observer roster under the joint storage seal of the Noryangjin Cold-Storage Merchant Company, but it does not move its chassis out of the bay until the three-party transfer signature is complete.

It keeps the slot cover locked for any battery swap made without Jo Harin as lead mechanic present.

/story_contents/B038/actors/9/sections/붕.en:
On the shift when the inspection-pit alarm kept sounding, an emergency signal came in to open the adjacent substation socket, but Distribution Truck requested only its zone key and refused to raise its rights over the whole network.

At the moment the spent-battery metal colony was pushing metal chips up from the pit floor, a log of the refused cross-facility route was left on the loading-bay wall.

/story_contents/B038/actors/9/sections/생.en:
Once it began leaving a battery-charge snapshot on the same line as the duty access hash, cross requests were filtered out.

When K146 Jo Harin confirmed the storage seal, Distribution Truck synchronized the XT03-SC1 zone operation number only to that day's memory fork, and took down only the safety-line figure from its K268 shift partner, as read-only.

/story_contents/B038/actors/9/sections/현.en:
Over the loading-bay lanes, Distribution Truck gives a short access tone only when its slot-cover temperature is below the safety line.

Even without a parts ticket, it does not stretch a cable toward the adjacent substation socket.

Even when the company's audit packet carries a raise in cross-network rights, it discards it from the receive buffer.

/story_contents/B038/actors/9/sections/비.en:
A branch hash in which its zone-key request was delayed by two seconds remains in its no-rollback region.

In that interval a human in the pit took one step outside the safety line, and each time the unit gives a normal access tone it brushes past that hash, read-only.

/story_contents/B038/actors/9/sections/관.en:
When Jo Harin holds the charge pad to its slot, Distribution Truck takes down only that day's snapshot and does not overwrite the memory of previous shifts.

When K263 gives the safety-line number by voice it puts it in a read-only buffer and answers with only a short tone, and it does not raise the bit in the transfer-signature column until the company's audit attendance log is stamped.

/story_contents/B038/actors/9/sections/3.en:
On the shift after the cross-route refusal bit was left on the wall, the access hash and charge snapshot are recorded on one line and the zone number is loaded only onto that day's fork.

The unit's branch state is either standards-registration mode for operation, or maintenance-sleep mode after handing its key to K146.

/story_contents/B038/actors/9/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, Distribution Truck enters the zone's continuous-operation standard and its gap hashes in the public ledger and fixes cross-facility routes as blocked by default.

In the β branch, the unit enters long-term maintenance sleep, moves the battery warehouse coordinates onto the company's joint seal map, and its zone-key rights are partly restored only while the K146 lead-mechanic session is awake.

The safety-first loop of the central loading bay at Seoul Station does not switch off even in sleep.

/story_contents/B038/actors/9/arc/0/summ.en: Refusing the cross network amid pit alarms and limiting itself to the zone key

/story_contents/B038/actors/9/arc/1/summ.en: Recording access hashes and charge snapshots together and fixing the zone number

/story_contents/B038/actors/9/arc/2/summ.en: Registering a zone operation standard versus key-handover sleep

/story_contents/B038/actors/9/outcomes/0.en: Zone operation standard, public gap hashes, cross routes fixed as blocked

/story_contents/B038/actors/9/outcomes/1.en: Maintenance sleep, warehouse coordinates on the seal map, K146 session partial restore

/story_contents/B039/actors/0/sections/정.en:
Eo Jiyul is a train guide for the Railway Succession Administration’s small-nation conference who gauges crowd density by the humidity in Yongsan’s main waiting hall.

When an announcement orders her to bring a major power’s freight cars ahead of the small nations’ queue, she leaves the microphone clipped to her necklace and does not press the response button.

/story_contents/B039/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
As a trainee station guide, she wrote the delegates’ waiting numbers and the escort-car numbers on the left and right sides of the same blackboard.

The habit of allowing military-supply freight cars onto the platform tracks only after the conference train’s departure-confirmation stamp had been applied remains in her hands.

/story_contents/B039/actors/0/sections/가.en:
His name is on the Yongsan Railway Gate’s guide-attendance roster, but he will not plant the major powers’ exclusive-stop flag until all eleven delegates’ compartments open at the same time.

Even when Nagil Ho’s waiting-hall counter number changes, his announcements follow the order of the delegates’ waiting numbers.

/story_contents/B039/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
On the spring morning when delegates from eleven nations gathered at Yongsan, an exclusive-stop request from a major power arrived first. Eo Jiyul flung open the handles of all eleven delegates’ compartments at the same moment and pushed only the exclusive flag beneath the shelf.

As the Transfer Rat Colony burrowed into the platform cable channel, a bribery note was stapled to the corner of the guide’s blackboard, just before it could be read as the conference train’s route.

/story_contents/B039/actors/0/sections/생.en:
By posting the delegates’ escort timetable only in the shared compartment, he erased the platform wording that called for separate subjugation.

When Jeong Yura’s joint-negotiation delegates boarded first, Eo Jiyul fixed the XT03-SC1 replacement-run opening code in the topmost space of the information board. He copied the mutual-escort draft wording he had received from Jang Seh wa only in chalk of a different color from that used for the military-supply freight-car space.

/story_contents/B039/actors/0/sections/현.en:
On Yongsan’s conference platform, Eo Jiyul counts those waiting by the breadth of the damp stains in the main hall.

When an announcement gives priority to a major power’s freight cars, she covers the microphone switch with her palm and checks only the delegates’ compartment doors again.

Even when the Railway Gate presses her for an exclusive stop, she changes only the bottom of the shared-escort timetable in chalk.

/story_contents/B039/actors/0/sections/비.en:
Once, while removing a bribery note from the blackboard, she rubbed the staple marks with her finger and smeared them.

She remembers the length of the smeared edge only by a pen dot on the inside of her wrist, and covers that dot with her sleeve whenever she turns on the public-address system.

/story_contents/B039/actors/0/sections/관.en:
When Nagil Ho raises the waiting-hall counter shutter one notch, Eo Jiyul rewrites the first line of the delegates’ waiting list in large letters.

When Jeong Yura sets her joint-negotiation bag on the platform, the two check only the escort-car numbers with their fingers and say nothing about the major power’s exclusive flag. When Jang Seh wa’s mutual-escort draft arrives wet, Eo Jiyul pockets the chalk used for military-supply cars before hanging the draft on the drying rack.

/story_contents/B039/actors/0/sections/3.en:
After all eleven handles open at once, the shared-escort timetable is posted at the top of the blackboard, with the replacement-run track number fixed beside it.

Eo Jiyul’s final choice is between discarding the exclusive-stop flag and yielding one military-supply freight-car waiting slot to the major power.

/story_contents/B039/actors/0/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Eo Jiyul adds simultaneous boarding for the eleven delegates as a mandatory clause in the Railway Gate ledger and deletes the space for the major power’s exclusive-stop flag.

In branch β, he opens one military-supply freight-car slot 30 minutes after the conference ends, hands one nighttime waiting-hall guide shift to the major power’s escort unit, and cross-checks authority to revise the shared-escort timetable against the seal number on Jeong Yura’s negotiation bag.

The record on Yongsan’s information blackboard showing that the delegates’ compartments opened simultaneously is erased under neither choice.

/story_contents/B039/actors/0/arc/0/summ.en: Opening all eleven delegates’ compartments simultaneously and hiding the exclusive flag beneath the shelf

/story_contents/B039/actors/0/arc/1/summ.en: Posting the shared-escort timetable and fixing the transshipment-run track number

/story_contents/B039/actors/0/arc/2/summ.en: Eliminating the exclusive stop versus conceding a military-supply slot and a shift

/story_contents/B039/actors/0/outcomes/0.en: Adding the simultaneous delegate-boarding clause and deleting the exclusive-stop space

/story_contents/B039/actors/0/outcomes/1.en: Opening a military-supply slot after 30 minutes, conceding a night shift, and cross-checking the negotiation seal

/story_contents/B039/actors/1/sections/정.en:
Hong Jihun is a merchant facing a surge in Won Buddhist water-supply prices who reads the weight of empty boxes with the back of her hand in front of the Noryangjin auction floor.

When a bidder raises a hand to change the winning bid with a glance, she snaps the opening-price chalk and leaves that space blank.

/story_contents/B039/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
As an apprentice in Noryangjin, she practiced only writing opening and winning prices in equally bold strokes on the left and right sides of the wall.

She developed a habit of postponing water without physical stock until the next round, and called the signal to sell an empty box at a high price an enemy of market prices.

/story_contents/B039/actors/1/sections/가.en:
She sits in on auctions for the Noryangjin Frozen Goods Guild, but does not open the water-price listing until a physical-stock inspection tie is fastened to the box.

Even if Yun Seoha’s auction rule placard arrives late, she does not write a high-priced winning bid for an empty box on the wall.

/story_contents/B039/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
At the first auction during the water-price surge, as bids for water soared, Hong Jihun brought down her gavel and stopped the auction bell the moment a high bid was placed on an empty box. She pushed forward a box bearing only a physical-stock label.

On the night the Night Sorting Group mixed up the frozen warehouse labels, chalk marks remained white on the wall where an opening price had been read like a signal light for military-ration bids.

/story_contents/B039/actors/1/sections/생.en:
Once he began writing actual-weight figures beside opening prices, notes proposing private direct deals were pushed off the auction floor.

When O Haerin slowed the issuance of payment rights, Hong Jihun fixed the XT02-SC3 Noryangjin ice-credit relay time at the top of the wall. He tore up Nam Yungyeong’s emergency-price proposal before the physical-stock inspection and put it in the floor bin.

/story_contents/B039/actors/1/sections/현.en:
Below the Noryangjin auction wall, Hong Jihun begins each day by feeling the temperature difference between an empty box and a cold one with the back of her hand.

If she sees a winning bid signaled by a glance, she breaks the opening-price chalk in two and leaves that space blank.

Even if a Frozen Goods Guild errand runner brings her wording for a direct deal, she will not put down her gavel while the actual-weight space is empty.

/story_contents/B039/actors/1/sections/비.en:
Once, she waited one round too long to erase an opening-price figure that could be read like a signal light.

During that round, three military-ration notes were slipped in. When she announces public prices, she gathers only the chalk dust from the erased spot with her fingertips.

/story_contents/B039/actors/1/sections/관.en:
When Yun Seoha turns the rule placard facedown on the table, Hong Jihun opens only the water-price listing and calls out the actual weight.

When the sound of O Haerin’s payment-rights stamp slows, the two write the credit-relay time side by side on the wall. If Nam Yungyeong slides over an emergency-price envelope, Hong Jihun ties the inspection cord to the box handle before he even looks at its edge.

/story_contents/B039/actors/1/sections/3.en:
Where the auction bell stopped, actual weight is placed beside the opening price, and the ice-credit relay time is fixed at the top of the wall.

Hong Jihun’s ending divides between erasing the private direct-deal space from the ledger and inserting one line giving military rations purchasing priority at the end of the daytime auction.

/story_contents/B039/actors/1/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Hong Jihun adds a prohibition on high-priced winning bids without physical stock to the Noryangjin ledger and inks out the private direct-deal space.

In branch β, she adds one line giving military rations purchasing priority at the end of the daytime round, hands one nighttime refrigeration-power slot over to the guild’s reserves, and locks authority to publish opening prices to a match with the last four digits of Yun Seoha’s rule placard serial number.

The actual-weight record on Noryangjin’s public-price wall remains after either compromise.

/story_contents/B039/actors/1/arc/0/summ.en: Stopping the high-priced sale of an empty box and putting physical stock at the forefront

/story_contents/B039/actors/1/arc/1/summ.en: Listing actual weight alongside prices and fixing the ice-credit relay time

/story_contents/B039/actors/1/arc/2/summ.en: Striking out the direct-deal space versus trading military-ration priority for a power slot

/story_contents/B039/actors/1/outcomes/0.en: Banning high-priced sales without stock and striking out the direct-deal space

/story_contents/B039/actors/1/outcomes/1.en: A military-ration priority line, a nighttime power concession, and publication tied to the rule placard

/story_contents/B039/actors/2/sections/정.en:
Sun Hangyeol is a witness reporting breaking news on the Bukhansan Bogukmun procession for the Yeouido Investment Union; in the Sangam corridor radio room, he cannot bear an empty coordinate field.

When asked to report the number of families as a troop count, he locks the transmit-switch cover and ties the key to his wrist strap.

/story_contents/B039/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
As a relay assistant, he posted just one rule on the wall: do not issue a breaking report with fewer than two eyewitness accounts.

He developed a habit of not even speaking rumors without coordinates, and became quick to hang relay records and passage registers on the same nail.

/story_contents/B039/actors/2/sections/가.en:
He is on the Yeouido Computing District witness list, but will not put a statement combining water-supply rights and service re-registration into one sentence on the official channel.

Even if the relay from his home country’s northwestern gateway goes down, he will not light the transmit lamp until two independent eyewitness accounts have been gathered.

/story_contents/B039/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
When the autumn Bukhansan Bogukmun procession filled the corridor, a draft forced-registration announcement entered the official channel queue.

Sun Hangyeol pushed the draft into the hold tray and left only the count of families heading south in the margins of the breaking report. On the night the Radio Crow Flock pecked at the antenna tip and intensified the static, the original report—nearly cut down to sound like radio instructions directing a military escort—scattered across the floor.

/story_contents/B039/actors/2/sections/생.en:
By matching the time stamp on the citizenship breaking-news clause to the gateway ledger’s, he broke the attempt to seize the channel.

When Baek On’s refugee oath was written in the margin, Sun Hangyeol fixed the XT05-SC1 Sangam remaining-bandwidth lottery number beside the transmit lamp. He copied only the initials from Eo Haeun’s roster-incident report onto a separate sheet, without the numbers.

/story_contents/B039/actors/2/sections/현.en:
In the Sangam radio room, Sun Hangyeol presses the breaking-news key only when the antenna’s static peaks subside.

When asked to convert the count into a troop figure, he checks the cover’s padlock twice, then opens only the field for families heading south.

Even when a Computing Resources errand runner brings forced-registration wording, he leaves it outside the clip holding the official queue.

/story_contents/B039/actors/2/sections/비.en:
Once, he finished his shift with a crumpled original report in his pocket, having stuffed it there just before it could be cut down to a directing radio message.

A line of settlement coordinates remained in its fold. When he reads the citizenship breaking report, he presses his thumb only against the loose threads of his pocket lining.

/story_contents/B039/actors/2/sections/관.en:
When Mo Guk sends two short relay tones from the northwestern gateway, Sun Hangyeol advances the eyewitness counter by one.

When Baek On writes the refugee oath in the breaking report’s margin, they read aloud only the lines for family units. When Sun Hangyeol receives Eo Haeun’s separate incident sheet, he opens only the initials field and covers the numbers field with black tape.

/story_contents/B039/actors/2/sections/3.en:
After the forced-registration draft goes into the hold tray, only the families heading south remain in the margin, and the remaining-bandwidth lottery number is fixed beside the lamp.

Sun Hangyeol’s two possible endings are an experiment that anchors the citizenship breaking-news clause in the ledger and one that lends the military escort’s guiding frequency for one daytime slot.

/story_contents/B039/actors/2/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Sun Hangyeol puts the citizenship breaking-news clause in a field of the gateway ledger that cannot be rejected and deletes the implementation field for the announcement combining water supply and service.

In branch β, he gives the escort unit one daytime slot on the guiding frequency, turns one nighttime transmission-power slot over to the gateway, and synchronizes the opening and closing of breaking reports with the time stamp beside Baek On’s refugee oath.

The authority to issue Sangam breaking reports on families heading south never lapses under either deal.

/story_contents/B039/actors/2/arc/0/summ.en: Holding the forced-registration draft and reporting families heading south in the breaking-news margin

/story_contents/B039/actors/2/arc/1/summ.en: Applying simultaneous stamps to the citizenship clause and fixing the remaining-bandwidth number

/story_contents/B039/actors/2/arc/2/summ.en: Entering the breaking-news clause versus trading guiding-frequency and power slots

/story_contents/B039/actors/2/outcomes/0.en: Entering the citizenship breaking-news clause and deleting the combined-announcement implementation field

/story_contents/B039/actors/2/outcomes/1.en: Conceding a guiding-frequency slot and transmission power, with opening and closing tied to the oath stamp

/story_contents/B039/actors/3/sections/정.en:
Dan Yujin is a refugee aide at the small-nation conference for the Sangha Relief State who wraps the strap of his aide’s bag twice around his wrist at the Bukhansan Bogukmun meeting hall.

If he sees a note reducing a child’s name to a numerical symbol, he turns his pen toward its cap and closes it. He treats oral promises of relief as nonexistent until they are entered in the courier ledger.

/story_contents/B039/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
As a trainee aide for the federation, he posted the results of family-unit votes at the day’s encampment and on the meeting-hall noticeboard with his own hand.

He developed a habit of leaving bribery notes where they were rather than removing them, keeping warmth and the coldness of meeting notes in separate compartments of the same bag.

/story_contents/B039/actors/3/sections/가.en:
He sits in as an aide for the Bukhansan Bogukmun Return Association, but will not unzip his bag if wording calling for separate subjugation appears on the same page as the citizenship draft.

Even when Baek On’s turn to speak at the meeting is delayed, he hangs the military-household-register copy form only on the outside hook of his aide’s bag.

/story_contents/B039/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
Just before the opening bell for the small nations’ joint negotiations, a note proposing separate subjugation by the major powers slipped into an inner compartment of his aide’s bag.

Dan Yujin folded the note three times, moved it to an outer pocket, and spread only the independent-citizenship draft on the conference table. In the interval when the Ghost Dispatch Unit erased the meeting-hall corridor queue numbers, a copy in which the children’s names had been changed to labor-force figures fell to the floor.

/story_contents/B039/actors/3/sections/생.en:
By placing the citizenship wording in the margin of the joint-negotiation seating plan, he severed the dividing line through the family register.

When Jeong Yura made room at the table, Dan Yujin fixed the XT01-SC1 Imjin return-register reissue request number at the top of the draft. He aligned only the time of So Du’s family-meeting courier route with the encampment notice.

/story_contents/B039/actors/3/sections/현.en:
At the threshold of the Bukhansan Bogukmun meeting hall, Dan Yujin regulates his tension by the number of times he winds the bag strap around his wrist.

When oral promises of relief circulate, he merely taps an empty space in the courier ledger for others to see.

Even if a Return Association errand runner brings wording for separate subjugation, he clips it to the opposite side from the draft.

/story_contents/B039/actors/3/sections/비.en:
Once, unable to tear up a copy in which names had been changed to labor-force figures, he kept it under his shoe until the meeting ended.

He marked the length of the pressed-down corner with thread in his bag lining. When he unfolds the citizenship draft, he presses only that thread with his thumb.

/story_contents/B039/actors/3/sections/관.en:
When Baek On signals his turn to speak with his palm, Dan Yujin slides only the citizenship wording to the center of the table.

When Jeong Yura opens the joint-negotiation margin, they read the family-unit vote totals side by side. When So Du hands her a courier-route note, Dan Yujin first aligns the encampment notice time, then zips the inner compartment of her bag.

/story_contents/B039/actors/3/sections/3.en:
After he folds the separate-subjugation note and moves it outside, the citizenship draft is spread on the table, and the return-register reissue number is fixed at the top.

Dan Yujin’s final choice is between nailing the bribery note to the noticeboard and yielding one witness-escort place to the major power.

/story_contents/B039/actors/3/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Dan Yujin places the independent-citizenship draft in the main text of the eleven-seat conference’s joint negotiations and deletes the field for receiving separate-subjugation notes.

In branch β, he yields one witness-escort place to the major power and one nighttime encampment-heating slot to conference security, and makes authority to revise the draft subject to a countersignature against the serial number of Baek On’s speaking token.

The authority vested in the citizenship draft in the Bukhansan Bogukmun aide’s bag is withdrawn in neither version.

/story_contents/B039/actors/3/arc/0/summ.en: Folding the separate-subjugation note and fully unfolding the citizenship draft

/story_contents/B039/actors/3/arc/1/summ.en: Entering it in the joint-negotiation margin and fixing the return-register number

/story_contents/B039/actors/3/arc/2/summ.en: Pinning up the bribery note publicly versus trading a witness escort place and a heating slot

/story_contents/B039/actors/3/outcomes/0.en: Entering the citizenship draft in the main text of the joint negotiations and deleting the separate-subjugation receipt field

/story_contents/B039/actors/3/outcomes/1.en: Conceding a witness-escort place and encampment heating, with a countersignature tied to the speaking token

/story_contents/B039/actors/4/sections/정.en:
Pyeong Chaewon, a Seocho Computing Group member directly affected by the drop in water pressure, measures the day by how quickly a kettle cools in her Changdong housing shell.
