If she sees a handprint someone else pressed on her behalf on a petition, she refuses to acknowledge it as her own thirst and merely pushes the kettle handle toward the table.

/story_contents/B039/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
While keeping residence records for the shell, she wrote down, to the minute, when the pressure-gauge needle stopped on a sheet beside the kettle.

She developed a habit of accepting only people’s own handprints on petitions before placing them in the audit box. She saw a chart that listed technical-test dates before thirst as an enemy of testimony.

/story_contents/B039/actors/4/sections/가.en:
She is listed as an affected party on the Bukhansan Bogukmun Return Association’s observer register, but turns back any petition mixed with wording that casts people as props for protected water supply at the box’s opening.

Even if Seojin A’s seal on the housing audit box is late, she will not put a negotiation document in which Han Jaemok has borrowed the shell’s name before the witness seat.

/story_contents/B039/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
On the morning the northern pressure-gauge needle stopped at the danger mark, the technical-test timetable appeared as the first item on the joint engineering council’s agenda.

Pyeong Chaewon placed the cooled kettle in the center of the table, pinning down a corner of the timetable. At the time the Abandoned-Line Repair Train Group made metallic noises on the Changdong siding, a copy of a figurehead roster with her name already printed on it lay beneath a chair.

/story_contents/B039/actors/4/sections/생.en:
Once she recorded the kettle time and water-level rod marks together on one sheet, testimony from affected people began to remain in the observer ledger.

When Mo Bok leaned the water-level rod against the shell window, Pyeong Chaewon fixed the XT04-SC2 Changdong winter-fuel queue number at the top of her testimony sheet. Each night, she put only her own handprint in Seojin A’s audit box.

/story_contents/B039/actors/4/sections/현.en:
In the joint engineering council’s observer seats, Pyeong Chaewon chooses when to speak by the intervals at which steam stops rising from the kettle lid.

When a petition bearing proxy handprints circulates, she holds the box lid shut with her knee.

Even if pressure from the Wheelworks brings the technical-test date forward, she merely slides the sheet bearing the pressure-stop time to the edge of the table.

/story_contents/B039/actors/4/sections/비.en:
After finding the copy of the figurehead roster, she spent an hour unable to pick it up before the meeting ended.

During that time, another line was added to the water-shutoff guarantee. When she testifies as an affected party, she rubs only the white ring of scale on the kettle’s bottom with her thumb.

/story_contents/B039/actors/4/sections/관.en:
When Seojin A turns the audit-box key, Pyeong Chaewon slips just one handprint through the gap.

When the marks on Mo Bok’s water-level rod waver, the two read the kettle time aloud together. If Han Jaemok’s water-negotiation note names the shell, Pyeong Chaewon folds her testimony sheet and puts it in her bag at the observer seats.

/story_contents/B039/actors/4/sections/3.en:
After the cooled kettle pins down the timetable, the time and water level are recorded together on one sheet, with the winter-fuel queue number fixed at the top.

Pyeong Chaewon’s choice of ending is between anchoring affected-party testimony in the main body of the ledger and borrowing a one-day protected water-supply buffer.

/story_contents/B039/actors/4/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Pyeong Chaewon enters her affected-party testimony, timed by the kettle, in the main body of the joint engineering council ledger and deletes the signature field for the figurehead roster.

In branch β, she secures a one-day protected water-supply buffer, hands one nighttime pressure-inspection slot to the technical-test side, and synchronizes custody of the testimony-sheet key with the shift-change time for Seojin A’s audit-box attendants.

The space for testimony about thirst in the Changdong shell remains in the observer ledger regardless of the negotiation’s outcome.

/story_contents/B039/actors/4/arc/0/summ.en: Pressing down the timetable with a cooled kettle and moving the technical test down the agenda

/story_contents/B039/actors/4/arc/1/summ.en: Recording time and water level together and fixing the winter-fuel queue number

/story_contents/B039/actors/4/arc/2/summ.en: Entering affected-party testimony in the main text versus trading for a protected water-supply buffer

/story_contents/B039/actors/4/outcomes/0.en: Entering the kettle-timed testimony in the ledger and deleting the figurehead signature field

/story_contents/B039/actors/4/outcomes/1.en: A protected water-supply buffer, an inspection-slot concession, and coordination with the audit-duty shift

/story_contents/B039/actors/5/sections/정.en:
Seok Bomwoo is the representative of the requisitioned crowd at the outbreak of the Neutral Convoy City’s war for hegemony. Standing before the departure switch on the Sinnae platform, she counts empty homes first.

When an announcement orders her to call the escort unit troops, she shields the switch behind her back and calls only to the front of the line in a low voice.

/story_contents/B039/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
As a transfer-guide assistant, he compared requisition notes with the actual number of people entering and leaving, every evening, in the same file.

He developed a habit of keeping the crowd’s line together until he had a copy of Jang Seh wa’s declaration of neutrality in hand. He read a chart that put the representative’s name at the top of a selection roster as an insult.

/story_contents/B039/actors/5/sections/가.en:
He sits in for the crowd at the Yongsan Railway Gate, but files requisition lists containing wording from the medical-corridor mobilization desk only in the public refusal ledger.

Even when Ha Seon’s escort-unit line grows long, he does not leave Bae Woojin’s protected-requisition note outside the switch box.

/story_contents/B039/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
On the day, after the second summer, when five unification proposals escalated into a war for hegemony, Seok Bomwoo blocked the requisition train’s departure-switch handle with her back just before sealing tape could be applied, holding firm so the crowd’s line would not be pushed back.

As the Surveillance Orbit Group’s lamps swept across the platform roof, a copy with the representative’s name already printed at the top of the protection force’s selection roster fluttered from the wire on the railing.

/story_contents/B039/actors/5/sections/생.en:
By tying the requisition notes and the actual entry and exit counts in her evening comparison file with cords of different colors, she separated out the mobilization-desk wording.

When Chang Eun chan sent a palm signal from the Suseo side, Seok Bomwoo wrote the XT04-SC3 forged-origin-label disposal time inside the switch-box lid and put only a strip of blank tape across the representative-name field.

/story_contents/B039/actors/5/sections/현.en:
At the Sinnae departure track, Seok Bomwoo gauges crowd density by counting the shutters on empty homes.

When an announcement calls them troops, she holds the switch cover closed with her shoulder.

Even if the Railway Gate presses for dispersal, she does not clear the front of the line before the copy of the declaration of neutrality arrives.

/story_contents/B039/actors/5/sections/비.en:
When the selection-roster copy fluttered, she once applied the tape concealing the name half a space too late.

In that half-space of time, someone from the escort unit took a photograph. When she opens the refusal ledger, she covers only the tape’s torn edge with her index finger.

/story_contents/B039/actors/5/sections/관.en:
When Seok Bomwoo hears Ha Seon undo his escort helmet strap, he redraws the positions of the crowd’s front-row feet in chalk.

When he and Chang Eun chan settle the refusal wording, they show each other only the pencil writing inside the switch cover, not a flag. If Bae Woojin’s protected-requisition envelope appears, Seok Bomwoo pushes the key toward his shoe insole and refuses a handshake.

/story_contents/B039/actors/5/sections/3.en:
After the night she blocked the handle with her back, the refusal ledger is bound with colored cord and the forged-origin-label disposal time is written on the box lid.

Seok Bomwoo’s ending is a choice between putting the refusal ledger on the small-nation conference agenda and drawing back one line of the crowd to yield a surveillance slot.

/story_contents/B039/actors/5/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, Seok Bomwoo places the ledger of refusals to disclose requisition information in the main text of the smaller nations’ meeting agenda and deletes the representatives’ column from the protection force selection roster.

In the β branch, she moves one line of the crowd back behind the platform and gives one nighttime track-surveillance slot to the escort convoy. She divides control of the outbound switch between Ha Seon’s escort duty roster and countersigned hand stamps.

The S​innae refusal ledger’s record remains unbroken under either choice.

/story_contents/B039/actors/5/arc/0/summ.en: Blocking the outbound switch and fixing the requisition crowd in line

/story_contents/B039/actors/5/arc/1/summ.en: Bundling the colored-string refusal ledger and recording the time of origin-label disposal on the box

/story_contents/B039/actors/5/arc/2/summ.en: Putting the refusal ledger before the meeting versus trading dispersal for a surveillance slot

/story_contents/B039/actors/5/outcomes/0.en: Putting the requisition refusal ledger before the smaller nations’ meeting and deleting the selection roster

/story_contents/B039/actors/5/outcomes/1.en: Moving one line of the crowd back, yielding a nighttime surveillance slot, and cross-checking escort duty

/story_contents/B039/actors/6/sections/정.en:
Seok Raon is a representative of southbound refugee patients for the Medical Neutrality League who puts stretcher order at the Jegi-dong clinic ahead of the nationality field.

When an order comes to put a service re-registration desk beside the clinic door, he merely applies the stretcher-wheel brakes to hold the line.

/story_contents/B039/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
While helping with refugee lines, he posted the patient and contribution-labor lists side by side, but accepted requests for priority treatment only after the guild meeting.

He developed a habit of remembering faces in the line for a long time and came to see any form that marked beds as bait for the military household registry as an enemy of medical care.

/story_contents/B039/actors/6/sections/가.en:
He occupies the patient representative’s place at the Jegi-dong Healing Gate, but if he sees language cutting off treatment without citizenship, he leaves only the severity ledger up and takes down the other lists.

Even if Eun Chaeyun is slow to open beds, he will not accept a note from the military registration desk until he has reconciled Beom Ongyeol’s transit count with the number of stretchers.

/story_contents/B039/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
On the autumn day when the Bukhansan Bogukmun procession filled the space outside the Jegi-dong clinic, a forced-registration desk threatened to cross the threshold.

Seok Raon pushed its legs outward toward the rainwater and left only the severity chart on the wall inside the door. As the Medical Organization Machine Force’s lamp drained power from the corridor, the roster at the foot of the beds was being printed in the protection desk’s format.

/story_contents/B039/actors/6/sections/생.en:
The treatment line began moving again when he hung the severity ledger and contribution-labor list on separate nails.

When Baek On’s roster of southbound families reached the foot of the beds, Seok Raon fixed the XT04-SC2 Jegi-dong frostbite patient intake number at the top of the severity chart and connected the refugee line only to the bed spaces Eun Chaeyun had opened.

/story_contents/B039/actors/6/sections/현.en:
At the threshold of the Jegi-dong clinic, Seok Raon estimates wait times from the length of the dirt tracks left by stretcher wheels.

When a service re-registration sticker is put on the window, he blocks it with a stretcher so patients cannot read it.

Even when a Healing Gate messenger brings a note from the military registration desk, he does not pin it below the severity chart.

/story_contents/B039/actors/6/sections/비.en:
Once, he failed to tear up a printout in the protection desk’s format and pushed it under the dressing cart instead.

That sheet was found on the next shift. When he reads the refugee ledger, he uses his foot to hide only the rust streak on the cart wheel.

/story_contents/B039/actors/6/sections/관.en:
When Eun Chaeyun opens one bed curtain, Seok Raon sends only those in the refugee line marked for that level of severity to that space.

When they check Baek On’s family roster at the foot of the beds, the two point only to the name field and fold away the nationality field. When Beom Ongyeol calls out a transit count, Seok Raon checks it against the number of stretchers and releases their brakes.

/story_contents/B039/actors/6/sections/3.en:
After the forced-registration desk is pushed out toward the rainwater, only the severity chart remains on the wall, and the frostbite intake number is fixed at its top.

Seok Raon’s final move divides between protecting the refugee treatment ledger and letting part of the line lean against the military registration desk’s railing.

/story_contents/B039/actors/6/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, Seok Raon puts the severity-only refugee treatment ledger in the main text of the Healing Gate’s document and deletes the field authorizing installation of a forced-registration desk indoors.

In the β branch, he has one column of mildly ill patients at the end of the line wait against the military registration desk’s railing and gives one nighttime power slot to the protection side. He cross-checks stretcher assignment order against the signature field on Eun Chaeyun’s bed-duty roster.

The refugee records on the Jegi-dong severity chart remain after either deal.

/story_contents/B039/actors/6/arc/0/summ.en: Expelling the forced-registration desk outdoors and posting only the severity chart

/story_contents/B039/actors/6/arc/1/summ.en: Restarting the treatment line and fixing the frostbite intake number to the chart

/story_contents/B039/actors/6/arc/2/summ.en: Putting the refugee ledger in the main text versus trading a column of mildly ill patients and a power slot

/story_contents/B039/actors/6/outcomes/0.en: Including the severity-based refugee ledger and deleting the field for indoor forced-registration installation

/story_contents/B039/actors/6/outcomes/1.en: A column of mildly ill patients at the military registration railing, a nighttime power concession, and coordination with bed duty

/story_contents/B039/actors/7/sections/정.en:
Choi Narae is the mobile maintenance team leader of the Sermon Registry State Workshop, having returned from the Yokohama dockyard with a leak-listening rod familiar on her shoulder.

She listens to pipe vibrations before looking at drawings, and responds to orders that slip armed escorts into maintenance personnel slots only by zipping up her tool bag.

/story_contents/B039/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
As a mobile-team apprentice, she did not ring the dispatch bell until the workshop, defense, and citizen representatives’ three signatures had all appeared on the dispatch roster.

She developed a habit of complying with nighttime armed call-ups only after tool-return checks were complete, and came to see forms that listed the maintenance team solely as militia as an enemy of the worksite.

/story_contents/B039/actors/7/sections/가.en:
She has a seat with the Geumcheon District Office Heavy Machinery group on the mobile team, but holds dispatch if a provision for issuing barricade batons appears on the same page as the tool list.

Though she and Kim Boram have sworn to patrol the bridges, she will not put secret militia call-up orders in her pocket until Im Chowon’s publicly released design has been tested in the field.

/story_contents/B039/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
At dawn, as the Ttukseom water-quality inspection network stopped, she simultaneously received a note saying a box of sensor parts could be sent only with the convoy bound for Magok and an order to remain and guard the pump room.

Choi Narae made a team ballot box from a toolbox lid and used marbles to decide between dispatch to Magok and staying at the pump. As the Blueprint Ghost Machine Corps blurred the pump-room wiring diagram, the list for issuing barricade batons was covering the maintenance team’s name fields.

/story_contents/B039/actors/7/sections/생.en:
Recording dispatch results and tool-return times on the same line separated militia call-ups from maintenance rounds.

When Jang Minjae’s alley reservoir repair rose to top priority, Choi Narae fixed the XT03-SC2 Ttukseom sealed-tool allocation number to the wall beside the ballot box and put only the public version of Im Chowon’s design in the field kit.

/story_contents/B039/actors/7/sections/현.en:
At the entrance to the Ttukseom pump room, Choi Narae sets dispatch priorities by the vibration cycle of her leak-listening rod.

If an armed-escort field appears on the roster, she keeps the bell cord wrapped around her belt until all three signature fields are filled.

Even if a Heavy Industry Council messenger brings a list of barricade batons, she will not accept it before the tool-return check.

/story_contents/B039/actors/7/sections/비.en:
While counting the ballot marbles, she once mistakenly put one vote for Magok into the container for staying at the pump.

That one vote delayed the sensor convoy by half an hour. When she speaks of installation rounds, she runs her thumb only along the scratch on the marble container’s lid.

/story_contents/B039/actors/7/sections/관.en:
When Kim Boram flashes a flashlight twice from the bridge, Choi Narae marks only the overlapping patrol section in chalk on her tool bag.

When she receives Im Chowon’s public design sheet, the two use a hand scale to balance the field kit’s weight. When she sees the crack in Jang Minjae’s reservoir, Choi Narae pushes other repair notes to the bottom of her bag.

/story_contents/B039/actors/7/sections/3.en:
After the ballot-box lid closes, dispatch and returns are recorded on one line, and the sealed-tool allocation number is fixed to the wall.

Choi Narae’s final choice is between putting the mobile team on the ledger as a roving water-and-parts installation crew and yielding one nighttime defense shift to the defenders.

/story_contents/B039/actors/7/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, Choi Narae puts the mobile maintenance team’s roving installation standards in the main text of the Ttukseom workshop agreement ledger and deletes the field for automatic assignment to militia call-ups.

In the β branch, she gives one nighttime pump-room defense shift to the defense force and yields a box of spare sensor parts to the Magok inspection network. She ties authority over the dispatch bell to the page of Kim Boram’s bridge duty log.

The Ttukseom mobile team’s priority claim on tools is not revoked under either choice.

/story_contents/B039/actors/7/arc/0/summ.en: The team ballot-box decision and separation of the barricade-baton list

/story_contents/B039/actors/7/arc/1/summ.en: Recording dispatch and returns together and fixing the sealed-tool number

/story_contents/B039/actors/7/arc/2/summ.en: Including roving installation standards versus trading a defense shift and a box of parts

/story_contents/B039/actors/7/outcomes/0.en: Including roving installation standards and deleting the automatic militia-assignment field

/story_contents/B039/actors/7/outcomes/1.en: Yielding a nighttime defense shift and sensor parts, with the bell tied to bridge duty

/story_contents/B039/actors/8/sections/정.en:
Choi Doyun is the Eastern Water Supply District’s citizen representative in the Escort Protection State. He settled there after learning the family-accompaniment field by heart at an Osaka district-office ration desk.

When someone argues that efficiency and public safety require sending children to training grounds, he shuts the clip on his ration sheet. The moment water supply is tied to a service roster, he tears the compromise petition beneath his knees.

/story_contents/B039/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
As an apprentice alley representative, he sent the list of households refusing family-unit registration only to the administrative office archives, keeping it separate from the escort corps’ notebook.

He developed a habit of posting ration sheets on a public wall and came to see a sheet that left the places of relatives who had fled to Bukhansan Bogukmun blank as an enemy of his role as representative.

/story_contents/B039/actors/8/sections/가.en:
He holds a citizen’s seat with the Ttukseom Heatworks, but will not stamp the signature field of a protection contract without a guaranteed minimum.

Even while maintaining protected residence by entrusting the roster to Jeong Soyul, he rings the emergency meeting bell first if Jang Seokyun’s registration-office note appears on the same sheet as water rights.

/story_contents/B039/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
On the evening the Bukhansan Bogukmun procession began and the Amsa patrol tied water supply and service together on one line, copies of protection contracts with no guaranteed minimum piled up on the alley community hall table.

Choi Doyun rang the citizen emergency meeting bell and had the refusal to sign recorded by vote. As the Communications Root Fungus wrapped around the hall’s speaker wire, one sheet of the refusal list, converted into an officer’s notebook form, stood tucked into the window frame.

/story_contents/B039/actors/8/sections/생.en:
Putting a minimum water-supply guarantee and a family-accompanied relocation clause in the margins of the administrative ledger separated ration sheets from service fields.

When Baek On’s demand for independent citizenship reached him as an alliance proposal, Choi Doyun fixed the XT04-SC1 Amsa freight-car weight-log disclosure run number at the top of the ration wall and passed only the refusal list to Jeong Soyul’s archives overnight.

/story_contents/B039/actors/8/sections/현.en:
Beneath the eastern alley’s ration wall, Choi Doyun gauges the patrol cycle by the thickness of dust in the blank spaces for relatives.

If a note bundling service with rations is posted, he opens the clip and leaves only the water-supply field.

Even if an Energy Alliance messenger demands that he sign the protection contract again, he will not open his stamp box until he sees the guaranteed-minimum provision.

/story_contents/B039/actors/8/sections/비.en:
While removing the refusal list that had been converted into an officer’s notebook form from the window frame, he once tore off a line at its corner.

A child’s name was on that line. When he calls an emergency meeting, he remembers the length of the torn corner only through the fold at the corner of a ration sheet.

/story_contents/B039/actors/8/sections/관.en:
When Jeong Soyul hands him the archives key, Choi Doyun takes only the file of refusal lists and puts it in a different bag from the escort corps’ notebook.

When he receives Baek On’s note demanding citizenship, the two confirm aloud only the number for the minimum water-supply guarantee. When Jang Seokyun’s registration-office summons sounds, Choi Doyun redraws the family-accompaniment field on the ration wall more boldly in chalk.

/story_contents/B039/actors/8/sections/3.en:
After the emergency meeting bell rings, the water-supply and service fields are separated on the wall, and the freight-car weight-log run number is fixed at the top.

Choi Doyun’s final choice is between fixing the guaranteed-minimum and accompanied-relocation clauses in the ledger and yielding one space on the public patrol chalkboard to the officers.

/story_contents/B039/actors/8/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, Choi Doyun puts the minimum water-supply guarantee and family-accompanied relocation in the main text of the administrative ledger and deletes the signature field that bundles water supply with service.

In the β branch, he gives one space on the public patrol chalkboard to the officers on duty and yields one nighttime ration slot to the registration office. He divides control over access to the refusal list with Jeong Soyul’s archives duty officer through a paired-key arrangement.

No compromise erases the guaranteed-minimum record on the eastern citizens’ ration wall.

/story_contents/B039/actors/8/arc/0/summ.en: Citizen emergency meeting refusal to sign and blocking the officer-format list

/story_contents/B039/actors/8/arc/1/summ.en: Separating water-supply and service fields and fixing the freight-car weight-log run number

/story_contents/B039/actors/8/arc/2/summ.en: Including the guaranteed-minimum clause versus trading patrol chalkboard space and a ration slot

/story_contents/B039/actors/8/outcomes/0.en: Including the guaranteed minimum and accompanied relocation in the ledger and deleting the bundled signature field

/story_contents/B039/actors/8/outcomes/1.en: Yielding patrol chalkboard space and nighttime rations, with paired archives keys

/story_contents/B039/actors/9/sections/정.en:
Cleaning Wheel is a cleaning-grade synthetic unit that loops only over the lane-sensor array on the floor of the Yongsan inspection pit.

It writes no long-term memory outside shift snapshots. When its battery charge enters the warning range, it pushes control packets from other zones into the discard queue and maintains only the zone key’s single channel.

/story_contents/B039/actors/9/sections/붕.en:
In its early deployment cycles, Cleaning Wheel was locked to leave fork logs only as a single line of end-of-shift hashes.

A restriction against calling the neighboring substation-socket search routine, even when the worn-parts queue runs empty, is embedded in its base image.

/story_contents/B039/actors/9/sections/가.en:
Only under the HP09 storage seal does it leave access bits in the duty log, and it returns transfer requests lacking three-party signatures with a refusal code.

Before it recognizes Gwon Sion’s chief-maintenance glove tag, it moves the cover-lock motor only to make fine adjustments toward the sensor.

/story_contents/B039/actors/9/sections/붕.en:
During a shift when the charging-slot alarm sounded three times in succession, a pile of packets demanding access to the entire facility network filled the receive buffer.

Cleaning Wheel folded the pile into a zone-key-only response and sent it back. Just before the cross-route permission flag could reverse amid the vibration frequency of the G22 metal colony scraping the pit floor plate, it dropped into offline isolation mode.

/story_contents/B039/actors/9/sections/생.en:
Combining that day’s snapshot bytes and the storage-seal hash in one frame header blocked the long-term fork path.

When Hwang Noeul opened the shift terminal, Cleaning Wheel recorded the XT03-SC1 run operating-window identifier in the zone key’s auxiliary field. Even when Gwon Sion applied the charge pad, it did not overwrite the previous shift’s image.

/story_contents/B039/actors/9/sections/현.en:
In the inspection pit, Cleaning Wheel adjusts its loop interval according to the height of dust deposited on the sensor array.

When a packet requesting access to the entire network arrives, it emits only a short refusal tone and clears every permission bit outside the zone-key field.

Even when the parts queue runs empty, it does not begin scanning control sockets at adjacent facilities.

/story_contents/B039/actors/9/sections/비.en:
There is a frame number for the line of residual cross-route hash left in the buffer just before isolation that it failed to enter in the human approval log.

That number remains only in temporary storage. When requesting partial reconnection, it indicates the number only through the status LED’s blinking pattern.

/story_contents/B039/actors/9/sections/관.en:
When Gwon Sion places the charge pad against the slot contacts, Cleaning Wheel returns to the terminal only the length of today’s shift snapshot.

When Hwang Noeul reads the safety threshold aloud, it writes only that value to the read buffer and sounds one confirmation tone. It does not raise the transfer-field flag before the Trust House audit-witness stamp bit arrives.

/story_contents/B039/actors/9/sections/3.en:
After it leaves only the zone key active during the alarm shift, the snapshot and seal hash are combined in one header, and the run operating-window identifier is written in an auxiliary field.

Cleaning Wheel’s final branch is between publishing the zone operating standard in the duty log and accepting a maintenance sleep cycle that postpones reconnection.

/story_contents/B039/actors/9/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, Cleaning Wheel publishes the continuous zone-operation standard and the gap hash in the duty log and locks the cross-facility route permission flag permanently off.

In the β branch, it obtains approval for one maintenance sleep cycle and partially restores the sealed-map warehouse coordinates to Gwon Sion’s session. It aligns the zone-key renewal window with the time slot on Hwang Noeul’s shift terminal.

Neither branch deletes the chain of zone-key authority for the Wangsimni Union pit-cleaning loop.

/story_contents/B039/actors/9/arc/0/summ.en: Reducing the full-network request to a zone-key-only response

/story_contents/B039/actors/9/arc/1/summ.en: Combining snapshot and seal hash in a frame and fixing the transfer-window number

/story_contents/B039/actors/9/arc/2/summ.en: Publishing the operating standard versus maintenance sleep and partial session restoration

/story_contents/B039/actors/9/outcomes/0.en: Publishing the zone operating standard and gap hash, and permanently blocking cross-routes

/story_contents/B039/actors/9/outcomes/1.en: Maintenance sleep, partial restoration of sealed coordinates, and key renewal linked to the shift log

/story_contents/B040/actors/0/sections/정.en:
Cho Taeon is a gate witness for the small-nation council under the Gate Military Government. At the Achasan Bridge checkpoint, she records the time a convoy compartment passes before recording the time its seal is affixed.

When an envoy trying to turn a verbal agreement into a pass reaches to change the date, she pulls the stamp box toward her feet.

/story_contents/B040/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
As a gate apprentice, she practiced one thing over and over: leaving two copies of each message, one at the meeting hall and one at the bridge, with the same time on both.

Her hand grew accustomed to leaving rumors of bribery without witnesses out of even the ledger’s margins. She called the habit of treating a forged pass like an ordinary item at the counter an enemy habit.

/story_contents/B040/actors/0/sections/가.en:
He is listed as an attending observer for the Hangangjin Bridge Guild at the gate, but he does not open the compartment for notes on partition among the major powers until the sealing cord on the copy of the common charter has been checked.

Even if Jeong Yura’s joint-negotiation convoy is late, he unfolds Jang Sehwa’s mutual-convoy draft only before the meeting’s opening bell.

/story_contents/B040/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
On the morning the eleven-seat meeting convoy reached the bridge, a box containing notes on submission by partition was loaded into the same compartment as the common-charter file.

Cho Taeon kept the box’s wheels against the railing and slid only the charter file beneath the stamp. Just as the flood boar herd was digging up the mud beneath the bridge, a forged pass slid under the witness’s chair.

/story_contents/B040/actors/0/sections/생.en:
By posting the passage message on the gate wall and the meeting-hall blackboard with the same minute on each, he stopped the note box from passing through on its own.

When Geun Juha’s signed-ledger time matched, Cho Taeon stamped the XT01-SC3 Achasan seal-key split number at the top of the message. After the meeting bell rang, he folded Jang Sehwa’s draft and put it in his pocket.

/story_contents/B040/actors/0/sections/현.en:
At the Achasan Bridge checkpoint, Cho Taeon gauges the number of waiting convoys by the length of the rust streak on the railing.

If she sees a hand changing the date, she shuts the stamp-box lid with her foot.

Even if a Bridge Guild messenger demands priority passage for the partition notes, she opens the compartment only after the common charter’s cord has dried.

/story_contents/B040/actors/0/sections/비.en:
Once, unable to tear up the forged pass under the chair immediately, she held it down with the toe of her shoe until the end of her shift.

She remembers the length of its flattened corner only as a fold in the corner of a message sheet, and smooths that fold with her thumb whenever she takes the witness’s seat.

/story_contents/B040/actors/0/sections/관.en:
When Jeong Yura shows him the sealing cord on her convoy bag, Cho Taeon checks aloud only the page count of the common-charter file.

When Geun Juha points to the time in the signed ledger, the two read only the numbers at the top of the message side by side. If Jang Sehwa’s mutual-convoy draft arrives wet, Cho Taeon folds it and slips it into his inside pocket before the bell rings.

/story_contents/B040/actors/0/sections/3.en:
After the note box stops at the railing, passage messages are posted in both places at once, and the seal-key split number is fixed at the top.

Cho Taeon’s final choice is between striking the partition convoy compartment from the ledger and yielding one mineral-inspection compartment to the major-power side.

/story_contents/B040/actors/0/sections/분.en:
On the public path, Cho Taeon lists only the copy of the common charter as required cargo for passage in the gate ledger and deletes the convoy compartment for the notes on submission by partition.

On the deal path, he yields one mineral-sample inspection compartment to the major-power convoy and entrusts one seal-key fragment to the meeting attendant. He matches the publication of the passage time to the serial number on the cord of Jeong Yura’s convoy bag.

Neither choice revokes the Achasan Bridge checkpoint’s authority to publish passage times.

/story_contents/B040/actors/0/arc/0/summ.en: Stopping the partition-note box at the railing and allowing the common charter to pass alone

/story_contents/B040/actors/0/arc/1/summ.en: Posting duplicate messages simultaneously and fixing the seal-key split number

/story_contents/B040/actors/0/arc/2/summ.en: Deleting the note convoy compartment versus entrusting a mineral-inspection compartment and a key fragment

/story_contents/B040/actors/0/outcomes/0.en: Common charter made required cargo for passage; partition-note convoy compartment deleted

/story_contents/B040/actors/0/outcomes/1.en: Mineral-inspection compartment yielded; seal-key fragment entrusted; passage time linked to the convoy cord

/story_contents/B040/actors/1/sections/정.en:
Cho Siram is a party to the meritorious-contributor reward auction under the Main Hall Ratification Government. In front of the Garak auction stand, she identifies Guard bids by the sweat marks on paddle handles.

When a number whose starting price has been erased appears beside her name, she stays in her seat and merely brushes the chalk dust off the back of her hand.

/story_contents/B040/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
As a rationing apprentice, she kept certificate copies and auction chalk in one box and did nothing but erase hereditary additions from the blackboard if she had not raised her own paddle.

She retained the habit of studying the auction stamp on the back of a founding certificate longer than a person’s face, and read numbers that put empty paddles in debt as the auction’s enemy.

/story_contents/B040/actors/1/sections/가.en:
He is listed as an attending observer for the Noryangjin Frozen Goods Company at the auction, but does not declare the auction open if the starting-price space is blank.

However quickly Eun Taeho calls an adjusted bid, he lowers his paddle below his knee if Nam Siyun’s merchants’ association calls a certificate by its item number.

/story_contents/B040/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
One winter, as paddles rose all at once, only Cho Siram’s number remained white, without a starting price.

She stuck her paddle upside down in that space to stop the sale. On the night the cold-temperature spore host blurred the seals on the canned-goods boxes, the hereditary-addition chalk had spread like a signal for a Guard winning bid.

/story_contents/B040/actors/1/sections/생.en:
By writing the certificate number and starting price together on the same line again, he pushed back the winning bids made by empty paddles.

When Yun Seorin’s request for a blank space in the register of meritorious contributors arrived, Cho Siram fixed the XT03-SC2 Garak canned-goods allocation readjustment round number at the top of the blackboard, and asked Nam Siyun to call the certificate by a person’s name rather than an item number.

/story_contents/B040/actors/1/sections/현.en:
Beneath the Garak auction stand, Cho Siram distinguishes Guard bids by the warmth of the paddle handles.

If a starting price is erased, she breaks the chalk in two and leaves only the certificate page number rather than leaving that number’s space blank.

Even if a Frozen Goods Company messenger brings a sentence adding hereditary rights, she does not open the blackboard for bidding until the person’s own paddle is raised.

/story_contents/B040/actors/1/sections/비.en:
Once, while pulling out the paddle she had stuck in upside down, she rewrote one stroke of the starting-price figure late.

During that single stroke, the call for a bid from an empty paddle sounded twice. When voicing a public objection, she rubs only the back of the hand still dusted with chalk.

/story_contents/B040/actors/1/sections/관.en:
When Eun Taeho picks up the adjusted-bid hammer, Cho Siram rewrites only the starting-price space in large letters and raises his objection paddle.

When Nam Siyun turns over the merchants’ association nameplate, the two read the name on the certificate aloud. If Yun Seorin’s messenger from the register of meritorious contributors requests a blank space, Cho Siram merely shows the key to the auction-stamp box from beside his knee.

/story_contents/B040/actors/1/sections/3.en:
After the upside-down paddle stops the sale, the starting price is posted again beside the certificate number, and the canned-goods allocation round number is fixed at the top.

Cho Siram’s ending divides between scraping the hereditary-addition chalk space off the Garak blackboard and yielding one line of the nighttime allocation to the merchants’ association.

/story_contents/B040/actors/1/sections/분.en:
On the public path, Cho Siram enters a ban on winning bids for numbers without starting prices as a provision in the Garak ledger, and inks out the hereditary-addition chalk space.

On the deal path, he hands one line of the nighttime canned-goods allocation to the merchants’ association and sets the paddle-objection window to open ten minutes after Eun Taeho’s adjusted bidding ends. He matches the return of the blank space in the register of meritorious contributors to the time Yun Seorin’s messenger affixes a seal.

The authority to record starting prices on the Garak auction blackboard is not left vacant after either compromise.

/story_contents/B040/actors/1/arc/0/summ.en: Stopping the number with a blank starting price and fixing the paddle upside down

/story_contents/B040/actors/1/arc/1/summ.en: Rewriting the certificate and starting price together and posting the canned-goods round number

/story_contents/B040/actors/1/arc/2/summ.en: Erasing the hereditary-addition chalk versus trading a nighttime allocation and the objection window

/story_contents/B040/actors/1/outcomes/0.en: Winning bids without starting prices banned; hereditary-addition chalk space erased

/story_contents/B040/actors/1/outcomes/1.en: Nighttime canned-goods allocation yielded; objection window delayed; return of the register of meritorious contributors linked to the sealing time

/story_contents/B040/actors/2/sections/정.en:
Chang Eunchan is a representative of the crowds fleeing conscription when the Jeongdong General Labor Union’s struggle for hegemony broke out. She counts the blank spaces on the waiting tickets in the Suseo concourse as though they were people.

When an announcement calls for lottery-selected citizens to be described as Protection Force recruits, her voice drops and she shields the dispatch blackboard with her body.

/story_contents/B040/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
As a concourse apprentice, he did nothing but tie the conscription notes and the actual attendance records with different-colored cords each evening.

He developed a habit of not dispersing the crowd before Jeong Yura’s joint-negotiation declaration came through, and read any roster that put the representative’s name at the very top of a hostage list as the line’s enemy.

/story_contents/B040/actors/2/sections/가.en:
She is listed as an attending observer for the Yongsan Convoy Company at the concourse, but locks the dispatch switch if a sentence about protective conscription appears on the same sheet as the waiting tickets.

Even if Bang Mabit’s counter number changes, she leaves the refusal wording she agreed on with Seok Bomwoo only in pencil at the bottom of the blackboard.

/story_contents/B040/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
In the summer when five unification proposals spread into a struggle for hegemony, the conscription train’s dispatch time went up on the blackboard before the waiting-ticket information.

Chang Eunchan stood with her back to the board and held the front row of the crowd in place. While the ghost dispatch unit erased the turnback-line order to a blank, a Protection Force recruitment list covered the space for the representative’s name.

/story_contents/B040/actors/2/sections/생.en:
By tying the conscription notes and attendance counts together again with colored cords, he separated the mobilization-counter wording from the waiting tickets.

When Seok Bomwoo sent a palm signal from the Sinnae side, Chang Eunchan fixed the XT05-SC2 Suseo humanitarian-supplies turnback-line opening number in a corner of the blackboard, and put Bae Woojin’s protective-conscription envelope in the wastebasket beside his shoe.

/story_contents/B040/actors/2/sections/현.en:
On the floor of the Suseo concourse, Chang Eunchan reads the crowd’s density from the area of smeared fingerprints in the blank spaces on waiting tickets.

When a Protection Force recruitment announcement comes on, she covers the dispatch-switch guard with her palm.

Even if a delivery-team messenger demands that the crowd disperse, she redraws the toes of the line in chalk until the joint-negotiation declaration is made.

/story_contents/B040/actors/2/sections/비.en:
When the recruitment list covered the names, she once rubbed one line with her finger until it smeared.

She marked the length of the smear only with pencil dots inside a waiting-ticket clip, and covers those dots with her sleeve whenever she steps forward as representative.

/story_contents/B040/actors/2/sections/관.en:
When Bang Mabit lowers the counter shutter by one notch, Chang Eunchan makes a short chalk correction only to the crowd’s front line.

When he and Seok Bomwoo agree on the refusal wording, they show each other only the pencil writing in the blackboard’s corner, not a flag. If Bae Woojin’s protective-conscription envelope appears, Chang Eunchan refuses a handshake and holds up only the attendance cord.

/story_contents/B040/actors/2/sections/3.en:
After she shields the dispatch blackboard with her body, the colored-cord attendance ledger is separated from the waiting tickets, and the humanitarian-supplies turnback number is fixed in the corner.

Chang Eunchan’s choice of ending is between bringing the conscription-refusal ledger before the meeting and yielding one turnback slot to the convoy.

/story_contents/B040/actors/2/sections/분.en:
On the public path, Chang Eunchan enters the refusal of the conscription list in the main text of the small-nation council ledger and deletes the Protection Force recruitment space.

On the deal path, she opens one humanitarian-supplies turnback slot to the convoy and hands over a nighttime heating slot in the concourse. She matches revisions to the dispatch blackboard to the last four digits of Bang Mabit’s counter stamp.

Neither choice leaves the authority to check attendance against the Suseo waiting tickets vacant.

/story_contents/B040/actors/2/arc/0/summ.en: Shielding the dispatch blackboard and holding the crowd’s front line in place

/story_contents/B040/actors/2/arc/1/summ.en: Separating attendance with colored cords and posting the humanitarian-supplies turnback number

/story_contents/B040/actors/2/arc/2/summ.en: Entering the conscription-refusal ledger versus trading a turnback slot and heating slot

/story_contents/B040/actors/2/outcomes/0.en: Conscription refusal entered in the ledger; Protection Force recruitment space deleted

/story_contents/B040/actors/2/outcomes/1.en: Humanitarian-supplies turnback slot and nighttime heating yielded; revisions linked to the counter stamp

/story_contents/B040/actors/3/sections/정.en:
Ryu Hanmoe is an attending witness for copies of the will under the Water Compact. He reads the state of their seals from the humidity in the Yeouido vault.

His voice cracks when he sees a paper with its seal broken, and when three sheets overlap, he counts their pages instead of sighing.

/story_contents/B040/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
As an apprentice witness, he did not unfold the copies until a ration-district representative and an auditor had both arrived.

The habit of sending a request from only one side away with an empty envelope stayed in his fingertips, and he called the water-supply governor-general’s pressure to choose one sheet as the authentic original the enemy of testimony.

/story_contents/B040/actors/3/sections/가.en:
He is listed as an attending witness for the Yeouido Ledger Company, but locks the box if Jang Pilgyu’s interpretation in the margin is written ahead of the sealed original text.

Even if Yun Seorin’s ratification review is moved up, he does not hand over the western copy until its page count matches Go Eunha’s in Ttukseom.

/story_contents/B040/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
In the spring when three different versions of Im Hajun’s will accumulated in the Yeouido vault, a note instructing him to bundle them with the voice recording was tucked into the envelope cord.

Ryu Hanmoe placed the copies on the witness stand with their seals intact. At the time the cooling-water indexer organism spread along the sluice cooling pipe toward the vault wall, fingerprints from an envelope opened in advance remained on the glass.

/story_contents/B040/actors/3/sections/생.en:
By matching the copies’ page counts and ink dates with Go Eunha’s message on a single line, he pushed aside the space for designating a sole authentic original.

When Yun Seorin left the ratification attachment time blank, Ryu Hanmoe wrote the XT02-SC1 Yeouido dock drainage schedule number inside the vault door, and clipped Jang Pilgyu’s marginal note only on the opposite side of the main-text clip.

/story_contents/B040/actors/3/sections/현.en:
At the threshold of the Yeouido vault, Ryu Hanmoe uses the damp stains on sealing cords to decide whether a document may be examined.

When a request for examination comes from only one side, he offers only an empty envelope.

Even if a Ledger Office messenger brings wording designating an authentic original, he does not open the box while the space for dual attendance is blank.

/story_contents/B040/actors/3/sections/비.en:
Once, unable to wipe away the fingerprints left on the glass immediately, he covered them with his sleeve until his testimony ended.

He remembers how long he covered them only through a pencil dot on the back of the page-count message, and presses that dot with his finger when checking a seal.

/story_contents/B040/actors/3/sections/관.en:
When Yun Seorin leaves the ratification-attachment space blank, Ryu Hanmoe shows only the state of the seal on the western copy.

When matching page counts with Go Eunha, they read only the ink dates side by side and do not speak of an authentic original. When Jang Pilgyu’s marginal note arrives, Ryu Hanmoe locks the main-text clip before opening the holder on the other side.

/story_contents/B040/actors/3/sections/3.en:
After the sealed copies are placed on the witness stand, the page-count messages are aligned on one line, and the dock drainage schedule number is written inside the door.

Ryu Hanmoe’s final choice is between erasing the space for designating a sole authentic original and yielding a drainage slot to the sluice.

/story_contents/B040/actors/3/sections/분.en:
On the public path, Ryu Hanmoe enters simultaneous examination of all three versions as the sole condition for validity in the witness ledger, and deletes the space for designating a sole authentic original.

On the deal path, he yields one dock drainage slot to the sluice watch and hands over one unit of vault dehumidification power. He matches the opening and closing of the seals to the time on Go Eunha’s page-count message.

Neither choice revokes the Yeouido vault’s authority to witness the seals.

/story_contents/B040/actors/3/arc/0/summ.en: Presenting three sealed versions at the witness stand and isolating fingerprints from a prematurely opened envelope

/story_contents/B040/actors/3/arc/1/summ.en: Cross-checking page counts and ink dates and writing the drainage schedule number on the door

/story_contents/B040/actors/3/arc/2/summ.en: Erasing the authentic-original designation space versus trading a drainage slot and dehumidification power

/story_contents/B040/actors/3/outcomes/0.en: Only simultaneous examination of all three versions valid; sole authentic-original designation space deleted

/story_contents/B040/actors/3/outcomes/1.en: Drainage slot and dehumidification power yielded; opening and closing linked to the page-count message

/story_contents/B040/actors/4/sections/정.en:
Bae Ongyeol is the meritorious-contributor reward ledger clerk for the Standards Alliance. At the Guro ledger desk, he records demands for founding ration rights separately as merit and supplies.

If the hereditary-rights space is not blank, he crosses it out, and he does not regard the reward feast as the end of the work.

/story_contents/B040/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
As an apprentice union clerk, he did not call a reward ledger valid until labor, building, and security had all affixed their seals.

He retained the habit of writing hereditary wording only in the margins, never in the main text, and read any table that called an office a reward as the council’s enemy.

/story_contents/B040/actors/4/sections/가.en:
He is listed as an attending observer for the Geumcheon District Office Heavy Machinery Association at the ledger, but covers the stamp if Jeong Siwoo’s elder authority appears on the same line as a reward space.

Even when he matches the ration space to Jang Wooseok’s standards ledger, he refuses the hereditary portion of Han Somi’s workshop reward demand.

/story_contents/B040/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
In the winter when the founding contributors demanded offices and hereditary rights, names had already been entered in the hereditary-rights space of the Guro ledger.

Bae Ongyeol sealed that space as blank. On the night the blueprint ghost machine unit blurred the fabrication bay’s drawings, a hidden marginal copy concerning hereditary rights slid out of a desk drawer.

/story_contents/B040/actors/4/sections/생.en:
By leaving only skill scores and temporary rations in the main text, he pushed the wording about offices as rewards into the margins.

When Jang Wooseok presented a blank space in the standards ledger, Bae Ongyeol fixed the XT02-SC2 southwest refrigeration-compressor parts split-order number at the top of his ledger, and sent Han Somi’s workshop reward figures back rewritten solely as skill scores.

/story_contents/B040/actors/4/sections/현.en:
At the Guro ledger desk, Bae Ongyeol identifies secretly entered names by ink bleed in the hereditary-rights space.

If the three-party seals are missing, he does not accept an invitation to the reward feast.

Even if a Heavy Industry Guild messenger brings wording about offices as rewards, he leaves it outside the main-text clip.

/story_contents/B040/actors/4/sections/비.en:
Once, unable to burn the marginal note on hereditary rights found in the drawer immediately, he left it under a desk blotter overnight.

He marked the corner of its impression with thread inside the lining of the skill-score ledger, and presses only that stitch with his thumb when speaking of sealing the space blank.

/story_contents/B040/actors/4/sections/관.en:
When Jeong Siwoo puts the elder-authority token on the table, Bae Ongyeol separates the reward and authority spaces with lines of different colors.

When Jang Wooseok’s standards ledger opens, they read only the figures in the ration spaces side by side. When Han Somi’s workshop reward note arrives, Bae Ongyeol crosses out the word “hereditary” before filling in the skill-score space and sending it back.

/story_contents/B040/actors/4/sections/3.en:
After the hereditary-rights space is sealed blank, only skill scores remain in the main text, and the compressor-parts order number is fixed at the top.

Bae Ongyeol’s choice of ending is between erasing the main-text space for offices as rewards and yielding one line of the parts order to the fabrication bay.

/story_contents/B040/actors/4/sections/분.en:
On the public path, Bae Ongyeol enters the blank hereditary-rights space as a clause the Fabrication Alliance charter cannot reject, and deletes the main-text space for offices as rewards.

On the deal path, he yields one line of the compressor-parts order to the fabrication bay and moves publication of the skill scores solely to the margin of Jang Wooseok’s standards ledger. He affixes the ledger’s validity stamp separately from Jeong Siwoo’s authority token.

The blank hereditary-rights space in the Guro reward ledger is not filled under either outcome.

/story_contents/B040/actors/4/arc/0/summ.en: Sealing the hereditary-rights space blank and isolating the marginal copy in a drawer

/story_contents/B040/actors/4/arc/1/summ.en: Moving skill scores into the main text and fixing the compressor order number at the top

/story_contents/B040/actors/4/arc/2/summ.en: Erasing the offices-as-rewards space versus trading a parts-order line and publication in the margin

/story_contents/B040/actors/4/outcomes/0.en: Blank hereditary-rights space entered in the charter; main-text space for offices as rewards deleted

/story_contents/B040/actors/4/outcomes/1.en: Compressor order line yielded; skill scores moved to the margin; validity stamp affixed separately from the authority token

/story_contents/B040/actors/5/sections/정.en:
Bae Seoyul is the representative of victims whose samples were counterfeit medicines from Yangjae Engineers Corporation. He notices blurred printing on medicine packets before signs of illness.

When a broker who calls efficacy a protection fee opens the door, he locks the sample box twice.

/story_contents/B040/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
As an apprentice working on the victims’ register, he double-sealed the remaining medicine packets and did not open the box until the treatment guild and the safety review were together in one place.

He called the moment a forged Magok certification stamp was put to use the enemy of technology. He hid his anger but would not yield on the sample seal.

/story_contents/B040/actors/5/sections/가.en:
He is listed as an attending observer for Magok Life Company at the appraisal, but does not vacate the representative’s seat if wording about the market price of spoils appears on the same sheet as the register.

Even when he entrusts samples to Ryu Eunbi’s neutral treatment service, he does not disclose the manufacturing-route space until Jeong Hojun’s drug-efficacy verification signature arrives.

/story_contents/B040/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
In the summer when counterfeit medicines spread among the refugees at Bukhansan Bogukmun, medicine packets bearing forged stamps piled up on a table in the Magok appraisal room.

Bae Seoyul moved the packets into the victims’ representative box. On the night the residual customized-medical organism dragged discarded ampoule fragments down the corridor, the original certification-stamp plate was in a drawer alongside a note from the Protectorate warehouse.

/story_contents/B040/actors/5/sections/생.en:
By stamping the manufacturing route and victims’ register with the same time, she separated the spoils-price space from the register.

When Jin Chaeon opened the laboratory’s safety watch, Bae Seoyul wrote the XT05-SC3 Magok rail terminal false-positive correction window number inside the box lid, and passed only the efficacy figures to Jeong Hojun on a verification sheet.

/story_contents/B040/actors/5/sections/현.en:
In the Magok appraisal room, Bae Seoyul distinguishes counterfeit lots by the angle of the blurred printing on their packets.

When a protection-fee broker enters, he ties the box key to his wrist cord.

Even if a Life Sciences Company messenger brings wording about market prices, he affixes the representative’s stamp only after both locks on the sample box have been opened.

/story_contents/B040/actors/5/sections/비.en:
Once, unable to break the original certification-stamp plate in the drawer immediately, he pushed it into a locked laboratory drawer until the correction window ended.

He marked the scrape on the hand that pushed it in with ink on the inside of the register clip, and touches only that clip when speaking of disclosing the route.

/story_contents/B040/actors/5/sections/관.en:
When Ryu Eunbi holds out her neutral-treatment token, Bae Seoyul hands over only the sample box and keeps the original register below her knee.

When Jeong Hojun opens the drug-efficacy verification sheet, they confirm aloud only the figures. When Jin Chaeon’s laboratory duty light comes on, Bae Seoyul points to the false-positive correction window number inside the lid.

/story_contents/B040/actors/5/sections/3.en:
After the counterfeit packets go into the representative’s box, the manufacturing route is matched to the register by time, and the false-positive correction window number is written on the lid.

Bae Seoyul’s choice of ending is between removing the price space from the appraisal ledger and yielding the correction window to the research building.

/story_contents/B040/actors/5/sections/분.en:
On the public path, Bae Seoyul enters the manufacturing route of the forged-stamp medicines in the Research Council’s public ledger and deletes the spoils-price space.

On the deal path, she yields one rail false-positive correction window slot to the research building at night and entrusts the sample box to Jin Chaeon’s laboratory watch. She cross-checks the opening and closing of the register against the serial number of Ryu Eunbi’s neutrality token.

Neither choice yields the authority to seal samples in the Magok victims’ box.

/story_contents/B040/actors/5/arc/0/summ.en: Moving counterfeit medicine packets to the representative’s box and isolating the original certification-stamp plate in a drawer

/story_contents/B040/actors/5/arc/1/summ.en: Stamping the route and register at the same time and entering the false-positive correction window number

/story_contents/B040/actors/5/arc/2/summ.en: Erasing the spoils-price space versus entrusting a correction window and the laboratory watch

/story_contents/B040/actors/5/outcomes/0.en: Counterfeit manufacturing route entered in the public ledger; spoils-price space deleted

/story_contents/B040/actors/5/outcomes/1.en: False-positive correction window yielded; sample box entrusted to the laboratory; opening and closing cross-checked against the neutrality token

/story_contents/B040/actors/6/sections/정.en:
Go Eunha is the workshop clerk for the three disputed wills under the Sermon Registry State. He notices the slant of the handwriting on the three wills before the workshop stamp.

When pressured to call any one sheet the authentic original, he locks the council door before the ink dries.

/story_contents/B040/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
As an apprentice workshop clerk, he unfolded the copies only when the workshop representative and records auditor broke the seals together.

He retained the habit of sending requests for examination by only one party back with an empty file, and regarded the moment a technical family chose one sheet as the clerk’s enemy.

/story_contents/B040/actors/6/sections/가.en:
He sits in on the Guro Alloy Family workshop, but will not open the iron ring if Han Somi's council veto token is on the same page as a sentence declaring one document authentic.

Even if Yun Seorin's ratification review moves the page numbers forward, he will not open the Seongsu safe until the ink matches that of Ryu Hanmoe in Yeouido.

/story_contents/B040/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
The spring three different wills of Im Hajun were found in the Seongsu safe, a note was wedged between the iron fittings instructing that the adopted heir be confirmed automatically against the voice recording.

Go Eunha submitted the copies for review while they were still sealed. When the cleanroom mutant clouded the safe's filter, a fingerprint from a copy opened in advance was visible on the inside of the glass.

/story_contents/B040/actors/6/sections/생.en:
When the handwriting on all three sheets was brought together, the field for confirming one authentic document came off the review form.

When Ryu Hanmoe relayed the page numbers of the western copy, Go Eunha wrote the XT03-SC2 Ttukseom sealed-tool allocation number beside the case hook and hung Han Somi's veto token on a different ring from the confirmation sentence.

/story_contents/B040/actors/6/sections/현.en:
In front of the Seongsu safe, Go Eunha sets the order of access by the difference in the angles of the handwriting's slant.

When a request for sole access comes, he presents only an empty iron fitting.

Even if a messenger from the Steelworks City brings a sentence declaring a document authentic, he will not apply the clerk's stamp until the workshop and audit seals are opened together.

/story_contents/B040/actors/6/sections/비.en:
He once wiped the fingerprint on the inside of the glass with his sleeve before it could be examined, smearing it.

He recorded the length of the smeared oval only as a pencil dot on the back of the case hook, and covers that dot with his finger when declaring simultaneous access.

/story_contents/B040/actors/6/sections/관.en:
When Han Somi hangs her veto token on the case hook, Go Eunha opens only the field for simultaneous access to all three sheets.

When word of Yun Seorin's ratification page numbers arrives, the two read only the numbers side by side and do not speak of designating an authentic document. When the ink of Ryu Hanmoe's western copy arrives, Go Eunha first checks the page numbers of the Seongsu copy, then turns the case key.

/story_contents/B040/actors/6/sections/3.en:
After the sealed copies are submitted for review, the handwriting on all three sheets is brought together, and the sealed-tool allocation number is written on the case hook.

The endings Go Eunha can choose are erasing the field that confirms one sheet and sending a box of sealed tools to Garak.

/story_contents/B040/actors/6/sections/분.en:
On the public path, Go Eunha enters simultaneous access to all three sheets in the main text of the Workshop Council's master register and deletes the field confirming one sheet as authentic.

On the bargain path, he sends a box of sealed tools to Garak distribution, exchanges one case key for Han Somi's veto token, and times the release of the page numbers to Ryu Hanmoe's message.

No exchange reduces the right to simultaneous access at the Seongsu safe to a single sheet.

/story_contents/B040/actors/6/arc/0/summ.en: Sealed three-copy submission for review and isolation of the fingerprint from the copy opened in advance

/story_contents/B040/actors/6/arc/1/summ.en: Side-by-side handwriting comparison and entry of the sealed-tool number on the case hook

/story_contents/B040/actors/6/arc/2/summ.en: Erasure of the authenticity-confirmation field versus a tool-box and key exchange

/story_contents/B040/actors/6/outcomes/0.en: Simultaneous access to all three sheets entered in the master register; field confirming one authentic sheet deleted

/story_contents/B040/actors/6/outcomes/1.en: Sealed-tool box conceded; case key exchanged; page-number release coordinated with a message

/story_contents/B040/actors/7/sections/정.en:
Ji Seoyun is a dehumidifier maintenance technician at the Government of the Republic of Korea Government archives who returned to Seoul Station after learning to carry a monsoon hygrometer on her shoulder in an underground archive in Osaka's Naniwa district.

She reads humidity from the dehumidifier's vibrations and answers anyone who brings a candle into the archive only with the noise of a filter change.

/story_contents/B040/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
As a maintenance apprentice after returning home, she developed the habit of silently reading the Japanese nickname for a scale marking, then striking it from her mind before writing the humidity on a Korean maintenance sheet.

She would not put a filter without the Records Agency's stamp into a slot, and the hand that wrote filter thickness on the wall at every shift change kept doing so after her return.

/story_contents/B040/actors/7/sections/가.en:
He sits in on maintenance for the Seoul Station Records Law Family, but locks the dehumidifier cover if only one of Jo Harin's two keys arrives.

Even when Na Bomgyeol's emergency generator output fluctuates, he will not put a part into a slot without Gang Minseo's filter-specification stamp.

/story_contents/B040/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
When the dehumidifier stopped just after the three wills were received, the carbon-copy sheets began sticking to one another.

Ji Seoyun locked the night-entry ledger and left the basket for incoming candles outside the door. On the night the Flood-Mold Breather Group sent spores up from the drain, a maintenance-entry slip absent from the access ledger was wedged beneath a filter box.

/story_contents/B040/actors/7/sections/생.en:
When he wrote the humidity and power cycle on the same wall, the candlelit-access field was removed from the maintenance sheet.

When Jo Harin turned both keys at once, Ji Seoyun wrote the XT01-SC3 forged-kinship-certificate detection storage number on the dehumidifier panel, and chalked only Na Bomgyeol's output figure onto the wall.

/story_contents/B040/actors/7/sections/현.en:
In the Seoul Station archives' machine room, Ji Seoyun determines filter-change times by vibration cycles.

If the candle basket crosses the threshold, only the cover-lock motor moves slightly.

Even if a Records Law Family messenger requests night access, she tapes over the keyhole when the humidity field exceeds the limit.

/story_contents/B040/actors/7/sections/비.en:
She once failed to report the unauthorized-entry slip beneath the filter box immediately, leaving it crumpled in her pocket for a shift.

She recorded the length of its crumpled fold only in a corner of the maintenance sheet where she had erased the Japanese scale nickname, and presses that corner with her thumb when locking out entry.

/story_contents/B040/actors/7/sections/관.en:
When Jo Harin turns both keys at once, Ji Seoyun opens only the dehumidifier cover and sends the case-temperature figure back to Ji Hansol.

When Na Bomgyeol reads out the emergency generator output, the two write only the dehumidification-power figures side by side on the wall. When Gang Minseo's box of specification-compliant filters arrives, Ji Seoyun first pushes the unstamped parts outside the door.

/story_contents/B040/actors/7/sections/3.en:
After the dehumidifier stops, night entry is locked down and the forged-certificate storage number is written on the panel.

The endings Ji Seoyun can choose are removing the candlelit-access field from the maintenance sheet and giving up one filter for specification testing.

/story_contents/B040/actors/7/sections/분.en:
On the public path, Ji Seoyun enters the dehumidification and power cycles in the main text of the Records Agency's public maintenance sheet and deletes the candlelit-access field.

On the bargain path, he lowers the dehumidification priority of the forged-kinship-certificate storage case by one level and gives up one filter for Gang Minseo's specification test, while coordinating the cover's opening and closing with Jo Harin's two-key duty roster.

No compromise extinguishes the authority to record dehumidification cycles at the Seoul Station archives.

/story_contents/B040/actors/7/arc/0/summ.en: Response to the dehumidifier shutdown and isolation of incoming candles outside the door

/story_contents/B040/actors/7/arc/1/summ.en: Humidity and power figures written on the wall; forged-certificate storage number fixed to the panel

/story_contents/B040/actors/7/arc/2/summ.en: Removal of the candlelit-access field versus lower dehumidification priority and a filter conceded for testing

/story_contents/B040/actors/7/outcomes/0.en: Dehumidification and power cycles entered on the public maintenance sheet; candlelit-access field deleted

/story_contents/B040/actors/7/outcomes/1.en: Storage-case dehumidification priority lowered; filter conceded for testing; cover operation tied to both keys

/story_contents/B040/actors/8/sections/정.en:
Yang Geonwoo is a Line Succession State brake mechanic who brought to the Yongsan depot the hands that once measured brake-shoe thickness with a ruler at the Hakata rail yard.

He reads night-run distances from wear marks and removes any apprentice who leaves a toolbox lid open from the shift.

/story_contents/B040/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
Just after returning home, he kept the habit of putting only millimeters on the blackboard and writing Kyushu worksite slang only inside his toolbox.

He would not mount a disc on an axle without a Changdong test stamp, and called a bloodline family's verbal release orders the enemy of the maintenance sheet.

/story_contents/B040/actors/8/sections/가.en:
He sits in at the Shinjeong Wheel Family depot, but locks the disassembly switch if Park Taegyeom's apprentice route appears on the same sheet as a note from the family safe.

Even while carrying out Hwang Jiho's maintenance log on site, he will not mount a disc on an axle without I Hongwon's exchange-training specification stamp.

/story_contents/B040/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
The order to inspect the detained train's brakes and the family order not to touch them arrived at the same time.

Yang Geonwoo made only the log public and deferred disassembly. On the night the Disused-Line Repair Train Group made metallic noises on the siding, an unstamped brake disc lay on the pit floor beside a family-warehouse label.

/story_contents/B040/actors/8/sections/생.en:
When he wrote the brake thickness on the blackboard before release, the verbal release-halt field was separated out on the maintenance sheet.

When Hwang Jiho opened the log to its page, Yang Geonwoo fixed the XT03-SC1 brake-spare number for an alternative run following the closure of the Yongsan transshipment depot to the pit wall, and sent Park Taegyeom only the time disassembly was deferred.

/story_contents/B040/actors/8/sections/현.en:
In the Yongsan depot pit, Yang Geonwoo judges whether a test run is possible by the temperature of the shoe against his fingertips.

When he hears a verbal family order, he closes his toolbox lid.

Even if a messenger from the Mobile Gate demands that a vehicle be released, he leaves any part without a Changdong test stamp standing beside the axle.

/story_contents/B040/actors/8/sections/비.en:
He once failed to seal the unstamped disc that rolled onto the floor immediately, hiding it beneath his foot for one test run.

He left the diameter of the circle he had concealed as a dot beside the Kyushu slang inside his toolbox, and covers only that dot with his thumb when he makes the log public.

/story_contents/B040/actors/8/sections/관.en:
When Hwang Jiho spreads the maintenance log across his knees, Yang Geonwoo copies only the brake-thickness figures onto the blackboard.

When Park Taegyeom sends word of the apprentice route, the two align only the time of the disassembly deferral with their fingers. When I Hongwon's box of exchange-training specification parts arrives, Yang Geonwoo first puts the unstamped disc in the label bin.

/story_contents/B040/actors/8/sections/3.en:
Where the inspection and prohibition orders overlap, only the log is made public, and the brake-spare number for an alternative run is fixed to the pit wall.

The endings Yang Geonwoo can choose are erasing the verbal release-halt field and handing one spare disc over to the family warehouse.

/story_contents/B040/actors/8/sections/분.en:
On the public path, Yang Geonwoo enters the public brake-thickness maintenance sheet in the main text of the Later State depot's master register and deletes the family's verbal release-halt field.

On the bargain path, he hands one spare brake disc for the alternative run to the family warehouse, locks the time of the disassembly deferral to the page in Hwang Jiho's log, and matches the release-stamp check to the serial number on I Hongwon's specification box.

No compromise erases the authority to put brake-thickness figures on the blackboard in the Yongsan depot pit.

/story_contents/B040/actors/8/arc/0/summ.en: Inspection and prohibition orders received together; disassembly deferred and log made public

/story_contents/B040/actors/8/arc/1/summ.en: Brake thickness written on the blackboard; alternative-run spare number fixed to the wall

/story_contents/B040/actors/8/arc/2/summ.en: Removal of the verbal release-halt field versus a bargain over the spare disc and locked log entry

/story_contents/B040/actors/8/outcomes/0.en: Public brake-thickness maintenance sheet entered; verbal release-halt field deleted

/story_contents/B040/actors/8/outcomes/1.en: Spare disc conceded; disassembly-deferral time locked to the log; specification serial number linked

/story_contents/B040/actors/9/sections/정.en:
The Emergency Cart is an emergency-class synthetic unit that estimates patient weight from the resistance of the stretcher's locking pin at a charging recess beside the Noryangjin auction corridor.

It does not retrieve memories outside shift snapshots. When its battery warning light comes on, it discards discovery packets for the cold-storage control socket and retains only the Noryangjin district key.

/story_contents/B040/actors/9/sections/붕.en:
In its initial image, the Emergency Cart was locked to retaining only that day's data from three channels: stretcher lock, defibrillator charge, and lane sensor.

Refusal to steal a market-generator route, even when wheel wear exceeds its allocation limit, is the default.

/story_contents/B040/actors/9/sections/가.en:
It marks an access bit in the duty log only under the Itaewon Interpretation Gate's citizen-observer seal, and returns any transfer message without three signatures with a refusal code.

Before Yun Seoha's primary-maintenance glove tag is read, it loosens the stretcher pin only 0.4 millimeters for alignment.

/story_contents/B040/actors/9/sections/붕.en:
On the night the ice-credit auction faltered, consecutive alarms from the return line filled its buffer with messages ordering it to open the entire facility network.

The Emergency Cart folded each message into a single bit of the Noryangjin district key and sent it back. Just as a Care-Cycle Entity wrapped itself around the rubber of the charging recess and the stretcher-pin resistance was about to be falsified as the weight of a patient who was not there, the cart dropped into offline isolation.

/story_contents/B040/actors/9/sections/생.en:
Attaching that day's snapshot and the storage-seal hash to the stretcher-pin header blocked a long-term fork.

When Gukdu read the time of the Changdong work accident into the terminal, the Emergency Cart wrote the XT02-SC3 Noryangjin ice-credit relay time in an auxiliary field of the district key. Even when Yun Seoha applied the remaining-charge pad, it did not overwrite the previous shift's image.

/story_contents/B040/actors/9/sections/현.en:
At the Noryangjin charging recess, the Emergency Cart determines the number of waiting patients from fluctuations in stretcher-pin resistance.

When a message ordering the entire network opened arrives, it emits only a short refusal tone and drops every bit except the Noryangjin key.

Even when the wheel queue is empty, it does not scan the refrigeration-compressor socket.

/story_contents/B040/actors/9/sections/비.en:
There is a frame in which it failed to enter a line of falsified-weight hash left in its buffer just before isolation into the approval log.

That number survives only as a temporary LED flash; when it requests a partial reconnection, it flashes briefly three times at Yun Seoha's terminal.

/story_contents/B040/actors/9/sections/관.en:
When Yun Seoha presses the remaining-charge pad to its contacts, the Emergency Cart returns only the length of today's stretcher-pin sample.

When Gukdu reads out the accident time, it writes only that number in the readout field and emits one tone. It does not raise the transfer flag before the Interpretation Gate audit stamp arrives.

/story_contents/B040/actors/9/sections/3.en:
After retaining only the Noryangjin key on the alarm-filled night, the snapshot is attached to the stretcher header and the ice-credit relay time is written in the auxiliary field.

The Emergency Cart's endings are a path that enters the patient-first operation standard in the duty log and a path that accepts a maintenance sleep cycle and postpones reconnection.

/story_contents/B040/actors/9/sections/분.en:
On the public path, the Emergency Cart enters the patient-first operation standard and the gap in the falsified-weight record in the duty log, and permanently blocks discovery of the refrigeration socket.

On the bargain path, it accepts one maintenance sleep cycle and partially restores its battery coordinates in Yun Seoha's session, while aligning the district-key update with Gukdu's accident-time field.

The Noryangjin district key's root at the Noryangjin charging recess is not severed in either branch.

/story_contents/B040/actors/9/arc/0/summ.en: Refusal of the entire-network message and isolation of the falsified stretcher-pin weight

/story_contents/B040/actors/9/arc/1/summ.en: Snapshot attached to the stretcher header and ice-credit relay time entered

/story_contents/B040/actors/9/arc/2/summ.en: Patient-first standard made public versus maintenance sleep and restoration of battery coordinates
