/story_contents/B040/actors/9/outcomes/0.en: Patient-first operation standard made public; refrigeration-socket discovery permanently blocked

/story_contents/B040/actors/9/outcomes/1.en: Maintenance sleep; battery coordinates partially restored; key update linked to accident time

/story_contents/B041/actors/0/sections/정.en:
Go Jaemin is the Escort Protection State's captive witness to the medical-train exposure, who reads the loading order by the width of the oil slick on the floor of the Godeok freight car.

When a note comes telling him to cite the officers' network as his alibi, he memorizes the four freight symbols before the rope marks on his wrists.

/story_contents/B041/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
As a freight assistant, he wrote release stamps and seal-cord colors on the left and right of the same notebook.

The habit of making them rewrite the weight log whenever ammunition crates were mixed in under the medical-car emblem stayed in his thumb.

/story_contents/B041/actors/0/sections/가.en:
There is a witness column on the waste-heat pipe inspection roster of the Ttukseom Heat-Source House, but he does not read out release symbols until the water administration and the escort corps' staff sit at one table.

Even when Han Bora's patrol-train dispatch changes, he does not alter the order of the oil slicks in the freight car.

/story_contents/B041/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
In the winter the floor of the medical train was opened on the Godeok siding, a weapons case stamped with an Amsa-made emblem came to light under the bandage crates.

Go Jaemin, still wearing a captive's tag, wrote the four release symbols on the floor with his finger, and at the moment the bespoke-medicine remnant wound IV hoses around the cargo rails, a chair for solitary interrogation by officers was set at the car's entrance.

/story_contents/B041/actors/0/sections/생.en:
Once he wrote the release symbols and the sealed crates' weights on one line, the sentence that let the secret officers' network read as official escort was erased.

When Yeo Seoha came to align the inquiry clerk's page numbers, Go Jaemin drove the XT04-SC1 public number of the freight-car weight log into the top of his notebook, and left whether Bae Woojin would be punished only as a blank, a condition of his testimony.

/story_contents/B041/actors/0/sections/현.en:
On the Godeok freight platform, Go Jaemin uses only the car where the oil slick breaks off as his witness seat.

When the solitary interrogation chair is pushed toward him, he hides his wrists under the table and repeats only the four symbols.

Even when the pressure from the waste-heat pipes brings escort-disguise wording, he corrects only the public ledger column in pencil.

/story_contents/B041/actors/0/sections/비.en:
Once, while untying his bonds, he let one stroke of a symbol smear in the oil.

He remembers the length of that smeared stroke only as an ink dot beside his thumb, and when he begins testifying he covers that dot with his sleeve.

/story_contents/B041/actors/0/sections/관.en:
When Han Bora sounds the patrol train's whistle briefly, Go Jaemin writes the dispatch time and the freight symbols overlapping in the same column.

When Yeo Seoha opens the inquiry pages, the two match only the sealed crates' weights with their fingers and never speak of the officers' network, and when Bae Woojin's notice of punishment is late, Go Jaemin folds the blank in his testimony and puts it in his pocket.

/story_contents/B041/actors/0/sections/3.en:
After the weapons case is opened under the bandages, the weight log is attached to its public number and the release symbols are fixed on the first line of the ledger.

Go Jaemin's last move splits between entering the symbols in the Waterworks Corps ledger and giving one prisoner-exchange slot to the escort corps.

/story_contents/B041/actors/0/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, Go Jaemin enters the Amsa-made release symbols in the body of the Waterworks Corps public ledger and deletes the officers' solitary-interrogation column.

In the β branch, he hands one sealed crate over as exchange goods for the escort corps, gives one Godeok night testimony shift to the staff seat, and cross-checks the right to revise the symbols against the seal on Yeo Seoha's inquiry pages.

The four release symbols in the Godeok freight car are not erased in any choice.

/story_contents/B041/actors/0/arc/0/summ.en: Exposure of the weapons case in the medical car and testimony under a captive's tag

/story_contents/B041/actors/0/arc/1/summ.en: Fixing the public number of the weight log and holding the punishment blank

/story_contents/B041/actors/0/arc/2/summ.en: Ledger entry versus exchange goods and a yielded shift

/story_contents/B041/actors/0/outcomes/0.en: Release symbols entered in the ledger; solitary-interrogation column deleted

/story_contents/B041/actors/0/outcomes/1.en: Sealed crate exchanged, night testimony shift yielded, inquiry pages cross-checked

/story_contents/B041/actors/1/sections/정.en:
Pyeong Yejun is the Republic of Korea Government's witness to the return of emergency powers, who retraces the time of the Great Blackout by the sound of stamps at the threshold of the Seoul Station archive.

When anyone calls powers never returned a legitimate succession, he breaks the blackboard chalk and leaves that line empty.

/story_contents/B041/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
As an archive duty apprentice, he wrote return times and unreturned jurisdictions at the top and bottom of the same blackboard.

The habit of accepting no later correction until the two duty officers of the time had both re-signed stayed in his wrist.

/story_contents/B041/actors/1/sections/가.en:
His name is on the cross-check seating of the Seoul Station Records Legalist House, but he does not turn the Great Blackout log into broadcast sentences until Yun Seorin's ratification hash is stamped.

Even when Na Bomgyeol's generator log is late, he does not rewrite the unreturned-jurisdiction column as advertising copy.

/story_contents/B041/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
On the night of Collapse Year 0, when the lights all went out at once, Pyeong Yejun watched from the archive threshold as the heads of water, rail, and records each clutched their emergency stamps.

At the moment the watch-rail swarm scraped the reading-room ceiling rails, a great power's leaflet on development legitimacy lay on a box lid, cut up like fragments of testimony.

/story_contents/B041/actors/1/sections/생.en:
Once he wrote return times and unreturned jurisdictions side by side on one blackboard, the sentences advertising legitimate succession were erased.

When Ji Hansol offered the box's sealing time as the anchor of his testimony, Pyeong Yejun drove the XT05-SC2 handover-list hash storage number into the corner of the blackboard, and moved the cut fragments of testimony only while sealed.

/story_contents/B041/actors/1/sections/현.en:
In the records reading room, Pyeong Yejun counts shifts by the intervals when the stamp sounds stop.

When a sentence advertising legitimacy comes in, he keeps his chalk in his pocket and only reads the return times again.

Even when the Legalist House presses for sole publication, he corrects only the cross-check column.

/story_contents/B041/actors/1/sections/비.en:
On his first day of duty he wrote one line of unreturned jurisdiction too late, and the leaflet went out first.

He remembers those minutes of delay only under fingernails dusted with chalk, and he clenches his fists whenever he lights the blackboard.

/story_contents/B041/actors/1/sections/관.en:
When Yun Seorin opens the cross-check box, Pyeong Yejun hands over only the first page of the Great Blackout log.

When Na Bomgyeol reads the emergency generator times, the two match only the second hands and never say the word legitimacy, and when Ji Hansol's sealing time arrives on a wet note, Pyeong Yejun covers the advertising leaflet before drying it.

/story_contents/B041/actors/1/sections/3.en:
After the three heads' stamps come down at once, returned and unreturned are posted on one blackboard, and the handover-list hash is fixed beside them.

The ending Pyeong Yejun chooses is either making the unreturned jurisdictions public or hiding the cut fragments and receiving a witness-protection shift.

/story_contents/B041/actors/1/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, Pyeong Yejun enters the list of unreturned jurisdictions in the body of the Records Bureau's public blackboard and scraps the column for legitimacy-advertising leaflets.

In the β branch, he leaves one cut fragment of testimony in the sealed store, hands one night witness-escort shift to the Legalist House, and ties the right to revise the blackboard to the re-signing of Na Bomgyeol's generator log.

The record of return times at the archive threshold is not deleted in any branch.

/story_contents/B041/actors/1/arc/0/summ.en: Witness at the threshold of the Great Blackout and three stamps seized at once

/story_contents/B041/actors/1/arc/1/summ.en: Returned and unreturned side by side on the blackboard and the handover hash fixed

/story_contents/B041/actors/1/arc/2/summ.en: Publishing jurisdictions versus hiding fragments for an escort shift

/story_contents/B041/actors/1/outcomes/0.en: Unreturned jurisdictions made public; legitimacy-leaflet column scrapped

/story_contents/B041/actors/1/outcomes/1.en: Testimony fragment sealed, night escort shift, blackboard revisions tied to the generator log

/story_contents/B041/actors/2/sections/정.en:
Ran Hayul is the Line Succession State's assistant accuser in the matter of succession-trial parts, who gauges brake wear and shaved bearings with the same hand at the Yongsan transshipment depot.

Unless a family's verbal instruction is given again in writing, he leaves the first line of his accusation blank.

/story_contents/B041/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
As a depot apprentice, he practiced only writing sample numbers and dispatch times overlapping on one line.

The habit of not driving a nail into the board until both an apprentice and a dispatcher had signed together stayed on the back of his hand.

/story_contents/B041/actors/2/sections/가.en:
He sits on the dispatch seating of the Yongsan Line Gate, but he holds back his accusation whenever a charter-train sentence sits on the same sheet as a table that erases the emergency column.

Even when Hwang Jiho's maintenance log is late, Ran Hayul does not cover shaved bearings on verbal instruction alone.

/story_contents/B041/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
On the night parts from the northern succession trial turned out to carry the same numbers as a Yongsan transshipment lot, Ran Hayul wrapped the shaved samples in oilpaper and stapled them to the back of his accusation.

At the moment the dead-line repair-train swarm gnawed the rails of the transshipment pit, a note telling him to put an assistant's signature in the accomplice column was stuck beside the nail on the board.

/story_contents/B041/actors/2/sections/생.en:
Once he bound sample numbers and dispatch times on one line, the sentence steering toward a third war was erased.

When Dan Sion held out a request to inspect, Ran Hayul drove the XT03-SC1 code for opening the alternative return line into the corner of his accusation, and checked I Hongwon's Changdong trial ledger only from the depot side.

/story_contents/B041/actors/2/sections/현.en:
At the workbench of the Yongsan transshipment depot, Ran Hayul judges whether a lot is genuine by the grain size of the bearing dust.

When a verbal instruction arrives first, he keeps the board nail in his pocket until the joint-signature column is full.

Even when the Line Gate presses a charter train on him, he will not accept a table with the emergency column erased.

/story_contents/B041/actors/2/sections/비.en:
Once, while wrapping samples, he was one sheet of oilpaper short and spilled bearing dust on the floor.

He remembers the length of the sweep marks from that day only as a knife cut on the corner of the workbench, and he covers that cut with his palm whenever he opens an accusation.

/story_contents/B041/actors/2/sections/관.en:
When Hwang Jiho folds a page of his maintenance log for him, Ran Hayul moves only the brake-wear figures into the grounds column of his accusation.

When Dan Sion stamps an inspection request, the two match only the sample numbers with their fingers and never speak of the accomplice column, and when I Hongwon's trial ledger comes down from Changdong, Ran Hayul ties with red thread only the lines that overlap the transshipment lot.

/story_contents/B041/actors/2/sections/3.en:
After the shaved bearings are bound to the accusation, samples and dispatches are written on one line and the alternative return-line number is fixed beside them.

The ending Ran Hayul chooses is either raising the double-ledger accusation into a standard of the successor states, or hiding the accomplice-column note and giving up one Changdong escort slot.

/story_contents/B041/actors/2/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, Ran Hayul puts a double-accusation standard, filing the Yongsan transshipment log and the Changdong trial ledger together, into the successor states' agreement ledger and deletes the automatic accomplice-column entry.

In the β branch, he hands one crate of sealed samples to the Changdong escort, yields one night dispatch slot to the Line Gate, and trades the right to open and close the board for a page of Hwang Jiho's maintenance log.

The seal number of the transshipment lot is not withdrawn in any choice.

/story_contents/B041/actors/2/arc/0/summ.en: Sealing the shaved bearings and separating out the accomplice-column note

/story_contents/B041/actors/2/arc/1/summ.en: Recording samples and dispatches on one line and fixing the return-line number

/story_contents/B041/actors/2/arc/2/summ.en: Registering a double-accusation standard versus trading an escort crate and a dispatch slot

/story_contents/B041/actors/2/outcomes/0.en: Double-ledger accusation registered; automatic accomplice entry deleted

/story_contents/B041/actors/2/outcomes/1.en: Changdong escort crate, night dispatch slot yielded, board posting tied to the maintenance log

/story_contents/B041/actors/3/sections/정.en:
Chu Boram is Won Buddhism's shipowner for the lesser-state council's food escort, who opens the fuel drums and remaining ice for inspection before sailing at the Noryangjin berths.

He stops shipowners who hide their remaining stock even before bankruptcy does, and the hand that moves slips like goods he folds only during council escorts.

/story_contents/B041/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
As a dock apprentice, he wrote remaining stock at sailing and unredeemed slips side by side on the same blackboard.

The habit of suspending dock use for shipowners piled up with slips bought on false inventory stayed on his palm like a rope burn.

/story_contents/B041/actors/3/sections/가.en:
He sits on the berth seating of the Noryangjin Cold-Storage Merchant Company, but he holds back sailing whenever a berth sentence in the name of great-power army rations sits on the same sheet as the food column.

Even when O Doyun's Merchants' Hall State slips are pushed on him, Chu Boram filters them out of the council escort.

/story_contents/B041/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
In the spring of the second year, when envoys of eleven nations gathered at the Noryangjin berths, a berth request in the name of army rations came down first.

Chu Boram floated only the lesser states' food column and folded the ration flag below deck, and at the moment the migratory-bird wetland predators pecked at the dock piles, a heap of false-inventory slips was blocking the entrance to the council column.

/story_contents/B041/actors/3/sections/생.en:
Once he wrote remaining stock at sailing and the envoys' food-column numbers on one line, the sentence of partitioned-vassal docks was erased.

When Jeong Yura's joint-negotiation envoys came aboard, Chu Boram drove the XT02-SC3 relay time of the auction broadcast into the top of the berth blackboard, and copied Jang Sehwa's mutual-escort draft only in chalk of a different color from the remaining ice.

/story_contents/B041/actors/3/sections/현.en:
At the Noryangjin council berth, Chu Boram decides whether sailing is possible by the wetness of the remaining ice.

When the ration flag goes up again, he coils the rope and checks only the door of the food column once more.

Even when the Cold-Storage Merchant Company presses for shipowners' shares to come first, he corrects only the mutual-escort working column.

/story_contents/B041/actors/3/sections/비.en:
Once, while filtering out a false-inventory slip, he smeared an unredeemed figure with his finger.

He left the place of that smeared figure only as a pen dot beside his rope burn, and he covers that dot with his glove whenever he blows the sailing whistle.

/story_contents/B041/actors/3/sections/관.en:
When O Doyun holds out Merchants' Hall State slips, Chu Boram sticks them only in the council escort's filter column.

When Jeong Yura sets the negotiation bag down on deck, the two match only the food-column numbers and never speak of the ration flag, and when Jang Sehwa's mutual-escort draft gets wet, Chu Boram pockets the shipowners'-share chalk before drying it.

/story_contents/B041/actors/3/sections/3.en:
After only the food column floats, remaining stock and column numbers are written on one line and the auction relay time is fixed on the blackboard.

The ending Chu Boram chooses is either entering mutual-escort practice in the berth ledger or giving up one ration slot after the council ends.

/story_contents/B041/actors/3/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, Chu Boram enters the lesser states' food escort in the berth ledger as a working clause of the mutual-escort treaty and deletes the berth column in the name of army rations.

In the β branch, he opens one ration slot 30 minutes after the council ends, hands one night berth-duty seat to a great-power escort, and cross-checks the right to revise sailings against the seal number of Jeong Yura's negotiation bag.

The public record of remaining stock in the Noryangjin food column is not erased from the berth blackboard in any branch.

/story_contents/B041/actors/3/arc/0/summ.en: Refusing the ration berth and sailing the lesser states' food column alone

/story_contents/B041/actors/3/arc/1/summ.en: Remaining stock and column numbers side by side and the auction relay time fixed

/story_contents/B041/actors/3/arc/2/summ.en: Registering mutual-escort practice versus yielding a ration slot and a duty seat

/story_contents/B041/actors/3/outcomes/0.en: Mutual-escort working clause registered; ration berth column deleted

/story_contents/B041/actors/3/outcomes/1.en: Post-council ration slot, night duty yielded, negotiation seal cross-checked

/story_contents/B041/actors/4/sections/정.en:
Hong Woochan is the Yeouido Investment Union's informant on the origin of retransmissions, who points out the waveform of a short retransmission from the railing of the Sangam transmission tower faster than rumor.

When an intruder tries to open the toolbox, she stops the person first and then closes the tools.

/story_contents/B041/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
As a tracking-team apprentice, she drew the direction-finding routes on the board every day, and never opened the door to the tower until two patrols had come together.

The habit of recording a waveform matching the edited Superintendent's voice as the same crime as forgery and jamming stayed under her wristwatch.

/story_contents/B041/actors/4/sections/가.en:
Her name is on the log-trust seating of the Digital Media City Trust House, but when asked to trade original faces for passage rights she hands over only aggregate figures.

Even when Jo Eunwoo's radio tracking is late, Hong Woochan does not rewrite the origin note as a pretext for censorship.

/story_contents/B041/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
On the night the antenna mast beside the Yongsan detention line flickered briefly, a retransmission of the same waveform coincided with the time the medical car was found.

Hong Woochan pinned the origin map to the wall of the programming council, and at the moment the radio-crow flock pecked at the feed lines, an internal note telling her to turn the tracking team into a censorship body was clipped to the railing.

/story_contents/B041/actors/4/sections/생.en:
Once she overlaid the direction-finding routes and the time the medical car was found on one sheet, the pretext for internal blocking was erased.

When Yong Bok came to align the northwest gate patrol times, Hong Woochan drove the XT05-SC1 remaining-bandwidth lottery number into the corner of the origin map, and moved Sun Gaon's discovery time over only as a mark on the waveform scale.

/story_contents/B041/actors/4/sections/현.en:
At the Sangam tower railing, Hong Woochan corrects the direction of the origin by the intervals of the waveform's flicker.

When a censorship note is clipped there again, she blocks the railing door with her shoulder until two patrols gather.

Even when the Trust House presses for original faces, she opens only the aggregate column.

/story_contents/B041/actors/4/sections/비.en:
Once, while pinning up the origin map, she smeared one mark on the waveform scale with the tip of her glove.

She remembers the angle of that smeared mark only as a rust stain on the railing, and she covers that rust with her glove whenever she begins a report.

/story_contents/B041/actors/4/sections/관.en:
When Jo Eunwoo hands her the tracking headset, Hong Woochan reads only the coordinates of the origin note into her ear.

When Yong Bok sounds the gate patrol whistle briefly, the two match only the times and never use the word censorship, and when Sun Gaon's medical-car discovery time arrives on a wet note, Hong Woochan pockets the jamming sentence before drying it.

/story_contents/B041/actors/4/sections/3.en:
After the mast flickers, the origin map is pinned to the wall and the remaining-bandwidth lottery number is fixed in its corner.

The ending Hong Woochan chooses is either entering retransmission in the Corporation ledger as the same crime as forgery and jamming, or handing one shift of excessive lockdown to the programming council.

/story_contents/B041/actors/4/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, Hong Woochan enters the same-waveform retransmission in the Corporation's public ledger under the same charge as forged broadcasting and military jamming, and deletes the column turning the team into a censorship body.

In the β branch, she hands one shift of the tower-access lockdown to the programming council's patrols, leaves one origin coordinate only as a trust aggregate, and ties the right to revise the routes to a page of Jo Eunwoo's tracking log.

The nail hole of the origin map on the Sangam railing is not filled in any branch.

/story_contents/B041/actors/4/arc/0/summ.en: Retransmission from the detention-line mast and posting the origin map

/story_contents/B041/actors/4/arc/1/summ.en: Overlaying detection routes with the medical-car time and fixing the bandwidth lottery

/story_contents/B041/actors/4/arc/2/summ.en: Entering the same charge versus yielding a lockdown shift and keeping only aggregates

/story_contents/B041/actors/4/outcomes/0.en: Retransmission entered under the same charge as forgery and jamming; censorship column deleted

/story_contents/B041/actors/4/outcomes/1.en: Tower lockdown shift yielded, origin kept only as an aggregate, tied to the tracking log

/story_contents/B041/actors/5/sections/정.en:
Sun Jimin is a deserter from the Sangha Relief State's forced-registration procession, who retraces the time she left the column by the dew marks on the Eunpyeong mountain path.

When oath and survival collide she stays silent a long time and then steps out of line, and before an iron slip that splits families she breaks that silence.

/story_contents/B041/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
On bivouac duty, she wrote the time of desertion and the names of the family left behind on the same note.

The habit of testifying so that no one person could hold both armed duty and ration duty stayed on her palm like a pencil mark.

/story_contents/B041/actors/5/sections/가.en:
Her name is on the family-reunion roster seating of the Bukhansan Bogukmun Returnees' Society, but when asked to trade names on the waiting line for the service roster she opens only the column for the person's own consent.

Even while clashing with O Hangyeol's militia oath, Sun Jimin did not open the side door of the storehouse.

/story_contents/B041/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
In the autumn Bukhansan Bogukmun procession, when Amsa bound water rights and service re-registration into a single iron slip, Sun Jimin stepped out of line and went back down the mountain path.

At the moment the stray-dog iron pack licked the bivouac fence, a reprisal search list ordering that the desertion be recorded only as rebellion hung from the handle of the storehouse side door.

/story_contents/B041/actors/5/sections/생.en:
Once she bound the time of desertion and the names of the family left behind on one note, the sentence about a mercenary procession was erased.

When Bok Mo laid down a detour marker, Sun Jimin drove the XT01-SC1 reissue number of the Imjin quarantine roster into the corner of the note, and offered Baek On the reason for her desertion at the family council.

/story_contents/B041/actors/5/sections/현.en:
At a milepost on the Eunpyeong evacuation road, Sun Jimin uses only the point where the dew marks break off as her seat for testifying to the desertion.

When the reprisal search whistle sounds, she tucks the note into her shoe insole and points only to the mountain path.

Even when the Returnees' Society presses to use the roster as a hostage, she corrects only the column for the person's own consent.

/story_contents/B041/actors/5/sections/비.en:
Once, as she stepped out of line, she wrote her younger sibling's name on the note late, and the search made a circuit of that bivouac.

She remembers the slant of that late stroke only as a knife cut on the milepost, and she covers that cut with the back of her hand whenever she unfolds the note.

/story_contents/B041/actors/5/sections/관.en:
When O Hangyeol holds out the militia oath, Sun Jimin keeps the storehouse side-door key without returning it and leaves the signature line blank.

When Bok Mo stacks detour stones, the two match only the angle for going around the bivouac and never use the word rebellion, and when Baek On's family council opens, Sun Jimin reads the reason for her desertion on the first line only.

/story_contents/B041/actors/5/sections/3.en:
After the iron slip binds water and service, her desertion by the mountain path is written on the note and the quarantine reissue number is attached to its corner.

The ending Sun Jimin chooses is either entering the desertion route in the league ledger as a rescue, or laying out the reprisal list while hiding one bivouac.

/story_contents/B041/actors/5/sections/분.en:
In the α branch, Sun Jimin enters the route of desertion from forced registration in the league's public ledger as a rescue and deletes the column allowing armed and ration duty to be held together.

In the β branch, she lays the reprisal search list out on the council table and, in exchange for hiding the location of one remaining bivouac, hands one night roster-duty seat to the Returnees' Society, tying the right to revise the note to the seal of Baek On's family council.

The note of desertion times on the Eunpyeong mountain path is not burned in any choice.

/story_contents/B041/actors/5/arc/0/summ.en: Refusing the water-and-service iron slip and deserting by the mountain path

/story_contents/B041/actors/5/arc/1/summ.en: Desertion note and family names side by side and the quarantine number fixed

/story_contents/B041/actors/5/arc/2/summ.en: Registering a rescue versus publishing the list and hiding a bivouac

/story_contents/B041/actors/5/outcomes/0.en: Desertion route registered as a rescue; dual armed-and-ration column deleted

/story_contents/B041/actors/5/outcomes/1.en: Reprisal list published, bivouac location hidden, note tied to the family council

/story_contents/B041/actors/6/sections/정.en:
Dan Geonwoo is the Seocho Computing Group's northern envoy technician to the lesser-state council, who writes accident dates before people's names at the workbench by Changdong's main gate.

When a housing note is posted above the technical log he snaps his chalk, and he does not open base operations on verbal approval alone.

/story_contents/B041/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
As an apprentice, he wrote the rotation of work crews and accident signatures side by side in the same ledger.

The habit of leaving notes that demand a test postponement on the board as they are stayed on his sleeve like chalk dust.

/story_contents/B041/actors/6/sections/가.en:
His name is on the defense-key seating of the Changdong Defense House, but he closes the envoy's bag whenever a slip ordering the barrier door's remote key handed to the escort corps sits on the same sheet as the technical log.

Even when I Hongwon's technical test schedule slips, Dan Geonwoo does not open the main gate on verbal approval alone.

/story_contents/B041/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
On the morning he packed the envoy's bag at Changdong's main gate, a military-supply monopoly clause had been laid over the draft of repair rights.

Dan Geonwoo folded the monopoly clause into the bottom of the bag and kept only the draft of mutual repair rights, and at the moment the blueprint-ghost machine corps blurred the test-wheel drawings, a bribed postponement note was covering the nail on the board.

/story_contents/B041/actors/6/sections/생.en:
As repair standards and workers’ freedom of movement were written into a single draft, the sentence from the ration counter note was erased.

When Gang Minseo handed over the sealing-specification figures, Dan Geonwoo fixed the XT04-SC2 winter fuel queue allocation number inside his envoy’s bag and placed only the northern technical clause before Jeong Yura’s joint-negotiation seat.

/story_contents/B041/actors/6/sections/현.en:
At the workbench by Changdong’s main gate, Dan Geonwoo sets the order of tests according to the intervals between accident dates.

When a housing note is stuck over the log, he snaps the chalk and pushes the note underneath.

Even when Defense Gate’s demands call for a remote lock, he opens the key inspection only after the civilian evacuation broadcast.

/story_contents/B041/actors/6/sections/비.en:
While folding away the monopoly clause, he once crumpled a line of the draft repair-rights agreement against the bottom of his bag.

He remembers the crease in that line only as a groove in the workbench chalk, and covers the groove with his thumb whenever he opens the envoy’s bag.

/story_contents/B041/actors/6/sections/관.en:
When I Hongwon writes the technical-test schedule on the board, Dan Geonwoo copies only its dates into the envoy’s evidence field.

When Gang Minseo hands him the repair-standards seal, the two use a hand scale to balance only the weight of the draft and leave out any mention of a military-supply monopoly. When Jeong Yura vacates the negotiating seat, Dan Geonwoo sets down only the draft northern technical clause.

/story_contents/B041/actors/6/sections/3.en:
After the monopoly clause is folded away, repair rights and freedom of movement are written into one draft, and the winter fuel queue number is fixed inside the bag.

Dan Geonwoo’s choice of ending is between entering the northern envoy’s signature in the Production Standards Alliance ledger and making the delay note public while yielding one main-gate duty post.

/story_contents/B041/actors/6/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Dan Geonwoo puts Changdong’s repair standards and workers’ freedom of movement in the body of the joint-negotiation draft and deletes the military-supply monopoly field.

In branch β, he posts the bought-off delay note on the notice board, hands one main-gate night-duty post to Defense Gate, and ties authority to open the envoy’s bag to a renewed signature on I Hongwon’s test schedule.

The draft mutual repair rights at Changdong’s main gate are discarded in neither branch.

/story_contents/B041/actors/6/arc/0/summ.en: Folding away the military-supply monopoly clause and preserving the draft repair rights

/story_contents/B041/actors/6/arc/1/summ.en: Combining standards and freedom of movement in one draft and fixing the fuel queue number

/story_contents/B041/actors/6/arc/2/summ.en: Registering the northern signature versus disclosing the delay note and yielding a duty post

/story_contents/B041/actors/6/outcomes/0.en: Registering the repair-standards and freedom-of-movement draft; deleting the military-supply monopoly field

/story_contents/B041/actors/6/outcomes/1.en: Disclosing the delay note; yielding a main-gate duty post; tying bag access to the test schedule

/story_contents/B041/actors/7/sections/정.en:
Ji Yunjae is a Won Buddhist mechanic for Noryangjin’s ice-making machines. The hands that once read freezing cycles through compressor vibrations at a Yokohama dockside ice yard came to Noryangjin by way of Busan’s Gamcheon bonded cold-storage warehouse.

She takes assistants who leave tools on the ice off the shift and offers only the noise of a test run in place of an answer.

/story_contents/B041/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
As a yard apprentice, she wrote compression temperature and brick weight in separate upper and lower sections of the machine-room wall.

Her habit of refusing to install parts without a merchant-house stamp stayed on her tool handles like salt from the Yokohama breakwater.

/story_contents/B041/actors/7/sections/가.en:
Her name is on the short-range cart roster of Noryangjin Delivery House, but she locks the test-run switch if the long-distance delivery crew tries to trade ice-making power for an auction bid.

Ji Yunjae does not move the balance weight until Seo Nayeon’s brick inscription arrives on site.

/story_contents/B041/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
When the ice-machine compressor stopped on the first day of the blackout, a modification note telling her to make up the weight with meltwater was posted on the machine-room door.

Ji Yunjae left only the manual-cycle handle in place and tore down the note with an ice knife. As low-temperature spore hosts bloomed in the drainage groove, a box of unstamped modification parts sat on the floor like a shipment from Gamcheon.

/story_contents/B041/actors/7/sections/생.en:
When compression temperature and brick weight were brought together on one board, the instruction to use meltwater for weight was erased.

When Na Ruhui came to balance the power for ice-making, Ji Yunjae fixed the XT03-SC3 interpreter-counter terminology-conflict record in the corner of the maintenance sheet. He stamped Gang Minseo’s sealing-standard inspection mark only on parts bearing a stamp.

/story_contents/B041/actors/7/sections/현.en:
In Noryangjin’s ice-making machine room, Ji Yunjae sets the shift order by the rhythm of compressor vibrations.

When unstamped parts arrive, she keeps the handle locked and rewrites only the temperature field on the board.

Even when the Liaison Bureau presses her to trade alley carts for ice-making power, she changes only fields on the public maintenance sheet.

/story_contents/B041/actors/7/sections/비.en:
While turning the manual cycle, she once rubbed the inscription on one brick until it blurred.

She remembers the depth of that blurred inscription only as a scratch in the handle groove, and covers the groove with her glove whenever she starts a test run.

/story_contents/B041/actors/7/sections/관.en:
When Seo Nayeon brings down her brick-inscription hammer, Ji Yunjae supports only the weight on site.

When Na Ruhui raises generator output, the two agree only on the ice-making power figures and do not discuss the meltwater modification. If Gang Minseo’s sealing-standard stamp is late, Ji Yunjae keeps the parts box locked.

/story_contents/B041/actors/7/sections/3.en:
After the compressor stops, only the manual cycle remains, and the interpreter-counter record number is fixed to the maintenance sheet.

Ji Yunjae’s choice of ending is between entering the ice-making and refrigeration cycles in the merchant-house ledger through a public maintenance sheet and yielding one nighttime power slot to generation.

/story_contents/B041/actors/7/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Ji Yunjae puts the ice-maker and refrigeration compression cycles in the body of the Noryangjin ledger as a public maintenance sheet and deletes the meltwater weight-modification field.

In branch β, he gives one nighttime ice-making power slot to Na Ruhui’s generator, returns a box of unstamped parts to the Gamcheon bonded warehouse, and ties authority to start and stop test runs to Seo Nayeon’s brick-inscription log.

The manual-cycle handle in the Noryangjin machine room is removed in neither choice.

/story_contents/B041/actors/7/arc/0/summ.en: Compressor shutdown during the blackout and rejection of the meltwater modification

/story_contents/B041/actors/7/arc/1/summ.en: Recording temperature alongside brick weight and fixing the interpreter record number

/story_contents/B041/actors/7/arc/2/summ.en: Registering a public maintenance sheet versus yielding a power slot and returning parts

/story_contents/B041/actors/7/outcomes/0.en: Registering the ice-making and refrigeration cycle maintenance sheet; deleting the meltwater modification field

/story_contents/B041/actors/7/outcomes/1.en: Yielding a nighttime power slot; returning unstamped parts; linking access to the inscription log

/story_contents/B041/actors/8/sections/정.en:
Du Bong is a transmitter mechanic for the Yeouido Investment Union. His hands learned to hear backup-power noise before human speech in an Accra harbor shortwave workshop, then came to Sangam through the Songdo shortwave repair shop in Incheon.

As Gwon Mirae’s working-level assistant, his hands grow more precise as the night deepens; if a wire is wound carelessly, he starts that day’s work over.

/story_contents/B041/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
As a tower apprentice, he ran a rotation test on the backup power every day and did not connect a single tower for solo transmission before the programming committee approved it.

The noise-listening skill he learned on the Accra breakwater mingled with the smell of Songdo’s moisture-proof tape and stayed on his tool belt.

/story_contents/B041/actors/8/sections/가.en:
He is listed as the maintenance-duty representative for Magok Seed House’s kitchen broadcasts, but seals the backup-power switch if asked to mix stock locations into broadcast recipes.

Even when he divides up a pay cut and tower duty, Du Bong will not turn on a lone tower without the programming committee.

/story_contents/B041/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
When two edited gaps appeared in the transmission log of Im Hajun’s missing-person recording, Du Bong sealed the backup-power switch with lead.

As the Ghost Dispatch Desk stole the nighttime dispatch line, a note offering a deal to hand over the backup power to Han Gangguk was wedged in the repair-window lock.

/story_contents/B041/actors/8/sections/생.en:
When the rotation-test times and edited-gap fields were posted beside the rotation sheet, the sentence blaming the Propaganda Bureau was erased.

When Gwon Mirae opened the transmitter for inspection, Du Bong fixed the XT02-SC3 ice-credit relay-window identifier beside the lead seal. He deferred Bae Woojin’s demand for a power cutoff by recording it only in the technical-fault field.

/story_contents/B041/actors/8/sections/현.en:
At the Sangam transmission tower’s repair window, Du Bong sets the rotation order by the pitch of the backup-power noise.

When a solo-transmission plug arrives, he does not break the lead seal until the programming committee’s stamp is in place.

Even when the Food Culture Alliance presses to put kitchen broadcasts on the official channel, he does not mix stock locations into the recipes.

/story_contents/B041/actors/8/sections/비.en:
While melting a lead seal, he once joined a gap field to a test time with a single stroke.

He remembers the length of that stroke only as a lead stain on the repair window, and covers the stain with a rag whenever he begins a rotation test.

/story_contents/B041/actors/8/sections/관.en:
When Gwon Mirae opens the transmitter cover, Du Bong picks up only the faulty terminal with his gloved hand.

When Gam Bong rings the tower-duty bell twice, the two align only the rotation-test times and never mention solo transmission. When Bae Woojin’s power-cutoff notice arrives, Du Bong defers it in the technical-fault field and stamps the lead seal again.

/story_contents/B041/actors/8/sections/3.en:
After the two edited gaps come to light, the backup switch is sealed with lead, and the ice-credit relay-window identifier is fixed beside it.

Du Bong’s choice of ending is between entering a multi-node network that divides backup power among three locations in the works ledger and partially opening the seal to Han Gangguk’s duty shift.

/story_contents/B041/actors/8/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Du Bong enters the backup power for the Sangam–Changdong multi-transmitter network in the public works ledger on a three-branch rotation and deletes the single-tower solo-transmission field.

In branch β, with programming committee approval, he hands one circuit of the sealed switch to Gangguk’s duty shift, redistributes one nighttime maintenance shift with Gam Bong, and ties authority to revise the rotation test to a page of Gwon Mirae’s transmission log.

The lead-seal mark on the repair window is scraped away in neither branch.

/story_contents/B041/actors/8/arc/0/summ.en: Two edited gaps and a lead seal on the backup switch

/story_contents/B041/actors/8/arc/1/summ.en: Recording rotation tests alongside gap numbers and fixing the relay-window identifier

/story_contents/B041/actors/8/arc/2/summ.en: Registering a three-branch multi-node network versus partially opening a circuit and redistributing a shift

/story_contents/B041/actors/8/outcomes/0.en: Registering three-branch backup power; deleting the solo-transmission field

/story_contents/B041/actors/8/outcomes/1.en: Partially opening a sealed circuit; redistributing nighttime maintenance; linking access to the transmission log

/story_contents/B041/actors/9/sections/정.en:
Harbor Crane is a crane-class synthetic unit that reads container torsion from boom angles in the loading bay at the end of Sangam’s turnaround track.

It retains only shift-length snapshots, not complete long-term memory. When its counterweight battery charge enters the warning range, it pushes Yeouido Second Water Purification control packets into the discard queue and extends its arm only within the tide-bound hoisting window.

/story_contents/B041/actors/9/sections/붕.en:
During its commissioning cycle, Harbor Crane was locked to retain twistlock engagement counts and tide times only as a single end-of-shift hash line.

A restriction forbidding it to call the Second Water Purification cooling-pump socket even when its wire-drum allocation runs out is embedded in its base image.

/story_contents/B041/actors/9/sections/가.en:
It records bay-access bits only under the Yeouido Computing House cooling building’s observer seal and returns transfer packets lacking three-party signatures with a rejection code.

Before it recognizes Hwang Eunseol’s lead-maintenance glove tag, it moves the boom only for fine horizontal adjustments.

/story_contents/B041/actors/9/sections/붕.en:
On a shift when the West Sea tide receded twenty minutes ahead of the drainage schedule, the load cell screamed while the transmission-case container’s twistlocks remained engaged.

Harbor Crane discarded a forced-hoisting packet demanding access to the yard-wide inventory network and kept only the bay key. Just before boom vibrations exposed a classification tag the Night Sorting Unit had wedged in a lock groove, it dropped into offline isolation.

/story_contents/B041/actors/9/sections/생.en:
When the tide time and engagement count were bound into one frame, the route to the yard inventory network was blocked.

When Eo Yerin opened the test-wheel defect testimony terminal, Harbor Crane recorded the XT02-SC1 dock drainage schedule window in the hoisting-authorization field. Even when Hwang Eunseol applied the charge-status pad, it did not overwrite the previous day’s fork image.

/story_contents/B041/actors/9/sections/현.en:
In the bay on Sangam’s turnaround track, Harbor Crane shortens its hoisting cycle according to the movement of the load cell at the boom tip.

When a packet requesting access to the yard inventory network arrives, it emits only a brief rejection tone and drops every permission bit outside the zone network.

Even when the wire runs low, it does not begin scanning the Second Water Purification cooling socket.

/story_contents/B041/actors/9/sections/비.en:
During those twenty minutes when the locks would not release, one frame number marks its failure to put an engagement bit in the human-approval log.

That number remains only in the counterweight’s temporary area, and it displays it solely through flashes of the boom-tip LED when requesting a partial reconnection.

/story_contents/B041/actors/9/sections/관.en:
When Hwang Eunseol applies the counterweight charge-status pad, Harbor Crane returns only today’s hoisting-cycle count to the terminal.

When Eo Yerin reads the wheel-defect time aloud, it writes only the overlapping hoisting window to its read buffer. Until the Electronics Institute audit observer’s stamp arrives, it does not release the transmission-case coordinate field.

/story_contents/B041/actors/9/sections/3.en:
After the tide recedes early and the twistlock refuses to release, the drainage schedule window is attached to the hoisting-authorization field.

Harbor Crane’s choice of ending is between entering a tide-linked hoisting standard in the duty log and resting the boom on the water while passing only the transmission-case coordinates to Hwang Eunseol’s session.

/story_contents/B041/actors/9/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Harbor Crane makes the tide-linked hoisting window and twistlock rejection count public in the duty log and locks the yard-inventory-network permission flag to a permanent block.

In branch β, it obtains approval to rest the boom on the water for one cycle, partially restores the transmission-case coordinates to Hwang Eunseol’s session, and aligns the bay-key renewal window with the wheel-defect time slot on Eo Yerin’s testimony terminal.

The Mapo Union turnaround-track crane’s line of bay-key authority is revoked in neither branch.

/story_contents/B041/actors/9/arc/0/summ.en: Drainage preceded by the tide’s retreat, twistlock rejection, and disposal of the yard-network packet

/story_contents/B041/actors/9/arc/1/summ.en: Combining tide time and engagement count and fixing drainage-schedule hoisting authorization

/story_contents/B041/actors/9/arc/2/summ.en: Publishing a tide-linked standard versus resting the boom on the water and partially restoring transmission-case coordinates

/story_contents/B041/actors/9/outcomes/0.en: Publishing tide-linked hoisting; recording twistlock rejections; blocking the yard inventory network

/story_contents/B041/actors/9/outcomes/1.en: Resting the boom on the water; partially restoring transmission-case coordinates; linking key renewal to the wheel-defect time

/story_contents/B042/actors/0/sections/정.en:
Geun Soli was a Neutral Convoy City failed-auction official who, in the Neutral Market beside the Sinnae platform, read the sway of an empty scale before the failure bell.

When a bid document stamped with a military-supply emblem arrived wrapped up as a market price, he pushed the broker out from behind the scale.

/story_contents/B042/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
As a transfer apprentice he only repeated the work of writing the highest bid and the failure time on the left and right sides of the wall.

The habit of erasing blank winning bids before the faces in the credit ledger stayed in his finger joints.

/story_contents/B042/actors/0/sections/가.en:
His name stood in the Noryangjin Delivery House's auction seating, yet when O Haerin's price broadcast strayed outside market hours he did not open the emergency-supplies column.

Until Bok Yong's Sinnae price bell and Heung Yena's Garak failed-lot items pointed to the same lot, he did not raise the re-auction token.

/story_contents/B042/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
When the day's third Water Compact expired and prices surged, Geun Soli let three emergency-supply auctions fail and bound the scale beam with a padlock.

On the night the Night-Sorting Swarm mixed the labels in the lower alleys, a preemption note wedged into the failure bell's hole tried to buy up the floor prices all at once.

/story_contents/B042/actors/0/sections/생.en:
He rewrote the failure times and highest bids on the wall and sealed the weapon-emblem bid documents until Bok Yong's posting.

When the XT04-SC1 freight-car weight log crossed into the Sinnae transfer slot, he left only the emergency column in the public re-auction queue and put the great-power preemption token away in a drawer.

/story_contents/B042/actors/0/sections/현.en:
Beneath the Sinnae market wall, Geun Soli halted the auction whenever the empty scale's needle trembled even a single notch.

When a preemption broker spread the credit ledger open, he read out only the failed-bid ledger's page count and covered the winning-bid seal.

/story_contents/B042/actors/0/sections/비.en:
Once, right after the third failure, he locked the scale's notches one notch late.

In that interval one blank cell leaked away under a great-power-side alias, and he left that day's needle position only as a pencil mark inside his sleeve.

/story_contents/B042/actors/0/sections/관.en:
Whenever Bok Yong struck the Neutral Market's price bell once, Geun Soli rewrote the failure time on the wall in large letters.

When Heung Yena spread the item column of the Garak failed-bid ledger, the two matched lot numbers by finger alone, and when O Haerin's price broadcast eyed hours outside market time, Geun Soli wound the microphone cable around the scale's leg.

/story_contents/B042/actors/0/sections/3.en:
Where the scale stood locked, a public re-auction queue formed, and the weight log was aligned with the transfer slot.

Geun Soli's final choice split between erasing the preemption column from the ledger and lending the preemption side one slot of the night-alley carts.

/story_contents/B042/actors/0/sections/분.en:
In the failure-disclosure ending, Geun Soli raised the failed-bid ledger into a mandatory clause of the public re-auction and erased the great-power preemption column in ink.

In the slot-concession ending he handed one slot of the night-alley carts to the preemption side, entrusted one scale-lock key to Bok Yong's stronghold vault, and aligned the re-auction amendment authority with the last four digits of Heung Yena's Garak ledger.

The three-stop tally strokes on the Sinnae failure wall were not erased even after the agreement ended.

/story_contents/B042/actors/0/arc/0/summ.en: Three failed emergency-supply auctions and the scale beam locked

/story_contents/B042/actors/0/arc/1/summ.en: Weight-log and transfer-slot collation, and the preemption token sealed

/story_contents/B042/actors/0/arc/2/summ.en: Deleting the preemption column versus conceding the night-cart slot

/story_contents/B042/actors/0/outcomes/0.en: Failed-bid ledger fixed into the public re-auction, and the great-power preemption column deleted

/story_contents/B042/actors/0/outcomes/1.en: Night-alley cart slot conceded, and the scale key transferred to Bok Yong's vault

/story_contents/B042/actors/1/sections/정.en:
Geun Wooram was a Medical Neutrality League military-household-register treatment-refusal witness who, at the foot of a Jegi-dong cot, folded family-unit service-registration notes into evidence of refused treatment.

The officer told to read the household register before the cot drew back the wrist that tried to correct the document's date.

/story_contents/B042/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
As a dispensing assistant she trained only in writing the refusal time and the cot number on the same line.

She kept greetings brief, and formed the habit of shoving notes that demanded corrections before the ink dried down under the drawer.

/story_contents/B042/actors/1/sections/가.en:
She sat in the Jegi-dong Healing Gate's witness seating, yet did not carry the refusal ledger out the door until Jeong Harin's prescription double-check was finished.

She divided Jeon Sol's patient-assignment queue from the refusal queue, but took no seal from the military-tally counter.

/story_contents/B042/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
During the creation oral record's military-household-register dispute, when the Amsa military faction pushed family registration up to the cots, Geun Wooram left that scene in the witness box and shoved the forced-registration counter out the door.

At the hour the Custom-Medicine Remnant Bodies mixed medication labels with patient names, the refusal records came close to being cut short like a deserter roster.

/story_contents/B042/actors/1/sections/생.en:
She made Gang Minseo's restoration-service citizenship solidarity the backbone of her testimony and refused Bae Woojin's family-service demand before the cot.

When the XT04-SC2 winter fuel queue pushed frostbite patients into the Jegi-dong infirmary, she left only the severity tags and covered the military-tally column.

/story_contents/B042/actors/1/sections/현.en:
At the Jegi-dong clinic door, Geun Wooram stopped testifying whenever a refusal time failed to match the previous day's ledger.

Even when a Healing Gate errand arrived carrying the tracking-compass emblem, she took no note without the re-signatures of the two who were on duty at the time.

/story_contents/B042/actors/1/sections/비.en:
There was a line on which she wrote the cot number one cell late on her first day of testimony.

During that delay one officer-network note slid under a patient's blanket, and every time she testified in public she covered that cell's pencil marks with her palm.

/story_contents/B042/actors/1/sections/관.en:
When Gang Minseo read out the citizenship-solidarity wording, Geun Wooram rewrote only the refusal ledger's first line.

When Bae Woojin set down his family-service iron tablet, the two confirmed only cot numbers and left the household-register story unspoken, and when Jeon Sol divided the patient assignments, Geun Wooram took the queue only after pocketing the military-tally counter's pen.

/story_contents/B042/actors/1/sections/3.en:
After the cot refusal was entered in the ledger, the severity tags covered the military-tally column, and the frostbite-patient queue was pinned to the infirmary's side.

Geun Wooram's close split between raising the refusal ledger into the solidarity disclosure and placing one line of the testimony copy into the military faction's reading box.

/story_contents/B042/actors/1/sections/분.en:
In the refusal-disclosure ending, Geun Wooram raised the forced-registration refusal records into a mandatory clause of the council ledger and deleted the deserter-roster column.

In the reading-concession ending the officer network read one line of the copy in return, the cot-tracking authority was locked to Jeon Sol's duty hours, and the solidarity wording's amendment was aligned with Gang Minseo's signature hash.

The time lines of the Jegi-dong cot refusals were not inked over even after the agreement ended.

/story_contents/B042/actors/1/arc/0/summ.en: Family-registration refusal before the cot and the forced-registration counter driven out

/story_contents/B042/actors/1/arc/1/summ.en: Severity tags fixed and the frostbite-patient queue covered

/story_contents/B042/actors/1/arc/2/summ.en: Refusal-ledger disclosure versus conceding one line of the copy for reading

/story_contents/B042/actors/1/outcomes/0.en: Forced-registration refusal records entered in the council ledger, and the deserter column deleted

/story_contents/B042/actors/1/outcomes/1.en: Officer network reads one line of the copy, and cot-tracking authority locked to Jeon Sol's duty hours

/story_contents/B042/actors/2/sections/정.en:
Seok Jua was a Gate Military Government Sixteen-Banners gate-accreditation official who, on the Guui ridge, remembered even the fold marks of the charter copies.

Asked to make a late accreditation retroactive, he locked the chest and turned back from the gate any hand that reached to alter a date.

/story_contents/B042/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
As a ridge-clerk apprentice he wrote the banner accreditation dates and the passage customs in separate columns of the wall.

The habit stayed in his wrist of laying down the brush whenever a retroactive-ratification request arrived unless both witnesses of the time signed again.

/story_contents/B042/actors/2/sections/가.en:
His name stood in the Hangangjin Bridge Council's accreditation seating, yet he did not open the chest when the founding-accreditation chest Go Seojun entrusted to him drifted from the customs-closure standard.

Until Yun Seorin's Seoul Station accreditation date and Sim Gaeun's joint-approval storage cycle lined up, he took no post-facto sealing request.

/story_contents/B042/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
When the Sixteen Banners of the creation oral record were declared, Seok Jua folded the gate charters that had received Seoul Station accreditation and the passage customs that had not into the chest separately.

On the night the Flood-Boar Swarm tore up the ridge soil, a great-power protection emblem was moments from being overpainted on the chest lid.

/story_contents/B042/actors/2/sections/생.en:
He rewrote the banner accreditation dates on the ridge wall and tied retroactive-ratification requests to witnesses appearing again in person.

When the XT01-SC3 forged bloodline certificate arrived together with an Achasan seal-key fragment, Seok Jua disclosed only the folded list and moved the original chest over toward the bridge inspection path.

/story_contents/B042/actors/2/sections/현.en:
At the Guui gate sentry post, Seok Jua closed the accreditation counter whenever a charter's fold marks differed from the previous day.

Even when a Bridge Council errand set a protection-emblem overpainting down before the chest, he gave up no chest unless the witnesses present at the time signed again.

/story_contents/B042/actors/2/sections/비.en:
Once, while folding the passage-customs sheet, he smudged one line of the edge with his finger.

He measured that day's smudged length only with the short ruler hidden in the bottom of the chest, and every time the accreditation was read he covered the ruler with his sleeve.

/story_contents/B042/actors/2/sections/관.en:
When Go Seojun laid the founding-accreditation chest's key on the table, Seok Jua rewrote only the banner accreditation dates on the wall.

When Yun Seorin read out the Seoul Station accreditation date, the two matched only the fold marks and never spoke of protection emblems, and when Sim Gaeun's joint-approval documents arrived still wet, Seok Jua put the post-facto sealing brush into the drawer before hanging them on the drying rack.

/story_contents/B042/actors/2/sections/3.en:
After the folded charters were divided between chests, the accreditation dates went up on the ridge wall and the seal-key fragment moved to the bridge inspection path.

Seok Jua's final choice split between discarding the overpainting request and handing one line of post-facto sealing to the ridge-side protection envoy.

/story_contents/B042/actors/2/sections/분.en:
In the original-keeping ending, Seok Jua wrote that the banner accreditation originals were valid only inside the Guui chest and deleted the post-facto sealing column.

In the sealing-concession ending he took down one line of the protection emblem only after the meeting closed, entrusted one chest key to Go Seojun's customs journal, and aligned the accreditation-date amendment with the page count of Yun Seorin's merit roll.

The Sixteen-Banners accreditation dates on the ridge wall were not chalked over even after the agreement ended.

/story_contents/B042/actors/2/arc/0/summ.en: Separate storage of the banner charters and the passage customs

/story_contents/B042/actors/2/arc/1/summ.en: Accreditation dates fixed on the wall and the seal key moved to the bridge

/story_contents/B042/actors/2/arc/2/summ.en: Deleting the post-facto sealing column versus conceding one line of the protection emblem

/story_contents/B042/actors/2/outcomes/0.en: Accreditation valid only in the Guui chest, and the post-facto sealing column deleted

/story_contents/B042/actors/2/outcomes/1.en: One line of the protection emblem accepted after the meeting, and the chest key transferred to the customs journal

/story_contents/B042/actors/3/sections/정.en:
Seok Oreum was a Cathedral Accreditation State convoy-bidding failure witness who, at the Garak convoy counter, counted the strands of a bid-chest seal cord by eye.

When a rumor ran that the secret officer network had moved the wagon, he cut apart the numbers and the blank winning bids first in the witness box.

/story_contents/B042/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
As a rationing apprentice he only wrote the bid times and the winning bidders on the left and right pages of the same book.

The habit stayed on the back of his hand of pocketing the stamp whenever a number without a starting price surfaced on the blackboard.

/story_contents/B042/actors/3/sections/가.en:
He sat in the Yongsan Convoy House's bidding seating, yet did not move the failure notes out of the waiting hall until Mun Doyun's convoy-bid posting opened.

Until Park Taegyeom's dispatch-investigation hour was stamped as the witness box's anchor, he did not carry Bae Woojin's officer-network rumor into the ledger.

/story_contents/B042/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
When the winter black dispatch table opened, Seok Oreum testified that the Amsa-made weapons that had come off the medical train and the Garak convoy bid chest had used thread of the same color.

At the hour the Phantom Dispatch Corps shuffled the night-permit numbers, that thread mark was on the verge of reading like a permit emblem covering coup preparations.

/story_contents/B042/actors/3/sections/생.en:
He rewrote the bid times and winning bidders into the same book and kept the seal covered until independent witnesses gathered.

When the XT03-SC2 canned-goods allocation was readjusted at the Garak counter, Seok Oreum fixed the sealing tools' arrival time beside the bid posting and erased the blank winning-bid numbers.

/story_contents/B042/actors/3/sections/현.en:
At the Garak convoy counter, Seok Oreum stopped testifying whenever the seal cord's strand count differed from the previous day's record.

Even when a delivery-corps errand set a post-facto-approval pretext down at the counter, he left the book's right column blank if no independent witnesses gathered.

/story_contents/B042/actors/3/sections/비.en:
There was a line where he recorded the scene of the weapons and the bid chest using the same thread one beat late.

During that beat one blank winning bid leaked away under an officer-network-side alias, and every time he testified he gathered only that line's pencil dust at his fingertip.

/story_contents/B042/actors/3/sections/관.en:
When Mun Doyun raised the convoy-bid posting one column, Seok Oreum rewrote the failure time in large letters.

When Park Taegyeom read out the dispatch-investigation hour, the two matched only the thread strand counts and never spoke the officer network's names, and when Bae Woojin's iron tablet was laid on the counter, Seok Oreum looked at the envelope's edge only after the witness list was filled.

/story_contents/B042/actors/3/sections/3.en:
After the same-color thread attached to the testimony, the sealing tools' time was fixed beside the posting and the blank winning-bid numbers were erased.

Seok Oreum's final choice split between raising the failure-and-winning-bid disclosure into a ledger clause and letting the night-permit counter read one line of post-facto approval.

/story_contents/B042/actors/3/sections/분.en:
In the bidding-disclosure ending, Seok Oreum raised the failures and winning bids into mandatory columns of the Garak ledger and deleted the blank winning-bid numbers.

In the approval-concession ending he took down one line of post-facto approval only after the meeting, handed one night-permit column to the delivery corps' reserve, and aligned the testimony amendment authority with the trailing digits of Mun Doyun's posting serial.

The thread strand count of the Garak bid chest was not erased from the book even after the agreement ended.

/story_contents/B042/actors/3/arc/0/summ.en: Testimony that the medical-train weapons and the bid chest used the same thread

/story_contents/B042/actors/3/arc/1/summ.en: Sealing-tools time fixed and the blank winning bids erased

/story_contents/B042/actors/3/arc/2/summ.en: Failure-and-winning-bid disclosure versus conceding one line of post-facto approval

/story_contents/B042/actors/3/outcomes/0.en: Failures and winning bids entered as mandatory ledger columns, and the blank winning-bid numbers deleted

/story_contents/B042/actors/3/outcomes/1.en: One line of post-facto approval accepted, and a night-permit column transferred to the delivery corps

/story_contents/B042/actors/4/sections/정.en:
Cho Jinsol was a Jeongdong General Labor Union witness investigating the black dispatch trains who, at the Suseo rolling-stock depot, read contract-escort freight-car numbers and shipping-release emblems at a glance.

When a rumor ran that the secret officer network had moved the southern trains, he first checked whether the log stood empty and covered the seal.

/story_contents/B042/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
As a depot apprentice he only wrote the release times and the order emblems on the top and bottom of the same book.

He was taciturn, but he formed the habit of leaving a column blank whenever thread of an unfamiliar color showed on a freight-car handle.

/story_contents/B042/actors/4/sections/가.en:
His name stood in the Sinjeong Wheel House's investigation seating, yet he did not move the release log to the waiting hall until Won Choon's depot duty blackboard opened.

He kept Park Taegyeom's dispatch investigation apart from I Hongwon's succession-test part-tampering rumor in the witness box, but wrote neither name into the ledger before the witnesses gathered.

/story_contents/B042/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
When the black dispatch table dropped into the Suseo release bay, Cho Jinsol testified that thread of the same color used on the medical-train weapons also remained on the handles of the Suseo release freight cars.

At the hour the Surveillance-Orbit Swarm swept across the passing-loop cameras, that thread was on the verge of looking like a permit emblem covering post-facto confirmation.

/story_contents/B042/actors/4/sections/생.en:
He rewrote the release times and order emblems into the book and sealed the third-party-frame-up column blank.

When the XT03-SC1 Yongsan transload warehouse closed one line and Suseo opened an alternate passing loop, Cho Jinsol pinned the passing-loop slot numbers to the head of the duty blackboard and covered the secret-note column.

/story_contents/B042/actors/4/sections/현.en:
At the Suseo release bay, Cho Jinsol stopped testifying whenever a freight-car number differed from the previous day's blackboard.

Even when a mobilization-order errand set a post-facto-approval emblem down before the bay, he left the book's bottom column blank unless two independent witnesses gathered.

/story_contents/B042/actors/4/sections/비.en:
Once, while cutting handle thread into an envelope, he dropped one strand on the floor.

He kept that day's dropped strand tied to nothing but the duty room's key ring, and every time he testified he cupped the ring in his palm.

/story_contents/B042/actors/4/sections/관.en:
When Won Choon erased one column of the depot duty blackboard, Cho Jinsol rewrote only the release times in large letters.

When Park Taegyeom set down a dispatch-investigation note, the two matched only freight-car numbers and passed over the secret dispatch note's contents in silence, and when I Hongwon's test-part rumor came in, Cho Jinsol opened the rumor envelope only after the witness list was filled.

/story_contents/B042/actors/4/sections/3.en:
After the handle thread attached to the testimony, the passing-loop slot was pinned to the head of the blackboard and the secret-note column was covered.

Cho Jinsol's final choice split between disclosing the official orders and the secret notes side by side and passing the post-facto-confirmation emblem over to the contract auditor's desk.

/story_contents/B042/actors/4/sections/분.en:
In the release-disclosure ending, Cho Jinsol raised the official orders and the secret notes into side-by-side columns of the Suseo ledger and deleted the third-party-frame-up column.

In the approval-transfer ending the contract auditor read one line of the post-facto-confirmation emblem, one passing-loop slot was handed to the mobilization order's night reserve, and the testimony amendment was aligned with Won Choon's blackboard serial.

The freight-car number lines of the Suseo release bay were not erased from the blackboard even after the agreement ended.

/story_contents/B042/actors/4/arc/0/summ.en: Collating testimony on the Suseo freight-car handle thread and the medical-train weapons

/story_contents/B042/actors/4/arc/1/summ.en: Alternate passing-loop slots pinned and the secret-note column sealed

/story_contents/B042/actors/4/arc/2/summ.en: Orders and notes disclosed side by side versus transferring post-facto approval to audit

/story_contents/B042/actors/4/outcomes/0.en: Official orders and secret notes entered as side-by-side columns, and the third-party-frame-up column deleted

/story_contents/B042/actors/4/outcomes/1.en: Post-facto approval read by audit, and a passing-loop slot transferred to the mobilization order's night reserve

/story_contents/B042/actors/5/sections/정.en:
Eom Saeul was a Water Compact turbid-water damage-zone representative who, whenever an earthy smell rose from a Yeongdeungpo alley faucet, went around the houses before touching the ledgers.

She did not trust managers who covered turbid water with explanations, and when a child's ration can ran empty she never let the meeting with the Director-General lapse.

/story_contents/B042/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
As a rationing crew leader she only sealed the alley water-quality notes and sent them to the purification process, every day.

The habit stayed in her palm of gathering up every ration-slip seal at once whenever a below-standard reading appeared.

/story_contents/B042/actors/5/sections/가.en:
Her name stood in the Yeongdeungpo Sluice House's damage seating, yet she did not open the compensatory-supply column until Park Nuri's valve lock was confirmed in the alley.

Even in conflict with Han Jaemok's supply-maintenance directives she kept the sluice keys from gathering in one pocket, and opened the counter only after handing a turbid-water sample to Go Choyun in Magok.

/story_contents/B042/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
After the summer downpours pushed the Yeongdeungpo raw water past the standard, Eom Saeul took up the damage roster and declared a collective ration refusal.

On the night the Sewer-Raccoon Pack slipped in and out of the pipe openings, one day of hiding the exceedance would have carried contamination all the way to the Yangcheon reservoir, and a protection contract came close to filling that gap.

/story_contents/B042/actors/5/sections/생.en:
She resealed the alley water-quality notes every day and withdrew the ration-slip seals whenever readings fell below standard.

When the XT02-SC1 Yeouido sluice rebuilt the dock drainage schedule around the West Sea tides, Eom Saeul pinned the tide table beside the damage roster and covered the concealed-inspection column.

/story_contents/B042/actors/5/sections/현.en:
Beneath the Yeongdeungpo alley faucet, Eom Saeul closed the rationing counter whenever the earthy smell differed from the previous day.

Even when a Sluice House errand laid a protection-contract emblem down in the alley, she returned no seal before the sealed sample reached Magok.

/story_contents/B042/actors/5/sections/비.en:
There was a line where she wrote one roster household late on the first day of the collective refusal.

During that delay a child's ration can stood empty, and every time she requested a meeting with the Director-General she pressed that household's door-plate number into the back of her hand.

/story_contents/B042/actors/5/sections/관.en:
When Park Nuri lowered the valve-lock handle one notch, Eom Saeul rewrote the alley note-sealing time.

When Han Jaemok read out the supply-maintenance directives, the two matched only the turbidity figures and never spoke of protection contracts, and when Go Choyun returned the public-copy sample, Eom Saeul opened the envelope only after the ration-slip seals were withdrawn.

/story_contents/B042/actors/5/sections/3.en:
After the ration refusal attached to the roster, the tide table was fixed beside the notes and the concealed-inspection column was covered.

Eom Saeul's final choice split between raising outages and compensatory supply into an automatic roster clause and leaving one line of the inspection gap on the Director-General meeting's table.

/story_contents/B042/actors/5/sections/분.en:
In the roster-automatic ending, Eom Saeul raised turbid-section outages and compensatory supply into clauses that opened along the damage roster and deleted the concealed-inspection column.

In the reading-concession ending the Director-General read one line of the exceedance, one dock-drainage slot was handed to the sluice watch, and the roster amendment was aligned with Go Choyun's public-copy hash.

The earthy-smell note times at the Yeongdeungpo faucet were never left out of the seal even after the agreement ended.

/story_contents/B042/actors/5/arc/0/summ.en: Downpour turbid-water roster refusal and valve-lock solidarity

/story_contents/B042/actors/5/arc/1/summ.en: Tide table pinned and the concealed-inspection column sealed

/story_contents/B042/actors/5/arc/2/summ.en: Automatic outage-and-compensation clauses versus conceding one line for the Director-General to read

/story_contents/B042/actors/5/outcomes/0.en: Turbid-water outages and compensatory supply entered as automatic roster clauses, and the concealed-inspection column deleted

/story_contents/B042/actors/5/outcomes/1.en: One line of the exceedance read by the Director-General, and a dock-drainage slot transferred to the sluice watch

/story_contents/B042/actors/6/sections/정.en:
Ryu Gyeore was a Standards Alliance refugee-intake herald who, before the Geumcheon cutoff gate, counted the children's ration cans before the footprints of the southward procession.

She heard proposals to trade intake for parts payments as insults, and passed routes along briefly and refusals plainly.

/story_contents/B042/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
As a union-herald apprentice she only took the citizens' delegate's and the labor union's seals together on the encampment notes.

The habit stayed on her shoulder strap of never putting a guard-force-only travel pass into her bag.

/story_contents/B042/actors/6/sections/가.en:
Her name stood in the Guro Alloy House's intake seating, yet if Gang Minseo's repair standards turned military-supply-only she did not send the encampment notes out.

She kept the herald post before the cutoff gate unemptied until Han Jion's raw-water-and-food allocation tied into the procession and Baek On's southward march reached the Geumcheon side.

/story_contents/B042/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
When service-contract expirations and food shortages overlapped in the autumn Bukhansan Bogukmun procession, Ryu Gyeore stood before the cutoff gate holding the Guro–Geumcheon encampment notes.

At dawn, while the Abandoned-Dog Iron Pack bored under the cutoff-gate rails, the count of the procession's frozen dead came close to being written into statistics pointing to a raw-water shortage of their own.

/story_contents/B042/actors/6/sections/생.en:
She had the citizens' delegate and the union stamp the intake notes together and pulled the guard-force-only token out of her bag.

After the XT01-SC2 Changdong wheel convoy halted outside the gate and Sinnae opened a detour transfer, Ryu Gyeore wrote the detour time at the head of the encampment note and covered the service re-registration column.

/story_contents/B042/actors/6/sections/현.en:
At the Geumcheon cutoff-gate herald post, Ryu Gyeore opened no gate whenever the count of children's ration cans differed from the previous day's note.

Even when a steel-city errand laid a parts-payment emblem on the herald post, she let no procession through before the morning water lottery ended.

/story_contents/B042/actors/6/sections/비.en:
Once, on the first encamped night, she stopped counting a child's ration can midway and turned her eyes to the footprints.

In that short interval one can went empty, and every time she wrote a refusal message she traced that can's paint flaw with a finger.

/story_contents/B042/actors/6/sections/관.en:
When Han Jion read out the raw-water-and-food allocation figures, Ryu Gyeore corrected only the encampment note's morning-water column.

When Baek On set the southward family roster down on the Geumcheon side, the two matched only children's names and never spoke of service re-registration, and when Jong Harin arrived carrying the encampment hours, Ryu Gyeore took the note only after checking the cutoff-gate rail lock.

/story_contents/B042/actors/6/sections/3.en:
After the note before the cutoff gate was entered, the detour time was written at its head and the service re-registration column was covered.

Ryu Gyeore's final choice split between raising one-night lodging and morning water into a union-lottery clause and pinning one line of the herald route to the Amsa counter's board.

/story_contents/B042/actors/6/sections/분.en:
In the lottery-fixed ending, Ryu Gyeore raised one-night lodging and morning water into a mandatory clause of the union lottery and deleted the service re-registration column.

In the route-concession ending the Amsa-side counter was allowed to read one line of the herald route, one detour-transfer slot was handed to Sinnae dispatch, and the note amendment was aligned with the seal on Baek On's family roster.

The count of children's ration cans at the Geumcheon cutoff gate was not erased from the note even after the agreement ended.

/story_contents/B042/actors/6/arc/0/summ.en: The Guro–Geumcheon encampment notes and the standoff before the cutoff gate

/story_contents/B042/actors/6/arc/1/summ.en: Detour-transfer time entered and the service re-registration column sealed

/story_contents/B042/actors/6/arc/2/summ.en: Union-lottery clause versus conceding one line of the herald route

/story_contents/B042/actors/6/outcomes/0.en: One-night lodging and morning water entered as union-lottery clauses, and the service re-registration column deleted

/story_contents/B042/actors/6/outcomes/1.en: One line of the herald route read by the Amsa counter, and a detour-transfer slot transferred to Sinnae dispatch

/story_contents/B042/actors/7/sections/정.en:
