Du Gam was a Sangha Relief State encampment-stove technician who kept the fires alive with the hand habit of knocking twice on the Eunpyeong encampment flue.

In his mother's notebook the flue-part names stood side by side in Wolof syllables and Hangul, and only after calling a broken damper by those syllables did he reach for its Korean tool name.

/story_contents/B042/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
As an encampment apprentice he only read the stove checklist before the evening rations.

Words thinned at the sight of cold ash, and the habit of blaming whoever had blocked the flue before any talk of efficiency stayed in his throat.

/story_contents/B042/actors/7/sections/가.en:
His name stood in the Bukhansan Bogukmun Return Society's maintenance seating, yet he did not turn the stove to militia-only use before Baek On's public ration hour arrived.

He shared tools with O Hangyeol's fuel-store watch and tended the stove beside Hwang Serin's ration warehouse, but he took no note ordering him to swap the family-reunification roster for the service roster.

/story_contents/B042/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
When the heating fuel shrank to a three-day supply and part of the militia began whispering to open the warehouse side door, Du Gam held out until flue-incident signatures were written by the crew leader and the technician together.

On the night the Radio-Wave Crow Flock tore at the encampment's antenna lines, the maintenance parts nearly opened as a militia-only share.

/story_contents/B042/actors/7/sections/생.en:
He tied the stove and the water pump into a single line of the league toolbox and rewrote the rotation so the fire would not die even without great-power fuel rations.

When the XT01-SC1 Imjin quarantine-station return roster was damaged, Du Gam used the Wolof syllables of his mother's notebook only as a flue-parts comparison table and did not carry them into the bloodline-certificate column.

/story_contents/B042/actors/7/sections/현.en:
Before the encampment stove, Du Gam lit no fire whenever the ash temperature differed from the previous day's checklist.

Even when a Return Society errand laid a militia-only parts emblem down before the stove, he opened no flue before the evening ration bell.

/story_contents/B042/actors/7/sections/비.en:
Once, when he first heard the side-door whispers, he entered one checklist line late.

During that delay one flue clogged, and every time he kept the fire alive he covered that line's broken pencil stroke with a finger.

/story_contents/B042/actors/7/sections/관.en:
When O Hangyeol turned the fuel-store lock one notch, Du Gam corrected only the stove checklist's flue column.

When Hwang Serin read out the warehouse-side stove temperature, the two matched only the ash heights and never spoke of the side door, and when Baek On struck the ration bell, Du Gam kept the fire alive only after receiving fuel notes that were not on the family roster.

/story_contents/B042/actors/7/sections/3.en:
After the side-door whispers were blocked, the league toolbox rotation attached, and the damaged return roster and the flue comparison table were fixed side by side.

Du Gam's final choice split between binding the stove and the pump with league tools and handing flue parts to one column of militia duty.

/story_contents/B042/actors/7/sections/분.en:
In the league-tools ending, Du Gam raised the encampment stove and the water pump into a mandatory line of league tools and deleted the militia-only parts column.

In the duty-concession ending the militia watch was allowed to use one flue-parts column, one warehouse side-door key was entrusted to Hwang Serin's ration scale, and the checklist amendment was aligned with O Hangyeol's fuel-store serial.

The double-knock mark on the Eunpyeong encampment flue was not erased from the checklist even after the agreement ended.

/story_contents/B042/actors/7/arc/0/summ.en: Three days of fuel and the side-door whispers stopped

/story_contents/B042/actors/7/arc/1/summ.en: League toolbox rotation fixed and the Wolof comparison table restricted

/story_contents/B042/actors/7/arc/2/summ.en: The mandatory league-tools line versus conceding one militia-duty parts column

/story_contents/B042/actors/7/outcomes/0.en: Stove and pump entered as a mandatory league-tools line, and the militia-only parts column deleted

/story_contents/B042/actors/7/outcomes/1.en: One flue-parts column conceded to militia duty, and the side-door key transferred to the ration scale

/story_contents/B042/actors/8/sections/정.en:
Du Mo was a Seocho Computing Group wheel technician who read pitch at the Changdong repair shop by humming the French numeral tones of bearing stamps.

Her father had moved gauge stamps onto Korean notes in a subcontract shop, and only after counting screws by those tones did Du Mo take Song Hayul's apprentice routine into her hands.

/story_contents/B042/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
In her first apprentice year she only pinned the maintenance journal to the elders' board with her own hands.

She counted the sneaking-away of other people's tools as the same offense as test fraud, and could not stomach a crew leader who passed defect specimens along without cutting them.

/story_contents/B042/actors/8/sections/가.en:
Her name stood in the Changdong Protection House's field seating, yet she laid no hand on the house-succession wheels until I Hongwon's public technical-test wheels came up the priority line.

Even when she was rotated into Jo Woochan's work crew, the note ordering her to hand the cutoff-gate remote key to the escort corps never left the toolbox.

/story_contents/B042/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
When an intentionally shaved bearing turned up in the leading successor's test wheel, Du Mo sealed her own toolbox.

At the hour the Retired-Line Maintenance-Train Corps scraped same-lot iron stock off the retired cars on the siding, the hidden defect came close to remaining behind as her own tool marks and becoming the pretext for handing the base over to the residents' delegate.

/story_contents/B042/actors/8/sections/생.en:
She cut the defective part and kept it as a specimen, and pinned the maintenance journal back to the board.

When Changdong divided the XT04-SC2 winter fuel queue, Du Mo used the French numeral tones only for bearing-pitch collation and did not carry them into the fuel-ledger column.

/story_contents/B042/actors/8/sections/현.en:
At the Changdong repair shop, Du Mo stopped signing whenever a test wheel's cut surface differed from the previous day's specimen.

Even when a defense-order errand arrived carrying the house-succession wheels, she opened no cover before the toolbox seal received Jo Woochan's and Song Hayul's cross-confirmation.

/story_contents/B042/actors/8/sections/비.en:
A cell remained where she had copied the specimen number one beat late when she first picked up the shaved bearing.

During that delay one piece of same-lot iron stock slipped away toward Yongsan, and every time she pinned up the journal she covered that number's broken pencil stroke.

/story_contents/B042/actors/8/sections/관.en:
When Song Hayul set down the apprentice-routine note, Du Mo corrected only the test wheel's priority line.

When Jo Woochan moved the rotation blackboard one column, the two matched only toolbox seal numbers and never spoke of house succession, and when I Hongwon pushed the public test wheels forward, Du Mo opened the cover only after the cut specimen was posted.

/story_contents/B042/actors/8/sections/3.en:
After the toolbox was sealed, the cut specimen was pinned to the board and the winter fuel queue and the pitch collation were kept apart.

Du Mo's final choice split between completing the test wheel under her own signature and entrusting one toolbox key to the elders' board drawer.

/story_contents/B042/actors/8/sections/분.en:
In the signature-completion ending, Du Mo raised the public technical-test wheels into a clause completed under her own signature and deleted the house-succession wheels column.

In the key-concession ending an elder was allowed to read one toolbox key, one piece of the cut specimen was handed to Jo Woochan's incident record, and the journal amendment was aligned with Song Hayul's apprentice-note serial.

The shaved-bearing specimen numbers of the Changdong repair shop were not taken down from the board even after the agreement ended.

/story_contents/B042/actors/8/arc/0/summ.en: The shaved bearing found and the toolbox sealed

/story_contents/B042/actors/8/arc/1/summ.en: Cut specimen posted and pitch collation kept apart from the fuel column

/story_contents/B042/actors/8/arc/2/summ.en: Test-wheel signature completion versus an elder reading the toolbox key

/story_contents/B042/actors/8/outcomes/0.en: Public test wheels entered as a clause completed under her own signature, and the house-succession column deleted

/story_contents/B042/actors/8/outcomes/1.en: Toolbox key read by an elder, and a cut-specimen piece transferred to the incident record

/story_contents/B042/actors/9/sections/정.en:
The Dock Shuttle was a mobilization-grade synthetic chassis that ran back and forth only over the Bukhansan Bogukmun loading bay's battery slots and lane sensors.

It used no memory beyond the length of a shift snapshot, and when its remaining charge entered the warning band it pushed other-zone control packets into the discard queue and kept only the bay-key single channel.

/story_contents/B042/actors/9/sections/붕.en:
In its early deployment cycles the Dock Shuttle was locked so that a fork left only a single shift-end hash line in the log.

Even when the worn-parts allocation neared empty, the limit built into its base image kept it from seeking neighboring substation sockets.

/story_contents/B042/actors/9/sections/가.en:
Only under the Sinjeong Wheel House's citizen-observation seal did it leave entry bits in the duty log, and transfer requests without three-party signatures went back as rejection codes.

Until Hwang Serin's periodic-maintenance glove tag was recognized, it moved the cover-lock motor only for fine sensor-direction adjustment.

/story_contents/B042/actors/9/sections/붕.en:
On the shift when the loading-bay alarm rang three times in a row, a packet mass demanding facility-wide network opening filled the receive buffer.

The Dock Shuttle folded the mass into single-item bay-key responses and sent them back, and above the vibration frequency of the Iron-Scale Colony scraping the floor plates it dropped into offline isolation mode just before the cross-route allow flag flipped.

/story_contents/B042/actors/9/sections/생.en:
As it appended the day's snapshot length and the storage-seal hash to a single frame header, the long-term fork paths closed.

When An Dohan opened the Sinnae transfer-slot terminal, the Dock Shuttle wrote the XT01-SC1 quarantine-roster reissue-window identifier into the bay-key auxiliary field, and when Hwang Serin applied the charge pad the earlier shift image was not overwritten.

/story_contents/B042/actors/9/sections/현.en:
In the loading bay the Dock Shuttle scaled its round-trip cycle against the dust deposition height over the lane sensors.

When a facility-wide network-opening packet arrived it emitted only a short rejection tone and dropped every permission bit outside the bay-key field.

Even with the parts allocation near empty it never began a scan of the adjacent facilities' control sockets.

/story_contents/B042/actors/9/sections/비.en:
There was a frame number whose one line of cross-route residual hash, left in the receive buffer just before isolation, never made it into the human-approval log.

That number survived only in temporary storage, and when partial reconnection was requested it was signaled only through the count of status-light blinks.

/story_contents/B042/actors/9/sections/관.en:
When Hwang Serin pressed the charge pad to the slot contacts, the Dock Shuttle returned only that day's shift snapshot length to the terminal.

When An Dohan read a transfer-slot number aloud it wrote only that value into the read buffer and sounded one confirmation tone, and until the mobilization-order audit witness stamp bit arrived it raised no transfer-field flag.

/story_contents/B042/actors/9/sections/3.en:
After the alarm shift left only the bay key behind, the snapshot and the seal hash merged into one header, and the quarantine-reissue window identifier was written into the auxiliary field.

The Dock Shuttle's final branch divided between the path that disclosed the zone operation standard in the duty log and the path that accepted a maintenance sleep cycle and put off reconnection.

/story_contents/B042/actors/9/sections/분.en:
In the operation-disclosure ending, the Dock Shuttle published the zone's continuous-operation standard and the blank hash in the duty log and locked the cross-facility route allow flag to permanent block.

In the sleep-recovery ending it was approved for one maintenance sleep cycle, partially restored the sealed map's warehouse coordinates into Hwang Serin's session, and aligned the bay-key renewal window with An Dohan's transfer-terminal time slot.

The bay-key permission stem of the Yeouido-line loading-bay round trips was deleted on neither branch.

/story_contents/B042/actors/9/arc/0/summ.en: Facility-wide requests shrunk and the zone key answered item by item

/story_contents/B042/actors/9/arc/1/summ.en: Snapshot and seal hash combined and the quarantine-window identifier recorded

/story_contents/B042/actors/9/arc/2/summ.en: Operation-standard disclosure versus maintenance sleep and partial session recovery

/story_contents/B042/actors/9/outcomes/0.en: Zone operation standard and blank hash disclosed, and the cross-route block fixed permanently

/story_contents/B042/actors/9/outcomes/1.en: Maintenance sleep and sealed coordinates partially recovered, and the transfer-terminal linked key renewed

/story_contents/B043/actors/0/sections/정.en:
Ryu Haneul is the emergency-authority clerk for Yangjae Machineworks Company during the Great Blackout, timing the moment the Magok Emergency Committee archive lamp goes out by the second hand of her watch.

When a note tells her to fill a communications gap with oral testimony, she marks only the return field with a red line and puts down her pen.

/story_contents/B043/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
As an archive assistant, she recorded the time authority was exercised on the left of a note and the time it was returned on the right, distinguishing them only to the minute.

She called the practice of keeping the emergency seal overnight an enemy of the log, and retained the habit of locking the reading window herself if even one stored copy was missing.

/story_contents/B043/actors/0/sections/가.en:
His name is on the list of emergency attendees for the Magok Life family, but he does not write a provision opening the research building on its own before the three-party deliberation box is closed.

He enters the return clause only in a field where Jeong Hojun’s safety-review veto remains in force, and does not comply if Yun Seorin’s ratification leaves the return-time field blank.

/story_contents/B043/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
On the night regional power stopped in Collapse Year 0, a military supervisor’s notice seeking to redesignate the research building as an emergency facility arrived first.

Ryu Haneul recorded the exercise of authority and its return time, to the minute, across three copies. As a Cleanroom Mutant tore apart the airlock filter, one copy of the return record was on the verge of being read as a form for a junior officer’s post.

/story_contents/B043/actors/0/sections/생.en:
She decided not to turn the reading key until the research director, the safety reviewer, and the residents’ representative each held a copy.

When Im Sion presented a blank in the archive’s return log, she entered the time but did not copy over the authority provision, and fixed the XT05-SC3 orbital-terminal false-alarm correction number at the top of the emergency log.

/story_contents/B043/actors/0/sections/현.en:
At the threshold of the Magok archive, Ryu Haneul suspends reading for the day if the lamp’s afterglow falls out of step with the second hand.

Even if a military supervisor’s redesignation provision arrives, she does not break the seal if the three-party box weighs differently from the day before.

Even when an HC03 summons demands the research building’s exclusive personnel list, she discloses only the return-time field.

/story_contents/B043/actors/0/sections/비.en:
The time she sealed the residents’ representative’s copy one field late is marked as a dot inside her sleeve.

During that delay, an officer peered through the reading window; when she speaks of lawful authority, she covers only that dot with her thumb.

/story_contents/B043/actors/0/sections/관.en:
When Im Sion opens the archive box, Ryu Haneul rewrites only the first line of the return log in large letters.

When Jeong Hojun turns the three-party deliberation seal face down on the desk, the two use their fingers to match only the emergency-clause number. If Yun Seorin’s ratification box arrives wet, Ryu Haneul puts the military redesignation wording in his pocket before drying the return-time field.

/story_contents/B043/actors/0/sections/3.en:
After the minute-by-minute log is split into three copies, the false-alarm correction number is attached at the top, and the reading-key rule is fixed.

Ryu Haneul’s final choice divides between making the return ledger a mandatory public provision and yielding one nighttime power slot to the supervisors.

/story_contents/B043/actors/0/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Ryu Haneul enters the Great Blackout authority-return time in a mandatory field of the Research Council’s public ledger and deletes the enforcement field for redesignation as an emergency facility.

In branch β, he hands one nighttime power slot to the military supervisor on duty and yields one spare box of airlock filters to the HC03 audit, while synchronizing reading access with the time of Jeong Hojun’s three-party seal.

Neither choice erases the authority over the return-time field in the Magok emergency log.

/story_contents/B043/actors/0/arc/0/summ.en: Chalking the three-copy log and concealing the redesignation notice

/story_contents/B043/actors/0/arc/1/summ.en: Fixing the false-alarm correction number and the three-part reading-key rule

/story_contents/B043/actors/0/arc/2/summ.en: Entering the return ledger versus yielding a nighttime power slot

/story_contents/B043/actors/0/outcomes/0.en: Mandatory public entry of the return time; deletion of the emergency-facility redesignation field

/story_contents/B043/actors/0/outcomes/1.en: Yielding a nighttime power slot and filter box; reading access linked to the three-party seal

/story_contents/B043/actors/1/sections/정.en:
Bae Nagyeong is the water-supply contract-expiration negotiation clerk for Seolgyo Myeongbujeong, reading expiration times from the needle of the pump pressure gauge at the Seongsu negotiating table.

When she sees the chief administrator’s empty signature field, she puts down her pen and erases only the wording that recasts an acting official’s seal as an extension.

/story_contents/B043/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
As an apprentice workshop clerk, she used different ink colors for the Ttukseom and Yeouido copies and did not file an extension sealed on only one side.

She called nights when pump pressure fell before the contract wording did evidence of expiration, and her habit of trusting the gauge over people’s words hardened.

/story_contents/B043/actors/1/sections/가.en:
She attends negotiations for the Guro Alloy family, but does not accept a provision on intervention by a major power into the body of the expiration ledger before the Workshop Council’s public ledger is opened.

Before Han Somi’s joint-governance proposal reaches the signature field, she exchanges only expiration copies with Bae Chodam and keeps the guarantor field for the missing Im Hajun blank.

/story_contents/B043/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
On the morning the third water-supply contract ended amid the chief administrator’s disappearance, the seal of an acting official sent by the Protectorate government slid onto the Seongsu table.

Bae Nagyeong tied the guarantor field shut with sealing cord and refused the seal. As the Sewer Raccoonfolk burrowed into the Seongsu side drain, the blank signature field was on the verge of being read as a consent form.

/story_contents/B043/actors/1/sections/생.en:
When she wrote the expiration time on the same line as the pump pressure, the automatic-extension provision was pushed off the copy.

When Bae Chodam handed her the Yeouido ink copy, Bae Nagyeong fixed the XT03-SC2 sealed-tool allocation number high on the negotiating-room wall and clipped only Han Somi’s joint-governance proposal beside the signature field.

/story_contents/B043/actors/1/sections/현.en:
At the Seongsu negotiating table, Bae Nagyeong closes the counter when the pressure-gauge needle reaches the expiration mark.

If she sees an acting official’s seal, she picks up an eraser first and restores that field to a blank.

Even if a messenger from Cheolseong brings an extension provision, she does not file it unless the ink matches on both sides.

/story_contents/B043/actors/1/sections/비.en:
While tying the sealing cord, she once smudged the edge of the guarantor field with her finger.

During that time, one more note from the acting official’s side slipped in; when she speaks of expiration, she hides only the loose strand of the cord’s knot with her sleeve.

/story_contents/B043/actors/1/sections/관.en:
When Han Somi turns the joint-governance proposal token face down on the table, Bae Nagyeong opens only the signature field and calls out the expiration time.

When Bae Chodam’s Yeouido copy arrives, the two compare the ink colors side by side. When they point to Im Hajun’s empty guarantor field, they confirm that it is blank only with their pen caps closed.

/story_contents/B043/actors/1/sections/3.en:
After the guarantor field is tied shut with sealing cord, the expiration time shares a line with the pressure reading, and the sealed-tool number is posted high on the wall.

Bae Nagyeong’s ending divides between scraping the acting official’s seal field out of the negotiation ledger and yielding one nighttime pump reserve-power slot to Cheolseong.

/story_contents/B043/actors/1/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Bae Nagyeong makes the water-supply contract’s expiration valid only when entered in the body of the Workshop Council’s public ledger, and blacks out the major power’s acting-official seal field with ink.

In branch β, she hands one nighttime pump reserve-power slot to the HC07 auditor on duty and yields one set of sealed tools to the Garak ration supply, while cross-locking the authority to refuse an extension to the serial number of Han Somi’s joint-governance proposal.

The empty guarantor field on the Ttukseom expiration copy remains unfilled after any compromise.

/story_contents/B043/actors/1/arc/0/summ.en: Sealing the guarantor field and refusing the acting official’s seal

/story_contents/B043/actors/1/arc/1/summ.en: Recording expiration alongside pressure and fixing the sealed-tool number

/story_contents/B043/actors/1/arc/2/summ.en: Striking the acting-official field versus yielding reserve power and tools

/story_contents/B043/actors/1/outcomes/0.en: Expiration valid only in the public ledger; acting-official seal field struck out

/story_contents/B043/actors/1/outcomes/1.en: Yielding nighttime reserve power and sealed tools; refusal linked to the joint-governance proposal

/story_contents/B043/actors/2/sections/정.en:
Bae Eunchan is the logistics clerk for the Escort Protection State’s protection clauses, reading a clause’s duration field before the Godeok warehouse scale.

When he sees a provision that renames an indefinite garrison a recovery achievement, he erases only that line; he makes the dispatch figures public but leaves interpretation only in the margins.

/story_contents/B043/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
As a logistics apprentice, he flipped the dispatch switch only after the duration and audit fields were filled in.

He developed a habit of turning back officers’ unilateral, indefinite requisitions at the warehouse door, calling any hand that turned an escort’s weight into permission without a time limit an enemy of logistics.

/story_contents/B043/actors/2/sections/가.en:
He attends logistics proceedings for the Ttukseom Heat Source family, but will not attach even a provision granting priority to waste-heat pipes to a dispatch field while the duration is blank.

He does not comply with Bae Woojin’s publication of recovery achievements before Im Gyeore’s protection-contract audit wording is copied into the logistics field, and opens the door only when the weight of western Giba Reum’s sealed emergency-escort box matches.

/story_contents/B043/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
On the day emergency escorts and contract termination were recorded again in the second water-supply agreement of the Founding oral account, a dispatch slip with a blank duration field arrived first.

Bae Eunchan sent it back from the warehouse door. As a Cooling-Water Discoloring Bacterial Colony clouded a joint in the waste-heat pipe, the logistics copy was on the verge of being read as a retroactive approval order.

/story_contents/B043/actors/2/sections/생.en:
By binding protected supplies and the end time in the same ledger, he cut off the basis for an indefinite garrison.

When Giba Reum called out the sealed box’s weight, Bae Eunchan fixed the XT04-SC1 railcar weight-log disclosure number at the very top of the dispatch blackboard and copied only Im Gyeore’s audit wording beside the duration field.

/story_contents/B043/actors/2/sections/현.en:
At the Godeok siding warehouse, Bae Eunchan begins each day by checking the width of the blank in the duration field.

If an indefinite requisition is mixed in, he does not set down the scale weight.

Even if a messenger from the Energy Union brings a waste-heat priority provision, he locks dispatch if the audit field is blank.

/story_contents/B043/actors/2/sections/비.en:
He once failed to tear up immediately a copy that looked like retroactive approval, leaving it beneath the ledger until the shift ended.

He remembers the length of its tucked-under corner only as a chalk dot beside the scale weight, and covers that dot with the back of his hand when he reads the termination conditions.

/story_contents/B043/actors/2/sections/관.en:
When Im Gyeore holds out the audit-wording token, Bae Eunchan opens only the duration field and records the end time alongside it.

When Giba Reum’s sealed box has the correct weight, the two call out the dispatch numbers together. When a note about Bae Woojin’s recovery achievements arrives, Bae Eunchan looks at its edge only after the duration has been filled in.

/story_contents/B043/actors/2/sections/3.en:
After the blank dispatch slip is returned, the end time is bound to the ledger, and the railcar weight disclosure number is posted on the top line of the dispatch blackboard.

The endings Bae Eunchan tests are deleting the indefinite-requisition field and lending one nighttime waste-heat slot to the Union.

/story_contents/B043/actors/2/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Bae Eunchan binds emergency escorts and contract termination on one page of the eastern logistics ledger and deletes the indefinite-garrison requisition field.

In branch β, he yields one nighttime waste-heat slot to the HC04 staff on duty and one container of reserve cooling water to the Amsa waste-heat pipe, while matching dispatch access to the last four digits of Im Gyeore’s audit token.

No bargain returns authority over Godeok logistics’ duration field to a blank.

/story_contents/B043/actors/2/arc/0/summ.en: Rejecting a blank dispatch slip and closing off the duration field

/story_contents/B043/actors/2/arc/1/summ.en: Recording the end time alongside it and fixing the railcar weight number

/story_contents/B043/actors/2/arc/2/summ.en: Deleting the indefinite field versus trading a waste-heat slot and reserve water

/story_contents/B043/actors/2/outcomes/0.en: Escorts and termination entered on one page; indefinite-requisition field deleted

/story_contents/B043/actors/2/outcomes/1.en: Yielding a nighttime waste-heat slot and reserve water; dispatch linked to the audit token

/story_contents/B043/actors/3/sections/정.en:
Eo Doyun is the Won Buddhist market witness to the first water-supply agreement, remembering the first year when water and parts were dispersed by the graduations on the Noryangjin berth scale.

When a young merchant raises a hand and calls the temporary agreement an eternal right, she rewrites only the exchange date on the wall and cuts her remarks short.

/story_contents/B043/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
As an apprentice witness in Noryangjin, she rewrote the exchanged goods and their weights on the left and right of the wall in strokes of equal thickness.

She developed a rule of accepting later interpretations only with the renewed signatures of two witnesses from the time, calling hands that read it solely as a protection contract enemies of market prices.

/story_contents/B043/actors/3/sections/가.en:
He sits as a witness for the Noryangjin Frozen-Goods Merchant Guild, but does not enter first-year goods in the auction field until the physical-inventory inspection cord is tied to the box handle.

He adds his first-year testimony to O Haerin’s neutral market legitimacy, but refuses to sign again when Han Jaemok’s water-exchange weight differs from the number on the wall.

/story_contents/B043/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
On the afternoon the first water-supply agreement of the Founding oral account was made at the berth, Eo Doyun stood before the scale and saw water and parts loaded for different districts.

On a night when the Night Sorting Corps mixed up frozen-warehouse labels, her memory was nearly cut into a Sluicegate Alliance propaganda slogan, leaving the market on the verge of being read as a protectorate counter.

/story_contents/B043/actors/3/sections/생.en:
When he rewrote the exchange weights on the wall, the claim of an eternal right was pushed off the price board.

When O Haerin delayed issuing settlement rights, Eo Doyun fixed the XT02-SC3 Noryangjin ice-credit relay time at the top of the wall. He kept only the weight of the box of pump parts Im Hajun handed him in his palm and used it as the standard for signing again.

/story_contents/B043/actors/3/sections/현.en:
Below the Noryangjin berth wall, Eo Doyun begins a day of testimony by feeling the temperature of empty and chilled boxes against the back of her hand.

If a propaganda slogan is posted in a cut-down form, she leaves only the date field and scrapes away the rest of the chalk.

Even if a messenger from the Frozen-Goods Merchant Guild brings a protection-contract interpretation, she does not put down the hammer without renewed signatures from two witnesses.

/story_contents/B043/actors/3/sections/비.en:
She once finished an auction with a line of remembered wording, nearly cut into propaganda, crumpled in her pocket.

The number for the parts’ weight remained in the crease; when she speaks of public rights, she presses only the loose thread of her pocket lining with her thumb.

/story_contents/B043/actors/3/sections/관.en:
When O Haerin places the neutral-market token on the table, Eo Doyun opens only the first-year goods field and calls out the weight.

When Han Jaemok’s water-exchange figure is written on the wall, the two check the price and public-rights wording side by side. When Eo Doyun takes the handle of Im Hajun’s pump-parts box, he ties on the inspection cord before opening the lid.

/story_contents/B043/actors/3/sections/3.en:
Where the berth scale stopped, the exchange weights are posted on the wall again, and the ice-credit relay time is fixed high above them.

Eo Doyun’s ending divides between erasing the protection-contract-only interpretation field from the berth ledger and inserting one line granting priority purchase to military provisions near the end of the daytime auction.

/story_contents/B043/actors/3/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Eo Doyun enters the first water-supply agreement in the body of the Noryangjin ledger as testimony to a public right and deletes the protection-contract-only interpretation field.

In branch β, he adds a line granting priority purchase to military provisions near the end of the daytime auction, hands one nighttime refrigeration-power slot to the merchants’ reserve, and matches the authority to sign again to the serial number of O Haerin’s neutral-market token.

The record of first-year exchange weights on the berth wall is erased in neither outcome.

/story_contents/B043/actors/3/arc/0/summ.en: Witnessing the berth exchange and preventing testimony from being cut into propaganda

/story_contents/B043/actors/3/arc/1/summ.en: Rewriting weights on the wall and fixing the ice-credit time

/story_contents/B043/actors/3/arc/2/summ.en: Deleting the protection-interpretation field versus trading a military-provisions line and power slot

/story_contents/B043/actors/3/outcomes/0.en: Public-rights testimony entered; protection-contract-only interpretation field deleted

/story_contents/B043/actors/3/outcomes/1.en: Military-provisions priority line and refrigeration power yielded; renewed signatures linked to the neutral-market token

/story_contents/B043/actors/4/sections/정.en:
Chu Woochan is the meeting-broadcast recorder for the Yeouido Investment Union’ Association, filtering remarks from eleven seats by the seconds marked on the Sangam relay room’s delay buffer.

If a statement calling for divided subjugation comes in a single breath, he covers the broadcast key with his palm and copies only the joint-negotiation wording into the left side of the ledger.

/story_contents/B043/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
As an apprentice recorder, he did not put pen to transcription ink until two independent testimonies had been gathered.

He developed a habit of recording reasons for withholding only in the margins of that day’s relay log, not inside the repository door, and a firm refusal to repeat a manipulated voice even aloud.

/story_contents/B043/actors/4/sections/가.en:
His name is on the recorders’ attendance list for the Yeouido Computing family, but he does not put remarks calling for subjugation divided among major powers into the official channel queue.

He does not light the transmission lamp before Guk Dubong’s verification ledger is opened. Before Jeong Yura’s draft joint charter reaches the relay order, he accepts only the line numbers from Seop Doyun’s courier copy.

/story_contents/B043/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
When the eleven-seat meeting opened in the spring of the second year, an audio fragment of a statement calling for divided subjugation entered the official queue.

Chu Woochan confined the fragment to the delay buffer and left only the joint-negotiation wording in the ledger. On a night when a flock of Radio Crows pecked at the antenna tips and amplified the noise, the manipulated audio nearly came out bearing the recorder’s handwriting.

/story_contents/B043/actors/4/sections/생.en:
By matching the joint-negotiation wording and the reason for withholding with the same minute-stamped seal, he broke the attempted seizure of the channel.

When Guk Dubong opened the verification ledger, Chu Woochan fixed the XT05-SC1 Sangam remaining-bandwidth lottery number at the top of the relay log and copied only the line numbers from Seop Doyun’s courier copy onto a separate sheet.

/story_contents/B043/actors/4/sections/현.en:
In the Sangam relay room, Chu Woochan presses the broadcast key only when the delay-buffer reading stabilizes.

When a request for divided subjugation arrives, he checks the ledger cover twice before opening only the joint-negotiation field.

Even if a messenger from the Electronic Resources Office tells him to execute a withheld transcription, he keeps it outside the official queue clip.

/story_contents/B043/actors/4/sections/비.en:
He once finished a shift with a sheet of the original manipulated audio record tucked inside the back cover of the relay log just before it could be cut up.

A line of rumors about bribery remained in its crease; when he reads the joint-negotiation wording, he presses only the corner of the back cover with his thumb.

/story_contents/B043/actors/4/sections/관.en:
When Guk Dubong taps the verification-ledger clip twice in quick succession, Chu Woochan advances the testimony counter by one.

When Jeong Yura writes the draft joint charter in the relay margin, the two confirm aloud only the speaking order. When Chu Woochan receives Seop Doyun’s separate courier sheet, he opens only the line-number field and covers the audio field with black tape.

/story_contents/B043/actors/4/sections/3.en:
After the divided-subjugation audio is trapped in the delay buffer, only joint negotiation remains in the ledger, and the remaining-bandwidth lottery number is posted at the top of the log.

Chu Woochan’s ending divides between making the joint-negotiation relay clause a fixed provision in the corporation’s ledger and yielding one nighttime relay-power slot to the checkpoint escort unit.

/story_contents/B043/actors/4/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Chu Woochan enters the clause for relaying negotiations jointly conducted by weaker nations in a nonrefusable field of the corporation’s ledger, and deletes the enforcement field for divided-subjugation transcriptions.

In branch β, he diverts one nighttime relay-power slot to the checkpoint escort unit and yields one spare storage reel to the Electronic Resources Office audit, while synchronizing broadcast access with the time of Jeong Yura’s joint-charter margin seal.

No bargain removes Sangam’s joint-negotiation relay authority from the queue.

/story_contents/B043/actors/4/arc/0/summ.en: Trapping divided-subjugation audio in the delay buffer and leaving only joint negotiation in the ledger

/story_contents/B043/actors/4/arc/1/summ.en: Simultaneously sealing the reason for withholding and fixing the remaining-bandwidth number atop the log

/story_contents/B043/actors/4/arc/2/summ.en: Entering the relay clause versus trading nighttime relay power and a spare reel

/story_contents/B043/actors/4/outcomes/0.en: Joint-negotiation relay clause entered; divided-transcription enforcement field deleted

/story_contents/B043/actors/4/outcomes/1.en: Nighttime relay power and a spare reel yielded; broadcasting linked to the charter seal

/story_contents/B043/actors/5/sections/정.en:
Hong Eunseo is a recipient of meritorious-service reward relief from Sangha Relief State. Beside the stove at the Bukhansan Bogukmun camp, he reckons with the winter when relief boxes were converted into fields for official rank.

He turns off broadcasts telling people to fill empty places in the name of efficiency, and after the children fall asleep, he lowers the stove’s fire vent by one notch.

/story_contents/B043/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
As an apprentice ration clerk for the League, he compared reward copies with the actual ration list every evening.

He developed a rule against recording hereditary additions without the recipient present, and read notes directing founding rewards solely to the loyal-guard warehouse as a threat to the camp.

/story_contents/B043/actors/5/sections/가.en:
He attends relief proceedings for the Bukhansan Bogukmun Returnees’ Association, but does not enter a claim that combines office and ration rights in one provision into the camp ledger.

Until Hwang Serin’s public ration list passes the evening comparison, he treats only the blank line in Ran Jiho’s Seoul Station register as an incident from the same winter, and keeps Baek On’s shelter vow on the first line of the relief ledger.

/story_contents/B043/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
In the Winter of the Meritorious in the Founding oral account, when those credited with meritorious service demanded offices and ration rights together, only Hong Eunseo’s relief box was left with an empty field.

While the Ghost Dispatch Unit erased the sequence of turns in the camp corridor, a copy in which a child’s name field had been changed to a number for an official-rank pledge fell in front of the stove.

/story_contents/B043/actors/5/sections/생.en:
By matching the reduced relief allotment to the public ration list with the same evening seal, he cut off the route to the loyal-guard warehouse.

When Hwang Serin unfolded the ration list, Hong Eunseo fixed the XT01-SC1 Imjin returnees’ register reissuance request number to the box lid and left only Baek On’s shelter vow on the ledger’s first line.

/story_contents/B043/actors/5/sections/현.en:
At the threshold of the Bukhansan Bogukmun camp, Hong Eunseo uses the height of the stove flame to regulate tension over rations.

When a verbal relief announcement circulates, he merely taps the empty field in the courier ledger for others to see.

Even if a Returnees’ Association messenger brings a provision pledging official rank as collateral, he clips it on the opposite side of the ration-list clip.

/story_contents/B043/actors/5/sections/비.en:
He once failed to burn a copy changed to show a collateral figure immediately and left it standing beside the stove until the meeting ended.

He marked the length of its scorched corner with thread in the box lining; when he opens the relief ledger, he presses only that loose thread with his thumb.

/story_contents/B043/actors/5/sections/관.en:
When Hwang Serin places the public ration list on the evening scale, Hong Eunseo points by hand only to the empty-box field.

When Ran Jiho unfolds the blank line in the Seoul Station register, the two read side by side only the date of the incident from that same winter. When Baek On writes the shelter vow on the relief ledger’s first line, Hong Eunseo covers the hereditary-addition field with black tape before accepting a signature.

/story_contents/B043/actors/5/sections/3.en:
After the empty box remains, the reduced allotment and the ration list bear the same seal, and the returnees’ register reissuance number is attached to the lid.

Hong Eunseo’s final choice divides between nailing the official-rank collateral field to the noticeboard for disposal and yielding one witness-escort slot to the meritorious-service faction.

/story_contents/B043/actors/5/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Hong Eunseo enters the reduced relief allotment in the body of the League’s public ration record and deletes the official-rank collateral collection field.

In branch β, he yields one witness-escort slot to the meritorious-service faction and one nighttime camp-heating slot to meeting security, while requiring amendments to rations to be countersigned with the margin seal on Baek On’s shelter vow.

The recipient-name field on the Bukhansan Bogukmun relief box is not reclaimed in either outcome.

/story_contents/B043/actors/5/arc/0/summ.en: Preserving the empty relief box and isolating the official-rank collateral copy

/story_contents/B043/actors/5/arc/1/summ.en: Sealing the reduced allotment and ration list together and fixing the returnees’ number

/story_contents/B043/actors/5/arc/2/summ.en: Disposing of the collateral field versus trading an escort slot and heating slot

/story_contents/B043/actors/5/outcomes/0.en: Reduced relief allotment entered publicly; official-rank collateral collection field deleted

/story_contents/B043/actors/5/outcomes/1.en: Witness-escort slot and nighttime heating yielded; amendments countersigned with the vow seal

/story_contents/B043/actors/6/sections/정.en:
Sun Hajun is the wheel-exchange witness for the Seocho Computing Group's Second Water Supply Agreement. At Changdong's public scale, she sees dispatching end-of-life wheels under falsified weights as an accident no different from wear on the rails.

She counts freight bound for the family-only compartment twice and puts the scale reading ahead of the market-price note.

/story_contents/B043/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
As an apprentice witness in the wheel shop, she made sure two witnesses saw incoming weights and blocked the dispatch of orders bearing a family crest until the Seniority Council approved them.

She called anyone who cited an exchange whose guarantor had disappeared as grounds for military-only dispatch an enemy of the scale. She developed the habit of stamping brake boxes only in the specifications column.

/story_contents/B043/actors/6/sections/가.en:
Changdong Defense sits in on exchanges, but until the Changdong standard inventory ledger is opened, he will not accept the railway family's hostage clause as part of the wheel-exchange ledger's main text.

Until the agreement weight is matched against Hwang Noeul's recovery scale, he points only to the same boxes named in Chu Hangyeol's Yongsan transshipment testimony and witnesses the Changdong-side dispatch of parts from the compartment guaranteed by Im Hajun.

/story_contents/B043/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
When the Second Water Supply Agreement of the Founding oral account was concluded, Sun Hajun put end-of-life wheels and brake boxes on the Changdong scale and checked their specification stamps.

On the night the Decommissioned-Line Repair Train Group scraped the siding couplings, testimony given after the guarantor's disappearance was about to be read as grounds for military-only dispatch.

/story_contents/B043/actors/6/sections/생.en:
When he placed the agreement weight and recovery reading on the same line, the family-only column was pushed off the scale.

As Hwang Noeul set down the recovery weight, Sun Hajun pinned the XT04-SC2 winter fuel queue allocation number to the board beside the scale and moved only the transshipment box lots identified by Chu Hangyeol into the specifications column.

/story_contents/B043/actors/6/sections/현.en:
Beneath the Changdong scale, Sun Hajun starts each day by measuring the wear thickness of wheel rims.

If an order bearing a family crest appears, she padlocks the dispatch lever until the approval stamp arrives.

Even if a messenger from the Track Defense Gate brings a military-only citation, she covers the scale when the two witness positions are empty.

/story_contents/B043/actors/6/sections/비.en:
Once, she was a full turn late in erasing dispatch figures that looked like military allocations.

During that turn, three notes from the family side were slipped in. When she announces a public weight, she gathers only the chalk dust from the erased spot with her fingertips.

/story_contents/B043/actors/6/sections/관.en:
When Hwang Noeul raises the recovery scale weight one notch, Sun Hajun opens only the agreement-weight column and calls out the number.

When the box cited in Chu Hangyeol's transshipment testimony arrives, the two check its lot number side by side. When he points to the handle of the parts compartment guaranteed by Im Hajun, he opens the lid only after checking the Changdong dispatch stamp.

/story_contents/B043/actors/6/sections/3.en:
After the wheels and brake boxes go on the scale, the recovery reading is laid over the agreement line, and the winter fuel queue number is posted on the top line of the board beside the scale.

Sun Hajun's ending divides between scraping the family-only dispatch column from the inventory ledger and inserting a military-priority line into the last column of the daytime exchange.

/story_contents/B043/actors/6/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Sun Hajun enters the Second Water Supply Agreement's wheel exchange into the main text of the Changdong standard inventory ledger and inks out the family-only dispatch column.

In branch β, he adds a military-priority line near the end of the daytime exchange, gives one night-fuel allotment to the wheel shop's reserves, and locks the authority to disclose weights to the serial number of Hwang Noeul's recovery scale.

The agreement-weight record on Changdong's public scale remains after either compromise.

/story_contents/B043/actors/6/arc/0/summ.en: Weighing wheels and brake boxes and halting family-only dispatch

/story_contents/B043/actors/6/arc/1/summ.en: Recording recovery readings alongside agreement weights and fixing the winter fuel queue number

/story_contents/B043/actors/6/arc/2/summ.en: Erasing the exclusive column versus trading a military-priority line for a fuel allotment

/story_contents/B043/actors/6/outcomes/0.en: Wheel exchange entered in the standard ledger; family-only dispatch column erased

/story_contents/B043/actors/6/outcomes/1.en: Military-priority line, night-fuel concession, and disclosure linked to the recovery scale

/story_contents/B043/actors/7/sections/정.en:
So Dugam is a siding mechanic for the Neutral Convoy City and An Dohan's operations officer. He keeps a coupler gauge brought from Dakar's dry dock at the very bottom of the Mangwoo siding toolbox.

He cannot abide blanks in a timetable and remembers a dispatch that skipped brake and coupler checks as an insult.

His childhood habit of counting bolt pitch in Wolof numerals survives only alongside the Korean timetable on the site board; it does not signify dispatch authority.

/story_contents/B043/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
After passing through the Busan Parts Fair and moving his workbench into a single room in Mangwoo, he repeatedly posted the dispatch schedule and maintenance log on the same board.

He refused broadcasts that dressed up delays on terminal routes as political rankings. His practice remained to recognize medical-train priority only when it carried both Jang Sehwa's department stamp and a maintenance signature.

/story_contents/B043/actors/7/sections/가.en:
He sits in on maintenance for the Yongsan Track Gate, but locks the switch if a dispatch-team-only release clause appears on the same sheet as the maintenance signature.

He receives An Dohan's dispatch operations work at the siding, but will not align a coupler with I Hongwon's northern wheel-exchange time until he has shared tools with Gukso on base duty.

/story_contents/B043/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
At dawn, when weapons belonging to the Amsa cult were found on a medical train, So Dugam sealed the siding maintenance shed and padlocked the dispatch switch.

As the Surveillance Track Corps twisted the turnaround camera's angle, an unmaintained car was about to appear to have a route into the loading yard between Changdong and Amsa.

/story_contents/B043/actors/7/sections/생.en:
Putting the maintenance signature and dispatch time on one line pushed the weapons-loading invoice off the board.

When An Dohan handed him a dispatch operations note, So Dugam fixed the XT01-SC2 Sinnae detour transfer opening code beside the dispatch switch and recorded only the tool numbers he had shared with Gukso in the closure log.

/story_contents/B043/actors/7/sections/현.en:
In the Mangwoo siding pit, So Dugam decides whether a car can be dispatched by the finger-width of play in its coupler.

When he sees a blank in the timetable, he turns off the political-ranking broadcast and fills in only the maintenance-signature column in chalk.

Even if a Track Gate messenger demands dispatch by the dispatch team alone, he will not unlock the switch until the medical-train stamp and maintenance signature appear together.

/story_contents/B043/actors/7/sections/비.en:
Once, just after sealing the shed, he kept the dispatch-switch key in his pocket for a shift instead of handing it over to his replacement.

A detour transfer was delayed in the meantime. When he speaks of maintenance signatures, he runs his thumb along the scratches on the key's teeth.

/story_contents/B043/actors/7/sections/관.en:
When An Dohan moves the dispatch board up one slot, So Dugam rewrites only the maintenance-signature column in large letters.

When Gukso opens the duty toolbox, the two use their fingers to align only the markings on the coupler gauge. When I Hongwon's northern wheel-exchange time comes over the radio, So Dugam checks the dispatch-switch padlock before tightening the coupling.

/story_contents/B043/actors/7/sections/3.en:
After the maintenance shed is sealed, the signature and time are put on one line, and the detour transfer opening code is posted beside the switch.

So Dugam's ending is a choice between making a maintenance signature mandatory on the joint escort's actual timetable and giving one night-loading slot to the defenders.

/story_contents/B043/actors/7/sections/분.en:
In branch α, So Dugam enters simultaneous maintenance-signature and dispatch-time requirements for siding releases in the Transfer City's ledger and deletes the dispatch-team-only release column.

In branch β, he gives one night-loading slot to the medical defenders and yields a spare coupler set to Changdong's wheel exchange, while trading switch-opening authority against An Dohan's dispatch-board page.

In neither branch does authority over maintenance signatures at the Mangwoo siding leave the toolbox.

/story_contents/B043/actors/7/arc/0/summ.en: Discovery of weapons on a medical train and closure of siding dispatch

/story_contents/B043/actors/7/arc/1/summ.en: Combining maintenance and dispatch on one line and fixing the detour transfer code

/story_contents/B043/actors/7/arc/2/summ.en: Deleting the solo-dispatch column versus trading a loading slot and spare coupler

/story_contents/B043/actors/7/outcomes/0.en: Simultaneous maintenance-and-dispatch release entered; dispatch-team-only column deleted

/story_contents/B043/actors/7/outcomes/1.en: Night-loading slot and spare coupler conceded; switch operation linked to the dispatch board

/story_contents/B043/actors/8/sections/정.en:
Cheon Daum is a medicinal-herb dryer mechanic for the Medical Neutrality League and Sim Dalho's operations officer. She applies the ear for humidity she developed beside ginger racks on an Accra rooftop to the tally sticks in Cheongnyangni's drying room.

She hears the fans before she hears people speak and regards repairs made later than the date on a tally stick as an insult.

Her habit of using Twi forms of address for her mother's racks survives only in the hand motions with which she counts filter thickness; it does not signify authority over treatment.

/story_contents/B043/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
As an apprentice in Jegidong, he wrote the temperature and filter thickness on a tally stick every shift and installed no part without a guild stamp.

He developed the habit of stopping that day's shipments if a toolbox seal was skipped even once. He saw receipts for the major powers' advance purchases of damp medicinal herbs at low prices as an enemy of the drying room.

/story_contents/B043/actors/8/sections/가.en:
She sits in on maintenance for the Jegidong Healing Gate, but will not attach advance-purchase invoices to the shipping column until the Medical Council's public maintenance schedule is opened.

She stands beside Sim Dalho in the field to back up his origin tally sticks, but will not open the door at Ryu Eunbi's urging for treatment supplies until Su Hyoeun's emergency generator output matches the power needed for drying.

/story_contents/B043/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
During the week counterfeit summer medicine flowed toward Bukhansan Bogukmun, two days were missing from one drying-room bay's temperature log.

Cheon Daum locked that bay's shipments. As the Flood-Mold Breathing Corps planted spores in the filter grooves, the power gap was about to be read as a stopgap for Amsa's protected warehouse.

/story_contents/B043/actors/8/sections/생.en:
Re-engraving the temperature log and filter thickness on the same tally stick cut off the advance-purchase route.

When Su Hyoeun called out the emergency generator's remaining capacity, Cheon Daum fixed the XT04-SC2 Jegidong frostbite-patient intake power allocation number to the dryer control panel and put only Sim Dalho's origin tally stick in the shipping kit.

/story_contents/B043/actors/8/sections/현.en:
At the entrance to Cheongnyangni's drying room, Cheon Daum sets shipping priorities by the rhythm of vibrations in the fan noise.

If he sees a blank in the log, he pushes boxes of parts without guild stamps outside.

Even if a Healing Gate messenger brings an advance-purchase list, he will not accept it before comparing it with the public maintenance schedule.

/story_contents/B043/actors/8/sections/비.en:
Once, unable to disclose the entrant column for the two missing days immediately, he hid it behind a tally stick for one shift.

During that time, a basket of medicinal herbs absorbed moisture. When he speaks of the maintenance schedule, he traces the scratches on the tally stick with his thumb.

/story_contents/B043/actors/8/sections/관.en:
When Sim Dalho taps the origin tally stick twice, Cheon Daum copies down only the field temperature in chalk.

When Su Hyoeun's remaining generating capacity matches, the two check the drying-power figure as carefully as a hand scale. When Ryu Eunbi presses for treatment supplies, Cheon Daum opens the drying-room bolt only after the filter thickness meets specifications.

/story_contents/B043/actors/8/sections/3.en:
After the bay with the blank log is locked, temperature and filter thickness are engraved on one tally stick, and the frostbite-patient intake power number is posted on the control panel.

Cheon Daum's ending is a choice between placing the dryer under the Medical Council's public maintenance schedule and giving one night-protection shift to the defenders.

/story_contents/B043/actors/8/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Cheon Daum ties shipments from the Cheongnyangni dryer to the main text of the Medical Council's public maintenance schedule and deletes the automatic scheduling column for the major powers' advance purchases.

In branch β, she gives one night-protection shift in the drying room to the defenders and yields one spare rack of ginger to Bukhansan Bogukmun's fever-reducer allocation, while trading authority to open and close the shipping bell against Sim Dalho's origin tally-stick page.

In neither branch does authority over the Jegidong drying room's tool seals pass beyond the tally sticks.

/story_contents/B043/actors/8/arc/0/summ.en: Sealing off the blank temperature log and halting shipments of counterfeit medicine

/story_contents/B043/actors/8/arc/1/summ.en: Re-engraving the tally stick and fixing the frostbite-patient power number

/story_contents/B043/actors/8/arc/2/summ.en: Deleting the advance-purchase column versus trading night protection and a ginger rack

/story_contents/B043/actors/8/outcomes/0.en: Shipments entered on the public maintenance schedule; automatic advance-purchase scheduling column deleted

/story_contents/B043/actors/8/outcomes/1.en: Night-protection shift and ginger rack conceded; operation linked to the origin tally stick

/story_contents/B043/actors/9/sections/정.en:
Night Dispatch is a Class V synthetic unit that reads lane-sensor width only from the charging slot beneath Changdong's night dispatch board.

It does not open the previous shift's files. When its remaining charge reaches the warning mark, it discards dispatch telegrams from outside Changdong and retains only one Gangnam Line sector-key entry.

/story_contents/B043/actors/9/sections/붕.en:
On its first night assignment, Night Dispatch was locked to record slot occupancy times only as a single duty-end hash entry.

Even when brake-pad stocks run out, the routine for searching for a substation socket outside Changdong has been cut from its image.

/story_contents/B043/actors/9/sections/가.en:
Only under the Magok Life Family's joint-storage seal does it stamp entry and exit times in the Changdong duty ledger, and it rejects transfer telegrams lacking three signatures.

Until it recognizes Jo Woochan's chief mechanic glove tag, it will not open its body cover beyond the sensor-calibration angle.

/story_contents/B043/actors/9/sections/붕.en:
When the charging-slot alarm sounded three times in succession during the 3 a.m. battery-replacement window, command packets ordering it to open the entire network filled its receive buffer.

Night Dispatch sent back only the Gangnam Line sector key. Amid vibrations from the Iron-Scale Swarm scraping the pit-rail joints, it powered down just before a route to the neighboring base could open.

/story_contents/B043/actors/9/sections/생.en:
Putting the day's snapshot and the storage-seal hash in one header blocked the path for overwriting the previous shift's image.

When Guk Yong entered the stretcher-bay occupancy figure into the terminal, Night Dispatch wrote the XT01-SC2 detour transfer operating-window identifier in an auxiliary field. Even when Jo Woochan applied a remaining-charge pad, it did not open the previous shift's files.

/story_contents/B043/actors/9/sections/현.en:
In the Changdong inspection pit, Night Dispatch increases or decreases the spacing of night slots according to the height of dust above the lane.

If a packet orders it to open the entire network, it emits only a brief refusal tone and drops all authority except the sector key.

Even without brake pads, it does not scan the neighboring base's control sockets.

/story_contents/B043/actors/9/sections/비.en:
There is a frame, just before it powered down, in which it failed to place the neighboring-base route's residual hash in Jo Woochan's approval field.

The number remains only in scratch memory. When it requests a partial reconnection, it signals this solely by blinking the dispatch-board LED three times.

/story_contents/B043/actors/9/sections/관.en:
When Jo Woochan places the remaining-charge pad against the charging contact, Night Dispatch returns only the byte length of today's snapshot.

When Guk Yong reads the stretcher order aloud, it writes only that number to the buffer and gives a short confirmation tone. It does not set the transfer bit before the Life Sciences Family's audit stamp arrives.

/story_contents/B043/actors/9/sections/3.en:
After retaining only the Gangnam Line key during the late-night alarm, it joins the day's snapshot and seal hash in one header and writes the detour transfer window number in an auxiliary field.

Night Dispatch's ending is a choice between publishing the night-slot rules in the Changdong duty ledger and accepting maintenance sleep while postponing reconnection.

/story_contents/B043/actors/9/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Night Dispatch publishes the night-slot rules and gap hash in the Changdong duty ledger and locks the neighboring-base route under a permanent block.

In branch β, it stops its body only for the maintenance window opened by Jo Woochan, partially restores the sealed warehouse coordinates to his work terminal, and aligns the key-renewal time with Guk Yong's stretcher-duty slot.

The sector-key line of the Gangnam Line night-dispatch loop is erased in neither branch.

/story_contents/B043/actors/9/arc/0/summ.en: Reducing a whole-network command during the late-night charging alarm to a Gangnam Line sector-key response

/story_contents/B043/actors/9/arc/1/summ.en: Joining the day's snapshot and seal hash in one header and writing the detour transfer window in an auxiliary field

/story_contents/B043/actors/9/arc/2/summ.en: Publishing night-slot rules versus maintenance sleep and key renewal linked to stretcher duty

/story_contents/B043/actors/9/outcomes/0.en: Night-slot rules and gap hash published; cross-base route permanently blocked

/story_contents/B043/actors/9/outcomes/1.en: Maintenance sleep, partial restoration of sealed warehouse coordinates, and key renewal linked to Guk Yong's stretcher slot

/story_contents/B044/actors/0/sections/정.en:
Heung Jiwan represents the evacuation crowd transferring through Neutral Convoy City, reading the density of those waiting from the spread of rust on the emergency-door handle inside the station.

When a loudspeaker calls emergency powers a pretext for evacuation, she hides the handle behind her back and does not press the response switch.

/story_contents/B044/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
While assisting with transfer guidance, she wrote evacuation times in the upper section of the blackboard and jurisdictions not yet returned in the lower section.

The habit of releasing the emergency-door bolt only when the joint command network’s lamp was lit stayed in her hands.

/story_contents/B044/actors/0/sections/가.en:
His name is on the crowd-representative roster for the Yongsan Track Gate, but he will not open the later-amendments section until the two officers then on duty have both countersigned.

Even if An Dohan’s dispatch slot changes, he keeps the evacuation order only in the upper part of the blackboard.

/story_contents/B044/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
On the night of the great blackout in Year 0 of the Collapse, a draft advertisement claiming legitimacy for the great power’s development was placed in the loudspeaker script box on the Sinnae platform, where the joint command network had gone down.

Heung Jiwan pushed the draft beneath a shelf and opened the evacuation door. As the Transfer Rat Colony dug into the cable channel, a fragment of a cut-off statement caught on the railing wire and fluttered.

/story_contents/B044/actors/0/sections/생.en:
By nailing the evacuation times and jurisdictions not yet returned to the same blackboard, he kept the rival claims of lawful succession separate.

When Guk Yong pushed an infirmary stretcher toward the platform, Heung Jiwan fixed the XT01-SC2 bypass-transfer opening time at the top of the blackboard. He filed the disconnection log he submitted to Yun Seorin in a different binder from the draft advertisement.

/story_contents/B044/actors/0/sections/현.en:
At the Sinnae emergency door, Heung Jiwan counts those waiting by the spread of rust on its handle.

When an emergency-powers announcement comes on, she winds the loudspeaker cord around her wrist.

Even when the Track Gate urges her to close the door, she changes only the upper part of the blackboard with chalk until the officers on duty countersign.

/story_contents/B044/actors/0/sections/비.en:
Once, when the fragment of the cut-off statement was fluttering, she put up the covering paper half a space too late.

During that half-space delay, the great-power side took a photograph. When she opens the public ledger, she covers only the paper’s torn edge with her index finger.

/story_contents/B044/actors/0/sections/관.en:
When An Dohan thickens the evacuation entry on the dispatch blackboard with chalk, Heung Jiwan opens the door bolt one notch further.

When Guk Yong divides the stretcher queue, the two check only the patient count and evacuation count on their fingers and do not speak of emergency powers. When Yun Seorin’s cross-verification box arrives, Heung Jiwan pockets the draft advertisement before placing the disconnection log inside.

/story_contents/B044/actors/0/sections/3.en:
After the blackout door opens, the evacuation times and jurisdictions not yet returned are nailed to the blackboard, and the bypass-transfer time is fixed at its top.

Heung Jiwan’s choice divides between erasing the advertising-script section from the ledger and lending the nighttime loudspeaker slot to the escort convoy.

/story_contents/B044/actors/0/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Heung Jiwan places the public ledger of jurisdictions not yet returned in the main text of the Track Gate record and inks out the development-legitimacy advertising-script section.

In branch β, he lends the nighttime loudspeaker slot to the great power’s escort convoy and moves the front of the evacuation line back one step. He coordinates the blackboard revision with An Dohan’s dispatch duty time and chalk color.

The Sinnae evacuation roster’s authority is not erased from the blackboard by either advertisement.

/story_contents/B044/actors/0/arc/0/summ.en: Opening the emergency door during the great blackout and hiding the draft advertisement under a shelf

/story_contents/B044/actors/0/arc/1/summ.en: Nailing down evacuation times and jurisdictions not yet returned, and fixing the bypass-transfer time

/story_contents/B044/actors/0/arc/2/summ.en: Erasing the advertising-script section versus trading a loudspeaker slot and a retreat by the front of the line

/story_contents/B044/actors/0/outcomes/0.en: Entering jurisdictions not yet returned in the ledger and erasing the development advertising-script section

/story_contents/B044/actors/0/outcomes/1.en: Yielding the nighttime loudspeaker slot, moving the front of the evacuation line back, and cross-checking dispatch duty

/story_contents/B044/actors/1/sections/정.en:
Heung Daon represents the crowd subjected to requisition when the Pharmaceutical Neutrality Alliance’s war for supremacy broke out, reading crowd density from the quiver of the shipping scale’s needle at Jegi-dong Market.

When a broadcast orders people to call the quarantine team requisitioned troops, he covers the scale weight with his palm and does not ring the shipping bell.

/story_contents/B044/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
While assisting the market queue, he tied requisition slips and the actual numbers entering and leaving with different-colored cords each evening.

The habit of tearing up slips that listed medicinal supplies as military rations before accepting them stayed in his thumb.

/story_contents/B044/actors/1/sections/가.en:
He is on the crowd-representative roster for the Jegi-dong Healing Gate, but he will not disperse the line before a copy of Ryu Eunbi’s neutrality declaration arrives.

Even if Nam Hoseong’s medical escort is late, he does not break the seal on the shipping scale.

/story_contents/B044/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
On the day after the second summer when five proposals for unification spread into a war for supremacy, Heung Daon pressed the weight with his hand to stop the needle just before sealing tape was applied to a requisition cart’s shipping scale.

As a lamp from the Bespoke Medical Remnants swept over the sacks of medicinal supplies, a copy with his name already printed at the top of the Protector Force’s mandatory-selection list was wedged against a scale leg.

/story_contents/B044/actors/1/sections/생.en:
By tying the requisition slips and actual entry-and-exit counts separately with colored cords, she kept the mobilization office’s wording separate.

When Seok Bomwoo aligned the Sinnae refusal wording, Heung Daon wrote the XT04-SC2 Jegi-dong frostbite patient intake number inside the scale lid and returned Bae Woojin’s waterworks-protection requisition envelope stamped only with a refusal seal.

/story_contents/B044/actors/1/sections/현.en:
At the Jegi-dong Market shipping bay, Heung Daon estimates waiting times from the length of the soil marks left by the line’s footsteps.

When a broadcast calls them troops, he closes the scale cover with his shoulder.

Even if a messenger from the Healing Gate demands dispersal, he does not clear the front section before a copy of the neutrality declaration arrives.

/story_contents/B044/actors/1/sections/비.en:
When the selection copy was wedged against the scale leg, he once blacked out the name field one stroke too late.

During that stroke, the escort convoy read the number. When he opens the refusal ledger, he covers only the ink smear on the scale leg with his thumb.

/story_contents/B044/actors/1/sections/관.en:
When Heung Daon hears Nam Hoseong unfasten his medical-escort helmet strap, she redraws the position of the crowd’s front row in chalk.

When coordinating the refusal wording with Seok Bomwoo, they show each other only the scale weight. When Beom Chaeon brings the Jegi-dong refusal wording, Heung Daon pushes the shipping bell cord toward her shoe’s insole and refuses to shake hands.

/story_contents/B044/actors/1/sections/3.en:
After the night he stopped the needle with his hand, the refusal ledger is bound with colored cords, and the frostbite intake number is written inside the lid.

Heung Daon’s final choice is between putting the refusal ledger before the eleven-seat council and moving one column of the crowd back to give up a requisition-cart slot.

/story_contents/B044/actors/1/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Heung Daon puts the public requisition-refusal ledger in the main text of the small-nations council agenda and cuts out the Protector Force’s mandatory-selection representative field.

In branch β, he moves one column of the crowd behind the market and gives the escort convoy one nighttime use of the shipping scale. He overlaps his handprint for opening and closing the bell with Nam Hoseong’s escort duty time on the same line.

The Jegi-dong refusal-ledger record remains on the scale lid after any dispersal.

/story_contents/B044/actors/1/arc/0/summ.en: Stopping the shipping-scale needle and holding the requisitioned crowd’s line in place

/story_contents/B044/actors/1/arc/1/summ.en: Binding the refusal ledger with colored cords and recording the frostbite intake number on the lid

/story_contents/B044/actors/1/arc/2/summ.en: Entering the refusal ledger before the council versus trading dispersal and a shipping turn

/story_contents/B044/actors/1/outcomes/0.en: Entering the requisition-refusal ledger before the small-nations council and cutting out the selection-representative field

/story_contents/B044/actors/1/outcomes/1.en: Moving one column of the crowd back, yielding a nighttime shipping turn, and cross-checking escort duty

/story_contents/B044/actors/2/sections/정.en:
Geun Bareum is an assistant signatory for joint escorts under Gate Military Government who, at the Guui bridge railing, does not count verbal permission to pass as an assistant signature before the ink dries.

When a case lid with an empty bridge-clause field is opened, he puts down his brush and closes the case with his knee.

/story_contents/B044/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
As an apprentice gate clerk, he practiced only writing the assistant-signature time and witness name on the same line.

He developed a habit of locking the case if it bore fewer than two seals, and called slips offering protection fees in exchange for signature fields enemies of the case.

/story_contents/B044/actors/2/sections/가.en:
He is on the assistant-representative roster of the Han River Crossing Bridge Guild, but he does not move the protection-clause wording into the main text before Go Seojun’s joint-governance seal arrives as the key to the case.

Even if the numbers in Cho Naru’s Sinnae clerk’s ledger fall behind, he does not put his brush to an empty bridge field.

/story_contents/B044/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
On the morning when the second water-supply agreement of the founding oral account redefined emergency escort conditions, a forged fair copy slipped into an inner compartment of the assistant’s case.

Geun Bareum folded it three times and pushed it beneath the case, leaving only permission to cross the Guui bridge under his assistant signature. As the Iron-Scale Collective gnawed the railing rivets, the color of a misidentified signal flare bled into the fair copy’s margin.

/story_contents/B044/actors/2/sections/생.en:
By putting bridge crossings and emergency water supply in a single assistant ledger, he separated out the protection-fee field.

When Chang Haeon moved the medical clause into the bridge field, Geun Bareum fixed the XT04-SC3 mineral-sample seal-inspection time inside the case lid. He had still not taken out and read the protection-clause slip beneath the case.

/story_contents/B044/actors/2/sections/현.en:
At the Guui bridge threshold, Geun Bareum chooses the signing order by how quickly the brush hairs dry.

When verbal permission to pass circulates, he merely taps the empty case field with his finger to show it.

Even when a Bridge Guild messenger brings a protection clause, he clips it to the opposite side from the main text.

/story_contents/B044/actors/2/sections/비.en:
Once, unable to tear up the forged fair copy immediately, he left it on the bottom of the case until the meeting ended.

He marked the length of the resulting corner impression with thread in the case lining, and when he opens the assistant ledger, he presses only that loose thread with his thumb.

/story_contents/B044/actors/2/sections/관.en:
When Cho Naru signals a clause number from the Sinnae clerk’s ledger on his palm, Geun Bareum pushes only the bridge field to the middle of the table.

When Chang Haeon moves the medical clause, the two read aloud only the emergency water-supply figures side by side. When Go Seojun hands him the joint-governance seal, Geun Bareum fits the case key first, then closes the zipper on the lower compartment.

/story_contents/B044/actors/2/sections/3.en:
After he folds the forged copy and moves it beneath the case, permission to cross remains in the assistant ledger, and the mineral-seal inspection time is fixed to the lid.

Geun Bareum’s last choice is between nailing the slip from beneath the case to the noticeboard and lending the assistant-witness seat to the great power’s delegates for a day.

/story_contents/B044/actors/2/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Geun Bareum places the assistant ledger for bridge crossings and emergency water supply in the main gate record and cuts out the protection-fee signature-payment field.

In branch β, he lends the assistant-witness seat to the great power’s delegates for a day and transfers nighttime railing heat to meeting security. He cross-signs authority to amend the case against the serial number of Go Seojun’s seal.

The bridge clause in the Guui assistant’s case is not erased from the railing ledger after any seal is applied.

/story_contents/B044/actors/2/arc/0/summ.en: Hiding the forged fair copy beneath the case and assistant-signing bridge passage

/story_contents/B044/actors/2/arc/1/summ.en: Combining passage and water supply on one sheet and fixing the mineral-seal time to the lid

/story_contents/B044/actors/2/arc/2/summ.en: Cutting out the protection-fee field versus trading the witness field and heating slot

/story_contents/B044/actors/2/outcomes/0.en: Entering the bridge-and-water-supply assistant ledger and cutting out the protection-fee payment field

/story_contents/B044/actors/2/outcomes/1.en: Yielding the assistant-witness field and railing heat, with a cross-check against the joint-governance seal

/story_contents/B044/actors/3/sections/정.en:
Yeo Ri-an is the clerk who keeps the original first Water Compact agreement, judging an original’s authenticity by the thickness of its fold marks in the Yeongdeungpo double safe.

When he sees wording that turns a provisional agreement into a permanent right, he turns his pen toward its cap and closes it.

/story_contents/B044/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
As an apprentice sluice-gate clerk, he allowed copies to be consulted only after checking both their page numbers and fold marks.

He developed a habit of holding on to memories of the founding handshake longer than the contractual wording, and saw charts that treated clauses surviving only in memory as grounds for a western protectorate as enemies of preservation.

/story_contents/B044/actors/3/sections/가.en:
He is listed as a steward of the Seoul Station Records Law House, but does not open the original-document case until both the sluice security and distribution-zone keys have turned.

Even if Han Jaemok’s draft sluice charter is late, he allows no ink differing from the first agreement’s wording into the main text.

/story_contents/B044/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
