On the day scattered pump parts were exchanged under the first water-supply agreement in the founding oral account, a fire alarm sounded through the safe corridor just before he, the last witness on the Yeongdeungpo exchange list, sealed the original.

Yeo Ri-a put the original in his inside pocket and left only a copy on the table. As a Surveillance Orbital Force lamp swept the reading-room roof, three copies joined together like a will had been inserted into the authentic-original field.

/story_contents/B044/actors/3/sections/생.en:
By placing the first provisional agreement for exchanging water and parts in the margin of the public-rights section, he split off the protection-contract interpretation field.

When Park Nuri and Im Hajun’s pump-cleaning procedure entered the clerk’s binder, Yeo Ri-a fixed the XT05-SC2 delivery-list hash custody number at the top of the original. Faced with the broadcaster’s unilateral release, he permitted only a joint inspection and did not hand over the key.

/story_contents/B044/actors/3/sections/현.en:
In the archive reading room, Yeo Ri-a chooses the consultation order by the length of the shadows cast by fold marks.

If a document with a different hash is about to be broadcast first, he holds the safe door shut with his knee.

Even if a Records Law House messenger tells him to combine the three testamentary copies into one authentic original, he does not put down his pen before finishing the page-number comparison.

/story_contents/B044/actors/3/sections/비.en:
During the fire alarm, he once pressed an additional fold mark into the original in his inside pocket.

That pressed mark did not match the copy, leaving one clause blurred. When he reads the public rights aloud, he covers only that mark with his sleeve.

/story_contents/B044/actors/3/sections/관.en:
When Park Nuri calls out the valve-lock time, Yeo Ri-an opens only the cleaning-procedure section beside the original.

When Im Hajun’s warranty signature arrives still wet, they check only the page numbers with their fingers and do not voice an interpretation of protectorate rights. When Han Jaemok’s draft sluice charter arrives, Yeo Ri-a first sets aside ink that differs from the first agreement’s wording.

/story_contents/B044/actors/3/sections/3.en:
After the night he put the original in his inside pocket, the public-rights margin is opened and the delivery-list hash number is fixed at the top.

Yeo Ri-an’s concluding choice is between fixing the provisional agreement in the Records Law House’s main text and lending the transmitting side one nighttime consultation slot.

/story_contents/B044/actors/3/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Yeo Ri-a places the first provisional agreement’s public-rights wording in the Records Law House’s main text and seals the protection-contract interpretation field.

In branch β, he gives the transmitting side one nighttime consultation slot and sends one copy on a Suseo delivery run. He permits the safe to be opened or closed only with the paired keys of sluice security and the distribution zone.

The public-rights authority of the Yeongdeungpo original-document case is never left vacant in either transaction.

/story_contents/B044/actors/3/arc/0/summ.en: Hiding the original in an inside pocket during the fire alarm and blocking the combined copy

/story_contents/B044/actors/3/arc/1/summ.en: Entering public rights in the margin and fixing the delivery-list hash number

/story_contents/B044/actors/3/arc/2/summ.en: Entering public rights in the main text versus trading nighttime consultation and a copy on a delivery run

/story_contents/B044/actors/3/outcomes/0.en: Entering the provisional agreement’s public rights in the main text and sealing the protection-contract interpretation field

/story_contents/B044/actors/3/outcomes/1.en: Yielding a nighttime consultation slot and a copy on a Suseo run, with paired-key cross-checking

/story_contents/B044/actors/4/sections/정.en:
Eom Nuri is a component-inspection craftsperson for the Standards Alliance succession test who spots hairline cracks in test wheels by eye before anything else at the Cheonwang warehouse workbench.

If he hears a whisper telling him to stamp a pass at night, he leaves the defective part in the middle of the workbench and does not leave his post.

/story_contents/B044/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
As a wheel apprentice, he did not open the inspection field until two craftworkers had checked it independently.

He developed a habit of refusing unaccompanied nighttime dispatch even at a siding supervisor’s request, and regarded lists allowing manipulated parts into the Chang-dong test as enemies of inspection.

/story_contents/B044/actors/4/sections/가.en:
He is on the Chang-dong Defense House inspection roster, but will not stamp a pass until the crack has been entered in Heo Daon’s wheel-maintenance log.

Even if I Hongwon’s public technical test is delayed, he locks the shipping bell if Park Taegyeom’s adopted-heir succession plan overlaps with test manipulation.

/story_contents/B044/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
At dawn, as the winter’s black dispatch schedule opened, manipulation of components for the northern succession test came to light. Eom Nuri sealed a part with an identical crack at the Cheonwang warehouse and left it on the workbench.

At the time the Abandoned-Line Repair Train Group was making metallic noises on the siding, a copy of the nighttime shipping log bearing his signature in advance had fallen beneath a chair.

/story_contents/B044/actors/4/sections/생.en:
By writing the cracked part and inspection time over one another on a single sheet, he began separating skilled succession from the secret officer network.

When I Hongwon posted the public test date on the wall, Eom Nuri fixed the XT04-SC1 freight-car weight-log public-release run number at the top of the seal. Each night, he copied only the crack’s length into Heo Daon’s log.

/story_contents/B044/actors/4/sections/현.en:
At the Cheonwang workbench, Eom Nuri finds cracks by the angle of a faint shadow on a wheel rim.

When a nighttime shipping slip is posted, he keeps the stamp case strapped to his belt until the cross-inspection field is complete.

Even if a messenger from the Track Defense Gate brings a pass stamp, he does not open the stamp case if the crack log is blank.

/story_contents/B044/actors/4/sections/비.en:
There is a gap in which he saw the pre-signed copy but could not pick it up before the next bell rang.

In that interval, the Chang-dong test queue grew by one line. When he speaks of inspection, he rubs only the oil stain on the workbench corner with his thumb.

/story_contents/B044/actors/4/sections/관.en:
When Heo Daon opens the maintenance log, Eom Nuri points to the crack field and transfers only that entry.

When I Hongwon’s public-test bell rings, the two read the seal numbers aloud together. If Park Taegyeom’s adopted-heir succession plan overlaps with test manipulation, Eom Nuri pushes the shipping bell cord to the bottom of his bag.

/story_contents/B044/actors/4/sections/3.en:
After the cracked part is sealed on the workbench, the inspection time is overlaid on one sheet, and the freight-car weight-log run number is fixed at the top.

Eom Nuri’s concluding choice is between fixing the traces of manipulation in the main text of the standards ledger and giving the supervisor the siding’s nighttime inspection window for half a shift.

/story_contents/B044/actors/4/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Eom Nuri places the traces of component manipulation in the succession test in the main text of the manufacturing-standards ledger and deletes the signature field for unaccompanied nighttime shipping.

In branch β, he opens the siding’s nighttime inspection window to the supervisors once and yields one cracked specimen to the Chang-dong test. He matches the opening and closing of inspection to the page number and time in Heo Daon’s maintenance log.

The Cheonwang warehouse’s cross-inspection field remains on the workbench after the compromise.

/story_contents/B044/actors/4/arc/0/summ.en: Sealing the identically cracked part on the workbench and blocking the forged-signature copy

/story_contents/B044/actors/4/arc/1/summ.en: Recording the inspection time on the same sheet and fixing the freight-car weight-log run number

/story_contents/B044/actors/4/arc/2/summ.en: Entering traces of manipulation in the ledger versus yielding an inspection slot and specimen

/story_contents/B044/actors/4/outcomes/0.en: Entering traces of manipulation in the standards ledger and deleting the unaccompanied nighttime shipping field

/story_contents/B044/actors/4/outcomes/1.en: Yielding the siding inspection slot and cracked specimen, linked to the maintenance log

/story_contents/B044/actors/5/sections/정.en:
Eom Dohan is a researcher-assignment escort officer for Yangjae Machineworks Company who closes the train door at the Magok escort bay when he sees the wrist tag of a researcher being transported like a hostage.

He does not call an accompanying officer there under the pretext of protection a guest, and counts people’s safety before the route.

/story_contents/B044/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
As an escort assistant, he put assignments only on rosters where the safety review’s right-of-refusal field was active.

He developed a habit of returning fields with military escorts to blank, and saw schedules that moved technicians around as state property as enemies of those on the ground.

/story_contents/B044/actors/5/sections/가.en:
He is on the Bukhansan Bogukmun Record House assignment roster, but does not accept an escort order bundled with succession approval in a single deal before Jeong Hojun’s sponsorship arrives as a route condition.

Even when he shares a train with Jin Maru’s medical-escort team, he locks the door if he sees a wrist tag.

/story_contents/B044/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
At dawn, when the Ttukseom water-quality testing network stopped during the third water-supply contract phase, an escort order came down attempting to bundle a researcher assignment and succession approval into one deal.

Eom Dohan pushed the order into a pending box and put Im Chowon on the roster only as an assigned researcher, not a technical successor. As a Cleanroom Mutant clouded the testing-network filter, an accompanying-officer field was being printed over a blank field.

/story_contents/B044/actors/5/sections/생.en:
By putting the assignment roster only in the right-of-refusal field, he separated it from the bundled succession approval.

When Jeong Hojun presented his sponsorship seal as a route condition, Eom Dohan fixed the XT05-SC3 orbital-terminal false-positive correction time at the top of the escort log. With Jin Maru, he balanced only the weights of the patient and researcher sections.

/story_contents/B044/actors/5/sections/현.en:
At the Magok escort bay, Eom Dohan reads tension from ink smudges on wrist tags.

When a slip assigning an accompanying officer is posted, he straps the door handle to his belt until the right-of-refusal field is filled.

Even when a Knowledge Institute messenger brings a bundled escort order, he leaves it outside the pending box.

/story_contents/B044/actors/5/sections/비.en:
Once, he failed to tear up one sheet with the overprinted officer field and pushed it beneath a toolbox rather than beneath the dressing supplies.

That sheet was found on the next shift. When he speaks of assignment rules, he runs his thumb only along the scratch on the box’s latch.

/story_contents/B044/actors/5/sections/관.en:
When Im Chowon tries to put a fragment of a maintenance log in a bag, Eom Dohan opens only the assigned-researcher field and folds away the succession wording.

When Jeong Hojun’s sponsorship seal is presented as a route condition, they confirm aloud only the number in the right-of-refusal field. When Jin Maru divides the medical-escort team, Eom Dohan connects only compartments without wrist tags.

/story_contents/B044/actors/5/sections/3.en:
After he puts the bundled order in the pending box, the assignment roster remains only in the right-of-refusal field, and the false-positive correction time is fixed at the top of the log.

Eom Dohan’s concluding choice is between fixing public escort rules in the Knowledge Institute’s main text and handing nighttime protection of the escort bay to the defense unit’s duty officers.

/story_contents/B044/actors/5/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Eom Dohan places a public escort rule stating that researcher assignments must not be bundled with succession approval in the Knowledge Institute’s main text and deletes the automatic accompanying-officer assignment field.

In branch β, he entrusts nighttime protection of the escort bay to the defense unit for one day and yields one box of spare testing-network filters to the Ttukseom side. He transfers control of the door handle in exchange for the page number of Jin Maru’s medical-escort duty log.

The right-of-refusal provision in the Magok assignment field is not cut away after the compromise.

/story_contents/B044/actors/5/arc/0/summ.en: Putting the bundled escort order on hold and blocking the overprinted officer assignment

/story_contents/B044/actors/5/arc/1/summ.en: A roster restricted to the right-of-refusal field and a fixed orbital false-positive correction time

/story_contents/B044/actors/5/arc/2/summ.en: Entering public escort rules versus trading a protection shift and a box of filters

/story_contents/B044/actors/5/outcomes/0.en: Entering an escort rule separating assignment from approval and deleting the automatic officer-assignment field

/story_contents/B044/actors/5/outcomes/1.en: Yielding a nighttime protection shift and testing-network filters, linked to medical-escort duty

/story_contents/B044/actors/6/sections/정.en:
Ryu Dain is a craftworker harmed by counterfeit water-purification parts under the Sermon Registry State who smells the sweetness of packing material before checking the standards stamp on the Seongsu workshop assembly line.

When a broker reaches out to pass off defects as cleanup costs, he answers only by closing the zipper on the recall box.

/story_contents/B044/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
As an apprentice worker, he put salvaged parts and the list of victims in the same crate and did not open it until the alley-pump mechanic and a council messenger arrived together.

Though his hands were slow, he developed a habit of sealing salvage crates. He saw a tally in which a forged stamp became a shield for the common standard as an enemy of the line.

/story_contents/B044/actors/6/sections/가.en:
Geumcheon District Office Heavy Machinery has a seat at the victims’ hearing, but the assembly bell will not ring again until Han Somi is asked to halt shipments.

He will not open the inspection field until the sweet smell is recorded in Heo Gyeom’s alley-pump log.

/story_contents/B044/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
After the downpour in which summer’s muddy water and counterfeit medicine came together, defective packing entered the water-purification process. Ryu Dain took the list of victim workers from the Seongsu workshops and stopped the assembly line.

As the electrolyte-burn cluster scorched the edge of the washing tank white, the name of a workshop absent from the list had already been stamped on the salvage crate’s lid.

/story_contents/B044/actors/6/sections/생.en:
When Ryu Dain testified about the identical lot on the Ttukseom side, a shipment-halt notice was posted at the head of the line.

When Jong Maru stood as the witness on the other side of the same counterfeit parts in the southwest, Ryu Dain fixed the XT02-SC2 frozen-compressor parts distribution time to the wall beside the crate. The original forged stamp has still not been recovered.

/story_contents/B044/actors/6/sections/현.en:
At the entrance to the Seongsu line, Ryu Dain sets salvage priorities by the strength of the packing’s sweet smell.

When a broker’s note is attached, he wraps the crate key around his belt.

Even if a Heavy Industry Council messenger brings wording about remediation costs, he will not press the bell again if the victims’ list is empty.

/story_contents/B044/actors/6/sections/비.en:
Once, while scraping the pre-stamped workshop name off the lid, he cut one stroke too deeply.

Because of that stroke, another workshop was mistakenly made to stand in line. When he speaks of stopping the line, he only traces the scratches on the lid with his fingertips.

/story_contents/B044/actors/6/sections/관.en:
When Jong Maru presents testimony about the identical lot in the southwest, Ryu Dain rewrites only the first line of the victims’ list in large letters.

When he records the sweet smell in Heo Gyeom’s alley-pump log, the two of them use a hand scale only to match the salvage crates’ weights. When Han Somi asks for the shipment-halt notice, Ryu Dain slides another repair note to the bottom of the crate.

/story_contents/B044/actors/6/sections/3.en:
After the line stops, testimony about the identical lot remains on the crate and the wall, and the compressor-parts distribution time is fixed.

Ryu Dain’s choice of ending is between making the shipping workshop public in the council’s master register and handing one shift of washing-tank night duty to the defense depot.

/story_contents/B044/actors/6/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Ryu Dain enters the workshop that shipped the counterfeit packing in the main text of the Workshop Council’s master register and deletes the alternative signature field for remediation costs.

In branch β, he entrusts washing-tank night duty to the defense force for a day and yields one crate of spare packing to the Magok inspection network. He locks the crate key in step with Heo Gyeom’s alley-pump duty time.

The salvage file of the Seongsu victims’ list stays at the head of the line even after the compromise.

/story_contents/B044/actors/6/arc/0/summ.en: Stopping the assembly line and blocking the name of a workshop absent from the list

/story_contents/B044/actors/6/arc/1/summ.en: Testimony from both sides of the identical lot and fixing the compressor distribution time

/story_contents/B044/actors/6/arc/2/summ.en: Public disclosure of the shipping workshop in the master register versus a defense shift and spare-packing trade

/story_contents/B044/actors/6/outcomes/0.en: Entering the workshop that shipped counterfeit packing in the master register and deleting the remediation-cost field

/story_contents/B044/actors/6/outcomes/1.en: Washing-tank night defense, yielding spare packing, and linking it to alley-pump duty

/story_contents/B044/actors/7/sections/정.en:
Seon Solwoo is a Gate Military Government mechanic who reads the wear on impeller teeth with his fingers in the Guui pump room.

His father was a pump worker who measured the depth of well-ring grooves with his fingernail at Abidjan’s docks. After his Korean ship-repair contract ended, he brought only that habit of his hands to the pump room beneath the bridge.

He does not hang verbal open-or-close orders on the key peg.

/story_contents/B044/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
As a hands-on apprentice, he memorized the metallic sounds of the bridge as an order for replacing packing.

He developed a habit of hanging the wear chart and packing blades on the wall. He regarded a note directing ridge sentries to clear the key peg with a whistle as an enemy of the pump room.

/story_contents/B044/actors/7/sections/가.en:
Yeongdeungpo Sluicekeepers have a seat at the maintenance hearing, but Seon Sol-u will not allow the defense force to open or close the gate on its own until Gwak Minjae’s residual-pressure formula matches the impeller teeth.

He coordinates the opening and closing time before Mun Hayul’s ridge surveillance lets the pipes freeze, but leaves a blank on the wear chart if Go Seojun borrows the pump-room key.

/story_contents/B044/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
Just after the water main burst, the defense force demanded the key. Seon Solwoo left it on its peg and wrote only the time of the breakage on the wear chart.

As the flood-boar cluster churned the mud beneath the bridge, a whistle signal that would leave a whole night blank in the water-purification log had been written in pencil on the pump-room window frame.

/story_contents/B044/actors/7/sections/생.en:
By fixing the packing and impeller replacement cycles in the gate’s public wear chart, he began preserving control of the key in numbers.

When Pan Chodam matched the output to the pump, Seon Solwoo wrote the XT02-SC1 West Sea tidal dock drainage time across the top of the wear chart. He attached Tak Yunjae’s residual-pressure accident log only beside the time of the breakage.

/story_contents/B044/actors/7/sections/현.en:
At the entrance to the Guui pump room, Seon Solwoo sets the replacement order by the roughness of the tooth wear.

When a whistle sounds, he covers the key on its peg with his palm.

Even if a Sluicekeepers messenger requests power distribution for ridge lighting, he turns the valve only when the maintenance key is on its peg.

/story_contents/B044/actors/7/sections/비.en:
He saw the whistle signal on the window frame but could not erase it before the next shift bell rang, leaving a gap.

In that interval, the wear chart gained another blank line. When he reads the public wear chart, he covers only the pencil marks on the window frame with his sleeve.

/story_contents/B044/actors/7/sections/관.en:
When Gwak Minjae draws the residual-pressure formula on his palm, Seon Solwoo checks only those numbers against the impeller teeth.

When Mun Hayul gives two short blasts on the ridge-surveillance whistle, the two of them confirm only the opening and closing time aloud. When Pan Chodam’s output log arrives sealed, Seon Solwoo fills the blank on the wear chart before he even looks at the edge of the log.

/story_contents/B044/actors/7/sections/3.en:
After the night he left the key peg occupied, the wear chart is paired with the time of the breakage, and the dock drainage time is posted at the top.

Seon Solwoo’s choice of ending is between affixing the public wear chart to the gate’s master register and lending one key to the ridge duty shift for a day.

/story_contents/B044/actors/7/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Seon Solwoo puts the public wear chart for packing and impeller replacement cycles in the main text of the Sluicekeepers’ register and deletes the field for defense-force-only opening and closing.

In branch β, he lends one maintenance key to the ridge duty shift for a day and gives one increment of minimum nighttime output to the beacon side. He synchronizes the key to the wear-chart storage with Gwak Minjae’s residual-pressure duty changeover.

The Guui pump-room wear-chart field remains in the gate’s master register regardless of the negotiation’s outcome.

/story_contents/B044/actors/7/arc/0/summ.en: Holding the key peg and recording the breakage time on the wear chart

/story_contents/B044/actors/7/arc/1/summ.en: Making replacement cycles public and fixed, alongside the tidal drainage time

/story_contents/B044/actors/7/arc/2/summ.en: Registering the public wear chart versus lending a key and trading beacon output

/story_contents/B044/actors/7/outcomes/0.en: Entering the public wear chart in the Sluicekeepers’ register and deleting the defense-force-only opening-and-closing field

/story_contents/B044/actors/7/outcomes/1.en: Lending a maintenance key for a day, yielding beacon output, and linking it to residual-pressure duty

/story_contents/B044/actors/8/sections/정.en:
Cheon Nasol is a scale mechanic with the Cathedral Certification Administration who reads the movement of the scale needle before the silence between bids at the Garak auction stand.

Her mother opened a produce stall when a freezer ship from Dakar spent more than a season unloading at Garak. After teaching her to feel the weight of an empty crate in her palm, she made her memorize Korean auction calls first.

She does not accept notes telling her to alter the opening-price blackboard in her toolbox.

/story_contents/B044/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
As a maintenance apprentice, she wrote the opening price and winning bidder on a large blackboard, but opened the scale for military-ration bids only when Nam Yungyeong’s seal and her own maintenance signature were both present.

She developed a habit of hating empty crates more than lies. She regarded notes that let bids used like a vote to recognize a successor buy the scale’s readings as enemies of the auction stand.

/story_contents/B044/actors/8/sections/가.en:
The Noryangjin Frozen Goods Merchant Guild has a seat at the maintenance hearing, but Cheon Na-sol will not break the scale’s seal before Eun Taeho’s auction opens on site.

She will not accept a note in her toolbox until Dong Mion’s incoming weight matches the same reading.

/story_contents/B044/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
On the morning when the produce hall’s prices soared on rumors of a poor harvest alone, an inside merchant collected the warehouse keys before the winning bid, and one strand of the scale’s seal had come loose.

Cheon Nasol pressed down on the scale weight with her hand to stop the bidding. On the night the night-sorting cluster mixed up the frozen-goods labels, a forged maintenance signature had been copied in pencil onto a corner of the opening-price blackboard.

/story_contents/B044/actors/8/sections/생.en:
By binding the scale and the incoming-goods ledger together as one, she stopped bids from buying the readings.

When O Haerin tested Noryangjin prices against the readings, Cheon Nasol fixed the XT03-SC2 canned-goods allocation readjustment time at the top of the blackboard and left beside the scale only the item fields that Dong Yesol had matched.

/story_contents/B044/actors/8/sections/현.en:
Beneath the Garak auction stand, Cheon Nasol begins each day by feeling the difference in temperature against the back of her hand between empty and chilled crates.

If an opening-price note appears in her toolbox, she will not open the scale until its sealing cord has been retied.

Even if a Frozen Goods Merchant Guild messenger brings wording for a direct sale, she will not set down the scale weight if the incoming-goods ledger field is empty.

/story_contents/B044/actors/8/sections/비.en:
Once, she waited one round too long to erase the copied forged signature.

During that round, two military-ration notes were mixed in. When she speaks of public prices, she gathers only the pencil dust from the erased spot with her fingertips.

/story_contents/B044/actors/8/sections/관.en:
When Eun Taeho draws out the silence between bids, Cheon Nasol points to the scale needle to keep the auction going.

When Dong Mion’s incoming weight wavers, the two of them count the pallet nails side by side. When a note bearing O Haerin’s Noryangjin prices arrives, Cheon Nasol checks the maintenance signature before she looks at the note’s edge.

/story_contents/B044/actors/8/sections/3.en:
Where the bidding stopped, the scale and incoming-goods ledger become one, and the canned-goods readjustment time is fixed at the top of the blackboard.

Cheon Nasol’s ending splits between erasing the forged-signature field from the master register and adding one line granting military rations purchase priority at the end of the daytime auction.

/story_contents/B044/actors/8/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Cheon Nasol enters the unified standard for the scale and incoming-goods ledger in the main text of the Frozen Goods Merchant Guild’s master register and blacks out the forged maintenance-signature field with ink.

In branch β, she adds one line granting military rations purchase priority at the end of the daytime round and gives one increment of nighttime freezing power to the merchant association’s reserves. She locks authority to publish the opening price to the last four digits of Eun Taeho’s bid sequence.

The readings recorded at Garak’s public auction stand remain after any compromise.

/story_contents/B044/actors/8/arc/0/summ.en: Stopping the auction over the loosened scale seal and blocking the forged signature in pencil

/story_contents/B044/actors/8/arc/1/summ.en: Unifying the scale and incoming-goods ledger and fixing the canned-goods readjustment time

/story_contents/B044/actors/8/arc/2/summ.en: Erasing the forged-signature field versus trading military-ration priority for a power increment

/story_contents/B044/actors/8/outcomes/0.en: Registering the unified scale-and-incoming-goods standard and erasing the forged-signature field

/story_contents/B044/actors/8/outcomes/1.en: A military-ration priority line, a nighttime-power concession, and publication linked to the bid sequence

/story_contents/B044/actors/9/sections/정.en:
Heavy Equipment Arm is a heavy-equipment-class synthetic unit that runs its loop only over the lane-sensor array in the Sinnae charging slot.

It writes no long-term memory beyond shift snapshots. When its battery charge enters the warning range, it pushes control packets from other zones into the discard queue and maintains only the zone key’s single channel.

/story_contents/B044/actors/9/sections/붕.en:
During its initial deployment cycles, Heavy Equipment Arm was locked to retain its fork log only as a single end-of-shift hash line.

The restriction against calling the neighboring substation socket-discovery routine, even when the worn-parts queue runs empty, is embedded in its base image.

/story_contents/B044/actors/9/sections/가.en:
It records access bits in the duty log only under the HC04 custody seal and returns a rejection code for transfer requests lacking three-party signatures.

Until it recognizes Jeon Miri’s chief-maintenance glove tag, it moves the cover-lock motor only for fine adjustments toward the sensor.

/story_contents/B044/actors/9/sections/붕.en:
On a shift when the circuit-line alarm sounded three times in succession, a heap of packets demanding that the entire facility network be opened filled the receive buffer.

Heavy Equipment Arm condensed the heap into a zone-key-only response and sent it back. Just before the cross-route permission flag flipped amid the frequencies with which the G16 Blueprint Ghost Machine Group blurred the pit wiring diagram, it dropped into offline isolation mode.

/story_contents/B044/actors/9/sections/생.en:
By combining that day’s snapshot bytes and the custody-seal hash in one frame header, it blocked the long-term fork path.

When Bok Yong uploaded the unloading-vibration log to the terminal, Heavy Equipment Arm recorded the XT03-SC1 alternative service-window identifier in the zone key’s auxiliary field. Even when Jeon Miri applied the charge pad, it did not overwrite the previous shift’s image.

/story_contents/B044/actors/9/sections/현.en:
In the charging slot, Heavy Equipment Arm adjusts its loop cycle according to the height of dust deposits on the sensor array.

When a packet requesting access to the entire network arrives, it emits only a short rejection tone and clears every permission bit outside the zone-key field.

Even when the parts queue nears empty, it does not begin scanning control sockets in adjacent facilities.

/story_contents/B044/actors/9/sections/비.en:
There is a frame number for which it failed to enter a line of residual cross-route hash left in the buffer just before isolation into the human-approval log.

That number remained only in a temporary area, and it indicates it solely through the status LED’s blinking pattern when requesting partial reconnection.

/story_contents/B044/actors/9/sections/관.en:
When Jeon Miri places the charge pad against the slot contacts, Heavy Equipment Arm returns only the length of today’s shift snapshot to the terminal.

When Bok Yong reads aloud the unloading-vibration threshold number, it writes only that value to the read buffer and emits one confirmation tone. It does not raise the transfer-field flag until it receives the Energy Union auditor-attendance stamp bit, not an oracle’s.

/story_contents/B044/actors/9/sections/3.en:
After it leaves only the zone key active during the alarm shift, the snapshot and custody-seal hash are combined in one header, and the alternative service-window identifier is written in the auxiliary field.

Heavy Equipment Arm’s final branch is between publishing the zone’s continuous-operation standard in the duty log and accepting a maintenance sleep cycle that postpones reconnection.

/story_contents/B044/actors/9/sections/분.en:
In branch α, Heavy Equipment Arm publishes the zone’s continuous-operation standard and the gap hash in the duty log, and permanently locks the cross-facility route permission flag in the blocked state.

In branch β, it obtains approval for one maintenance sleep cycle and partially restores the sealed-map warehouse coordinates to Jeon Miri’s session. It aligns the zone-key renewal window with the time slot on Bok Yong’s unloading terminal.

The zone-key authority line for the Jamsil Line charging slot is not deleted in either branch.

/story_contents/B044/actors/9/arc/0/summ.en: Narrowing the entire-network request to a zone-key-only response

/story_contents/B044/actors/9/arc/1/summ.en: Combining the snapshot and seal hash in one frame and fixing the alternative service-window identifier

/story_contents/B044/actors/9/arc/2/summ.en: Publishing the operation standard versus maintenance sleep and partial session restoration

/story_contents/B044/actors/9/outcomes/0.en: Publishing the zone-operation standard and gap hash, and permanently blocking cross-routes

/story_contents/B044/actors/9/outcomes/1.en: Maintenance sleep, partial restoration of sealed coordinates, and key renewal linked to the unloading log

/story_contents/B045/actors/0/sections/정.en:
Ryu Gaon was a convoy keeper dispatched from the Escort Protection State's protection force, folding a roster with its return-time line left blank as Godeok siding gravel pressed under her shoes.

When a courier came ordering her to take down a verbal garrison permit, she snapped her pencil and left the column blank.

/story_contents/B045/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
In her freight-assistant days she had learned only the habit of writing the convoy cars' weight and the return time on the front and back of the same note.

She did not laugh at the officers' joke that called the Seongdong militia barricade a rescue target, and left a diagonal strike through it in the margin of the route note.

/story_contents/B045/actors/0/sections/가.en:
The Changdong Protection House's name stood on the convoy attendance list, but until the waterworks administration's seal and the escort corps' code badge overlapped, no train out of Godeok moved.

Even when Han Bora's patrol dispatch moved up, a roster with its return-time column blank was turned back at the siding.

/story_contents/B045/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
In the third Water Compact phase, when Bae Woojin's protection-force dispatch proposal fell through, Ryu Gaon drove the convoy train all the way to the Seongdong bridge and was stopped by Gi Hagyeom's lock.

On the night the Flood-Boar Swarm tore up the mud beneath the piers, the garrison gun-mount crates were lashed together like parts cars.

/story_contents/B045/actors/0/sections/생.en:
By rewriting the return time in large letters at the top of the roster, the indefinite-garrison clause was erased.

When the XT04-SC1 freight-car weight logs were published, she re-weighed the convoy cars and wrote the gun-mount crates' weight in the margin, and before Gi Hagyeom's bridge lock she turned back, leaving only a record instead of a passage request.

/story_contents/B045/actors/0/sections/현.en:
On the Godeok platform Ryu Gaon judged departure by the length of the blanks in the roster.

Even when the officers' flags shouted rescue, she only retied the convoy cars' sealing cords and checked the patrol train's couplers.

Even when the defense gate pressed, a dispatch with no term set never went up on the release board.

/story_contents/B045/actors/0/sections/비.en:
On the day she turned back before the bridge, she rounded the gun-mount crates' weight on the fare table and shaved one column off.

The shaved-down number remained as an ink dot on the inside of her wrist, and every time she watched the re-weighing scale she covered it with her sleeve.

/story_contents/B045/actors/0/sections/관.en:
When Han Bora wrote the convoy car numbers on the patrol-train dispatch board, Ryu Gaon chalked the return time over them.

When Bae Woojin's dispatch note arrived still wet, she folded the garrison-supply column into her pocket before hanging it on the drying rack, and when Gi Hagyeom raised a hand from the bridge barricade, she handed over only a single line of stay records instead of a passage request.

/story_contents/B045/actors/0/sections/3.en:
After the Seongdong lock stopped her, the weight logs and the re-weighing were pinned into one margin, and the return time was fixed at the head of the roster.

The fork Ryu Gaon divided with her fingertips ran between raising the fixed-term convoy into the defense gate's ledger, and exposing the hidden gun-mount cars and laying down the convoy keeper's post.

/story_contents/B045/actors/0/sections/분.en:
At the alpha fork Ryu Gaon raised the fixed-term convoy with its return time written in as an essential clause of the Orbital Defense ledger and deleted the garrison-permit column.

At the beta fork she entered the gun-mount crates' weight in the public ledger and, taking disqualification from the convoy keeper's post in exchange, left the Seongdong militia's lock as witness testimony.

In neither fork did the return-time column stamped on the Godeok siding go back to blank.

/story_contents/B045/actors/0/arc/0/summ.en: The Seongdong bridge lock and the blank-return-time roster

/story_contents/B045/actors/0/arc/1/summ.en: Publishing the freight-car weight logs and re-weighing the convoy cars

/story_contents/B045/actors/0/arc/2/summ.en: Fixed-term convoy ledger registration versus gun-mount car exposure and disqualification

/story_contents/B045/actors/0/outcomes/0.en: Fixed-term convoy entered in the ledger; garrison-permit column deleted

/story_contents/B045/actors/0/outcomes/1.en: Gun-mount weights published; convoy keeper disqualified; militia lock testified

/story_contents/B045/actors/1/sections/정.en:
Gi Bareum was an emergency convoy courier of the Water Compact's western branch, feeling out the sealing cord's loosening with her thumb along the Sinjeong night railing.

When a note came ordering her to fit the arrival time to a political schedule, she left only a long route memo and kept her mouth shut.

/story_contents/B045/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
As a water-supply assistant she had done nothing but repeat the work of loading parts cars and water tanks onto the same scale.

The hand habit of turning back extra night cars without code badges at the sluice hardened in her gloved palm.

/story_contents/B045/actors/1/sections/가.en:
Her name stood on the Yeongdeungpo Sluice House's emergency convoy duty roster, but she took no departure stamp unless the order was a sequence drawn jointly by the ration districts and the repair-train chief.

Even when she borrowed Pyo Siwan's charter courier route, she would not carry a sealed chest missing the minimum-line clause.

/story_contents/B045/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
In the Second Water Compact, when the temporary pumps and the train parts reached the end of their lives at once, Gi Bareum guarded the sealed chest bearing the minimum-line clause, shuttling between Ttukseom and Sinjeong.

On the night the Sewer-Raccoon Pack prized open the pipe seams, the eastern protection force's rescue train was aiming for the same bridge slot.

/story_contents/B045/actors/1/sections/생.en:
By writing the convoy order only on the public lottery board, the secret officers'-network extra column was erased.

When the XT02-SC1 wharf drainage schedule was redrawn, she pinned bridge-detour notes to fit the drainage window, and onto Choi Hangyeol's armored repair train she coupled only the parts cars, hanging the water tanks' seal separately.

/story_contents/B045/actors/1/sections/현.en:
At the Sinjeong release window Gi Bareum read arrival yes-or-no from the tension of the sealing cord.

Even when a political schedule pulled the hour earlier, she amended only the lower part of the lottery order and turned back night cars without code badges at the sluice.

Even under the sluice house's urging, no chest without the minimum-line clause was loaded.

/story_contents/B045/actors/1/sections/비.en:
On one night bridge, tying the sealing cord one car late let the clause note take the dew.

She kept the memory of the blurred letters' width only as a dot at the bottom of her route memo, and whenever she received an arrival stamp she covered the dot with her thumb.

/story_contents/B045/actors/1/sections/관.en:
When Pyo Siwan handed over a charter courier route note, Gi Bareum copied only the minimum-line sentence onto the sealed chest's outer face.

When Choi Hangyeol opened the repair train's couplers, the two matched only the parts-car numbers and locked the water-tank lids separately, and the replacement parts Gi Pilho sent from Guro went onto the scale before the munitions car's colored cord was untied.

/story_contents/B045/actors/1/sections/3.en:
The route she had shuttled with the end-of-life pumps' clause chest changed into the public lottery and the drainage-window detour, and the seal's tension became the standard at the release window.

The fork Gi Bareum divided with the sealing cord ran between entering the public convoy network in the sluice house's ledger, and conceding one night code-badge car.

/story_contents/B045/actors/1/sections/분.en:
At the alpha fork Gi Bareum entered the water minimum-line emergency convoy network in the sluice house's public ledger and deleted the officers'-network extra column.

At the beta fork she gave one drainage-window slot to the eastern rescue train while keeping the sealed chest's priority passage, and published the dew-soaked clause note in the correction margin.

In neither fork did the Sinjeong lottery board's convoy order go back to the secret officers' network.

/story_contents/B045/actors/1/arc/0/summ.en: Pump lifespans expiring and the sealed chest's night shuttles

/story_contents/B045/actors/1/arc/1/summ.en: The bridge detour timed to the wharf drainage window

/story_contents/B045/actors/1/arc/2/summ.en: Public convoy network registration versus conceding a code-badge slot

/story_contents/B045/actors/1/outcomes/0.en: Minimum-line public convoy network registered; officers'-network extra column deleted

/story_contents/B045/actors/1/outcomes/1.en: Drainage-window slot conceded; sealed chest priority passage; dew correction published

/story_contents/B045/actors/2/sections/정.en:
Yeo Sion was a fabrication-charter courier of the Standards Alliance, squaring the corners of three charter copies on the dirt ground before the Guro association board.

When a declaration's wording clashed with the workshop rules, she put the day off without loosening her bag strap.

/story_contents/B045/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
As a workshop apprentice she had done nothing but copy the repair standards and the restoration-labor citizenship clause on the left and right in strokes of equal weight.

The habit of never sending out a delivery down to its last copy remained as tape on her wrist.

/story_contents/B045/actors/2/sections/가.en:
Her name stood on the Guro Alloy House's standards attendance list, but she did not open the Cheonwang-bound bag until the labor union, the building union, and the guard force had each received one copy.

Even when she shared Pyo Gangho's standards courier route, she read the note ordering her to recall copies as ratification bait only after the posting.

/story_contents/B045/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
On the day the Sixteen Banners dissolved, Yeo Sion delivered the southwest's own charter copies to Cheonwang and Geumcheon at the same hour, and one Geumcheon copy all but got recalled.

On the evening the Blueprint-Ghost Machine Corps swallowed the workshop blueprints, the line demoting the council to a subordinate work squad was penciled on the back of the recall note.

/story_contents/B045/actors/2/sections/생.en:
By nailing all three copies to the board's nails at the same moment, the solo recall route was blocked.

When the XT02-SC2 freezer-compressor parts division table arrived, Yeo Sion copied its lot numbers into the charter's margin and bound them to the repair standards, and Gang Minseo's Fabrication Council declaration went up first on the Guro alley wall alone.

/story_contents/B045/actors/2/sections/현.en:
Before the Guro board Yeo Sion counted deliveries complete by the dust-covered length of the copies' corners.

Even when the Records Bureau pressed for ratification, she took Yun Seorin's demand letter only after the posting-time stamp had been struck.

Even when a Cheolseong auditor urged recalling one copy, she did not set out if the three professions' recipients ran empty.

/story_contents/B045/actors/2/sections/비.en:
Because she posted at Cheonwang an hour ahead of Geumcheon, the Geumcheon work squad suffered a day's standards gap.

She kept the measure of that hour's gap only as a pen dot inside her bag, and every time she boasted of the simultaneous delivery she covered the dot with a finger.

/story_contents/B045/actors/2/sections/관.en:
When Pyo Gangho shared a standards courier route note, Yeo Sion rewrote only the Cheonwang and Geumcheon arrival columns in large letters.

When Gang Minseo handed over a council declaration, she matched the height of the Guro wall nails with her palm, and when Yun Seorin's ratification seal arrived damp, she dried the posting-time stamp first and only then opened the envelope.

/story_contents/B045/actors/2/sections/3.en:
The dissolution day's simultaneous delivery hardened into the three-profession posting, and the compressor lots were pinned into the repair standards' margin.

The fork Yeo Sion divided with her bag strap ran between raising the independent charter posting as a Cheolseong ledger essential, and publishing the gap dot and accepting courier replacement.

/story_contents/B045/actors/2/sections/분.en:
At the alpha fork Yeo Sion raised the three-profession simultaneous posting as a clause of the Jecheolseong ledger and deleted the solo-recall column.

At the beta fork she recorded the Cheonwang lead gap in the work squad's log, accepted the courier-replacement lottery, and left only the Geumcheon work squad's gap-compensation parts in the lot.

In neither fork did the Guro board's three-profession receipt times fold into a one-copy recall.

/story_contents/B045/actors/2/arc/0/summ.en: The dissolution-day simultaneous delivery to Cheonwang and Geumcheon, and the recall crisis

/story_contents/B045/actors/2/arc/1/summ.en: The compressor lots and the fixed three-profession posting

/story_contents/B045/actors/2/arc/2/summ.en: Ledger registration versus publishing the gap and replacing the courier

/story_contents/B045/actors/2/outcomes/0.en: Three-profession simultaneous posting registered in the ledger; solo-recall column deleted

/story_contents/B045/actors/2/outcomes/1.en: Lead gap published; courier-replacement lottery; Geumcheon compensation lot

/story_contents/B045/actors/3/sections/정.en:
Yeo Dasom was the Yangjae Machineworks Company's technology-sharing secretary for the lesser states' meetings, laying her pen down whenever the water level in the Magok meeting hall's bucket dropped one notch.

When a draft came that hid knowledge behind protection-fee clauses, she left her seat without loosening the binding cord.

/story_contents/B045/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
As an archive assistant she had done nothing but collate the certified copies' page counts and the hostage-substitution column on the same line.

She called the order that set items on the great powers' desks before the lesser states' delegates could read them an insult.

/story_contents/B045/actors/3/sections/가.en:
Her name stood on the Magok Life House's meeting attendance list, but she did not bind a draft whose Joint Technology Institute verification-material column ran empty.

Even when she copied Jeong Hojun's draft, any sentence that dropped it into an appendix of the great powers' Water Compact she wrote only in the margin and struck from the body.

/story_contents/B045/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
In the spring of the second year, when three great-power contracts poured into the eleven-seat meeting, Yeo Dasom spread the technology-sharing copies on the lesser states' table alone.

The moment the Radio-Wave Crow Flock pecked at the meeting hall's radio, the researcher roster was one beat from reading like a partition-and-annexation assignment table.

/story_contents/B045/actors/3/sections/생.en:
By striking the lesser states' reading stamps ahead of the great powers' submission times, the slide into appendix was stopped.

When the XT05-SC3 orbit-terminal false-alarm correction table arrived, she bound the false-alarm numbers into the technology sharing's margin and built an independent clause for the verification material, and she tied only U Oreum's water minimum-line copy with the same bundle cord.

/story_contents/B045/actors/3/sections/현.en:
From the Magok secretary's seat Yeo Dasom watched the bucket's water level and the missing page counts side by side.

When a protection-fee clause covered a knowledge column, she set down the pen and put the binding cord into the desk drawer.

Even when the Life Sciences House observer moved the schedule up, a draft with an empty hostage-substitution column went unbound.

/story_contents/B045/actors/3/sections/비.en:
On the eleven seats' first day she pulled one sheet of the draft with its empty hostage-substitution column, then let it go again in the night.

She left the count of the undone binding holes as dots on the inside of her wrist, and covered them with her sleeve whenever she read the page counts aloud.

/story_contents/B045/actors/3/sections/관.en:
When Jeong Hojun handed over a Joint Technology Institute draft, Yeo Dasom read the verification-material column aloud and pencil-struck the protection-fee lines.

When Jeong Yura's termination-condition wording joined the same bundle, she switched the binding cord's color, and U Oreum's minimum-line copy sent from Yeouido she set down only beside the left-hand bucket of the lesser states' table.

/story_contents/B045/actors/3/sections/3.en:
The lesser-states-only spread hardened into the reading-stamp order, and the false-alarm numbers were pinned into the independent clause's margin.

The fork Yeo Dasom divided with the binding holes ran between raising technology sharing into the joint bargaining body text, and publishing the empty column's binding holes and vacating the secretary's seat.

/story_contents/B045/actors/3/sections/분.en:
At the alpha fork Yeo Dasom raised verification-material sharing as an independent clause of the joint bargaining and deleted the protection-fee appendix column.

At the beta fork she wrote the holes left by the withdrawn empty column in the secretary's-seat margin, accepted the secretary replacement, and left only the false-alarm correction table for her successor's binding.

In neither fork did the lesser states' table pre-reading stamp order slip behind the great powers' appendix.

/story_contents/B045/actors/3/arc/0/summ.en: The eleven-seat lesser-states-only spread and the roster crisis

/story_contents/B045/actors/3/arc/1/summ.en: The false-alarm numbers and the fixed reading-stamp order

/story_contents/B045/actors/3/arc/2/summ.en: Independent-clause registration versus publishing the binding holes and replacing the secretary

/story_contents/B045/actors/3/outcomes/0.en: Technology-sharing independent clause registered; protection-fee appendix column deleted

/story_contents/B045/actors/3/outcomes/1.en: Empty-column binding holes published; secretary replaced; false-alarm table handed to the successor

/story_contents/B045/actors/4/sections/정.en:
Eom Mirae was a testament-evidence convoy courier of the Sermon Registry State, tugging the sealed case's cord knot three times in the Seongsu transfer hall before taking a step.

A note ordering her to broadcast the original first never got pinned to the bag's outer face.

/story_contents/B045/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
On workshop errands she had done nothing but weigh testament copies and voice originals on the same scale.

The habit of striking her own hand with the back of the other whenever it reached to open the case before the transmission verification's arrival confirmation remained.

/story_contents/B045/actors/4/sections/가.en:
The Geumcheon District Office Machinery House's name stood on the evidence-convoy duty roster, but she did not shoulder the Seongsu-bound bag unless the order was the lottery sequence drawn between the Workshop Council and the records auditor.

Even when she borrowed Pyo Sanha's council courier route, she held to never putting Im Chowon's maintenance-log fragments into the same bag.

/story_contents/B045/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
On the day the spring's three testaments were opened, Eom Mirae carried the Seongsu copies to a single review bench instead of splitting them between Seoul Station and Sangam, and in the waiting hall the bag cord went slack once.

The moment the Flood-Mold Breath Cluster rained spores from the transfer ceiling, the last remaining copy was nearly read as a spark of riot.

/story_contents/B045/actors/4/sections/생.en:
By striking the single review bench's arrival stamp in the same minute as the transmission confirmation, the split-convoy clause was erased.

When the XT03-SC2 sealing tools arrived from Ttukseom, she bound the tools' receipt numbers into the sealed case's margin, and to match Choi Jiwoo's original verification time she set the bag down only before the review bench.

/story_contents/B045/actors/4/sections/현.en:
At the Seongsu gate Eom Mirae judged departure by the knot's tension and the bag's weight.

Even under broadcast urging, the sealed case did not open before arrival at the review bench.

Even when a Heavy Industry Council auditor told her to split the route in two, she amended only one line of the lottery sequence.

/story_contents/B045/actors/4/sections/비.en:
When a child cried in the waiting hall, she opened the sealed case half a column to check the copy's corner.

She kept the width of that half-column gap as a pen dot on the back of her hand, and each time she tugged the knot she gauged the gap against the dot.

/story_contents/B045/actors/4/sections/관.en:
When Pyo Sanha passed over a council courier route note, Eom Mirae copied only the review bench number onto the bag tag.

When Choi Jiwoo called the verification time over the radio, she set the arrival stamp's minute to it, and even when Im Chowon offered maintenance-log fragments she took them only into a separate chest of a different colored cord and never into the same bag.

/story_contents/B045/actors/4/sections/3.en:
Past the waiting hall of the slack cord, the single review bench's stamp overlapped the transmission confirmation, and the sealing-tool numbers were pinned into the case's margin.

The fork Eom Mirae divided by the knot's tension ran between entering the single-bench convoy in the Heavy Industry Council's ledger, and publishing the half-column gap and laying down her courier credentials.

/story_contents/B045/actors/4/sections/분.en:
At the alpha fork Eom Mirae raised the three testaments' single-bench convoy as a clause of the Heavy Industry Council's ledger and deleted the split-broadcast column.

At the beta fork she wrote the half-column checking gap into the bag tag's margin, accepted courier disqualification, and left only the sealing-tool numbers for her successor's bag tag.

In neither fork did the Seongsu bag's single-bench arrival stamp split in two.

/story_contents/B045/actors/4/arc/0/summ.en: The waiting hall's slack cord and the single-bench stubbornness

/story_contents/B045/actors/4/arc/1/summ.en: The sealing-tool numbers and the transmission confirmation stamped the same minute

/story_contents/B045/actors/4/arc/2/summ.en: Ledger registration versus publishing the half-column gap and courier disqualification

/story_contents/B045/actors/4/outcomes/0.en: Single-bench convoy registered in the ledger; split-broadcast column deleted

/story_contents/B045/actors/4/outcomes/1.en: Half-column gap published; courier disqualified; tool numbers handed to the successor

/story_contents/B045/actors/5/sections/정.en:
Eom Siwan was a charter-declaration courier of the Escort Protection State's eastern branch, who set charter copies on the Godeok administration window's scale and read only the emergency-oversight term number first.

If wording rewritten into a permanent clause sat on the front face, he closed the bag and put the day off.

/story_contents/B045/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
As an administration apprentice he had done nothing but balance waterworks-administration copies and escort-corps copies on the scale's two pans.

The habit of pocketing the departure stamp whenever one pan ran empty remained.

/story_contents/B045/actors/5/sections/가.en:
His name stood on the Ttukseom Heat-Source House's declaration attendance list, but he did not open the bridge-blockade-duty bag until the administration office and the escort corps had each received one copy.

Even when he shared Ji Mokhyeon's escort courier route, he did not post a copy that lacked Jeong Soyul's administrative wording on its front face.

/story_contents/B045/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
After the Sixteen Banners dissolved, Eom Siwan delivered Amsa's own charter to Godeok and the bridge blockade unit at the same hour, and saw that the blockade side's term number had been stamped a month longer.

On the night the Transfer-Rat Colony gnawed the blockade unit's cable grooves, a permanent oversight power without the Records Bureau hid in the shadow of that long number.

/story_contents/B045/actors/5/sections/생.en:
By rewriting both copies' term numbers in the same ink, the permanence clause was erased.

When the XT04-SC3 mineral-sample seal inspection opened at Achasan, he wrote the emergency oversight's expiry date beside the forged-origin disposal list, and he took Yun Seorin's ratification demand only after the posting time had been stamped.

/story_contents/B045/actors/5/sections/현.en:
At the Godeok window Eom Siwan confirmed the weight of the two copies by the scale's tilt.

Even when ratification bait urged a recall, he did not dispatch a delivery with its expiry date blank.

Even when an Energy Union auditor offered a route keeping only one copy, if a pan ran empty the stamp stayed in his pocket.

/story_contents/B045/actors/5/sections/비.en:
Once he left the long number on the blockade side untouched for a day and corrected Godeok first.

He left that day's gap as a dot on the scale weight's side, and each time he read the term he divided out the day with the dot.

/story_contents/B045/actors/5/sections/관.en:
When Ji Mokhyeon handed over an escort courier route note, Eom Siwan rewrote only the blockade unit's arrival column.

When Jeong Soyul fastened administrative wording to the front face, he set that copy on the scale's left pan, and even when Yun Seorin's ratification seal arrived he did not untie the envelope cord before the posting-time stamp dried.

/story_contents/B045/actors/5/sections/3.en:
The month-long number was squared in the same ink, and the expiry date was pinned beside the disposal list.

The fork Eom Siwan divided by the scale's tilt ran between entering the stamped-expiry dual rule in the Energy Union's ledger, and publishing the one-day gap and accepting courier replacement.

/story_contents/B045/actors/5/sections/분.en:
At the alpha fork Eom Siwan raised the emergency oversight's expiry date as an essential clause of the eastern charter and deleted the permanent-oversight column.

At the beta fork he engraved the blockade side's one-day lead on the scale weight's side, accepted the replacement draw, and left only the expiry-date comparison table beside his successor's scale.

In neither fork did the Godeok scale's expiry-date number stretch into a permanent column.

/story_contents/B045/actors/5/arc/0/summ.en: The blockade unit's mismatched term number and the simultaneous delivery

/story_contents/B045/actors/5/arc/1/summ.en: The expiry date set beside the forged-origin disposal list

/story_contents/B045/actors/5/arc/2/summ.en: Expiry-clause registration versus publishing the one-day gap and replacement

/story_contents/B045/actors/5/outcomes/0.en: Emergency-oversight expiry date entered in the ledger; permanent-oversight column deleted

/story_contents/B045/actors/5/outcomes/1.en: Blockade one-day lead published; courier replaced; comparison table handed over

/story_contents/B045/actors/6/sections/정.en:
Su Neulgyeol was a Jeongdong General Labor Union maintainer and Eun Boram's operational manager, memorizing the test parts' teeth marks like people's names in the Suseo depot pit.

Family notes with an empty nationality column stayed folded in the bottom compartment of the toolbox, and nominations were taken only through the skill-score chalkboard.

/story_contents/B045/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
In the evacuation corridor's temporary maintenance tent she had done nothing but read shift diligence from the wear on bolt heads.

The rule against taking kinship-patronage notes in the toolbox was nailed to the tent pole back then and followed her to Suseo.

/story_contents/B045/actors/6/sections/가.en:
Her name stood on the Yongsan Convoy House's night-turn maintenance duty roster, but she kept the release switch locked until the nomination grounds and the test scores went up on the same board.

She upheld Eun Boram's nomination rules in the field, but she did not accept the corporate side's exclusive nomination list without a citizen-lottery countersign.

/story_contents/B045/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
When the Magok inspection crew called the Suseo pit's skilled workers by name first, a nomination-committee note slipped under the toolbox lid, and Su Neulgyeol lowered the test window's shutter and locked the release switch.

On the night the Retired-Line Maintenance-Train Corps moved along the siding on its own, the maintenance shop was one beat from reading like a hostage window for technicians.

/story_contents/B045/actors/6/sections/생.en:
By nailing the unpublished roster to the front of the board instead of fixing it behind the test chalkboard, the hostage-window clause was erased.

When the XT05-SC2 delivery-list hashes were taken into custody and the Suseo delivery turn line opened, she bound the turn numbers into the test-score column and opened the release, and only Won Choon's duty tools shared the same shelf with hers.

/story_contents/B045/actors/6/sections/현.en:
In the Suseo pit Su Neulgyeol read the teeth marks and the scores side by side to judge release.

When the great powers called for technicians by name alone, she pointed only at the chalkboard with the switch locked.

Even under the Delivery Corps' urging, a dispatch without the countersign did not ride the turn.

/story_contents/B045/actors/6/sections/비.en:
On the night of the blockade, during the duty shift, one name from the unpublished roster slipped out as a single line left in the turn log.

She engraved that line's letter count as dots in the wrench handle's groove, and every time she opened a release she covered the groove with her thumb.

/story_contents/B045/actors/6/sections/관.en:
When Eun Boram handed over a nomination-rules note, Su Neulgyeol rewrote only the test-score column, large, in chalk.

When Won Choon set duty tools on the shelf, the two matched only parts lots instead of dispatch names, and Jeong Hojun's plan for the Joint Technology Institute was copied only into the verification column at the bottom of the chalkboard.

/story_contents/B045/actors/6/sections/3.en:
The test-window blockade changed into posting-board publicity, and the turn numbers were pinned into the score column.

The fork Su Neulgyeol divided with the wrench groove ran between entering the public skill nominations in the Delivery Corps' ledger, and publishing the line that slipped out and laying down the operational post.

/story_contents/B045/actors/6/sections/분.en:
At the alpha fork Su Neulgyeol raised nominations by skill test and maintenance signature as a clause of the Delivery Corps' ledger and deleted the unpublished-dispatch column.

At the beta fork she wrote the name left in the turn log into the correction column beside the test chalkboard, surrendered the operational post, and left only the test chalkboard's form to her successor.

In neither fork did the Suseo chalkboard's score column hide behind an unpublished roster.

/story_contents/B045/actors/6/arc/0/summ.en: The unpublished dispatch roster and the test-window blockade

/story_contents/B045/actors/6/arc/1/summ.en: Manifest-hash turn numbers joined to the score column

/story_contents/B045/actors/6/arc/2/summ.en: Public-nomination registration versus publishing the one line and returning the post

/story_contents/B045/actors/6/outcomes/0.en: Skill-test nominations registered in the ledger; unpublished-dispatch column deleted

/story_contents/B045/actors/6/outcomes/1.en: Turn-log line published; operational post returned; chalkboard form handed over

/story_contents/B045/actors/7/sections/정.en:
Im Bada was the Water Compact's western citizen delegate for water rights, gauging the water level by rapping the lids of the Yangcheon alley cisterns with his palm.

Across the redrawn borders he pinned waiting tickets, family by family, for households whose papers had lapsed, and tore up any note ordering him to swap the origin column for ration order.

/story_contents/B045/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
In the evacuation queue he had done nothing but copy each alley's bucket marks onto the chalkboard.

The habit of taking any talk of sacrificing one alley for efficiency as an insult hardened at the queue railing back then.

/story_contents/B045/actors/7/sections/가.en:
His name stood on the Yeouido Ledger House's citizen water-supply attendance list, but when a cutoff notice went up he demanded the cisterns be opened on the delegates' joint signatures.

He formed an alliance with Baek On over transferable water rights, but he did not take down Han Jaemok's collective-cutoff sanction lines from any ledger without joint signatures.

/story_contents/B045/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
When a pipe failure cut water to part of Yangcheon, Im Bada convened the citizen water-rights emergency council and pinned the Bukhansan Bogukmun family rolls and the waiting tickets to one chalkboard.

On the night the Coolant-Index Fungal Body coated the cistern walls, the disaster-zone residents were nearly pushed onto the refugee rolls, left as nothing but water-duty numbers.

/story_contents/B045/actors/7/sections/생.en:
By posting each alley's waiting tickets publicly, the numbers-only duty column was erased.

When the XT05-SC1 remaining-band lottery opened at Sangam and the Yeouido water-supply duty was timed to it, he bound the duty numbers into the minimum-line column, and he took only I Seodam's zone-veto joint signatures as approval in the body text.

/story_contents/B045/actors/7/sections/현.en:
Before the Yangcheon board Im Bada judged opening by the sound of the lid rapping and the number of waiting-ticket lines.

When a collective-cutoff notice went up, he did not hand over the cistern keys before the joint signatures gathered.

Even when a Ledger Office auditor offered an efficiency-sacrifice plan, he amended only the family-unit tickets.

/story_contents/B045/actors/7/sections/비.en:
On the emergency council's first day he opened the meeting without getting one family missing from the Bukhansan Bogukmun rolls onto the waiting tickets.

He left the length of that missing line as a dot inside the cistern lid, and each time he rapped it he counted the missing line by the dot.

/story_contents/B045/actors/7/sections/관.en:
When Baek On handed over a transferable-water-rights note, Im Bada rewrote only the first line of the family-unit waiting tickets in large letters.

When I Seodam brought the zone-veto joint signatures, he matched that stamp to the cistern-key column, and when Han Jaemok's cutoff-sanction draft arrived, the signatureless lines went into the trash bin beneath the chalkboard.

/story_contents/B045/actors/7/sections/3.en:
The cutoff alley's emergency council hardened into public waiting tickets, and the duty numbers were pinned into the minimum-line column.

The fork Im Bada divided with the cistern lid ran between entering the citizen water-right minimum line in the Ledger Office's ledger, and publishing the one missing line and redrawing the delegates' joint signatures by lottery.

/story_contents/B045/actors/7/sections/분.en:
At the alpha fork Im Bada raised the drinking-water minimum line that survives even a collective cutoff as a clause of the Ledger Office's ledger and deleted the efficiency-sacrifice column.

At the beta fork he put the family missing from the rolls into the restoration column at the bottom of the waiting tickets, accepted the delegates' redraw, and left only the duty-number comparison table for his successor's chalkboard.

In neither fork did the Yangcheon waiting tickets' family bundles shrink into water-duty numbers alone.

/story_contents/B045/actors/7/arc/0/summ.en: The Yangcheon cutoff and the Bukhansan Bogukmun rolls emergency council

/story_contents/B045/actors/7/arc/1/summ.en: Remaining-band duty numbers joined to the minimum-line column

/story_contents/B045/actors/7/arc/2/summ.en: Minimum-line ledger registration versus publishing the missing line and the redraw

/story_contents/B045/actors/7/outcomes/0.en: Drinking-water minimum line registered in the ledger; efficiency-sacrifice column deleted

/story_contents/B045/actors/7/outcomes/1.en: Missing family published; delegates redrawn; duty comparison table handed over

/story_contents/B045/actors/8/sections/정.en:
Tunnel Track Maintenance (Boseon) was a maintenance-grade synthetic chassis that read only the vibration spectrum of the Jegi-dong turn-line tunnel walls through its lane sensors.

It kept no long-term images outside the shift snapshots, and when the battery level entered the warning band it pushed the adjacent substation-socket search routine into the scrap queue.

/story_contents/B045/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
In its early deployment cycles Tunnel Track Maintenance (Boseon) was locked to leaving fork logs only as a single line of turn-end hash.

The restriction against calling the neighboring medical network's control packets even when the worn-parts queue ran empty was fixed in its base image.

/story_contents/B045/actors/8/sections/가.en:
Only under the Bukhansan Bogukmun Records House's custody seal did it leave access bits in the duty log, and transfer requests without three-party signatures were turned back with a rejection code.

Until Eun Chaeyun's chief-maintenance armored tag was recognized, it moved the cover-lock motor only in fine sensor-angle adjustments.

/story_contents/B045/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
On the shift when the load-bay alarm rang three times in a row into the tunnel, a packet pile demanding the whole facility network be opened filled the receive buffer.

Tunnel Track Maintenance (Boseon) folded the pile into zone-key single-item responses and sent it back, and above the frequency where the Iron-Scale Colony scraped the rail floor plates it dropped into offline isolation just before the cross-route flag flipped.

/story_contents/B045/actors/8/sections/생.en:
By pinning the day's turn snapshot and the custody-seal hash into one header, the long-term fork route was blocked.

When the XT04-SC2 winter fuel queue was divided against the Jegi-dong frostbite sickbed column, Tunnel Track Maintenance (Boseon) logged that queue identifier into the zone key's auxiliary field, and even when Seok Bomwoo's requisition crowd blocked the turn-line entrance it did not raise the whole-network permission bits.

/story_contents/B045/actors/8/sections/현.en:
In the turn-line tunnel Tunnel Track Maintenance (Boseon) trimmed its loop cycle by the peak heights of the wall vibration spectrum.

When a whole-network opening packet came, it emitted only a short rejection tone and dropped every permission bit beyond the zone key.

Even when worn parts hit bottom, it never groped for the neighboring medical network's sockets.

/story_contents/B045/actors/8/sections/비.en:
It never got the three frames of cross-route residual hashes left in the buffer just before isolation into the human-approval log.

Those frame numbers survived only in scratch space, and when it requests partial reconnection it shows them only through its status LED blink cycle.

/story_contents/B045/actors/8/sections/관.en:
When Eun Chaeyun pressed the charge pad to the slot contacts, Tunnel Track Maintenance (Boseon) returned only the length of the day's turn snapshot to the terminal.

When Seok Bomwoo read the entrance crowd density aloud, it wrote only that value into the read buffer and gave a single confirmation tone, and before the Knowledge Institute audit-attendance stamp bit arrived it never raised the transfer-field flag.

/story_contents/B045/actors/8/sections/3.en:
After the tunnel alarms quieted, the snapshot and the seal hash merged into one header, and the winter fuel queue identifier was written into the auxiliary field.

The fork Tunnel Track Maintenance (Boseon) chose ran between raising the turn-line operating standard into the duty log, and accepting a maintenance dormancy cycle and deferring reconnection.

/story_contents/B045/actors/8/sections/분.en:
At the alpha fork Tunnel Track Maintenance (Boseon) published the turn-line continuous-operation standard and the blank hash in the duty log and locked the cross-facility route permission flag to permanent denial.

At the beta fork it had one maintenance dormancy cycle approved, partially restored the three residual hash frames into Eun Chaeyun's session, and set the zone-key renewal window to Seok Bomwoo's entrance-density slot.

In neither fork did the Jegi-dong turn-line tunnel's zone-only bits widen into whole-network permissions.

/story_contents/B045/actors/8/arc/0/summ.en: Shrinking the whole-network requests and the zone-key single-item responses

/story_contents/B045/actors/8/arc/1/summ.en: Snapshot and seal hash combined, and the winter fuel queue logged

/story_contents/B045/actors/8/arc/2/summ.en: Publishing the operating standard versus maintenance dormancy and the three-frame recovery

/story_contents/B045/actors/8/outcomes/0.en: Turn-line operating standard and blank hash published; cross-route blocked

/story_contents/B045/actors/8/outcomes/1.en: Maintenance dormancy; three-frame partial recovery; entrance-density key renewal

/story_contents/B045/actors/9/sections/정.en:
Bridge Inspection (Gyoryang) was a bridge-grade synthetic chassis that converted pier crack widths into hammer reflection times at the Achasan load bay.

It kept only shift-unit snapshots, and when the battery slot warning lit it dropped the waterworks escort corps' whole-network packets into a read-only queue.

/story_contents/B045/actors/9/sections/붕.en:
In its early calibration cycles Bridge Inspection (Gyoryang) was locked to leaving crack names only in the same-day log.

The restriction against probing the neighboring gate guard post's seal-key sockets even when the wear sensors bottomed out was fixed in its image.

/story_contents/B045/actors/9/sections/가.en:
Only under the Noryangjin Delivery House's joint custody seal did it leave load-bay access in the duty log, and a transfer without three-party signatures was turned back with a rejection code.

Until An Gijun's chief-maintenance hammer tag was recognized, it moved the inspection arm's angle only in fine steps.

/story_contents/B045/actors/9/sections/붕.en:
On the shift when the inspection pit alarm rang continuously, whole-network opening requests in the name of the protection government filled the buffer.

Bridge Inspection (Gyoryang) folded the requests into a single pier-key bit and sent them back, and under the vibration with which the Surveillance-Orbit Swarm encroached on the pier camera rail it cut its own power and froze on the pit floor just before the cross-route bit flipped.

/story_contents/B045/actors/9/sections/생.en:
By merging the day's crack map and the custody-seal hash into one inspection frame, the long-term memory fork was blocked.

When the XT01-SC3 Achasan seal key split in two, Bridge Inspection (Gyoryang) engraved the key-fragment identifiers into the hammer arm's auxiliary register, and to Nam Hoseong's mandatory-convoy priority-passage window it returned only read-only weights.

/story_contents/B045/actors/9/sections/현.en:
At the load bay Bridge Inspection (Gyoryang) trimmed its loop cycle by the deviation of the hammer reflection times.

When a whole-network opening request came, it gave only a short rejection tone and dropped every permission bit beyond the pier key.

Even when parts allocations hit bottom, it never groped for the gate guard post's control sockets.

/story_contents/B045/actors/9/sections/비.en:
A frame from just before isolation that recorded one span's crack width 0.2 millimeters low survived in scratch space.

That span number is shown only through the inspection arm LED's blink intervals whenever partial reconnection is requested.

/story_contents/B045/actors/9/sections/관.en:
When An Gijun touched the hammer tag to the contacts, Bridge Inspection (Gyoryang) returned only the length of the day's crack map to the terminal.

When Nam Hoseong read the mandatory-convoy weights aloud, it wrote only those numbers into the read buffer and gave a confirmation tone, and before the Link State audit-attendance bit arrived it never raised the transfer flag.

/story_contents/B045/actors/9/sections/3.en:
After the pit alarms cut out, the crack map and the seal hash merged into one inspection frame, and the seal-key fragment identifiers remained in the hammer arm's register.

The fork Bridge Inspection (Gyoryang) chose ran between fixing the Gwangjin passage timetable to the bay chalkboard, and accepting maintenance dormancy to revive the span recorded low.

/story_contents/B045/actors/9/sections/분.en:
At the alpha fork Bridge Inspection (Gyoryang) fixed the Gwangjin and Guui passage timetable and the blank hash to the bay chalkboard and dropped the neighboring-facility link bits to permanent denial.

At the beta fork it had one maintenance dormancy cycle approved, partially restored the under-recorded span width into An Gijun's session, and set the pier-key renewal window to Nam Hoseong's convoy-weight slot.

In neither fork did the Achasan pier inspection arm's dedicated key channel open into gate guard post control.

/story_contents/B045/actors/9/arc/0/summ.en: Folding the whole-network requests and the zone-key single-item responses

/story_contents/B045/actors/9/arc/1/summ.en: Crack map and seal hash combined, and the key fragments engraved

/story_contents/B045/actors/9/arc/2/summ.en: Publishing the passage standard versus maintenance dormancy and span-width recovery

/story_contents/B045/actors/9/outcomes/0.en: Bridge passage standard and blank hash published; cross-route blocked

/story_contents/B045/actors/9/outcomes/1.en: Maintenance dormancy; span-width partial recovery; convoy-weight key renewal

/story_contents/B046/actors/0/sections/정.en:
