U Oreum was the Water Compact's water-quartermaster clerk for the Lesser States Council, who at the water stand beside the Yeouido conference hall counted the waiting personnel by the area of condensation on the water pails.

When a hand signal came to overlap three draft pages of water and protection compacts on one table, he covered the scale weight with his palm and corrected only the direction of the tap.

/story_contents/B046/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
As a quartermaster apprentice he kept the public weighing chart and the banquet release sheet at the left and right of the window, written in different inks.

The habit of filling the water pails before the session bell remained, and he called signing on an empty stomach another name for a quartermaster accident.

/story_contents/B046/actors/0/sections/가.en:
His name stood in the Yeongdeungpo Sluice House's quartermaster attendance, yet before the lesser states' joint scale reached zero he struck the great powers' solo-banquet column from the register.

Even when Jang Pilgyu's end date was blank, he did not ring the bell with the weighing column pre-filled.

/story_contents/B046/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
On the morning of the eleven-seat council, three sheets of the Protection Compact came in bound in one iron cord with copies of the western minimum line.

U Oreum untied the iron cord and set only the minimum line at the center of the lesser states' table, and at the moment the Coolant-Index Fungal Body whitened the inside of the water stand's hose, a banquet ale-cask receipt slid beneath the scale pan.

/story_contents/B046/actors/0/sections/생.en:
Once the council's water went out through open weighing alone, the solo-banquet release stamp was pressed no more.

When the cord of Jeong Yura's joint-bargaining satchel came into view, U Oreum stamped the XT02-SC1 Yeouido sluice tide-matched time into the top column of the weighing chart, and he bound the technology-sharing copy Yeo Dasom handed over with the same cord only after the pail's water level crossed the minimum line.

/story_contents/B046/actors/0/sections/현.en:
At the Yeouido water stand, U Oreum gauged the delegates' waiting line by the area over which the condensation had spread.

Whenever a hand showed itself about to overlap the drafts, he returned the scale weight to the exact center of the pan.

Even when a ledger keeper's errand arrived with the priority banquet release written on it, he opened the tap only after the joint scale's zero point checked.

/story_contents/B046/actors/0/sections/비.en:
There was a shift when he could not tear up the ale-cask receipt at once and wedged it into the scale's leg for a whole shift.

He remembered the length of the wet edge only as a fold in the corner of the weighing chart, and every time he sat at the clerk's seat he smoothed that fold open.

/story_contents/B046/actors/0/sections/관.en:
When Jang Pilgyu pressed a finger on the date at the end of the closing sentence, U Oreum copied that number alone into the margin of the council's copy.

When Jeong Yura's satchel arrived soaked, he turned the banquet-release ink bottle cap-side up before hanging it on the drying rack, and when he bound the technology-sharing copy with Yeo Dasom he matched the minimum line's page count in a low voice.

/story_contents/B046/actors/0/sections/3.en:
After the Protection Compact's iron cord came loose, open weighing was pinned to the water stand's brow, and the Yeouido sluice tide-matched time was fixed in the column beside it.

The choice U Oreum made last forked between striking the banquet-goods column from the register, and three lesser states taking the open-weighing duty in weekly rotation.

/story_contents/B046/actors/0/sections/분.en:
In the open branch, U Oreum raised the western water-supply minimum line as a required clause of the lesser states' joint bargaining and deleted the great powers' solo-banquet goods column from the quartermaster register.

In the rotation branch, one banquet-goods run was allowed only after the council adjourned, the weighing chart's reading order was rotated among the three lesser states, and the drainage times crossed the serial on Jeong Yura's satchel cord.

In both branches, the minimum-line copy's iron binding stayed where it lay at the center of the lesser states' table.

/story_contents/B046/actors/0/arc/0/summ.en: Separating the Protection Compact's iron cord and placing the minimum line alone

/story_contents/B046/actors/0/arc/1/summ.en: Fixing open weighing and entering the sluice tide-matched time

/story_contents/B046/actors/0/arc/2/summ.en: Erasing the banquet column versus rotating the weighing duty

/story_contents/B046/actors/0/outcomes/0.en: Minimum line entered as a joint clause · solo-banquet column deleted

/story_contents/B046/actors/0/outcomes/1.en: One banquet run allowed after adjournment · rotation of the lesser states' weighing duty

/story_contents/B046/actors/1/sections/정.en:
Gi Pilho was the Standards Alliance's fabrication quartermaster of the Hegemony War, who at the entrance of the Guro quartermaster warehouse counted skilled shifts by the number of scratches on tool-box lids.

When a hand lifted chalk to paste army-ration labels over the unified plans' names, he snapped the skill board's chalk and emptied that column.

/story_contents/B046/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
As a subcontract release assistant he bound the repair-standard materials manifest and the ammunition loading chart with nothing but different clip colors.

He wrote the order to divert civilian power into quartermaster reserve down as a release accident, and never hung the secret ordnance column's key on the same ring as the generation panel.

/story_contents/B046/actors/1/sections/가.en:
His name was up in the Geumcheon District Office Machinery House's quartermaster attendance, yet he opened no priority ordnance release before the council's lottery ball passed the skill-score column.

Even when Choi Dain's engineer work crew queued first, he pushed back any column whose shift time ran shorter than its tool-box count.

/story_contents/B046/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
In the summer when five unified plans were posted side by side in front of the same week's warehouse, the ammunition column's seal cord was mixed in with the repair-standard iron.

Gi Pilho left the ordnance column's lock shut with only standard materials remaining, and on the night the Blueprint-Ghost Machine Corps spun the shelf drawing-case handle in idle, hidden ammunition tags floated up in the oil on the floor.

/story_contents/B046/actors/1/sections/생.en:
Once release was allowed only after the lottery and the publication of skill scores, the shipments in the barrier-gate combat team's name stopped.

When Gang Minseo's draft of the Fabrication Alliance materials manifest arrived, Gi Pilho stamped the XT02-SC2 freezer-compressor parts split number at the top of the repair column, and when Gi Bareum opened the western escort column he handed over only standard parts with the weights matched.

/story_contents/B046/actors/1/sections/현.en:
At the Guro warehouse, Gi Pilho read shift density from the scratches on tool lids.

When an army-ration label was stuck beside a unified plan's name, he struck that line from the skill board.

Even when the heavy-industry council's urging demanded ammunition first, he touched the key ring only after the generation-output needle reached the safe mark.

/story_contents/B046/actors/1/sections/비.en:
There was a shift when he could not burn the ammunition tag floating in the oil at once and pressed it under a drainage-channel stone.

He kept the length of the pressed letters only as a single dot at the bottom of the skill board, and covered that dot with his sleeve whenever the release roll call began.

/story_contents/B046/actors/1/sections/관.en:
When Choi Dain measured the engineers' queue length with his palm, Gi Pilho shoved back only the columns with short shift times and rewrote the order.

When Gang Minseo proposed converting the unified plans' sentences into the materials manifest, he pocketed the ordnance column's colored clip and spread out only the repair column, and he turned the parts column's key one notch only when the weight of Gi Bareum's convoy seal box checked.

/story_contents/B046/actors/1/sections/3.en:
After the ammunition tag floated up in the oil, only repair-standard release remained, and the compressor-parts split number was fixed at the top.

The choice Gi Pilho made last forked between striking the ordnance column from the ledger, and opening the ammunition column briefly after the council adjourned.

/story_contents/B046/actors/1/sections/분.en:
In the sealed branch, Gi Pilho raised only the mutual repair-right materials manifest as required in the release ledger and sealed the ordnance column permanently.

In the exchange branch, the ammunition column opened for thirty minutes after the closing bell, the authority to draw skill-score lots stayed on the council's blackboard, and the compressor split number was matched to the weight of Gi Bareum's convoy seal box.

In both branches, the shift-time column of the Guro skill board was never erased.

/story_contents/B046/actors/1/arc/0/summ.en: Standard materials remaining and the ordnance lock held shut

/story_contents/B046/actors/1/arc/1/summ.en: Lottery-and-skill open release and the compressor split number fixed

/story_contents/B046/actors/1/arc/2/summ.en: Permanent sealing of the ordnance column versus brief opening after adjournment

/story_contents/B046/actors/1/outcomes/0.en: Mutual repair right as required release · ordnance column sealed permanently

/story_contents/B046/actors/1/outcomes/1.en: 30-minute opening of the ammunition column after adjournment · skill-draw authority retained

/story_contents/B046/actors/2/sections/정.en:
Gi Seojin was a Yangjae Machineworks Company non-military joint-investigation courier, who at the Magok archive unloading platform checked the convoy flag's color before a specimen box's thermometer.

When a note ordering the investigation team renamed an escort unit was slipped into a box cord, he tucked the note beside the thermometer's sensing element and put off the departure.

/story_contents/B046/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
As a courier apprentice he memorized the seal order of the Healing Guild, the safety review, and transmission verification as three dots on the back of his hand.

The hand that sent back any route marked with a military escort column without a departure stamp grew set, and he never pocketed a timetable at risk of confiscation.

/story_contents/B046/actors/2/sections/가.en:
His name was on the Magok Life House's convoy duty, yet he opened no simultaneous Jegi-dong and Sangam route before the three seals gathered on a box's outer face.

Even when Ryu Eunbi's Medical Charter clause ran late, he sent any note marked with an escort column back to the archive window.

/story_contents/B046/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
In the summer when muddy water and counterfeit medicine rose in the same week's bulletins, a radio message ordering a Magok specimen filed into a single great power's protection case file shook the unloading platform.

Gi Seojin pushed the box toward Jegi-dong and toward Sangam at the same time, and on the stretch where the Radio-Wave Crow Flock pecked at the convoy frequency, a confiscation tag wound around the flagpole.

/story_contents/B046/actors/2/sections/생.en:
Once departure was allowed only after the three seals had gathered, the forced stops at the patrol trains' overlapping times thinned.

When Choi Jiwoo asked for the bulletin accord's arrival time, Gi Seojin stamped the XT05-SC3 orbital false-positive correction number on the box's side, and he affixed Go Choyun's public inspection slip only in ink the same color as the flag.

/story_contents/B046/actors/2/sections/현.en:
At the Magok unloading platform, Gi Seojin read the wind from the flag cloth's flutter and corrected the minute of departure.

When the escort-renaming note came again, he put the thermometer inside the box and shut the door.

Even if the Living-Science House's schedule moved up, he sent back any route carrying fewer than three seals.

/story_contents/B046/actors/2/sections/비.en:
In the corner of his notebook was the time at which, one station later, he finally tore off the confiscation tag wound around the flagpole.

During that delay the box's temperature climbed one notch, and every time he reported an on-time arrival he remembered that notch.

/story_contents/B046/actors/2/sections/관.en:
When Ryu Eunbi read out the Medical Charter clause number, Gi Seojin set the specimen-route column to that number alone.

When Choi Jiwoo collated the arrival time against the broadcast draft, the two checked the flag color first and never spoke of the escort column, and when Go Choyun handed over an inspection slip he affixed it only at the center of the box's outer face.

/story_contents/B046/actors/2/sections/3.en:
After the radio message shook the unloading platform, the simultaneous courier route opened, and the orbital false-positive correction number was fixed on the box's side.

The choice Gi Seojin made last forked between striking the military escort route from the ledger, and releasing only the Sangam specimens after transmission verification.

/story_contents/B046/actors/2/sections/분.en:
In the three-routes branch, Gi Seojin deleted the military escort route that lacked three seals from the courier ledger and raised simultaneous Jegi-dong and Sangam transport as a required column.

In the entrustment branch, only the Sangam specimens were released after transmission verification, the Jegi-dong specimens were left in the Healing Guild's custody locker, and the false-positive correction number was matched to Choi Jiwoo's bulletin time.

In either branch, the Magok unloading platform's three-seal departure rule was never abolished.

/story_contents/B046/actors/2/arc/0/summ.en: Refusing the protection case file and departing for Jegi-dong and Sangam at once

/story_contents/B046/actors/2/arc/1/summ.en: Fixing the triple seal and entering the orbital false-positive number

/story_contents/B046/actors/2/arc/2/summ.en: Erasing the escort route versus Sangam release and Jegi-dong entrustment

/story_contents/B046/actors/2/outcomes/0.en: Military escort route deleted · simultaneous transport registered as required

/story_contents/B046/actors/2/outcomes/1.en: Sangam release after verification · Jegi-dong Healing Guild custody entrusted

/story_contents/B046/actors/3/sections/정.en:
Yeo Minwoo was the witness to the discovery of the Sermon Registry State's encrypted maintenance log, who gauged the time the log fell from the water-stain patterns on the Seongsu pump room floor.

When a whisper came asking him to pass on, without evidence, the rumor that only a quantum machine could read it, he shut the page with its blank cipher column under a cover.

/story_contents/B046/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
On night-watch assistant duty he repeated nothing but the practice of writing the discovery site and the seal time to the same minute on the assembly side and the generation side.

He called the habit of staging a solo decryption demonstration like a succession trial the workshop's enemy, and never wrote his witness signature into the bragging column.

/story_contents/B046/actors/3/sections/가.en:
His name stood in the Digital Media City Trust House's witness attendance, yet outside seats where the council's veto still lived he opened no decryption-demonstration column.

Even when Im Chowon's decryption authority was recognized, he copied no exclusive-access sentence into the trust ledger.

/story_contents/B046/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
At the time of the third Water Compact, the encrypted maintenance log of a general manager who had vanished in the immediate aftermath lay fallen on the pump room floor.

Yeo Minwoo left the seal time in both ledgers at once, and at the moment the Cleanroom Mutant spread white through the filter room's seams, dust marks that looked as if they had been moved in advance remained on the log's corner.

/story_contents/B046/actors/3/sections/생.en:
Once the discovery column was matched into the assembly record and the generation log at the same time, the bloodline-only demonstration's schedule slipped.

When Je Hayul pointed at the blank cell on the assembly side, Yeo Minwoo stamped the XT03-SC2 sealed-tool lot number into the discovery witness's margin, and whenever it overlapped Byeon Seokhun's night-gap times he pushed the demonstration to the next shift.

/story_contents/B046/actors/3/sections/현.en:
In the Seongsu pump room, Yeo Minwoo read the density of the watch from how fast the water-stain patterns dried.

When a rumor courier asked for quantum decryption, he screened the blank cipher column with a cover.

Even if the Trust House's schedule moved up, in seats where the veto had been switched off he never raised the demonstration switch.

/story_contents/B046/actors/3/sections/비.en:
There was a shift when he could not preserve the dust marks in a photograph at once and swept them once with his palm, leaving them faint.

He remembered the width of the sweep only as a dotted line inside his witness notebook, and covered that dotted line with his thumb whenever he read the seal time.

/story_contents/B046/actors/3/sections/관.en:
When Im Chowon showed the decryption key's serial, Yeo Minwoo acknowledged the authority but wrote no exclusive-access sentence.

When Je Hayul spread open the assembly record's discovery column, the two read only the seal times side by side, and when Byeon Seokhun's night gap overlapped that time, Yeo Minwoo left only the margin with the demonstration switch locked.

/story_contents/B046/actors/3/sections/3.en:
After the log fell to the floor, the double-ledger entry was added, and the sealed-tool lot number was fixed in the margin.

The choice Yeo Minwoo made last forked between striking the bloodline-only demonstration column, and opening one session of Im Chowon's decryption on condition of recording.

/story_contents/B046/actors/3/sections/분.en:
In the multi-approval branch, Yeo Minwoo allowed only workshop multi-approval decryption and deleted the bloodline-only demonstration column from the ledger.

In the demonstration branch, one session of Im Chowon's decryption opened on condition that the assembly record and the generation log be recorded at the same time, and the tool lot number was matched to Je Hayul's assembly column.

In either choice, the double-recorded seal times on the Seongsu pump room floor were never erased.

/story_contents/B046/actors/3/arc/0/summ.en: Finding the pump room log and sealing it in both ledgers

/story_contents/B046/actors/3/arc/1/summ.en: Entering the sealed-tool lot and collating the night gap

/story_contents/B046/actors/3/arc/2/summ.en: Deleting the solo-demonstration column versus one recording-conditional opening

/story_contents/B046/actors/3/outcomes/0.en: Only multi-approval decryption allowed · bloodline demonstration column deleted

/story_contents/B046/actors/3/outcomes/1.en: One session of Im Chowon's decryption · condition of recording both ledgers at once

/story_contents/B046/actors/4/sections/정.en:
Yeo Seoha was the Escort Protection State's investigator-clerk of the black dispatch table, who at the Godeok investigation ledger desk turned his nib toward the cap whenever a black column showed in the dispatch table.

When pressure came to mix the official command network and the secret officers' network into one line, he wrote the page numbers large and left the interpretation column empty.

/story_contents/B046/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
As an administration-clerk apprentice he learned nothing but the art of splitting the log into three copies for the administration office, the chief of staff, and the citizen delegates, stamped at the same time.

The habit of suspending reading whenever one copy went missing remained, and he called sentences that buried conclusions under after-the-fact approval the enemy of investigation.

/story_contents/B046/actors/4/sections/가.en:
His name stood in the Yongsan Convoy House's investigation attendance, yet he merged no command-route columns into one before all three lockboxes were shut.

Even when Kim Woochan's staff report arrived first, he kept the cover shut until Go Jaemin's release mark had been copied into the body.

/story_contents/B046/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
In the winter's black dispatch table, the medical train's weapons column and the northern succession-test parts tampering column sat on the same line.

Yeo Seoha wrote the command route split in two, and on the night the Phantom Dispatch Corps copied out empty train timetables, a margin with a third party's name erased fell beneath the desk.

/story_contents/B046/actors/4/sections/생.en:
Once the log's three copies went into three different cases, no line of after-the-fact approval could swallow the conclusion.

When Go Jaemin testified to the release mark, Yeo Seoha stamped the XT04-SC1 freight-car weight log number above the route divider, and left the next column blank for Bae Woojin's officer-punishment fork.

/story_contents/B046/actors/4/sections/현.en:
At the Godeok ledger desk, Yeo Seoha read forgery pressure from the ink bleed of the black column.

When a courier came demanding a single merged line, he stabbed the pen into its cap.

Even if the delivery crews' schedule moved up, when one lockbox stood empty he shut down the reading window.

/story_contents/B046/actors/4/sections/비.en:
There was a shift when he could not attach the margin from beneath the desk at once and left it covered under the toe of his shoe.

He remembered the surviving stroke of the covered letters only as a small crease in the page-number margin, and with a finger he smoothed that crease whenever he opened the cover.

/story_contents/B046/actors/4/sections/관.en:
When Go Jaemin traced the release mark with a finger, Yeo Seoha copied that mark alone into the log's body.

When Kim Woochan's staff report demanded a merged line, Yeo Seoha deferred interpretation with only the page numbers written large, and when Bae Woojin's punishment-fork column stood blank he never wrote a conclusion into it in advance.

/story_contents/B046/actors/4/sections/3.en:
After the black columns had been pinned to one line, the route split in two, and the freight-car weight log number was fixed above the divider.

The choice Yeo Seoha made last forked between striking the after-the-fact approval column, and sealing one copy of the staff report apart in a locked case.

/story_contents/B046/actors/4/sections/분.en:
In the dual-track branch, Yeo Seoha raised the dualization of command routes as required in the investigation ledger and deleted the after-the-fact approval column.

In the separate-custody branch, one copy of the staff report went into the sealed separate-custody case, only the citizen delegates' copy opened for public reading, and the weight log number was matched to Go Jaemin's release mark.

In both branches, the Godeok desk's three-copy log custody rule held.

/story_contents/B046/actors/4/arc/0/summ.en: Splitting the medical-weapons and succession-parts columns off one line

/story_contents/B046/actors/4/arc/1/summ.en: Three-copy log into separate cases and the freight-car weight number fixed

/story_contents/B046/actors/4/arc/2/summ.en: Deleting the after-the-fact approval column versus sealing the staff report apart

/story_contents/B046/actors/4/outcomes/0.en: Command-route dualization as required · after-the-fact approval column deleted

/story_contents/B046/actors/4/outcomes/1.en: Staff report sealed in separate custody · only the citizen delegates' copy opened

/story_contents/B046/actors/5/sections/정.en:
Gi Hagyeom was the Sermon Registry State's militia squad leader who refused Protection Force dispatches, turning back at the Seongdong Bridge entrance any courier who hailed an officer's flag as rescue.

When a note ordering the pump-guard night shift handed over to outside command was stuck into the barricade, she pulled the note out and still did not lower the barrier plate.

/story_contents/B046/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
On militia duty she blocked an outside officer's charging and lodging columns only on lines stamped with the council's refusal seal.

She regarded the habit of calling the muster roll without a daytime draw as the seed of a sedition frame-up, and did not begin the shift roll call until the citizen delegates' lottery ball had rolled.

/story_contents/B046/actors/5/sections/가.en:
Her name stood in the Hangangjin Bridge Council's defense attendance, yet before Kim Boram's pump-guard command times and the militia shift overlapped, she handed the bridge lock to no outside duty.

Even when Ryu Gaon's request to pass with the Amsa convoy arrived, she kept only the record and turned the procession back.

/story_contents/B046/actors/5/sections/붕.en:
In the third Water Compact phase, on the morning Bae Woojin framed Im Hajun's disappearance as a failure of governance and pushed forward the Protection Force dispatch proposal, the lodging-tent stakes were carried in across the Seongdong Bridge first.

Gi Hagyeom locked the militia to internal use alone, and at the moment the Flood-Boar Swarm tore up the mud beneath the bridge, a first-shot tag hung on the head of a barricade nail.

/story_contents/B046/actors/5/sections/생.en:
Once charging and lodging were stopped at the refusal column, the protected-zone declaration sentence never stuck to the bridge signage.

When Kim Boram matched the night shift times with a hand signal, Gi Hagyeom stamped the XT01-SC3 sealing-key split number at the top of the lock ledger, and she sent Ryu Gaon's passage request back with only the receipt time written on it.

/story_contents/B046/actors/5/sections/현.en:
At the Seongdong Bridge, Gi Hagyeom gauged the outside waiting line by the length of the stakes' shadows.

When the cry of rescue came again, she turned the flag courier back toward downstream.

Even when a Bridge Council errand brought over a written pretext for garrisoning, she opened the shift roll call only after the daytime lottery ball had rolled.

/story_contents/B046/actors/5/sections/비.en:
There was a shift when she could not put the shot tag from the nail head into the disclosure box at once and kept it folded inside her gauntlet for a whole shift.

She pricked a dot in the ledger margin the length of the folded corner, and covered that dot with her thumb at every lock roll call.

/story_contents/B046/actors/5/sections/관.en:
When Kim Boram lit the pump-guard shift lamp, Gi Hagyeom set only the militia side's personnel to the same time.

When Bae Woojin's dispatch proposal arrived before the bridge, she confirmed only the internal-use lock and did not open the lodging column, and when Ryu Gaon tendered a passage request she wrote down the receipt time and then turned the procession back.

/story_contents/B046/actors/5/sections/3.en:
After the lodging stakes touched the bridge, the internal-use lock went on, and the sealing-key split number was fixed at the top of the ledger.

The choice Gi Hagyeom made last forked between striking the Protection Force lodging column from the charter, and opening the record for one daytime passing train only.

/story_contents/B046/actors/5/sections/분.en:
In the lock branch, Gi Hagyeom raised the Seongdong Bridge's internal-use lock as required in the defense charter and deleted the Protection Force lodging column.

In the daytime branch, the record opened for one daytime passing train only, the night lock was kept, the dispatch proposal was left under the council's refusal seal, and the sealing-key number was matched to the time of Kim Boram's shift lamp.

In either choice, the rolling of the daytime-draw muster ball at the Seongdong Bridge entrance was never discontinued.

/story_contents/B046/actors/5/arc/0/summ.en: Stopping the lodging stakes and the internal-use lock

/story_contents/B046/actors/5/arc/1/summ.en: Cutting charging at the refusal column and fixing the sealing-key number

/story_contents/B046/actors/5/arc/2/summ.en: Deleting the lodging column versus opening the record for one daytime train

/story_contents/B046/actors/5/outcomes/0.en: Internal-use lock written into the charter · Protection Force lodging column deleted

/story_contents/B046/actors/5/outcomes/1.en: One daytime train's record opened · night lock kept · refusal of the dispatch proposal maintained

/story_contents/B046/actors/6/sections/정.en:
Im Chaewon was the Standards Alliance's occupational delegate for protective suits, who at the Guro protection workshop gauged the risk in the filter fabric by his stitching intervals.

After the temporary register beneath the Yangcheon embankment burned and the household-register column was left blank, he guarded the specimen numbers on the guild's release blackboard instead of citizen certification.

/story_contents/B046/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
After coming into Guro through the apprentice draw, he practiced the hand of writing release quantities on the blackboard in large letters and allowing ordnance preemption only when disaster-prevention specimens crossed the threshold.

He called the officer who piled protective suits into trophy piles a sewing accident, and even when the Yeouido water-right clerk would not accept the specimen numbers as evidence he never took the blackboard down.

/story_contents/B046/actors/6/sections/가.en:
His name stood in the Cheongnyangni Medical House's filter attendance, yet he opened no advance release for the barrier-gate crew before Choi Eunjae's performance-verification stamp landed.

In Gang Minseo's process split he took the protection column, but when Han Somi's leather workshop and the raw-materials boxes overlapped, only the filter packing rode the same boat and the fabric's main lot was never divided.

/story_contents/B046/actors/6/sections/붕.en:
On the day rumors of muddy water spread through the Guro alleys after the downpour, whether the filter stock went first to the water-purification work crew or first to the security barrier-gate crew had to be put to an occupational vote.

Im Chaewon hung the voting tallies marked with specimen numbers on the blackboard, and at the moment the Flood-Mold Breath Cluster spread black across the fabric warehouse ceiling, the seal cord of the filter boxes hidden inside the ordnance warehouse had gone slack.

/story_contents/B046/actors/6/sections/생.en:
Once the release quantities were written on the guild blackboard alone, the number of boxes slipping out into trophy piles fell.

When Choi Eunjae pressed the verification stamp, Im Chaewon stamped the XT05-SC1 residual-band lottery number on the back of the occupational voting tallies, and the raw-materials rivalry with Han Somi split the ship's hold by nothing more than a change of packing-cord color.

/story_contents/B046/actors/6/sections/현.en:
At the Guro workshop, Im Chaewon read fabric-lot trouble from how far the stitch intervals opened.

When the chant went up that no one breathes without a uniform, he returned the voting tallies to the middle of the blackboard.

Even if the Medical House's schedule moved up, he opened no barrier-gate-crew precedence without the verification stamp.

/story_contents/B046/actors/6/sections/비.en:
There was a shift when he could not expose the ordnance warehouse's slack seal cord at once and sewed it shut again with a needle for a whole shift.

He kept the count of sewn stitches only as a small diagonal stroke beside the specimen number, and covered that stroke with his palm at every occupational roll call.

/story_contents/B046/actors/6/sections/관.en:
When Choi Eunjae read out the filter performance figures, Im Chaewon copied those numbers alone into the verification column.

When Gang Minseo spread out the process-split table, he took only the protection column and wrote no ordnance-precedence sentence, and when Han Somi weighed the leather boxes, only the packing rode the same boat and the fabric's main lot stayed in each side's own column.

/story_contents/B046/actors/6/sections/3.en:
After the muddy-water rumors spread through the alleys, the occupational voting tallies were hung on the blackboard, and the residual-band lottery number was fixed on their backs.

The choice Im Chaewon made last forked between raising the water-purification crew's priority release as a standard, and lending the barrier-gate crew one filter lot only.

/story_contents/B046/actors/6/sections/분.en:
In the occupational branch, Im Chaewon raised the water-purification crew's priority release as required by the protection standard and voided the ordnance-preemption vote.

In the loan branch, one filter lot went to the barrier-gate crew only as a time-limited loan, the citizen release column stayed on the blackboard, and the lottery number was matched to the time of Choi Eunjae's verification stamp.

In either choice, the citizen column of specimen numbers written on the Guro release blackboard was never erased.

/story_contents/B046/actors/6/arc/0/summ.en: Muddy-water rumors and posting the occupational voting tallies

/story_contents/B046/actors/6/arc/1/summ.en: Fixing release on the blackboard and entering the residual-band number

/story_contents/B046/actors/6/arc/2/summ.en: Standardizing purification priority versus lending the barrier-gate crew one lot

/story_contents/B046/actors/6/outcomes/0.en: Water-purification crew priority release as standard · ordnance-preemption vote voided

/story_contents/B046/actors/6/outcomes/1.en: Time-limited loan of one filter lot to the barrier-gate crew · citizen release column kept

/story_contents/B046/actors/7/sections/정.en:
Jang Yerin was the Yangjae Machineworks Company's operations officer of the western water-quality inspection network, who at the Magok sampling stand kept the inspection cycle by the reagent lot's handwriting.

When he passed the gate carrying an outlying well's log, the nationality column stood empty, and the council opened the duty on lot-handwriting comparison alone, so he wrote the lot number before his name.

/story_contents/B046/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
As a sampling assistant he left the sampling times and reagent lots in a broadcastable ledger, and practiced the hand of tearing up any note ordering the cycle shortened to fit a political schedule.

He called the instruction to trust the pipes on a single passing verdict an inspection accident, and whenever a reading exceeded the standard he posted the recommendation to halt transmission to the council at once.

/story_contents/B046/actors/7/sections/가.en:
His name stood in the Ttukseom Heat-Source House's pipeline instrumentation attendance, yet he opened no western pipeline pass column before the cross-verification numbers matched Park Nuri's Yeongdeungpo specimens.

Even while Han Somi's pump workshop repaired the inspection sensors, he copied no political note into the ledger.

/story_contents/B046/actors/7/sections/붕.en:
When the Ttukseom inspection network's lamps went out after the downpour, Jang Yerin filed the western pipeline halt recommendation on Magok's sole-source sampling, and it landed on the desk at the same time as Han Jaemok's supply-continuation order.

At the moment the Sewer-Raccoon Pack lifted the sampling stand's manhole cover, a note ordering the halt recommendation hidden lay wedged between the reagent boxes.

/story_contents/B046/actors/7/sections/생.en:
Once the sampling times were kept only in the broadcast ledger, the sentence by which military protection rights had tried to fill the inspection gap was shelved.

When Park Nuri matched the Yeongdeungpo numbers, Jang Yerin stamped the sampling window meshed with the XT02-SC1 West Sea tide table at the top of the ledger, and he decided whether to hand the original muddy-water bulletin numbers to Choi Jiwoo only after the lamps came back on.

/story_contents/B046/actors/7/sections/현.en:
At the Magok sampling stand, Jang Yerin read lot trouble from the speed of the reagent's color change.

When another note came ordering the cycle shortened, he pinned that paper in the tongs outside the reagent box in public view.

Even if the Energy Union's schedule moved up, when the cross-verification stood empty he opened no pass column.

/story_contents/B046/actors/7/sections/비.en:
There was a shift when he could not post the hiding note from the box's seam at once and left it turned over in the tongs for a whole shift.

He drew a short underline beside the lot number for as long as the delay had lasted, and covered that underline with a finger whenever he read the halt recommendation aloud.

/story_contents/B046/actors/7/sections/관.en:
When Park Nuri set down the Yeongdeungpo specimen bottles, Jang Yerin aligned only the number columns side by side.

When Han Somi reported the sensor repair's completion time, he pressed no pass stamp before that time, and when Choi Jiwoo requested the bulletin original, he handed over the number lines only after the lamps were lit.

/story_contents/B046/actors/7/sections/3.en:
After the Ttukseom lamps went out, Magok's sole-source sampling entered the ledger, and the sampling window meshed with the West Sea tide table was fixed at the top.

The choice Jang Yerin made last forked between raising the halt recommendation as required on the open network, and granting the supply continuation a grace of six hours only.

/story_contents/B046/actors/7/sections/분.en:
In the halt branch, Jang Yerin raised the western pipeline halt recommendation as a required clause of the public inspection network and held the supply-continuation order in abeyance.

In the grace branch, Han Jaemok's supply continuation was allowed six hours only, the broadcast authority over Magok's sole-source sampling ledger was secured in the meantime, and the sampling window was matched to Park Nuri's cross-verification time.

In either choice, the lot-handwriting duty line of the Magok sampling-stand ledger was never left blank.

/story_contents/B046/actors/7/arc/0/summ.en: Ttukseom lamps out and the Magok sole-source sampling recommendation

/story_contents/B046/actors/7/arc/1/summ.en: Fixing the broadcast ledger and entering the West Sea tide-table sampling window

/story_contents/B046/actors/7/arc/2/summ.en: Requiring the halt recommendation versus a six-hour supply grace

/story_contents/B046/actors/7/outcomes/0.en: Halt recommendation required on the open network · supply-continuation order held

/story_contents/B046/actors/7/outcomes/1.en: Six-hour supply grace · broadcast authority over Magok sole-source sampling

/story_contents/B046/actors/8/sections/정.en:
The Sluice-Gate Cart was a sluice-grade synthetic chassis that at the inspection pit of the Garak produce hall gauged the weight of allotted boxes by the depth of its wheel tracks.

When the slot contact resistance entered the warning band, it read the remote command to open the Jamsil-side warehouse door into the read-and-discard queue and left only the pit entry log.

/story_contents/B046/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
In its first deployment cycle the Sluice-Gate Cart was locked so that its fork left only a single line of same-day entry times.

Even when its worn wheels ran down, the routine of seeking out the Jamsil distribution box was not in its image, and it did not recognize the voice ordering empty boxes pushed into the ration column.

/story_contents/B046/actors/8/sections/가.en:
It logged its entries on the duty terminal only while the Guro Alloy House's custody seal hung on the pit door, and it sounded a refusal tone for any transfer request lacking the three signatures of Ra Jinwoo, the Cheolseong audit, and citizen observers.

Before Ra Jinwoo's chief-maintenance gauntlet chip was read, it moved the cover motor only by the sensor-protrusion calibration angle.

/story_contents/B046/actors/8/sections/붕.en:
On the night its charging slot rang three cycles running, a heap of commands demanding facility-wide authority filled its inbox.

The Sluice-Gate Cart sent back only its single line of pit entries, and as the Night-Sorting Swarm's label-jumbling vibration shook the floor, it cut power and stopped just before the cross-warehouse permission bit flipped.

/story_contents/B046/actors/8/sections/생.en:
Once the same-day entry times and the custody seal numbers were attached to one transmission header, the previous day's image could not cover them.

When Won Miru held the origin-seal chip to the slot, the Sluice-Gate Cart wrote the XT03-SC2 Garak can-reassignment window number into an auxiliary column, and even when Ra Jinwoo attached the remainder pad it did not call up the previous day's map.

/story_contents/B046/actors/8/sections/현.en:
In the inspection pit the Sluice-Gate Cart shortened or lengthened its push interval by the thickness of dust on the protrusion.

When a facility-wide opening command arrived, it gave only a short refusal tone and dropped every permission column except the entry log.

Even with its wheels worn down, it did not scan the neighboring warehouse's control box.

/story_contents/B046/actors/8/sections/비.en:
There was a frame in which the cross-warehouse remainder numbers left in its inbox just before the power cut never made it into Ra Jinwoo's approval field.

Those numbers remained only in a temporary column, and when it petitioned for partial reconnection it signaled them only through the intervals of its status-light blink.

/story_contents/B046/actors/8/sections/관.en:
When Ra Jinwoo pressed the remainder pad to the contacts, the Sluice-Gate Cart showed the terminal only the length of that day's entry times.

When Won Miru read the origin-seal numbers, it wrote those values alone into the read column and gave a single confirmation tone, and it raised no transfer column before the Cheolseong audit's attendance stamp arrived.

/story_contents/B046/actors/8/sections/3.en:
On the night the alarm rang it left only the entry log, then the times and the seal numbers were attached to one header, and the can-reassignment window number was written into the auxiliary column.

The choice the Sluice-Gate Cart made last lay between publishing the allocation tags and remainders on the duty terminal, and accepting maintenance dormancy to defer reconnection.

/story_contents/B046/actors/8/sections/분.en:
In the open branch, the Sluice-Gate Cart posted the can allocation tags and the battery-remainder band to the duty terminal and lowered the cross-warehouse permission bit permanently.

In the dormancy branch, it received approval for one maintenance-dormancy cycle, partially restored the seal map's warehouse coordinates only into Ra Jinwoo's session, and matched the entry-log update times to the time Won Miru's origin chip was read.

In either choice, the permission stem of the Garak pit entry log was never cut away.

/story_contents/B046/actors/8/arc/0/summ.en: Refusing the facility-wide request and answering with a single line of pit entries

/story_contents/B046/actors/8/arc/1/summ.en: Binding entry times and seal numbers and recording the can-reassignment window

/story_contents/B046/actors/8/arc/2/summ.en: Publishing allocation and remainder on the terminal versus maintenance dormancy and partial coordinate restoration

/story_contents/B046/actors/8/outcomes/0.en: Allocation tags and remainder published on the terminal · cross-warehouse bit lowered permanently

/story_contents/B046/actors/8/outcomes/1.en: Maintenance dormancy · partial restoration of seal coordinates · sync to the origin chip's read time

/story_contents/B046/actors/9/sections/정.en:
The Emergency Tow was a tow-grade synthetic chassis that at the Suseo base's charging rail read towing load by the width of its hook's sway.

When its battery gauge fell into orange, it read the Gangnam-side track-switch message into the read-and-discard box and lit only the turn-permission indicator.

/story_contents/B046/actors/9/sections/붕.en:
In its early calibration cycle the Emergency Tow was locked to leave its switching history as a single cell of that day's turn times.

Even as its hook pad wore, the routine of seeking out the Gangnam transformer box was not in its image, and it ignored the radio ordering aid goods attached to the ordnance column.

/story_contents/B046/actors/9/sections/가.en:
It logged turns on the duty screen only while the Changdong Protection House's custody cord hung over the charging rail's divider, and it sounded a rejection tone for any transfer message the three parties — Gwak Eunjae, the Orbital-Defense audit, and citizen observers — had not signed.

Before Gwak Eunjae's maintenance gauntlet chip was read, it adjusted the hook motor only for load-gauge calibration.

/story_contents/B046/actors/9/sections/붕.en:
During the shift when the turn line's alarm would not stop, a heap of messages demanding the whole facility be opened filled its inbox.

The Emergency Tow sent back only its single cell of turn permission, and as the vibration of the Retired-Line Maintenance-Train Corps scraping the siding rails shook its hook, it cut towing power just before the cross-track permission column flipped.

/story_contents/B046/actors/9/sections/생.en:
Once that day's turn times and the custody-cord serial were attached to a single transmission header, the previous day's map could not cover them.

When Mae Haru read out the contaminated freight's isolation step count, the Emergency Tow engraved the XT03-SC1 Suseo substitute-turn-line window number into an auxiliary column, and even when Gwak Eunjae attached the remainder pad it did not call up the previous day's route.

/story_contents/B046/actors/9/sections/현.en:
On the charging rail the Emergency Tow shortened or lengthened its towing interval by the width of its hook's sway.

When a facility-wide opening message arrived, it gave only a short rejection tone and switched off every column except turn permission.

Even with its hook pad worn, it did not sweep the neighboring track's control box.

/story_contents/B046/actors/9/sections/비.en:
There was a cycle in which the cross-track remainder numbers left in its inbox just before the towing current was cut never made it into Gwak Eunjae's approval field.

That value remained only in a temporary column, and when it petitioned for partial reconnection it signaled it only through the width of its status-light blink.

/story_contents/B046/actors/9/sections/관.en:
When Gwak Eunjae pressed the remainder pad to the rail contacts, the Emergency Tow showed the screen only the length of that day's turn times.

When Mae Haru spoke the contaminated freight's isolation step count, it wrote that number alone into the read column and gave a short confirmation tone, and it lit no transfer column before the Orbital-Defense attendance stamp was pressed.

/story_contents/B046/actors/9/sections/3.en:
During the shift when the alarm would not stop it left only its turn permission, then the times and the custody-cord serial were attached to one header, and the substitute-turn-line window number was engraved into the auxiliary column.

The choice the Emergency Tow made last lay between posting the towing standard on the duty screen, and dragging only the contaminated freight to isolation distance.

/story_contents/B046/actors/9/sections/분.en:
In the standard branch, the Emergency Tow posted the substitute-turn-line towing standard and the blank numbers on the duty screen and switched off the cross-track permission column permanently.

In the isolation branch, it received approval to drag only the contaminated freight the isolation step count, matched the hook-lock key to the time of Gwak Eunjae's audit slip, and tied turn-permission renewal to Mae Haru's isolation step value.

At either fork, the turn-permission stem of the Suseo charging rail was never severed.

/story_contents/B046/actors/9/arc/0/summ.en: Rejecting the facility-wide message and answering with a single cell of turn permission

/story_contents/B046/actors/9/arc/1/summ.en: Binding turn times and the custody-cord serial and recording the substitute-turn-line window

/story_contents/B046/actors/9/arc/2/summ.en: Publishing the towing standard on screen versus towing contaminated freight to isolation

/story_contents/B046/actors/9/outcomes/0.en: Substitute-turn-line towing standard published · cross-track column switched off permanently

/story_contents/B046/actors/9/outcomes/1.en: Contaminated freight towed to isolation · hook-lock key tied to the audit slip

/story_contents/B047/actors/0/sections/정.en:
When spring thaw pushed up the reference point west of the firebreak base, Song Byeolha laid out the farewell bronze ruler and star shadow together to measure height again.

As a research-review surveyor for Yangjae Machineworks Company, he laid down the certification seal whenever the values on the safety-review table did not match the field survey markers.

The lineage descended from a Joseon court astronomer and calendrical technician who separated observation and calculation, through a medieval metalsmith who handled alloy scales, to a 1920s surveyor who left closure errors in the triangulation survey field notes—he wove them all together into one line of work.

The name Song Byeolha and the identifier K413 did not change even when research findings were overturned.

/story_contents/B047/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
During his surveying apprenticeship, he placed the memory of the aerial approach slope and the firebreak base drainage grade on the same coordinate grid, but marked the estimates with a red border.

He learned the administrative calculation table that cross-checked the altitude of sun and stars against the calendar calculation, and as in modern field notes, he took separate signatures from observer and calculator.

The bronze reference ruler inherited from the family workshop changed length with temperature, so each time he had to match it against the stone standard.

The principle that no one's authority could reduce error became his ambition to establish a shared technical record.

/story_contents/B047/actors/0/sections/가.en:
The Digital Media City Trust House gave him one seat at the review stone on the condition of keeping the aggregated measurement logs.

Song Byeolha passed the closure table and correction history to Choi Eunjae instead of raw coordinates, and did not exchange face records or resident movement lines for technical certification.

The family work stand modeled on the Goryeo-style casting workshop re-engraved the worn bronze ruler scales but could not touch the pass judgment.

When the resident representative Kim Doha demanded that he disclose the marker location, he folded only the range obscuring the evacuation passage and posted the error table as it was.

/story_contents/B047/actors/0/sections/붕.en:
After the blackout, in the first frozen compressor transport, one reference point at the unloading station subsided so that the box height and the drainage bottom were recorded as the same value.

Pressure came to pass through quickly, but Song Byeolha found a warped edge on the bronze ruler and erased the certification line.

During that delay, some of the seed-stock refrigerated boxes spoiled, and conversely, if he had approved the wrong grade, contaminated water would have flowed into the experiment building.

He wrote both the smell of decay and the rainwater level in one field notebook, but he could not draw a line between which loss was his calculation's fault.

/story_contents/B047/actors/0/sections/생.en:
The division arose in deciding whether to remeasure the entire subsidence section and stop the frozen freight, or send just one formation with conditional certification that disclosed the error range.

When the XT02-SC2 compressor part split number arrived, Song Byeolha appended the observation time and tidal deviation to the end of the Magok measurement log.

Full remeasurement protects the experiment building's safety but leaves the pharmaceutical refrigeration without service for a day, while conditional certification saves the patient parts but the reference point may move again with the next rain.

This judgment remains as two lines on the bronze scale K085-TURN.

/story_contents/B047/actors/0/sections/현.en:
Now Song Byeolha first unfolds the coordinate ledger at the tri-party review where researcher, safety reviewer, and resident representative meet.

His review procedure is reading the observation equipment's temperature and the surveyor's movement sequence before reading the research title.

The reference points between the firebreak base and Magok experiment building were made in three materials so that the deformation of one marker could not deceive the entire network.

The certification seal stands straight only after the field closure error comes within the published limit.

/story_contents/B047/actors/0/sections/비.en:
Beneath the drawer lies a rubbing of the bronze reference ruler that was already warped the day before the subsidence accident.

Song Byeolha delayed reporting this fact by one shift out of fear that discarding the family ruler would require reopening dozens of past certifications.

Whether the delayed report directly connects to the spoiled seed boxes was never proven, but he writes the temperature of that day in a separate column on every calculation table.

The SECRET file is opened only when Jeong Harin's safety-review original and Choi Eunjae's correction history are placed together.

/story_contents/B047/actors/0/sections/관.en:
At the meeting where Jeong Hojun chose a shared ledger before technical dispatch, Song Byeolha provided coordinates from three external reference points.

With Jeong Harin, he double-checked the experiment building's security perimeter against astronomical time and ground distance, and with Jang Yerin, he bound the western water-sampling point to the same triangulation network.

When Choi Eunjae tried to leave only aggregation, Song Byeolha and Choi stood at odds all night over the minimum columns needed to prove the existence of raw error.

The end point of their shared measurement season connects to STORY-B047-K413.

/story_contents/B047/actors/0/sections/3.en:
In act one, Song Byeolha places the subsided marker and warped bronze reference ruler beside the compressor box.

In act two, he binds the HP09 correction history and XT02 part split number to a coordinate grid marked with tidal data.

Act three's choice stands between the path of full remeasurement that delays refrigeration and the path of conditional certification that accepts the risk of resubsidence.

The narrative identifier is fixed as STORY-B047-K413.

/story_contents/B047/actors/0/sections/분.en:
In ending α, Song Byeolha closes the entire western reference network and remeasures it with three-material markers to secure the experiment building's drainage safety.

In exchange, the pharmaceutical refrigeration formation stops for a day and the spoiled inventory appears on the public loss table.

In ending β, he passes one compressor formation through with conditional certification bearing the error range and re-inspection time, but repeats the field review with each rainy season.

The current on-site decision is either full remeasurement of the reference network or approval of a conditional single formation.

/story_contents/B047/actors/0/arc/0/summ.en: Places the subsided marker and warped bronze ruler beside the compressor.

/story_contents/B047/actors/0/arc/1/summ.en: Binds the HP09 correction history and XT02 part number to the coordinate grid.

/story_contents/B047/actors/0/arc/2/summ.en: Bears one of the refrigeration costs between full remeasurement and conditional certification.

/story_contents/B047/actors/0/outcomes/0.en: Western reference network remeasured for drainage safety, refrigeration delayed.

/story_contents/B047/actors/0/outcomes/1.en: Error-disclosed conditional certification allows compressor passage, rainy-season re-review.

/story_contents/B047/actors/1/sections/정.en:
When Nam Hwigang pulls the blocking chain at Amsa East Bridge, she checks the tension and then reverses the guard-post shift board.

As one who holds both bridge blockade and sluice-gate guard for the Escort Protection State, she records the arch vibration and upstream water level before recording vehicle count.

Her field method combines the three-tier formation of the Joseon navy, the division between gate-tower and sluice shared by Goguryeo fortresses, and the load calculation of modern military engineers into one guard table.

Her official name Nam Hwigang and identifier K414 are maintained separately from the escort unit's personnel rotation.

/story_contents/B047/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
As a trainee, Nam Hwigang divided the patrol train into three sections like a fleet and assigned an independent horn to each section.

Using the inner-and-outer gate rotation method borrowed from fortress-defense organization, she ensured that the bridge deck and sluice machine room never remained empty at the same time.

She chose the shear bolts in place of the blasting cord from the modern military engineering manual, so that even when the bridge was severed, recovery traces could remain.

The idea that guarding water supply could not erase the residents' escape routes came before her own advancement.

/story_contents/B047/actors/1/sections/가.en:
The Yeongdeungpo Sluice House entrusted Nam Hwigang's outpost with one key piece of the Amsa sluice and responsibility for adjusting the water-level gauge.

He follows Han Jaemok's principle of divided storage but will not lower the bridge chain on Bae Woojin's order for total blockade alone.

The shift uses Joseon navy-style left-right sector names, posts two personnel per machine room like fortress sluice soldiers, and the military engineer squad counts bolt quantities in a separate materials table.

If there is no signature on the Sangsu Administrative Council resident evacuation table, even the escort unit vehicles stop at the inner lane.

/story_contents/B047/actors/1/sections/붕.en:
On the night a freight car with a dark load table pulled onto the East Bridge, a reverse-flow alarm sounded simultaneously from the upstream intake sluice.

Nam Hwigang drove the bridge blockade squad toward the freight car, and in the now-empty sluice-side outpost, an apprentice guard held the emergency handle by hand.

The freight car stopped, but the apprentice's fingers were caught in the gears, and eastern water supply was cut off in two districts for an hour.

Since then, she has feared most the moment when a formation blocking the outside saves one facility and isolates another.

/story_contents/B047/actors/1/sections/생.en:
The choice divides between blockading the overloaded freight car in the middle of the bridge for investigation or guiding it to the Godeok siding to restore sluice-gate guard coverage.

The published load log for XT04-SC1 has one axle weight column erased, so safety cannot be confirmed by engineering calculation alone.

On-site blockade holds the evidence and the bridge, but the sluice shift grows thin, while siding guidance restores water-supply guard but allows forged cargo to enter the eastern interior.

Nam Hwigang marks her decision with the three-section shift board of K143-TURN.

/story_contents/B047/actors/1/sections/현.en:
These days Nam Hwigang is the on-site commander of the joint shift where bridge blockade and water administration guard stand together.

If any one of the deck vibration monitor, water-level gauge, or evacuation personnel table is empty, vehicle blockade remains at the partial stage.

The military engineer squad keeps the shear bolt storage box, and the administration duty officer keeps the sluice key pieces.

She always clears one lane for pedestrian evacuation before the patrol train arrives.

/story_contents/B047/actors/1/sections/비.en:
The horn signal that the injured apprentice sent just before gripping the emergency handle was never formally recorded in Nam Hwigang's shift log.

Recording that signal would also reveal that he had reduced the sluice-side personnel below regulations.

He has never returned the horn cord to the apprentice's family, and every week he disassembles the gear cover himself.

The SECRET box opens only when Jeong Soyul's water-stoppage table and I Yunseo's blockade order copy are submitted together.

/story_contents/B047/actors/1/sections/관.en:
On the day Nam Hwigang received Bae Woojin's escort order in the field, he added one pedestrian-evacuation line beside the full-blockade text.

With I Yunseo, he measured the bridge blockade chain length while debating the boundary between command and field judgment, and with Jeong Soyul, he agreed on minimum sluice-shift personnel.

In the dawn when Ma Gilsang discovered the lower bridge crack, he sent the military engineer squad down first and delayed the patrol train departure.

Their joint guard record is bound to STORY-B047-K414.

/story_contents/B047/actors/1/sections/3.en:
In the first act, Nam Hwigang faces both the freight car with erased load and the empty sluice outpost at the same time.

The second act places the HP01 split key and XT04 load log in the three-section guard table.

The final act chooses between on-site bridge blockade and Godeok siding diversion, bearing the burden of either water supply or interior safety.

The individual narrative is STORY-B047-K414.

/story_contents/B047/actors/1/sections/분.en:
Ending α is the flow where Nam Hwigang fixes the overloaded freight car on the bridge and isolates the deck section with shear bolts.

Evidence is preserved but the sluice guard grows thin, restricting water supply to eastern two districts.

In ending β, she pulls the freight car to the Godeok siding to restore sluice shift coverage, and instead establishes a separate fortress-gate blockade line at the interior storage yard.

The intervention item is either on-site isolation investigation or blockade after siding diversion.

/story_contents/B047/actors/1/arc/0/summ.en: Faces both the freight car with missing load and the empty sluice outpost together.

/story_contents/B047/actors/1/arc/1/summ.en: Places the HP01 split key and XT04 load log on the three-section guard table.

/story_contents/B047/actors/1/arc/2/summ.en: Bears one of the water-supply costs between bridge isolation and siding diversion.

/story_contents/B047/actors/1/outcomes/0.en: Bridge on-site isolation preserves freight evidence, eastern water supply restricted.

/story_contents/B047/actors/1/outcomes/1.en: Siding diversion restores sluice guard, interior blockade line installed.

/story_contents/B047/actors/2/sections/정.en:
When the black-corrected record sheet rises onto the Seoul Station document storage drying rack, Jo Irok first examines the direction where the paper grain is broken rather than the text.

As a records notary for the Republic of Korea Government, she does not erase one of three copies when they differ in recording the same incident—instead, she stamps the difference itself.

Her notarial procedure comprises the on-site collation attitude of Joseon practical scholarship compilation, the archival practice of Goryeo officials who recovered scattered documents, and the modern preservationist's neutral paper and humidity management.

The name Jo Irok and the immutable identifier K415 remain regardless of the authenticity judgment of the document.

/story_contents/B047/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
As a records clerk, Jo Irok placed market receipts and well water-level records beside administrative statistics to verify whether the figures matched daily life.

Like the archival duty that gathered documents from many Goryeo offices, she kept separate storage boxes by source and did not exclude records that contradicted each other from collection targets.

She learned the pH measurement and low-temperature drying method of the modern preservation room, and when opening a ledger charred by fire, she recorded fiber damage before letter clarity.

The attitude of leaving verifiable blank space rather than complete chronology became her professional ambition.

/story_contents/B047/actors/2/sections/가.en:
Seoul Station Records Law House connected the original hash seal and access sequence to Jo Irok's notary station.

He follows Yeorian's sealing rules but does not judge that the circumstances of creation are also identical merely because the hash is the same.

Jo Harin's document storage holds boxes by collection source, and O Seoyul's contract window displays notarial results and counter-opinions side by side.

The community views him not as an official who writes correct answers but as a person who testifies to differences that were never erased.

/story_contents/B047/actors/2/sections/붕.en:
After the shelter fire, the three recovered family registers differed only in the arrival time of one child.

Jo Irok gave preliminary notarization to the clearest copy while drying the wet original, and that document opened rations but closed the claim from another guardian.

Later, when the erased time appeared beneath the original's fibers, the fact remained that the preliminary seal had hardened a family separation mistake.

She wrote the sentence that clear letters are not necessarily closer to truth only inside the notary station's desk drawer.

/story_contents/B047/actors/2/sections/생.en:
The issue rests between notarizing the three copies of the aid materials list in their discrepancy state or choosing one copy as the standard to open distribution immediately.

The XT05-SC2 list hash is valid throughout, but transport time and box count differ from each other.

Difference notarization preserves future verification but delays the medical box handover, while standard selection opens the warehouse but erases the rights of omitted recipients.

Jo Irok's choice remains as the three-way seal band K168-TURN.

/story_contents/B047/actors/2/sections/현.en:
When Seoul Station's treaties and succession documents arrive, Jo Irok binds the paper-condition table, source table, and content-comparison table with separate colored threads.

Records Director Yun Seorin cannot request any notarization that omits one of the three tables.

Damaged copies are not hidden beneath restoration copies but are placed on the lower stand of the same reading table.

Currently, his seal carves the range of confirmation and range of non-confirmation in larger characters than the word authentic.

/story_contents/B047/actors/2/sections/비.en:
Beneath the floorboard of the notary station lies the cancellation notice of the family register's preliminary seal that was never delivered.

Jo Irok wrote that the guardian could not be found, but he actually delayed sending because he feared the Records Office's trust would be shaken.

Because of that delay, where the separated family went remains blank in the ledger.

The SECRET disclosure is possible only when Yun Jiyul's medical-transport table and Jo Harin's humidity log point to the same date.

/story_contents/B047/actors/2/sections/관.en:
In Yun Seorin's first sixteen-flag approval rotation, Jo Irok participated in notarization only on the condition of not hiding torn edges.

With Gang Yejun, he separated the factual judgment and institutional validity judgment of succession phrases, and with O Seoyul, he preserved counter-opinions in copies of the water compact.

On the night Jo Harin moved the burned boxes to the document storage, the two unfolded the wet ledger separately on the fiber nets by source.

The terminus of relationship records is STORY-B047-K415.

/story_contents/B047/actors/2/sections/3.en:
In the introduction, Jo Irok places three lists with different receipt times and valid hash on a single reading table.

In the middle section, she separates the HP04 seal rule and XT05 handover list into source-table, condition-table, and comparison-table to verify each.

The final act's cost appears in two directions: preserving difference and delaying handover, or choosing the standard copy and damaging omitted rights.

STORY-B047-K415 is the identifier of this notarial narrative.

/story_contents/B047/actors/2/sections/분.en:
In ending α, Jo Irok notarizes the three copies' discrepancy as it is and opens the warehouse after the objection period of all recipients ends.

The medical box distribution is delayed, but the handover list remains for future verification without erased names.

In ending β, she adopts the copy with the most field signatures as the standard to distribute immediately and places the omitted claims in a separate debt ledger.

The on-site personnel choose either difference-preserving notarization or standard-copy emergency notarization.

/story_contents/B047/actors/2/arc/0/summ.en: Places three copies with different receipt times and valid hash on the reading table.

/story_contents/B047/actors/2/arc/1/summ.en: Separates HP04 seal and XT05 list into three kinds of verification tables.

/story_contents/B047/actors/2/arc/2/summ.en: Bears one of the handover costs between difference preservation and standard selection.

/story_contents/B047/actors/2/outcomes/0.en: Copy-difference notarization and objection-period guarantee, medical box handover delayed.

/story_contents/B047/actors/2/outcomes/1.en: Majority-signature standard-copy emergency notarization, omitted claims debt-ledger recorded.

/story_contents/B047/actors/3/sections/정.en:
Before the four-branch rail switch at Yongsan North Bank, Gwon Haejin counts the white armbands of the track workers before the departure bell.

As a dispatch and track mediation officer for the Line Succession State, he issues no passage table to any train if the post-council's order differs from the on-site blockade signal.

The responsibility-transfer practice of Joseon relay-station commanders, the steam-pressure and braking sense of post-opening railway engineers, and the work-stoppage procedure and shift rights of pre-collapse railway labor organizations are all mixed into his dispatch method.

The name Gwon Haejin and K416 are fixed in the public dispatch ledger, not in the lineage genealogy of the track family.

/story_contents/B047/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
As a station trainee, he directly transferred the locomotive key and operating documents to the next shift just as relay-station commanders transferred their shift boards.

He collected the work records where early-20th-century engineers identified wheel problems by sound and vibration, and attached them to the margins of the braking-distance table.

From the pre-collapse track labor organization, he learned the stoppage right: if one worker remained in the track bed, the dispatch officer also could not change signals.

His goal was to make blood-relation track families and skilled crew assume responsibility on the same ledger.

/story_contents/B047/actors/3/sections/가.en:
Yongsan Track Letter entrusts Gwon Haejin with the Yongsan column in the neutral dispatch table between Yongsan, Shinnaei, and Changdong.

He accepts Jang Sehwa's emergency-transport priority principle but prevents Park Tagyeom's post-council from covering crew rest time with freight slots.

The relay-station style transfer box holds the pass document and lodging table, the locomotive room holds pressure and braking tables, and the union wall board holds the reasons for refusing dangerous work separately.

Only when the times on all three records align can the track family also claim dispatch priority.

/story_contents/B047/actors/3/sections/붕.en:
The day when the central water-supply train and track repair car both demanded the same blockaded section, Gwon Haejin followed the coordinator's verbal order for water supply priority.

The repair crew withdrew to the siding but failed to detect the crack beneath the old switch, and one empty freight car derailed, blocking the escape route of two night workers.

He mistook the work-stoppage flag that came in just before the accident for a water-supply emergency signal.

Since then, on nights when the worker's armband and locomotive headlight overlap in the same color, he stops the departure bell by hand.

/story_contents/B047/actors/3/sections/생.en:
The division depends on whether to halt all trains at Yongsan due to the closed triple line, or send them to the Suseo alternate return siding while dispersing the track work crew.

The XT03-SC1 return slot is open, but it is a line received without the Yongsan labor union's on-site transfer, so the danger point is empty.

Full halt preserves the stoppage right but medical and water-supply freight spend the night in storage, while dispersed operations save the freight but workers must take responsibility for unfamiliar sections.

The decision table records K193-TURN together with the count of four armbands.

/story_contents/B047/actors/3/sections/현.en:
Now Gwon Haejin sits between the railroad coordinator and the track family representative, opening the work transfer box before the dispatch table.

He writes lodging space and water quantity at each station so long-haul crews are not bound to forced extended operation.

The acoustic inspection derived from steam-engine memory remains even on electric systems; when the wheel sound differs, he does not trust the automatic signal.

The work-stoppage flag is hung higher than the post-council seal.

/story_contents/B047/actors/3/sections/비.en:
On the day of the derailment accident, the original dispatch table has the time when Gwon Haejin saw the work-stoppage signal moved forward by one column.

In the investigation, he stated his memory was unclear, but he actually changed the time himself to avoid responsibility for the water-supply train delay.

Two night workers survived, but one could never stand on track again.

The SECRET box opens only when Gwon Sion's blockade log and Yeon Siwan's original ledger copy are compared.

/story_contents/B047/actors/3/sections/관.en:
In the first meeting where Park Tagyeom tried to make an adopted technician his successor, Gwon Haejin put the test as the dispatch qualification rather than blood relation.

With Gwon Sion, he operated the water-supply train priority slot, and with Song Iden, he prioritized crew rest over freight turnover while discussing the lodging table for transhipment storage.

On the night Sin Gaon demanded a family-exclusive line, he placed even Gang Daeun's locomotive under the same work-stoppage flag.

This shared history continues as the blockade record of STORY-B047-K416.

/story_contents/B047/actors/3/sections/3.en:
In act one, Gwon Haejin faces the closed triple line and the inadequate return siding before the four-branch rail switch.

Act two gathers the HP02 neutral dispatch table, XT03 alternate return slot, and the labor union's work-stoppage right into one ledger.

Act three decides which cost to bear between Yongsan full halt and track crew dispersed operation.

The narrative remains as STORY-B047-K416.

/story_contents/B047/actors/3/sections/분.en:
In ending α, Gwon Haejin halts all formations at Yongsan and maintains the stoppage right until the work crew transfers the alternate return siding through all sections.

Medical and water-supply freight is delayed but the responsibility for the unfamiliar line is disclosed.

In ending β, he dispatches two skilled workers each to the Suseo return siding to open limited operation, and bears the burden of reducing Yongsan maintenance shift by half.

The on-site decision at that time is either full work stoppage or dispersed transfer operation.

/story_contents/B047/actors/3/arc/0/summ.en: Faces the closed triple line and the alternate return siding without transfer before the rail switch.

/story_contents/B047/actors/3/arc/1/summ.en: Binds the work-stoppage right to the HP02 dispatch table and XT03 return slot.

/story_contents/B047/actors/3/arc/2/summ.en: Bears one of the shift costs between full halt and dispersed operation.

/story_contents/B047/actors/3/outcomes/0.en: Full halt until complete alternate-line transfer, medical and water supply delayed.

/story_contents/B047/actors/3/outcomes/1.en: Dispersed skilled-worker transfer for limited operation, Yongsan maintenance shift reduced.

/story_contents/B047/actors/4/sections/정.en:
Every dawn, Yun Sanho counts the stone steps in the Bukhansan corridor and ties a white cloth knot on each step missing since the day before.

As an evacuation-route guide for the Sangha Relief State, she proves her right to know the path not through passage fees but through the number of people following her.

The Joseon fortress-defense system's high-altitude shift rotation, the covert passage and communication of the righteous militia corridors, and the binding rope and casualty sorting of modern mountain rescue operations all remain together in her guidance rules.

Her name Yun Sanho and K417 are maintained in the evacuation roster even when camp locations move.

/story_contents/B047/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
As a mountain-rescue trainee, she first checked the knot count sent by the rear rescuer rather than the leader.

Taking the ridge, fortress gate, and warehouse rotation tables from fortress defense and overlaying them on modern mountain maps, she ensured no monitoring gap even in heavy rain.

What she learned from the choice of militia transit routes was not the technique of hiding path names but the principle of not gathering residences and contact points on one sheet.

Her long-term goal was to have every refugee understand their safe section without military registration.

/story_contents/B047/actors/4/sections/가.en:
Bukhansan Preservation and Return Association keeps the family-reunion roster and corridor-passage table in separate storage and gives Yun Sanho responsibility for on-site marking.

Baek On swore an oath not to use the roster as hostage, and Yun Sanho erases family names from the marking map while keeping only personnel count and movement capability.

The militia handles the fortress-style high-altitude rotation, relief organizations attach casualty-grade sorting, and mountain communities open alternate shelters.

No single one of the three organizations can own the complete corridor coordinates alone.

/story_contents/B047/actors/4/sections/붕.en:
In early winter sleet, a refugee procession fleeing military registration got bottlenecked at the Tangchundae junction.

Yun Sanho chose the valley detour to avoid patrol lights, but a frozen rope anchor point came loose and separated one family from the main group.

The rescue squad saved the injured and the militia blocked pursuit, but the separated child's name smudged on the wet temporary marker.

She learned that day that a hidden path both protects people and hides rescue signals.

/story_contents/B047/actors/4/sections/생.en:
The crisis asks whether to disclose the corridor marking to remake the damaged roster at the Imjin temporary quarantine station, or continue small-scale escorting with location hidden.

The XT01-SC1 reissue request is an opportunity to find families but public coordinates could become the pursuit route of the military-registration procession.

Disclosing the marking speeds mass evacuation and search but increases ambush risk, while non-public escorting protects the safety network but delays family reunion.

Yun Sanho marks K270-TURN with one rope knot and one blank name tag.

/story_contents/B047/actors/4/sections/현.en:
On days when the Bukhansan Preservation procession moves, Yun Sanho stands not at the front as guide but at the rear in the recovery squad.
